reviews.title: Short stay
reviews.text: This was a short stay for us 3 adults and 1 teenager. Everything was as it was described. Hotel rooms were clean with good housekeeping. Good location smooth checking and out.

reviews.title: Service above and beyond!
reviews.text: Arrived at Trump International on a Saturday night. Quickly greeted by Nick in valet who handled my valet.  Kevin was there to greet me and offer to bring my bags up to my room.  My adventure begins. I check in and was given an upgraded room on a high floor.  Passing through security on my way to room only one of the key cards worked, no problem I was going to head back down to meet a friend.  The bellman was on the elevator with me, we arrived at room and neither key card worked. He quickly called security, and they arrived immediately.  Within a couple of minutes in the room, I received a call from Nick in valet.  My rental car would not start, strange the car was a 2025.  I went downstairs to meet my friend and check on car at valet. Nick asked me to call rental car company for a tow and not to worry about the car he would handle getting it loaded when truck arrived.  If you have to have a car break down, be sure to do it at a 5* hotel where they offer to handle everything and send me on my way.  Tow truck company called upon arrival, and I couldn't help but go out to valet. Kevin who handled my bags was there and we joked about this big flat bed truck navigating valet.  I couldn't help but laugh that within 10 minutes of arriving at hotel 5-6 employees knew me by name. All through my 5 day stay they greeted me and we would joke about my car not starting. My room was very comfortable as was the bed, couch and chairs. Plenty of room in the nice size bathroom.  Housekeeping came each day and took care of room. As a woman traveling alone, I felt very safe with someone greeting me each time I arrived back at the hotel.I couldn't ask for a nicer stay.  I do have to do a shout out for Nick and Kevin who handled my car situation amazingly and greeted me each time I arrived or left the hotel.  As well as all the security people I encountered.  I will be back next time I travel to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Horrible water - all hot no cold
reviews.text: I got  3 night stay for $199, if I listened to Hilton Grand Reward Vacations time share   I said sure, never been to Vegas and took the bait. Hilton said only availability was Trump Hotel. They told us ot was a king size bed with kitchen teeth, sounded great!When we arrived they told us to room service, but if we needed something call.Room was on 34th floor and when we arrived it was a suite. Looked amazing with 2 bathrooms, 2 showers and a tub, and a full kitchen, overall we were happy and excited until...We used the water for a bath in the master bathroom in the jacuzzi tub.  It filled fine and we were enjoying it, but wanted some more cold water...there was none. Cold faucet ONLY produced HOT water. I tried, my boyfriend tried. The sink did the same.  We go to bed it was late and I use the master bath toilet in the middle of the night, weird the bowel feels hot.  Day 2 boyfriend uses shower seems fine although toilet it hot again. We gone al.ost all day a d arrive back to sleep. No shower that night.  We go to use shower on the 3rd day, scalding hot no matter what, toilet bowl hot and sink water.  Thankfully the 2nd bathroom seemed fine that was a showered only.I was thinking the pipes were just crossed and thankful for the 2nd shower. We left on the 3rd day complained and they told us they never had anyone complain about that before.  Well the whole thing really bothered me so I went online after getting home....sure enough a couple other complaints online about the SAME DAMB thing. This is a lawsuit waiting to happen.I would NEVER recommend this hotel to anyone. Yes the room looked amazing and we got a great price but at a cost. However, they have a major problem with the water.  Either all hot or all cold.

reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: 2nd stay at Trump Hotel in Vegas. Like this hotel as it's non smoking. Massive rooms. Bed & pillows really comfy. Room was cleaned daily. Good location,  just a short walk down to the main strip. Staff really friendly & helpful. Reasonable prices. Would definately stay again

reviews.title: A clean, well-lighted hotel -- with friendly service and good food
reviews.text: We expected garish decor, but this hotel is tastefully designed and decorated, with muted off-white colors in the lobby. Our room was spacious and comfortable. Staff were polite and helpful. The steakhouse restaurant, though not inexpensive, served excellent food, and the breakfast was delicious. Valet parking was efficiently run. The location across from a shopping mall is convenient. This is a well-run hotel.

reviews.title: W Trump
reviews.text: Shiny, extravagant, spotless. I’d expect nothing less from Trump. 5 star experience done in a way only Trump properties can. Honestly it’s a great spot for families because there’s no casino.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Hotel was excellent. Service was excellent. Location is an easy 30 minute walk to the Sphere. It is across from the mall.

reviews.title: Great place, location, service
reviews.text: Room service kept room clean, all the staff were very kind and helpful, spacious room near the Fashion Show Mall and the strip

reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL WITHOUT CROWD OF THE CASINOS
reviews.text: The location is excellent, the room is large and very comfortable. The pool is nice. Good service. I missed having a lounge in the lobby.

reviews.title: Just perfect!
reviews.text: The stay at the hotel was really nice! The room was clean and cozy, the staff very friendly and helpful. The location of the hotel was also perfect. Overall a very pleasant stay.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The hotel is extremely well located, has a square in front, and is walking distance from theme hotels. Very clean and luxurious. The room is large and very complete. The staff is very friendly. Breakfast at an affordable price just like the restaurant. 10/10 in security. I'd come back.

reviews.title: Room was great. Check in and Breakfast service took way too long!
reviews.text: I have stayed at this property before. I really like the fact that it doesn’t have a casino and is conveniently located. However on this visit, check-in took 45 minutes due to a long line and lack of staff. The next day I had breakfast in the lobby restaurant. Service was also painfully slow due to insufficient wait staff. On the bright side, I really enjoyed my room. The quality of the bed , pillows, linens furnishings etc was excellent.

reviews.title: Amazing Folks Representing the Brand,,,, BUT
reviews.text: The people working at this location are amazing!Valet parking is included but PLEASE TIP THEM.  They do an amazing job taking vehicle and getting it when needed.Enjoyed not having casino on the propertyTrain tracks 500 yards from the property so check your room location...  Rooms on 16th floor have the lights, illuminating the entire structure, just a few feet below the windows so have NO expectation on having a room dark at night. Could read in ours after even using hangers to fasten curtains.Elevators are amazingly fast!Small bar in lobby at night. We were literally the last customers at the pool bar for this season so you needs to walk/drive to other locations to get a drink.STILL advertised the jetted tubs have been shut off in all rooms.View on side of sphere is cool. Other side.... not so much.The folks working here are very polite and professional.HUGE mall across the street and Las Vegas Blvd isn't too far to walk.  If you want fufu coffee good luck. Nice folks at the lobby coffee bar are kind but black coffee only. and $7.50 a cup.Bring a sharp knife if you think you will need to cut something and don't count on the ice maker in the fridge working. Each floor is supposed to have an ice machine. Didn't try restaurant or room service...Would suggest that you do DO NOT OPEN door to built in combination washer/dryer. Apparently not used much and extremely funky. Apparently no rules against "hitting the hay" outside entrance so don't be surprised.Saw lots of pets which is very cool.In spite of the positive engagement with the folks, we will look for another place to stay when in town.BTW:  if traveling between Oct and Nov 2025, reconsider your plans unless you don't mind screwed up traffic and blocked streets.  Getting ready for F1 race and it's a frigging mess!!!!!

reviews.title: Nice.
reviews.text: Mixed views on this hotel. The service is definitely NOT 5 star. We had a room on the train track side and the noise from the horn of the freight train  woke us three times.  The manager David promises things and then front desk try to wriggle out of what he promised.  He’s then suddenly “not available” or “in a meeting for the rest of the morning.”  Funny that when I literally could see him at front desk two minutes later. Lying and hiding  from guests is not a good look David. Anyway that aside after delays with room change and the rudeness of front desk they did eventually comp my resort fees but I had to fight for it.  They don’t like being told when things aren’t right and accuse you of “coming at them and making them feel uncomfortable”.  Complete nonsense - I was completely polite and calm but this is their way of deflecting. The room we were moved to was better. We were not woken by train noise so make sure you ask for a room strip side.   Rooms are well appointed.  Note that they have turned off the whirlpools on the bathroom so they don’t work. Not sure why - maybe they caused problems.    Didn’t matter - the bath was huge and lovely.  The shower is a proper powerful drench shower. Really nice high end toiletries in the bathrooms. Really liked that you had a mini kitchenette with coffee machine, complementary fridge, microwave.  Beds and pillows and linen were incredibly comfortable!   It’s quite a walk to the strip but good to get your steps in!

reviews.title: Fabulous Corner Suite!
reviews.text: The room was top notch in every way. We booked a corner suite and the views from the 46th floor were fabulous! It was a surprise that we had two bathrooms. The suite was absolutely huge. Loved every minute there.It was also so nice that it didn't have a casino and was nonsmoking. After walking through a couple other Vegas hotels, we were SO happy we had decided to stay at Trump International!It should be considered a business hotel rather than a resort. The pool is pretty but basic (and was not open in the evenings when we were there). The spa was closed half the week. The restaurant was fine for breakfast, but glad we went elsewhere for dinner since it's located right in the lobby and kind of noisy.Complimentary valet parking was nice but there was quite a long wait when all the guests checked out at the same time. The valet workers were running and did a great job, but it was not a luxury experience to be waiting wihle with crowds on the curb for our vehicle to appear. If we went back to Las Vegas, we would love to stay here again.

reviews.title: Have water with you. The hikes are long and remember that Las Vegas is in a desert.
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Trump Hotel on 2 occasions and both have been very satisfactory.Compared to the other 5 stars this is a very good price being an excellent choice for value for money.There is no casino, so you will find a much more relaxed Mood. It is a discreet luxury and the reference images that are put online are very faithful to what you will find there.The staff is very friendly and willing to help you. several speak Spanish, but those who still won't find a way to give you what you need.Spacious rooms, very comfortable bed, with kitchen and refrigerator, large bathrooms with double sink and bathtub for two people. It doesn’t offer a Jacuzzi anymore, but you’ll still enjoy a nice dip after long walks on the Strip.If you get a room on high floors facing the Strip, you will have another show there. The sphere itself is one that is active 24 hours.The location is correct, 500 meters walk from the Strip and in front of the Fashion Show Mall, which is the largest in the city.It also has free Valet Parking (very comfortable).

reviews.title: Great Spot Just Off The Strip
reviews.text: Trump offers great accommodations just slightly off the strip.  Without a casino, it is nice and quiet, but the rooms have a full kitchen which is great, and the restaurant is excellent.

reviews.title: A good alternative in LV  but not 5 star
reviews.text: We have just returned from a stay at Las Vegas Trump hotel. I chose it for a number of reasons. The price was ok. It is a non casino resort and is located off the Strip but is a 5 minute walk away. Check in was smooth and the front desk.staff were friendly and helpful. We opted for a high floor ( 51 ) with a mountain view.The room itself appeared a little dated ie old tech tv and no usb sockets. On the plus side the bed was very comfy and we made use of the kitchen facilities for our breakfast requirements. We didn’t eat at the restaurant but after chatting to other guests we were told the food was good but expensive. The pool area was a lovely place to chill and not crazy  like many other LV pool areas. Located across the road from the front entrance is a decent shopping mall which was very useful.

reviews.title: Incredible hotel
reviews.text: Great Hotel.  No Complaints.  Perfect hotel, wonderfull location!  Staff was there for everything we needed.

reviews.title: Great, clean. Big poll
reviews.text: Great Service big pool, great gym.all people are nice and normal. only valet parking, sometimes long wait until you can drop the key

reviews.title: First time staying at this resort and overall experience is very good
reviews.text: Room is spacious and comfortable. Living room sofa is a bit uncomfortable. Location is not the best as it is further away from Vegas strip. Staff is friendly. I would stay here again if I want a quieter place overnight, but if I want to be clsoe to shops and entertainment I would choose another resort.

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: Amazing!Amazing!amazing!Everything was perfect:location, pool, rooms(amazing view), staff so friendly and accommodating.  The hotel is beautiful a clean, luxurious atmosphere.

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: WOW.Nothing really to say. There are all the comforts, large rooms, clean and sanitized daily, free valet Service, attentive staff to any need. Absolutely the best stay of our trip to the USA.Extra point for the fact that the hotel is has two steps from the Strip and does not have Casino inside.. which makes it quiet and even more exceptional

reviews.title: TRUMP TOWER AN AMAZING EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: Staying at Trump  Tower has always been on my bucket list.  It did not disappoint.  From the valet upon arriving to the check out process, everything was perfect.  The staff is incredible, everyone went out of their way to make our experience wonderful.I love the smoke free environment and the upscale class .  The room was amazing!!We will be back!

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and room
reviews.text: Please know that there is no maid service. They did bring fresh towels when we called, but they do not even empty the trash cans or make the beds.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort,
reviews.text: Everything is top notch. True Trump fashion. The restaurant was delicious, prices were fair ( a little pricey for breakfast ). Close enough to the strip to walk. Directly across from fashion show mall, which is huge. Plenty to do, staff couldn’t be nicer. A really great resort!

reviews.title: Perfect hotel
reviews.text: Very good hotel. Very clean with perfect service. Really close from Strip. No casino inside so quite calm inside. Recommended

reviews.title: Never forget something in your room
reviews.text: Beautiful room beautiful bedding But forget nothing I forgot my IPad and despite several calls and specifying that the app of Apple location located it in their establishment it remained untraceable

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Reasonable priceGood atmosphere and serviceRooms were cleanGood locationShopping mall right oppositeNot exactly on the Vegas strip though and no entertainment on offer

reviews.title: Not good.
reviews.text: Not as good as my last visit in 2017.    The TV was a mess - it was installed with some fancy (that means problems!) extendable arm that does not secure the TV properly, so it can rest on the base which has control buttons that are depressed or activated.  First afternoon they sent unqualified housekeeping staff come in to fix and didn't work and said they would get maintenance who didnt arrive.  Eventually he figured it out.  Secondly, the whirlpool bath (which I wanted to use) was broken.  They need to up their game for this level of Hotel.

reviews.title: Canadians first time Vegas stay
reviews.text: This hotel was the best ! So quiet st night didnt smell like an ash tray like the rest of them we walked through and no casino was amazing to keep it quiet. Best staff. We would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great hotel whilst in Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel, short walk to the wonderful Las Vegas strip. Fantastic room with more than you'll require. Lovely staff,  fantastic pool area with all facilities. Would definitely choose this hotel again for my next visit.

reviews.title: QUIET HOTEL STEPS FROM STRIP
reviews.text: To begin with this is not the typical Hotel and Casino, apparently some problem of compatibility between gambling and politics allowed Trump to build his luxury hotel but did not allow him a casino inside, therefore this is an excellent hotel without the bustle of hotels that have casino. The location is very good, almost at the end of the strip, facing the Venetian and Treasure Island. One of the amenities of this 60-story hotel is that it has at least 10 large elevators, which are divided by floor sectors. There are 3 that only go from the lobby to the 12th floor, then another 3 that go from the 13th to the 18th floor and so on. I was staying on the 58th floor so the elevators I took climbed dizzyingly to the 54th floor without stops and from there only stops on the floors to the 64th, this prevents crowding and makes you get much faster to the upper floors. The rooms are spacious and feature living and a kitchen area with stoves, fridge, coffee maker, electric kettle and microwave oven, the king beds are super comfortable and the bathroom is a luxury, with toilet and shower in separate cabinets, two pools on a large table and a jacuzzi, I stayed in room 5809 which overlooked the sphere. Complimentary bottles of water are being offered all the time and in the pool area, towels are available in bulk. It is also important to note that in the lobby we always find some employee who spoke Spanish, the wifi works wonderfully, it also has a restaurant where you can have breakfast, lunch and dinner, but this is not included in the reservation.

reviews.title: I'd come back 1000 times
reviews.text: Excellent in all respects.Enormous apartment with mini kitchen structure, wonderful bathroom with shower and bathtub.Location near Fashion Mall. Free parking!!!

reviews.title: Friendly staff, but room for improvement
reviews.text: Large, clean and quiet rooms with kitchenette, ideal for relaxing away from the casino noise. Friendly staff and good Price quality ratio convince. Slightly off the Strip, with sometimes long waits at the valet and occasionally inconsistent cleaning.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel, highly recommend
reviews.text: Hotel without casino, which to me is positive, safe, beautiful, fast and free maneuvering Service, impeccable room, clean every day, if you need any kitchen items, just request by phone that deliver in the room quickly.   Near the Strip, it's away from the mess, with an excellent shopping front.    I recommend!

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: Very quality hotel in Las Vegas. Nothing wrong. Everything is perfect! And sometimes the prices are almost the same as those of other less rated hotels!

reviews.title: Good location, great value
reviews.text: Used points to get a great room.  Location was more convenient than we expected.  Walked back from concert at the sphere that wasn’t bad at all.  Very close to Wynn, Encore and Venetian.

reviews.title: Love this hotel
reviews.text: great experience!  very big room, perfectly designed and very restful.   Staff was very friendly and they made us feel like we were welcome

reviews.title: good experience
reviews.text: excellent location, friendly and attentive staff and unbeatable room. Very nice stay I recommend it 100%

reviews.title: Gteat location and food.
reviews.text: Off the strip but very neat to it, which was very nice as it was quieter and less foot traffic. Beautiful property and services were as advertised and worth every penny. Can't wait to return..

reviews.title: We Loved Our Stay!
reviews.text: We LOVED our suite and the housekeeping services were very efficient! Our front desk clerk (Ms. Yazzy) was very friendly and welcoming as well!!!However, you'll need patience with the valet services...

reviews.title: Elegance in Vegas
reviews.text: Elegance in Vegas I think that the place was surprisingly awesome. I would go back here again. I liked the fact there was no resort fee and no cost to park

reviews.title: Excellent hotel with great amenities
reviews.text: Recently stayed at the Trump International Hotel in August 2025. The weather was great and not too extreme (hot) as expected. It actually rained on a couple of days we were here. The hotel was an excellent pick as it was located very close to the Fashion Outlet Mall, within walking distance. Access the strip was very easy as well . The rooms at the hotel were very clean and spacious. I was located on the 29th floor and an excellent view of the Sphere and the Venetian hotel. There weren't any issues with the house keeping which showed up on the 5th days we were here. I would definately stay at this hotel again.

reviews.title: Three Stars masked in High Profile Brand
reviews.text: Pool was murky and way too warm. Room looked like a Hampton Inn- not cleaned to five star standards.  It's embarrassing to see his name on the top of something so awfully average. Really wanted to love it, but the view of Vegas's slums, porn industry and dispensaries didn't do it for us. I can only imagine the folk leaving a five star review have never actually been to a five star hotel in Vegas.

reviews.title: Trump Hotel
reviews.text: The Trump hotel is an absolute peak of comfort and luxury. The whole visit there, even though short, was pleasant, comfortable and unforgettable. The views from the rooms are definitely one of the best in Las Vegas and the beds are highest quality. One of the most impressive things in the hotel is definitely the restaurant, looks terrific and the food is great as well.

reviews.title: A dream night
reviews.text: Returning from Page with 5 hours of travel I had booked a top hotel for the last night in Las VegasI found a fabulous room with a huge whirlpool shower room spacious scrambled room, very kind staff we were received by a very friendly manager. My daughter particularly enjoyed the pool. Everything runs like a perfect machine: Congratulations everyone!

reviews.title: Great Location and Bright comfortable stay
reviews.text: A great location with easy access to Vegas Strip and a stone throw away from a nice fashion mall.  Spacious rooms, full kitchen and a very clean pool.  I would highly recommend the hotel.

reviews.title: Decent - but bit of a walk to strip
reviews.text: Very well facilitated gymNo cutlery in the room.Breakfast Room service was very quick  - delivered within 5mins of ordering. A little far from the strip if it’s hot.Can hear the train through the night that is located nearby.Strip facing room which had excellent views.  Pool area was easy to get a sunbed. Pool towels provided. Water station at the pool area for nice chilled water.

reviews.title: Trump Las Vegas: More Carnival Cruise Than Luxury Hotel
reviews.text: Let me begin by saying that as a proud Trump Card member, I actively seek opportunities to stay at Trump hotels and have always been treated exceptionally well, until this trip. On this trip, I booked two rooms and traveled with friends to celebrate my wife’s recent retirement, selecting Trump Las Vegas specifically because of the high standards we’ve experienced at other Trump properties. Sadly, this stay fell far short. We arrived at 2 PM to find the valet and drive-in area completely jammed. It took 10–15 minutes just to drop off our car, and we were told it was due to understaffing. Thankfully, the bellman was excellent, he took our luggage promptly and met us at our room as promised. Check-in was smooth, and the young woman assisting us kindly arranged a suite upgrade for only $50 more per night. The room itself was beautiful, with a fantastic view.Unfortunately, the atmosphere quickly soured. Each day felt busier than the last, and the clientele became increasingly loud and boisterous to the point it felt more like a Carnival cruise than a luxury hotel. This is not the refined environment we’ve experienced at other Trump properties.The valet situation was especially frustrating. We were told we could not call ahead for our car, and the “summon” feature in the app had been disabled, again, due to understaffing. Each time, we waited nearly 20 minutes for our vehicle. Completely unacceptable for a property of this caliber.While I look forward to visiting other Trump hotels in the future, I will not return to the Las Vegas location. I could have received better service at the Wynn, Four Seasons, or other nearby high-end hotels. I have always said that although I don’t have a billion dollars, Trump hotels make me feel as though I do. I sincerely hope that remains true at other locations, because it was not the case here.

reviews.title: Best in town
reviews.text: Great hotel, service and facilities. Not your typical casino circus hotel. Free parking which is rare enough to be mentioned. Next to a modern mall with a (real) pool and gym.

reviews.title: Review for Trump International Las Vegas – Pool Team & Lifeguard Liv Bawek
reviews.text: Review for Trump International Las Vegas – Pool Team & Lifeguard Liv BawekMy wife and I always enjoy our time at the Trump International pool, and it’s because the team here is truly exceptional. Every staff member is warm, friendly, and engaging—always greeting guests with a genuine smile and making everyone feel welcome.One lifeguard in particular, Liv Bawek, stands out. Liv’s kindness, attentiveness, and professionalism are remarkable. She goes out of her way to ensure guests are comfortable and cared for, and her thoughtful, friendly nature makes a lasting impression. Trump Hotel should never let her go—she is an asset to the team and to the guest experience.It’s rare to find such consistently outstanding service, and Liv exemplifies it perfectly. We look forward to seeing her and the rest of the wonderful pool team on every visit.

reviews.title: Elegant setting, attentive Service
reviews.text: The property is very elegant and the atmosphere more refined than other facilities in Las Vegas, the attention to guests is in line with the category. The rooms are very spacious and clean, the huge bathrooms with fine finishes even if today can be considered a bit 'dated. The hotel is not located on the Strip but still remains in a good location. The Sphere was clearly visible from the room.

reviews.title: You need to read this
reviews.text: The stay started out amazing in the beginning… last day was horrible. I saw the true colors of the staff. The manager was snobby and did not seem interested in what I had to say about the issues I had and did not have a desire to provide a complimentary service. I had to ask for free meal and he seemed hesitant to even provide that. I was in one room on the 32nd floor and the washer broke down leaving my clothes soaking wet so they moved us to another room same floor where we waited hours for an engineer to show up to unlock the door to access this washer and dryer ( I’m currently still waiting for the engineer to come, keep in mind this is my last day here all my plans are ruined I had reservations for area 15 and my flight is at 9) they do not care to assist you it’s like pulling teeth. Hopefully they keep in mind not everyone is snobby and just wants some assistance. I am not disrespectful but when someone or in this case many of the stay are disrespectful I return the disrespect. DO NOT STAY HERE THEY NEED A CHANGE starting from the manager.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT RESORT, LOCATION, AMENITIES AND SERVICE
reviews.text: I reserved in this resort for the rating...and it eas true. It is excellent! The good conditions of the resort. Location, Amenities, the big and comfortable room mates my holidays awesome. The pool is big, even though some days was closed for cleaning issues the ither datos we enjoyed it too much  Personal in the pool was very kind. I asked for a strip view room and also you gave it to me. All the People were very kind and helpful. On my next trip I will choose you again. Thank for made my holidays very special.

reviews.title: Awful Stay!
reviews.text: Awful Service! No Customer care or help in anyway! Terrible experience!!Parking was not good Towels were cheap and showed over useThe mattress were Not comfortable Definitely DoNot Stay here There is like No one working can’t find a housekeeper for extra pillow One of the worst stays ever!!

We stayed at a unit managed by VRBO. It was terrible. The carpet, the furniture is dated and so dirty that you don't want to sit on. The mattress caused my husband a backache the next day. it is simply old and dirty.The building is nice though a bit dated. The marble bathroom has Italian marble and big but not clean. You can see it used to be beautiful once upon a time.

reviews.title: Terrible service and a waste of money.  I won’t be back.
reviews.text: This hotel has no food service or room service upstairs. The swimming pool closes at 8 PM. Valet is mandatory and it’s slow as hell and the pool is really small and not much to it. I’m never staying here again.  We’ve been waiting for our Valet car for over 30 minutes now and you can’t even call from upstairs to get them to pull the car up for you. Just ridiculous Service..

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Check in was a nightmare. All I asked was a hipper floor facing the strip if it is available and possible. I was told yes but to wait a bit. We did not mind waiting, however if they have changed their minds, they should have let us know instead of telling us up till 4:30 pm from 8:30am that the room is not ready. Everyone we tried approaching them on the front desk, they all just walk away. We eventually requested for any room even if it is located close to the toilet. Magically, a room became available, it was around 4:30 pm. They were saying we are Hilton guest therefore check goes from 4 pm all the way to midnight. We never asked for any preferential treatment. We just needed someone to be honest and tell us from the beginning that upper floor facing the strip cannot be reserved for us and we will wait till whenever they decide to check us in. It was my third time in this hotel and check in has always been a breeze and they were always kind. This time this was not the case. Anyway, I will definitely stay again.
We walked from the Fashion Show shopping mall by the Strip. We found the hotel beautiful with an understated elegance. Restaurant/bar was simple yet elegant.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel from 8 to 12 July. Even before our accommodation we had a bad assistance, we contacted them to ask if it was possible to bring forward the departure by a day but they never responded, either by e-mail or by chat integrated with the platform on which we ordered.Upon our arrival we noticed that the refrigerator inside our room froze food, we contacted them to ask for support but we were only granted it after 2 hours.On July 11th we asked the Hotel staff if it was possible to clean our room while we went to the pool. On our return the room had been cleaned but there was missing an envelope in the bathroom that contained our dirty clothes. We immediately went to the Reception where, however, we did not receive the necessary assistance. Mr. and Mrs. Fernando Oliva (assistant front Office manager), April Jackson and the person in charge of security promised us that they would solve the problem even remotely promising us the discovery of the envelope or the refund of the value of the clothes that amounted to about 500 euros as, as we listed, it contained the change for 4 days of 4 people and all branded.We left with these promises and when we returned to Italy no one was heard from, we sent several emails to which we received only two replies, the first where they claimed that they were still carrying out checks, the second, today, where they wrote that it is not their responsibility as nothing can be seen on the cameras and they did not find their clothes. I state that to clean the rooms they enter with cleaning carts in the rooms where there are no cameras! Luckily we had stored the valuables such as watches, money and documents inside the safe.So, not only have we been made fun of but we will never get our clothes back and we will never get a refund to buy them back! I recommend the Trump for the cleanliness and beauty of the structure but be careful, any person you meet who works in this Hotel will never be able to solve problems of any nature!

reviews.title: Great Hotel, But Parking Needs Serious Improvement
reviews.text: This is the first time I’m not giving this hotel a 5-star rating. The room was super clean and spacious as always, and the staff were great — no complaints there. I've stayed here many times and usually take an Uber, but this time I rented a car and ran into a major issue: parking.The hotel only offers valet parking, which is complimentary — a nice perk — but it quickly becomes a problem during busy times. At checkout, everyone is leaving around the same time, and the valet service gets overwhelmed. It took over 30 minutes to get my car, and there’s just not enough space for all the vehicles to come through efficiently.The valet staff are clearly working hard, but the system itself isn’t working. The hotel really needs a better solution for handling parking, especially during peak checkout times.

reviews.title: Trump delivers again
reviews.text: This was so wonderful!!  We had so much fun. The beds are so comfy and we especially like not having a casino to get lost in. They need to redo the poo area. Very hot surface and need ambiance

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: The staff were quite nice and accommodating was good and the pool is good!!!!!!!!👍 😏😏😏😏😏😏😏😏😏😏✌️✌️✌️✌️✌️✌️✌️✌️

reviews.title: Beautiful Property
reviews.text: The room was very spacious, bedding was comfortable and everything on the property was very clean. You can't walk ten feet thru the lobby without encountering an employee eager to help you should you need. The DJT restaurant has an outstanding staff, food is average. The front desk personnel are very eager to help with any questions or concerns you may have. The valets might quite possibly be the hardest workers in the place, since there isn't a self park option (valet is free) you are at their mercy to get your vehicle and that can take a bit during their peak hours but they are obviously working their tails off so its hard to get frustrated by a 15-20 minute wait...just plan for it.

reviews.title: Diamond in the Ruff
reviews.text: This was my very first time being in Vegas and I thought I by me choosing to stay here would have been the least of my worries. I won't trash this hotels name or value.i mean the rooms are beautiful ...But if it had not been for Fernando and the other guy management, my stay would have been terrible. So thank you Mr Fernando for making my stay as comfortable as possible...  I will never forget your kindness and patience... I won't be back there but if and when I do come back I will stop by and say hi...

reviews.title: Great location.  Clean, quiet & smoke-free.  Great bar.
reviews.text: This hotel is conveniently located just off the Strip with a short walk to the casinos and the main hub of Las Vegas.  As it's a hotel not a casino, it was not super crowded and there was no smoke, so this was a huge bonus for us.  When we arrived, we were offered a room on the floor of our choice and we chose 54, so the view was amazing.  Our room was big, with a small kitchenette (including microwave) and a huge bathroom.  We really appreciated the bar and the restaurant downstairs and enjoyed a meal and a few drinks sitting at the bar, being served by a first-class bar tender.  We were able to take our leftover dinner to the room and heat it up for lunch the next day.In terms of things that could have been improved - the shower temperature was not hot enough, in our opinion, and it took 5 minutes of running the shower for the warm water to come through.  No tea was provided in the room, so we bought a tea & coffee in the hotel which was super expensive (US$15).  We brought wine glasses up from the bar and they were not removed by housekeeping when the room was cleaned so these sat on the kitchenette counter until we left.  That said, these were minor annoyances, and we would likely stay here again if we returned to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Top notch stay.
reviews.text: Top of the line service!! Upon arrival I tried to grab my bag out of the trunk but a bell hop was immediately by my side saying he would be taking everything upstairs to our room and that all cars receive valet parking. Everything was immaculate and the stuff was unbelievably organized.  This was such a top notch experience for all of us.  The pool was clean and pool staff were vigilant and friendly. Definitely recommend this smoke free and safe resort.

reviews.title: The trump hotel
reviews.text: The Trump Hotel is a lovely hotel, clean and friendly. Our hotel room was clean and tidy and cleaned and restocked everyday of pur trip. There is a restaurant and in the morning there is a smaller takeaway area for breakfast items which was a takeaway service, it was quite expensive but the food was goodWe were disappointed to not be able to sit at the bar and enjoy a drink as this is apparently not on option. We ended up going to a bar around the corner, which we would highly recommend called The Happy Camper.The concierge was good and they offered transport services if they weren't overwhelmed with other jobs. The trump hotel is one of the only hotels without a casino, which was a nice touch for us.

reviews.title: AMAZING…BEAUTIFUL AND ROYAL STAFF
reviews.text: Beautiful Luxury Hotel with a Phenomenal Staff… it the Staff that creates the Magic at a Hotel and the Trump Staff exceeds expectations and goes the extra distance with smiles, respect and sweet personalities. From the helpful friendly Valet when you arrive to helpful kind bellman and front desk staff(everyone smiles and are very caring). The restaurant food was delicious and their servers, support staff, Hostesses, managers and bartenders were giving Royal Service with Grace and Friendliness. I learned why the staff are so incredible…it’s the Management. They lead with Professionalism, Kindness and Caring for guests and Staff alike. From Fernando O (front office asst mngr and David Lee ( Front office mngr) to the Best General Manager in Las Vegas(Mr Ryan M. and a Giant of a Leader ( Director Brian B.). They are Titans in the Hospitality business known for putting guests first and I was so pleased to meet both of these Gentlemen. All these managers are the reason it’s the Best run Hotel in Las Vegas. Thank you Gentlemen for making our stays always AMAZING❤️🙏

reviews.title: Worth it!
reviews.text: Stayed 3 nights in late April. Check in, DJT and pool fabulous. Miguel at the desk was very helpful. Ernest was great at the pool and for breakfast. DJT was good for any meal. The pool was great and Calen was very helpful

reviews.title: Elegance and tranquility just steps from the Strip
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas and the experience was overall very positive. The structure stands out for elegance and tranquility: a well-kept, orderly and, above all, quiet environment. It is ideal for those who want to rest away from the noise and chaos of the Strip, while remaining minutes from everything.The rooms are spacious and bright, with large windows overlooking the city. The interior layout, although in part it seems adapted – some elements of the furniture show a certain modularity – still remains pleasant and well finished. The style is sober, functional, but with a touch of class.The bathroom is one of the highlights: spacious, finished in marble, equipped with a comfortable whirlpool bath, a spacious shower and a double sink with golden mirror. A really comfortable environment, designed for relaxation.The common areas are also well-kept and welcoming. The staff is friendly, helpful, and the lobby atmosphere is elegant and relaxed.However, there is a significant flaw: the hotel bar closes at 10pm. In a city like Las Vegas, where nightlife is an integral part of the experience, being back and not being able to order even a drink was a pretty disappointing limit. A detail that, for a hotel of this level, weighs more than you might think.

reviews.title: Great stay in a great location
reviews.text: Trump Towers offers a clean, stylish, and relaxing stay. The rooms are fantastic — spacious, comfortable, and well-appointed. Service throughout the hotel was excellent, and the food was very good.The bar service was a little slow at times, but the overall experience more than made up for it. The location is excellent, and the lack of a casino gives the hotel a more peaceful, laid-back feel compared to others in the area.The pool and gym facilities are also very good. A great choice if you’re looking for a more relaxed luxury stay.

reviews.title: Luxury and Comfort at Trump's Hotel in LV 💸
reviews.text: My family and I booked an apartment at Trump's Las Vegas for one week: One of the best experiences ever made! Perfect location in the heart of LV, great views and a fantastic pool awaits you. Recommended for families before the hot summer days. 😎

reviews.title: Unbelievably Bad Experience
reviews.text: Wow, my wife and I just had an unbelievably bad experience at Trump International Hotel. We booked our hotel room one month in advance excited for our first experience at Trump's hotel. Our flight got in around 8 p.m. and we arrived to the hotel at around 9:00 p.m. As we got in the "check-in" line, we noticed that the people at the check-in counters we having a hard time checking in.When it was our turn to check-in, we approached the counter and Desiree greeted us. Initially it sounded promising, but within a minute Desiree let us know that our "room was not available" and that there was no definitive time frame for when it would be available. After asking her what was going on, she said that while our check in time is 3:00 p.m. that does not ensure that a room will be available to us (even though it was 9:45 p.m. at this point). She then told us sarcastically that she could cancel our room at no charge and that we could go find somewhere else to stay if we like. After asking what was going on and when our room would be ready, Desiree became upset and called security over.We asked to speak to a manager - Fernando - who was already speaking to another couple who was going through the same experience. When he came to us he let us know that the rooms were not available and that they may not be ready until after midnight. In fact, other people had been waiting over 5 hours for their rooms. Fernando then explained that Korean Air had a conference there and had done an ultra late checkout on a lot of its rooms and that the contract with Korean Air was more important to the Hotel than any of the customers that were now without a room. When pressing Fernando on how that was possible, it became evident that despite knowing about this request for late checkout by Korean Air personnel in advance, Trump Hotel and its staff did nothing to notify any of its impacted incoming guests that their rooms would not be available for them to stay in and that they would not be doing anything to try to help their guests. So, were were told we were guest number 15 in line to get a room with no rooms currently available.To add insult to injury, there was no effort to apologize or to make things right except for a $50 food voucher. The approach to the situation was abysmal leaving many people without anywhere to stay late at night despite having reservations. And they didn't really care.I was looking forward to supporting a DJT establishment, but this was worse than bad.

reviews.title: In decline, but decent as a business traveler
reviews.text: This is my go-to hotel in Las Vegas, but it's clearly suffering -- room rates during the week and weekend are pretty low, staffing levels are far below what they'd normally be (thus long waits for various things), and rooms have been put on a program of managed decline -- the "jacuzzi tubs" are being turned into "soaking tubs" by no longer maintaining them when they break, other maintenance is being rationed, etc.The hotel still has a lot of good things about it -- being a non-casino hotel, it's a lot less annoying as a guest, and the rooms are basically condo/apartments (especially the suites) with a great refrigerator, microwave, oven/stove, and dishwasher.  However, the cutbacks over the years, and the areas where the property has always been weak (Food and Beverage, especially) make it not a particularly "fun" place.  It's good as a business traveler and someone with a car, especially if you're going to conferences at nearby properties/convention centers, but it's not really a place I'd go for the "Vegas Experience".

reviews.title: Excellent Quiet Vacation
reviews.text: The many associates were very professional. They assisted even with my wheelchair and made sure we were guided in safely. The building was beautiful, inside and out.  Housekeeping was superior to many hotels we have visited. The one maid for our room was very kind as well as quick with the work. The room was kept superbly clean. Loved the wheelchair accessible bathroom.  So very quiet we were able to truly rest very well. Bed was excellent. Loved the recessed alcove greatly dampening any walking traffic in the hall. The only fly in the ointment, as it were, was the registration system is bugged. Efforts to register for a party of two (military couple) kept glitching, three times, to show only one person.  Hence the room was set for only one.  The housekeeping staff very quickly restocked our room for two people.  Other than that, I would recommend Trump International L. V.

reviews.title: Deposits
reviews.text: The hotel itself was amazing however, we were misled with poor communication from staff. When we got to the hotel, we had 3 rooms under a booking and paid 500$ deposit on each room. We was told that money we spent in the restaurant would be redeemable against all three rooms and we would only need to give one room number rather than spread it out across the three to make things easier. When we checked out, we were told as all the money was on one room that the money over the 500$ had to be paid extra rather than redeemed across the three rooms. This left us short of money in our accounts as the 1000$ deposit from the other two rooms was not back in our account for several days. I would have understood this policy however the fact we was told one thing to ‘make things easier’ and then when it came to it be misled was very disappoint. Whilst staff remained professional whist dealing with the issue, I can’t say they were too helpful about it.

reviews.title: One week stay
reviews.text: We love that it’s clean and quiet. A place to rest and recover from the busyness of the strip. Love the non smoking policy… love the gym and pool.. truly classy and elegant 🥰

reviews.title: elegant and quiet place
reviews.text: Nordstrom (mall) closer. Valet parking excellent service.  Trasportation free in luxury SUV Cadillac Escalade.

reviews.title: Great experience!!
reviews.text: My wife and I usually stay over at the Bellagio and while it is a very lovely hotel it was booked up on the day we needed to stay there, so we decided to give the Trump International Hotel a try and we were very happy with our choice. The DJT restaurant is absolutely stellar. We tried numerous things on the menu, but I must say that the Filet mignon is an absolute must do. We stayed on the 54Th floor with a strip view. We’ve stayed in many beautiful hotels in Vegas over the years, but none with a more beautiful view. The room was gorgeous in every aspect. There was a lot of attention to detail when this hotel was built and it really shows. Subzero refrigerator, a small stove top and kitchen sink were in the room all of the cabinets were self closing and the Bathroom was exquisitely decorated. I was impressed that although we were on the 54Th floor the water pressure was really good. The bed was very comfortable and we were able to get a good nights sleep. The hotel doesn’t have a casino in it but this actually has an advantage to it the check in and out is very easy because you don’t find yourself trucking through a mile of slot machines before you can get to the front desk and it’s just as easy to get to your room without walking another mile through large crowds of people. The bottom line is if you’re looking to stay in a luxury hotel with friendly staff and fair prices this is the perfect place to stay.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: I had a very worthwhile experience here. Although there were very few Koreans, I felt the class and respect for the country. The staff were very friendly and the service skills were the best. The staff were very friendly and the service skills were the best.

reviews.title: AWESOME ACCOMMODATIONS, NEED FIRMER BEDS!
reviews.text: Elegant suite. Spacious, bath n a half! Excellent accommodations, view and service.Our floors were OWNED by Hilton Hotels. There was a second couple with us. We were Hilton travelers, directed to Trump Hotel as Hilton had NO suites available. We wanted suites!  WE LOVED IT!One Problem- Mattress was SOFT! Our backs HURT! I slept on the sectional  sofa in the living area. No real rest for the 4 day stay. To have such GREAT amenities and not able to rest well..NOT!😪PLEASE get some decent, firm mattresses on those beds. I'd like to return THEN.Thank you for a great trip. We plan to return.

reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.text: Booked this hotel although it is not in LV strip. Room is having kitchen like space with microwave and sink. Utensils are not provided but it is sent to us after we called attache services.Bathroom is large with separate shower, bath tub and toilet. Bath tub with jet but didn't work, only until we soaked in a while, it suddenly turned on by itself. Gym room is big. Although I didn't get the chance  to use it but it is the reason we booked this hotel as it has 24-hour gym facility.Just a bit surprised that i heard quite clearly a train passed by from my 59th floor room at 11.36 night.Checked out is fast n easy through our in-room TV with all the charges. Receipt is sent to our email.

reviews.title: Disappointing Experience and No Response from Management
reviews.text: I recently stayed at Trump International Hotel Las Vegas (April 23–27, 2025), expecting a high standard of service. Unfortunately, our stay was marred by a series of issues:1. The jacuzzi was cold and unusable, with staff unable to resolve the problem even after another guest had already reported it and we waited an hour.2. Maintenance issues in our room (broken shower head, non-working drain stopper) were fixed, but housekeeping failed to service the room-no fresh towels or cleaning.3. Our Uber was unable to drop us at the entrance due to parking mismanagement, forcing my elderly mother to walk from the street.4. The master bathroom’s jetted tub-a selling point for booking-was inoperable, and only after purchasing bath supplies did we learn all jets are permanently disabled, with no prior disclosure.5. The shower in the second bedroom flooded. While maintenance responded quickly, our request for a one-hour late checkout to accommodate the disruption was denied, leaving us scrambling to leave on time.While some staff responded promptly to individual problems, the overall experience was a cascade of inconveniences, poor communication, and inflexibility. Most frustrating: after reaching out directly to management with these concerns, I have received no response or acknowledgment to date.Given the Trump brand’s reputation, this was a disappointing and stressful stay. Based on my experience and the lack of follow-up, I cannot recommend this property.My  review seems to be consistent with other guest complaints about unresolved issues and lack of communication from management at this property. :(

reviews.title: One word is insane!!!
reviews.text: We booked 5 rooms, and when I arrived at 16:30, they said the hotel was overbooked and the rooms would be delivered later. We thought you should upgrade at least one room to get one right away, and they had a staff who couldn’t even imagine it. We paid for this upgrade and just received one room. When I arrived around 8:30, they said that 1 room was more ready, but they couldn’t offer the other 3 rooms. An ignorant and relationship management zero night manager explained the situation and apologized that they would refund the nightly rate for these 3 rooms. 3. Have paid a Reservation to them We said this refund from party properties was unlikely and was not processed in the last w0 days. We didn’t have such a request from them yet, so we told them to give them the room. Said it would be ready at Q1 at night, uh, we went because we had it. When we arrived at 12 a.m., the rooms still weren’t available, and these 3 people were given a suit room at our request. This suite room didn’t make us happy, but there was nothing to do due to jetlag, so we had to stay in one room instead of 3 different rooms. Their staff is incredibly rude and ignorant. I’ll never even stand by trump hotel chains again.

reviews.title: LUXURY ACCESSIBLE WITH PERFECT LOCATION
reviews.text: Hotel level!Great location 5 minutes walk from the Strip, but away from noise and chaos.The gigantic room overlooking the sphere and the skyline.Extreme cleaning of both the room and the common areas.Free parking with attendants in front of the reception who pick up and return cars as needed (subject to a non-mandatory tip of even $ 1 / 2 )Impeccable facilities, beautiful reception and relaxed / very luxurious atmosphere.Excellent value for money taking into account that it is a 5 star with all suites (price considerably lower than hotels on the strip)

reviews.title: Fabulous Hotel Stay & Housekeeping Service
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel. Our housekeeping lady, Yattou who services our room when we are there is amazing. She cares so much about doing a good job and making our room perfect I have to say wow. Trump should never let her go, she is special. Always when we are staying at Trump International we request only Yattou to clean our room. Truly excellent service.

reviews.title: Pleasant Stay in Sin City
reviews.text: Loved this hotel.  Very close to the Fashion Mall.  This hotel has high quality finishes, a great restaurant, no casino to minimize noise and excellent location to the strip.  We definitely will be staying here again.  Highly recommend this hotel for any occasion.

reviews.title: mentaince not done for room be be rented
reviews.text: We checked into Room 5711 for a two-night stay. The next morning, I attempted to use the jacuzzi tub but found it wasn’t working. I contacted the front desk and was informed that the hotel had changed its amenities and the tub was no longer a functioning jacuzzi—it's now considered a "soaking tub." This change was not communicated at the time of booking, which was misleading and disappointing.On the second night, around 9 PM, the cold water supply suddenly stopped while my sister was in the shower. Her hair was shampooed and her body was fully wet when only scalding hot water remained. She had to jump out of the shower immediately, and her skin turned visibly red from the heat. It took her 10–15 minutes of applying ice packs to cool down.Even after 30 minutes, when the technician (Gilbert) arrived and ran the water, the cold supply had not returned. We were later told that some type of maintenance or repair was being performed. However, there was no advance warning about a cold water shutdown, which is completely unacceptable—especially in a hotel that advertises five-star service.I reported the incident to the manager on duty, Steven, who asked if I wanted to file a report with the security department. By that time, it was close to 11 PM, we had early plans the next morning, and my sister’s skin had stabilized, so we chose not to escalate further that night.This was, without a doubt, one of the most disappointing hotel experiences I've ever had. I hope management will take this incident seriously and implement better communication and safety protocols for future guests.

reviews.title: This Hilton timeshare was fab!
reviews.text: Luckily got a deal and would happily stay here again.  The only thing that made me nervous was the constant police presence.  All fees included so not nickeled and dimed.

reviews.title: Lovely Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The Trump was a beautiful place to escape in Vegas. The staff were all exceptional. Our view of the Sphere was spectacular. The restaurant and bar were very good. We were disappointed in the pool and hot tub. Thus the four star review rather than a five star review.

reviews.title: The best hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Trump Hotel Las vegas is definitely the best option to stay if you want a high-end hotel and with the peace of mind that gives you no casino.This hotel is wonderful, located in what for me is the best area, opposite has a wonderful shopping , this hotel is meters from the strip without being on this which avoids you noise and see the worst of Vegas at night. The hotel itself is beautiful, reception, restaurant, floors, has a beautiful pool and excellent gym.In the mornings you have the option to buy your breakfast on the ground floor near the reception before entering the elevators.In my case I bought a deluxe room with a view of the city , what a wonderful room, spacious beautiful, comfortable and with a view that took your breath away on a 46th floor, had a kitchen, microwave and refrigerator, we ordered the utensils to be able to breakfast in the room as they give you an exquisite complimentary coffee.The hotel has free parking.It is certainly the best hotel in Las Vegas and my only choice when I return to this city.

reviews.title: RCI Hilton Timeshare at Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: Overall average.  A lot of room for improvement.  Items are given as requested in very small amounts.  Housekeeping is very slow to bring the requested items.  Sometimes I have to ask for it twice or 3 times to have items delivered to my room.

reviews.title: Bogus charge st trump international hotel spa
reviews.text: Very disappointed.   The spa charged me 200 dollars for a spa treatment I did not book.   The hotel manager, Roger, told me it was a mistake and took off bill.   I checked out on January 30 and paid bill of 83.41 dollars.   When arrived home I found the hotel charged my Amex card 200 dollars.   I’m 82 years old and cannot afford this bogus charge.  Please never stay there.  Sandra

reviews.title: Security Deposit Not Refunded - Disappointing Service
reviews.text: Extremely disappointing experience at Trump International Las Vegas. The security deposit of over $500 was not refunded after check-out. Despite multiple emails over the past 3 months, I've received no response from the hotel and still no refund. The service is unacceptable and completely fails to meet even basic customer service standards. Potential guests should be wary of this practice.

reviews.title: A Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: We loved the Trump Hotel.  The location is the best as it is not on the busy loud strip but just barely a block off the strip, easy walking distance to the Sphere. Also, just right across the street is the indoor mall. The rooms were updated, nice and clean. The room service was excellent.  The staff was super friendly.  We can't wait to stay here again.

reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.text: The trip was all around amazing the staff was great always willing to help with the quickest way possible wouldn't take a trip no other way or wouldn't never go thru anyone else or any other trip advisor me or my friends will always go together.

reviews.title: Great stay at Trump Hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel! The beds were comfortable, the place was extremely clean, bathrooms are beautiful, the toiletries were top-notch. The Bartenders were great, selections were great, breakfast was incredible. I would warn you that getting the adult size pancakes, unless you have a giant appetite, they are as big as frisbees. Class all the way.

reviews.title: Thanks a ride without a casino - a perfect vacation
reviews.text: For the third time in the hotel of the ride ..the hotel is magnificent levels over +++ all in goldEnormous rooms with 3 shower rooms and huge jacuzzi bathrooms and panoramic viewsThe team's service is amazing.I love not having a casino.Besides the kitchen with a huge microwave refrigerator, a dishwasher and more...The restaurant is very good. Everything is clean.Thank you and hopefully I will be back soon.

reviews.title: No better place in Vegas!!
reviews.text: Staying at Trump International this past week has ruined me from ever wanting to ever stay anywhere else in Las Vegas, and in fact, has me wanting to come back to Vegas specifically so I can stay here again! The hotel is absolutely THE BEST from the time you pull up in front of it — every aspect of the hotel is just luxurious. I’ve never stayed in as nice a hotel room — it was so spacious with huge windows, and I had the most incredible views!! I could go on and on about how beautiful the hotel was, but that’s not what I loved about it. The most incredible thing about Trump International Hotel is that you’ll experience the friendliest vibe among staff and guests. They were kind and courteous and happy and friendly, and treated us as though we were family who they were so excited to host. It was just a very down to earth vibe that made us feel so welcome!! I wish I could give a shout out to specific staff members, but honestly, I don’t know how I would pick them out because it was an across the board stellar staff — they seemed truly happy that we were their guests and treated us as such. Although this is a five star luxury hotel, there was not the stuffiness that sometimes goes along with such a luxurious place. I’ve stayed at five star hotels where I felt like I didn’t measure up to the level of clientele they wanted, and felt a little out of place. You won’t feel that at all at Trump international. They honestly seemed like they valued all guests with the same level of friendliness and helpfulness whether they were in sequins & heels or jeans & sneakers. I wish there were better words to explain the vibe of this place, but all I can say is if you get to stay here, I’m so jealous!  I literally can’t wait to come back. Thank you to all the staff at Trump international for your smiles, kindness & commitment to excellence!!

reviews.title: poor value
reviews.text: it is very over priced and the service was not good - slow and really quite unfriendly. in a town with a lot of options i would skip this hotel. i also found the location was not to my liking close to a busy road. the pool was pretty average and small for the size of the hotel

reviews.title: Cold Showers, Poor Service
reviews.text: Our showers (both rooms 5226 and 5222) broke on the 3rd day and would only run cold. After multiple complaints at reception and follow up emails I never got another hot shower or email response from anyone. Very disappointed we spent $6k+ to wake up to cold showers for 5 days. Most disappointing was after making a written complaint via email (as nothing was done at reception) to multiple email addresses including the manager David Li, still no one has responded! It seems once they have your $6k the service stops there.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel
reviews.text: This is the best deal on the Las Vegas strip, all the furnishings in the hotel have been replaced within the last couple of months. we were upgraded to a suite, had an amazing time.  We had breakfast several times at the restaurant downstairs was pretty good.  Whether you love him or hate him this is the best deal going.

reviews.title: The best and most reasonably priced five star hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: I stayed at the Trump hotel several times in the past and the furniture and rooms were getting a little bit dated, they have just finished a massive remodel everything is brand new new furniture new carpeting new bedding this place is outstanding. We booked a 500 square foot one bedroom for $132 on TripAdvisor, and were able to upgrade to a one-bedroom suite for an extra $50, that is the way to go there again this should be number one on TripAdvisor

reviews.title: Rate of Trump International Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel Washington a very nice sorprise, it's beutiful, confortable, the rooms have a good size and with a lot of things thas help to enjoy your time in this hotel. Líke microwave and others electronics.To enter at the rooms are enough security to access, with out your card of access you can't use the elevator.

reviews.title: Rude staff, room not well cleaned.
reviews.text: The staff was rude. When I found someone else’s dirty socks under my bed the guy at the front desk laughed and joked about us getting a “free pair of socks” The room was not well cleaned there were water spots on the fixtures and dust in the corners.

reviews.title: Great overall!
reviews.text: We were very happy with our check in/out experience and our room was lovely. It included a nice kitchenette which allowed us to enjoy leftovers. This property wasn't as chaotic as the other strip hotels because it doesn't have a casino. My only negative is that it's off the strip and 1 mile from the closest monorail station so we had to walk A LOT or Uber to get to everything on the strip. Also we faced the interstate and train tracks so we could hear speeding motorcycles and trains all through the night. Light sleepers beware!

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Hotel is closed by in the strip. Easy in out in the hotel. Excellent service at valet. Not to crowded in the lobby. The bar tender is so nice to make me a special drink.

reviews.title: Amazing room , great service
reviews.text: Was here for a conference and I notice over the course of many years I stay healthy staying here instead the smoke filled hotels on the strip.They always go above and beyond great security , really good fish and chips and just nice people.Jake the manager went out of his way to make me feel comfortable and I had a personal emergency and he did nothing but show empathy and care for me. Made me a lifelong customer here.

reviews.title: We expected great not very good.
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Trump hotel.The rooms and bathrooms are large with comfortable beds.We like that the hotel does not have a casino or entertainment so it’s quiet and smoke free.The staff is very good and polite. The rooms are very clean.There is only one restaurant and that didn’t live up to expectations and the Trump name with poor service.One problem we had was we wanted to have breakfast with room service. We could not order the night before. I could live with that. Selections were limited which I found surprising. Then I couldn’t bill it to my room which surprised me. It had to be Apple Pay. We decided to pass on breakfast and went out.

reviews.title: safety first
reviews.text: It is a walk to the strip but this is the safest hotel I have ever been in. You can not get to the elevators without you key card. The room is spacious. The bathroom is pure luxury. the toilet and shower are both enclosed in the bathroom. The jacuzzi is huge. Dept store shopping is across the street. Valet parking is free and all day.Free bottles of water all day

reviews.title: Very nice hotel buy luxurious is a stretch.
reviews.text: Stayed there twice recently. The first night was on the west side of the property. The road and train noise was loud and we were on the 53rd floor. The toilet paper holder was loose. The jetted tub did not work. Internet was good, room size was great with plenty of cabinets and a kitchenette. Resort fee is $44/night which was not disclosed when booking via 3rd party. Valet parking was free which took some of the stung out of the resort fee. Hotel lobby was forgettable. The 2nd stay was on the east side of the property (at my request). 42nd floor this time. Had a great view of the Sphere. Much quieter than the previous stay.The property is across the street from Fashion Show Mall which is very nice.  Hotel staff was great. They could use a permanent coffee shop on site opposed to the cart that’s available a few hours in the morning. The spa closes early in the evening. They need to up their game if they want to include luxurious in their description, especially in Vegas.

reviews.title: Great location close to the strip, dining and shopping
reviews.text: My business partner and I were in town for a conference and we enjoyed our stay. Great location near the strip, shopping mall, and dining. Super clean and staff was very accommodating. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: Nice, large clean room! Exceeded my expectations. Top of the line appliances. One of the best time share spots in a while.It was close enough to the Strip and convenient to have valet parking.

reviews.title: Las Vegas 2.25
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and very spacious rooms!  Loved that it didn’t have a casinos or shows or theatre venue.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE!!!
reviews.text: Absolutely do not stay here! There are constant protests, which means you can’t get into the hotel for hours. There is a lot of police presence and the staff is not going to accommodate in anyway. Yazzy and the manager Paul C. who worked at the front desk were absolutely horrific. They just seem to shrug their shoulders at everything that was happening, which we understood because they can’t control the protest but they seem to be angry with us about feeling inconvenienced. They also said one thing they cannot guarantee is our safety in the hotel. When we were finally able to enter after hours, we had to go in a back way and drive through a dirt road and we were told to carry our bags about half a mile and climb through rocks to get to the front entrance. When we asked them if they could help us with our bags, the response was “do  you absolutely need help or can you carry them on our own?” Clearly that meant no, they can’t help. We ended up carrying everything on our own and climbing through the rocks just to get into the entrance. Yazzy and the manager, Paul C. were extremely rude when we asked them for help with bags to our room now that we’ve carried them inside. They also had very rude responses when we were asking them why they weren’t able to call us, since the protest had been going on for five hours, to let us know they weren’t going to be able to let people in for hours after check-in time. they should’ve called us so that we could’ve found another place to stay. At this point, the staff was extremely rude and that might be because they were frustrated with the protest outside, but still taking that out on us was not right. We ended up canceling our stay and finding another hotel. Do not stay here at least during the next four years since they said that there are going to be constant protests and there’s nothing they can do to ensure a convenient day or the valet parking that was promised. They also cannot guarantee safety.

reviews.title: Very pleased with the room, the service, the location!
reviews.text: The rooms were very comfortable (we had a suite) that faced the Strip and the Sphere.  Staff were professional and the location was great for us.  We actually were pleased that there was not a casino on property as it was a quiet oasis after all the commotion, crowds, and noise at the various hotels and casinos near by.  The shopping center is across the street and there were plenty of restaurants in easy walking distance.  We did eat at the hotel dining area and the food and service were good (even though it was a crowded weekend).  We felt the value was much better than the Bellagio (where they wanted to charge us for a teapot in the room!).  The suite here has a refrigerator, coffee maker, etc.  We would definitely recommend and would stay here again when we visit Las Vegas.  Good service, good value.

reviews.title: Great way to see Las Vegas
reviews.text: Best suite we have stayed in on a corner room, 28th Floor.  Great views of Vegas and the Sphere!  Quieter just off the strip.  Very effective security.

reviews.title: enjoyable and nice stay
reviews.text: We enjoyed the stay at Trump International Las Vagas its location to the strip was a couple of blocks. The staff was friendly and helpful, we had a few questions of things to see and do, they gave us a few ideas. All in all it was an enjoyable stay.

reviews.title: Very comfortable stay
reviews.text: Hotel is very comfortable, best pillows I’ve ever slept on, very very large room, friendly staff and large bathtub in room. Highly recommended. Just remember all the low rated stays especially 1 stars are just leftist crybabies that hate Trump and have never stayed here.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our Getaway
reviews.text: Scored a great deal on a corner suite for my birthday weekend. Front desk staff are very friendly and valet were very fast. Luggage arrived promptly. Our room was located on the east side of the tower, great views of the strip. Room had plenty of space, the kitchen definitely came in handy. Jacuzzi tub was relaxing after a day of walking the strip. We had our two dogs with us and they received treats and toys which they loved and they had plenty of space to run and play. Decor didn’t feel outdated, was better than I was expecting. Bed was comfortable and we slept with the curtains open to enjoy the scenery. The only negative is the location of the designated dog area. It’s located to the left side when exiting the tower right along the sidewalk. There is so much foot and car traffic that we had to be extra careful and the pups couldn’t run and exercise because the area isn’t fenced off. Other than that we felt safe, slept comfortably and enjoyed our stay. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: What a fantastic hotel!
reviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom suite that had to be 1,000 sq ft. And it had two full bathrooms!  The main bathroom was as large as most hotel rooms. But what made it completely special were the employees!  They are so kind and helpful and friendly!  We will definitely go back!

reviews.title: Beautiful Property!
reviews.text: The hotel, the staff, the room, the location…was just perfect. 10/10 recommend staying here especially if smoking and gambling aren’t a priority.

reviews.title: Horrible experience/ Expected much more
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible experience at the Trump Hotel. I expected mush more from this organization. I booked a New Years Eve trip for my Birthday and my 34th wedding anniversary so we would arrive Dec 31st. When we arrived at 4pm, we were told the room was not quite ready but we could check in. I asked if it would be a couple of hours and was told yes. This was lie #1! We waited around until 6:30 pm and checked back in and were told it the room was not ready. I went to the manager desk and asked why and was told the people in the room would not check out until 8:30 pm and then they would have to clean the room. The manager said he would refund the room for the first night which was not doing enough since we would miss our dinner reservation and our NYE party at that point. The refund part was lie #2! We ate dinner at the restaurant and the food was not very good so that did not help matters. At 8:30 we started seeing a flight crew of 17 people from Korean Airlines coming down and checking out. Granted at this point the lobby was full of angry people and kids sitting on the parents lap crying and upset. The manager, David L., was no where to be found unless we made someone go get him from his hiding spot in his office. We were finally able to check into our room at 10 pm which was too late to get cleaned up and dressed for our party. Thanks for ruining day 1 for us! The next morning, we awoke to fireworks going off and when we looked outside we saw the Cyber Truck fiasco going on. I do not hold that against the hotel, as they could not control that. However, there response and handling of the situation leaves a lot to be desired from both the guests and residents of this Hotel. There was absolutely no communication from the hotel or anyone and the only thing we knew was what was on the TV. I walked down 39 flights to see if we needed to be evacuated and was told I had to leave even though my wife and clothes were all up in the room, yet we would be safe if we would stay in the tower and they would not let us return. I waited in the cold parking lot herded like cattle and told my wife to stay put. I finally had to leave the parking lot to go to the mall and stay warm. 4 hours later I told my wife to come down and we would find somewhere to go as there was no food in our room. WE walked around all day in what my wife could bring down for me. We had to cancel our dinner and show reservations for night 2 since we could not get cleaned up and changed. We still had not communication from the hotel. At 9 pm that night we asked the police if they knew when we could go back since we could not find a room that was available. He told us we could go back in the back way to get to our room. We walked the long way across the parking lot (1/4 mile) and told the staff they should get golf carts or shuttles to help the elderly people struggling to get across the parking lot. Not one of the 4 people cared and made comments there was nothing they could do. The next 2 days were good and we had a nice time. When I checked out, I questioned the staff on my refund for the first night and I should get a refund for the second night. I was told they could not refund either night since I booked through a 3rd party. They refunded me the resort fees after I asked to speak to a manager but that still did not amount to enough to cover what I lost in show tickets and being out for 2 days.
