The hotel room was very nice, but I would not recommend them and will not stay there again due to how they handled the entire situation.

reviews.title: Perfect family stay with Grand Canyon and Antelope Canyon  tours
reviews.text: Room was so clean for being a Vegas hotel. We pick the hotel because we didn’t want to walk through the casino. Perfect for family with full kitchen and refrigerator with lots of storage space so we can keep things tidy. Bed was very comfortable. Design is timeless.

reviews.title: Cybertruck Explosion Handling
reviews.text: This was my second stay at the Trump, great room, very spacious and I had a view of the strip on New Year's Eve, it was exceptional until the cybertruck explosion happened. I was one of the guests who evacuated the building, and understandable that safety came first. I would recommend management to review its crisis management practice; guests and staff were outside in the parking lot for 1.5 hours (many of us were freezing in our pajamas out in the cold with no wallet and ID, 40F) and supposedly guests were said to be transported to the Resort World to be more comfortable while waiting, it never happened, we lined up from the parking lot, then onto a bus and sat there for another 4 hours. There was no communication from the hotel and when we were allowed to return to our room after 5.5 hours, it wasn't even announced, we the guests had to find out on our own. They could of communicated via text or email, just let us know the status, it was definitely an unforgettable experience. It dampened my confidence with the hotel chain.

reviews.title: Would stay here every time in Vegas!
reviews.text: We have stayed here before (4 yrs ago) and we had 1 night in Vegas, so we enjoyed so much the first time, we stayed again.  Our king room cost (takes and resort fee) was around $160-$175.  The hotel was very busy (it was Christmas Day).  We ate dinner at the DJT, was seated promptly, and waiter was excellent.  The food was great as well.  We enjoy this place bc there is no casino here.  The rooms were immaculate, and the view of Vegas is awesome!  Everything about this place screams excellence, and for a good price!You honestly feel like you are being pampered and living close to luxury for a not luxurious price.  Anytime we are in Vegas, we will stay here

reviews.title: ONCE IS GOOD FOR ME
reviews.text: First I'll start with the good stuff.- Staff is very friendly- Beds are really comfortable- Very nice roomsNOW THE BAD STUFF- The light system is TERRIBLE!  Wow- The heating system is also terrible.  I wanted it warmer an when I put the heat up the screen goes blank.  You can't tell the temperature.- The tv remotes are CHEAP.  You'd better have long nails to choose something and if the bosses are reading this - YOU TRY IT.  You'll seeThe picture I've added is a counter where you can work on stuff.  Why would they NOT have a light here!

reviews.title: Incredibly, it surprised
reviews.text: We love this hotel, super comfortable, always in good condition very luxurious with excellent lighting in the spacious rooms and very comfortable for four people, the views the hotel has are incredible. The pool is very good size, has no casino, but the truth is that at the price it is incredibly good to sleep and be very comfortable

reviews.title: Beware of unauthorised charges
reviews.text: I haven’t even stayed there yet. I have just made a booking a day ago with free cancellation until April. My card has been charged twice. No email or any message about the charges. Once I will sort out everything with my bank as my card is now blocked I will be cancelling this stay.

reviews.title: Need to Fix the Mattress to Earn Higher Score
reviews.text: Beautiful large room and bath but the bedding was so soft we got back aches.  I had expected a high end room service experience but instead the delivery was a paper bag full of what you would expect from a fast food takeout with paper plates, cups, and disposable tableware.

reviews.title: Luxury,  enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: Beautiful décor, quiet rooms. Staff were efficient, helpful, and cheerful. Valet attendants very quick. Doorman nice touch, gave the experience a New York luxury feel. Security attendants very reassuring. We had a beautiful room on an upper floor, but the water temperature in the shower was inconsistent. It would cool down during our shower then heat up again. We would still stay here again when in town.

reviews.title: Nice hotel, Bad Practices
reviews.text: We booked this hotel a few months prior to our trip.  100% prepaid, done, right?  When you arrive they of course require a credit card for “incidentals” which one would think things like “restaurant charges/movies/others” NOPE.  We stayed without charging absolutely anything to our pre-paid room.  I go back and check my expenditures from the trip and have a random $176.88 charge from Trump Int’l. They failed to email a receipt for these extra charges or provide a description for them.  This is not cool, it was plenty to stay here for 4 nights, without unidentified or undisclosed charges.  We are 100% positive we did not charge anything to the room or purchase any services.  Do not stay here!  One of those places that charges you once for doing it, then again because they think they can.  Watch your credit card very closely, if you do. Then, you will know stay somewhere else next time.  I don’t mind paying for things I enjoy, but i do mind when places just take it randomly.  Stay somewhere else!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay!
reviews.text: Wonderful stay at Trump Vegas. Enjoyed the quietness of the hotel without a casino and yet close proximity to the Vegas strip, right across the street from Fashion Mall. Although, the restaurant options at the hotel were limited.

reviews.title: Daddy Trump Tower
reviews.text: Was our first choice to stay, after our little Las Vegas wedding ceremony! Huge room, great views, and great people working and staying there! We went during Rodeo week! So many Cowyboys and girls! So many patriots! Can't wait for our next visit!

reviews.title: Excellent vacation, relaxing resort
reviews.text: Very clean, welcoming and these days a safe resort. Large rooms (ask for view of the sphere) with nice pool and exercise area. Across the street from the mall and a short walk to Wynn, Venetian, Caesars, etc. Free valet parking for timeshare. We vacation here twice a year.

reviews.title: A great starting point
reviews.text: Great hotel The best in Vegas Book Monday through Thursday for excellent rates The weekend is a little pricey We started in Vegas because the flight was cheap and the access to some of the country’s best national parks are fairly close by Had a great time with on our 29th anniversary!

reviews.title: Iconic hotel
reviews.text: Very nice hotel with a decidedly lavish style, in perfect Vegas style. It is located 10/15 minutes from the nightlife area and is one of the few hotels in Las Vegas that does not have the casino inside, resulting in a particularly quiet. The room was very large and comfortable. Negative note, the staff service not 5 stars, we were not redone the room the next morning and several times we had to request slippers not in the room. The room service closes at about 10pm. Restaurant improveable.

reviews.title: Extremely Poor Service
reviews.text: Upon arriving for 3pm check-in, we were told our room was not ready. Each hour, we checked back to see when room would be available. Only after asking for a manager to assist, we were able to check in at 6:30pm (3 1/2 hours later).Once we were checked in, we were informed that the room we had booked and prepaid for was not available. We were downgraded to a less superior room but told we would be refunded the difference already paid.The next morning, we called room service to ask if we could get extra towels and shower gel. After waiting an hour, we called to let them know we would be leaving the room to get breakfast and asked for an update on when someone would arrive as we did not want to miss them. The employee responded, "well since you only called 9 min ago, sometimes it takes us 10 min to get to your room." This was appalling as we had been waiting an hour.The following morning when we checked out of the hotel, we were still charged daily resort fees (of which manager said we would not be charged as an inconvenience of having to wait 3 1/2 hours to check in). We were still charged for a breakfast (of which the manager said we would not be charged as an inconvenience of having our room downgraded). And we were still charged the full rate of the upgraded room we booked but were not able to stay in. While the hotel corrected the resort fees and breakfast charges, the upgraded room charges have still not been resolved.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Just returned from a 7 night stay at the Trump Hotel Las Vegas. It’s not on the strip, but just off. It doesn’t have a casino but the plus is a smoke free hotel and probably saved money by not having a quick flutter before bed. The staff are all welcoming and cannot do enough. We had a rental car and used the valet parking and that worked brilliantly. We had a deluxe room overlooking the strip and the sphere. The rooms are huge with a small kitchen and sofa area, very nice. The only criticism I have is the bathroom was huge with a jacuzzi bath, two sinks and a wc. The only shower was over the bath (there was more than enough room for a walk in shower) and basically unless you are a child you had to hold it to have a shower as it did not extend to a large enough height. Very poor for a hotel like this. But to be a fair that is the only fault. excellent hotel with excellent staff.

reviews.title: Great stay off the strip!
reviews.text: Trump International is a great hotel to be at off the strip.  The staff was friendly and fun and it is nice to stay at a hotel where there is no gambling.  Makes for a quiet tranquil stay and you don't have to walk forever to get to an elevator and your room.  Added bonus President Trump was in town and the hotel handled everything surpurbly!!  Will defintely stay here again.

One of the best hotels in Vegas! The rooms are stunning, the meals are of exceptional quality, and the staff is truly outstanding. They went above and beyond to make my stay unforgettable. The only thing that could improve is the espresso coffee—it’s still not quite as expected. Can’t wait to return!

reviews.title: Fabulous Hotel
reviews.text: What a fabulous hotel, from the moment we arrived it was everything we expected and more.  The lobby is beautiful, very elegant, check in was fast and Alex was very helpful. We were travelling with my sister and her husband and were given rooms close to each other which was fantastic.  The rooms were beautiful and the added bonus of a kitchen area with a decent size fridge was great, the bed was huge and very comfortable, we also had a sofa and 2 chairs which we really liked.  The bathroom was very large and had everything you could need, plenty of towels and lovely toiletries, very good quality.  We had a small issue with our shower, I spoke to the concierge and it was fixed straight away.  We ate breakfast & dinner in DJT a few times, food was delicious and the staff were excellent, very accommodating of some of our specific needs, nothing was too much trouble.  Every morning my sister & I would pop down for a latte, Arnold & Jiles along with Tanya were so friendly it started our day on a very happy note.  The bar area is comfortable and Annie & Lance make great cocktails.  The shop is great and both ladies that work there are so helpful, I don’t feel that it was particularly over priced, we got some great gifts there, they also have a good selection of sundries, lip balm, pain meds, and lots of other things should you need something.Housekeeping were excellent, they too were very friendly and professional.  Check out was very quick & easy (again with Alex).  It was really nice that the hotel doesn’t have a casino, we had no issues with anyone causing havoc, yes you can hear the train but that didn’t bother us at all.  The hotel is a couple of minutes walk from the Strip & Fashion Show Mall is opposite if you want to shop. Any staff we encountered could not have been more friendly or helpful, they were great.  All in all we had a great week and I would definitely recommend staying here, I really hope to be able to return again soon.

reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Staying at the Trump Hotel in Vegas was a great experience. The rooms were spacious, clean, and felt super luxurious, with a killer view of the Strip. The staff was friendly and professional, and I loved that the hotel is non-smoking and quieter compared to the casinos. It’s close enough to all the action but still feels like a retreat. Definitely worth it for a more relaxed Vegas stay!

reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed in a 1-bedroom unit. The room was very clean, and the staff were very friendly. The location could be a little better, but Treasure Island has free parking and it's on the strip. The pool area is very nice with bar service. While we were their President Trump actually stayed there at the hotel, it was crazy security everywhere. I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Disappointing customer service
reviews.text: Our stay was pleasant, but the customer service was awful. After our stay, I noticed an unexpected charge of $19.99 on my credit card. While I was aware of the resort fee, I was shocked to see an additional $20 charge for internet. We only used the complimentary internet included in our stay and never requested any upgrades. I called twice to resolve this issue, but both interactions with customer service were extremely disappointing. The agents were rude and condescending, repeatedly insisting that "someone in your party must’ve purchased it." This was not the case. When I asked about filing a complaint, the representative spoke to me in an unprofessional and disrespectful manner, saying, “It’s on the record, so you must’ve bought it.”This was unhelpful and unacceptable, especially for a 5-star hotel. We had plans to return but have decided never to stay here again. If you’re considering staying, be cautious about potential unauthorized charges to your credit card and don’t expect 5-star customer service

reviews.title: Quality Hotel
reviews.text: I have just returned from a week stay in this lovely hotel. I loved everything about it. The entrance and foyer are beautiful and impressive. It sets the feel for the rest of the hotel. DJT restaurant serves delicious, good quality food and drinks, with great choices. I had my first coffee there every morning. Arnold, Jiles made fantastic lattes, Annie great cocktails, Tanya, who I think was a manager in the restaurant, were so friendly and made us feel like valued guests. All staff were very professional, helpful and friendly, accommodating too. The rooms were large, luxurious and exactly as they appeared online. I was delighted with it. I particularly liked having kitchen area, which is unusual in American hotels. When jet lag hit, hubby and I were able to have a tea (my own teabags) or coffee in the middle of the night. The bed was so comfortable, and the pillows were really fluffy, soft but supporting. Bedding and towels were very good quality. I loved the bathroom too. It was large with separate toilet and shower cubicles. It also had twin basins and a huge jacuzzi bath. The toiletries too were a lovely addition. Some hotels use inferior products: not so here. They were a pleasure to use. Shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, body lotion and bar soap. You definitely don’t need to bring your own.The hotel shop was a hit too. Plenty of gifts to buy, plus essentials you may have forgotten - Indigestion remedies, pain killers etc. I had a fantastic stay and I would not hesitate to go to this hotel again. I highly recommend it.

reviews.title: Normal
reviews.text: The room we found good in question that the bed is really cozy, it is just what you need to rest deeply after much doing in Las Vegas, the bathroom has the perfect size and amenities, what is unfortunate is that they are not very friendly, they are just norrmal and supposedly absolutely no one speaks Spanish, and the cleanliness leaves much to be desired, from then on, the trip was fine, the hotel I think can improve in attention to travelers with "third party" reservations.

reviews.title: Dated- average hotel
reviews.text: Non Smoking- non gaming hotel next to fashion city mall. Walking distance from resort world. Rooms are dated and our couch had a blood stain. Large jet tub and decent size bathroom with Kitchenette .Some minus points are slow house keeping service. Lobby gets very noisy and front desk does not step in to help as there were a large group of drunks in 17th floor and was laughing/yelling at 3 am in the morning. Only one dining option downstairs and its decent.

reviews.title: Very good hotel
reviews.text: All wonderful, with a point of attention associated with the fact that there is no heated pool in the hotel, in a place of such low temperatures.

reviews.title: Hotel The Trump International Hotel
reviews.text: Ask to be given a room with a view of the sphere. Super clean and all luxury hotel. Excellent option with valet parking included. Close to downtown and easy to get to and from. The rooms are super stylish and comfortable. The prices quite accessible more if it is a Sunday. I would definitely return

reviews.title: Getaway
reviews.text: Hotel was courteous and room was very clean. Overall service was beyond satisfactory and would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Needs updated.  Jacuzzi tubs in rooms. "They no longer work". On purpose supposedly, but does not disclose that.  Beautiful but
reviews.text: Needs updated.  Jacuzzi tubs in rooms. "They no longer work". On purpose supposedly, but does not disclose that.  Beautiful but

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: This hotel is off the Strip. We were booked here for a HGV tour. The staff are accommodating and the amenities are excellent. The hotel is beautiful and our suite was perfect. We were on the 32nd floor and it was very quiet. Arrived on Election Day and that evening the bar and restaurant were packed with folk watching the results. Lobby was full too. Moved to the Elara mid-week and we were surprised at how much nicer Trump International was.

reviews.title: Filthy hotel!
reviews.text: We had high hopes for our stay here but were truly disappointed. The first room they gave us had a dirty bathtub and the air conditioning didn't work. We asked for and were given another room. The mattress was uncomfortable and we didn't sleep well because of this and the noise outside. I do not recommend! We also got bed bugs from staying here.

reviews.title: Favourite Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: This was a very high class luxurious hotel that me and my partner really loved staying in. The rooms are absolutely massive and can accommodate your every need. There is also an oven and microwave, which we didn’t use but it seemed to be very useful. Within the hotel there is a lovely pool, the Trump store and the DJT restaurant. Big shout out to the bartender at the DJT restaurant who got our food orders right before close as we were starving! Huge shout out to the receptionist when we checked in (I believe her name was Katy) who tried her absolute best to give us the best possible room. The staff were all really friendly, and this has become my no-brainer location when coming to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas did Not Disappoint!
reviews.text: This hotel is conveniently located directly across from the Fashion Show Mall. It is only a 4 minute walk to the strip. The hotel entrance is grand and nicely decorated with fresh flowers daily. All the staff we encountered during our stay were extremely pleasant and helpful. The unit itself was larger that the average hotel room that we had previously stayed in on past trips. It had a super comfortable king size bed, sofa bed, bar fridge, an induction stove top, a kettle and a kurig coffee maker.  Lots of free bottled water and coffee available  in our room.  The outdoor pool area was large with lots of loungers. Gym was well equipped.  Both the pool and gym had free water stations set up which was nice as it was extremely hot (for October). Elevators were sectioned off for the first half of the building and then the top half. We did not have to wait long and they were very fast. Like the fact that there was no casino located in the hotel. Made for a more pleasant stay. Woud definately recommend.

reviews.title: Trump excellence
reviews.text: Excellent staff,  superb rooms excellent distance to resturaunts and attractions.Elevators are fast and very easy to get on with 4 of them.  Rooms were super clean and comfy.  Bathrooms were super clean, roomy.  Shower was great.  Roomy, clean.  Hvac was a breeze to use and very precise in temp maintenance. Trump store was great for the Trump Souvineers you may want.  Over all, excellent  hotel.

reviews.title: We Loved the Trump Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Trump International Hotel Las VegasWe stayed at Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas for an extended weekend getaway in October 2024. The hotel is quiet, clean & smells fresh. The beds & pillows are very comfortable, the bathroom is clean & roomy. There's a nice sitting area with a couch and chairs. They don't have a casino, so it doesn't reek of cigarette smoke, & there isn't constant noise from slot machines. It's a nice change from all the hustle & bustle of the loud casinos. Fashion Show Mall is literally right across the street, there is a wide variety of stores & a lot of the same stores that are in the Venetian & Ceasar's Palace. We walked all over from the hotel - we like getting a walk in everyday, so for us every place we wanted to go was within reasonable walking distance. It's easier than driving and fighting for parking spots. We took an uber to & from the airport. We also took an Uber to see Sammy Hagar @ the Palms, it's a short ride to most places. It was over 100 degrees the entire time we were there, so we spent a lot of time at the pool. The water was perfect. There's food & drink service at the pool. They have many loungers & towels available. They also play a variety of music. The gym is very nice with a lot of options. There is 1 main restaurant. They also have room service & food available at the pool. In the morning, they have giant muffins, sweet rolls and coffee for sale. All of the staff we encountered were friendly & accommodating. We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: Very classy
reviews.text: LOVED it.  Great hotel just off the strip very classy and upscale. Nice restaurant and bar.   Best part no casino. Nice and quiet atmosphere.   Very gracious staff great pool area will definitely stay there again next time  great place to stay 👍👍

reviews.title: Las Vegas getaway
reviews.text: Great property close to the strip no casino so there was no smoking inside the building whatsoever. Love that.

reviews.title: Started out slowly but became one of the best ever time share week
reviews.text: Our week was the best ever even when I had a heart attack because the staff did everything possible to make my wife feel better

reviews.title: Wheelchair accessible suite
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of spending 10 nights in a WHEELCHAIR ACCESSIBLE SUITE floor 53 thanks to Mister "Nico Tanner" concierge.This suite was thanks to the trump international tower las vegas and especially the conciergeMISTER NICO TANNER provided complimentary.THIS WHEELCHAIR SUITE IS A DREAM,EVERYTHING YOUR HEART DESIRES.A CLASSIC QUIET ELEGANCE AND A SLEEP LIKE ON CLOUDS.2 BATH UNITSHIGH TOWER GLASS FRONTJACUZZI TUBFULLY EQUIPPED KITCHEN -MICROWAVE-OVEN-REFRIGERATOR LARGE-HIGH CLASS-Dogs allowed.A wonderful scent envelopes the entire hotel!We thank you for this wonderful time and the kindness shown to us.Also many thanks to “NICK”responsible for Valent parking!Their mother did everything right for them!

reviews.title: Trump hotel Vegas
reviews.text: The pillows are too flat. Otherwise, the service was great.The room was big including the bathroom.The kitchenette is also Included and the fridge.The spa with the heated poll with daybed and lavishly equipped,air conditioned cabanas. Restaurant ,bar etc.

reviews.title: Class and style
reviews.text: No matter your politicle views, this place is worth the money. From very plush bedding, tv built into the mirror so when on the mirro becomes a tv, and off its back to being a mirror. First time ever having a phone with outside line next to the toilet.Across the street from high end shopping. If your looking to spoil someone special a night or two should do it, and if that someone is yourself so be it.Very impressive

reviews.title: Top hotel
reviews.text: This is our 2nd visit in as many years The main man was in the hotel the first few days but wasn’t such a distraction Corner one bed suite over looking the sphere Room was tidy every day fresh towels Breakfast was great in restaurant if not little pricy Room service great Will stay again

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Apartment is big, clean and beautiful  only negatives (very small ones) no teaspoons for making Tea and Coffee and no where to hang dresses or long skirts as hanging areas are only long enough for shirts and skirts etc, other than that fab!

reviews.title: Trump Towers
reviews.text: The resort was clean and comfy. We walked to other resorts to gamble and go to shows.  We ate lunch at the pool and had dinner twice at Trump towers.  Good food.  Full bar.

reviews.title: A sphere from the window of the room,
reviews.text: It was a lovely hotel, except for a few details.First of all, there is no casino, so the customer base is good. I'm calm.From the 51st floor room, the sphere was fully visible between Wynn and Palacio. I was comforted by the constantly changing sphere of the world. The elevator is fast and stress-free.It is also convenient to have a mall across the street.Small points.It's still a long way from Poolbird. It's so far away.The Jacuzzi is too big to float.It's not well-built, the closet doesn't close, well, a lot of things.It was a great deal considering the price.

reviews.title: Stayed here Oct 2024, and WILL come back!
reviews.text: Just stayed here and it was great!Rooms very large and HUGE bathroom.  I've stayed at many of the hotels around Las Vegas strip and this one is now ranked as one of my top "go-to" hotels, especially for the money.  I'll definitely stay again (and again)!  Yes, it doesn't have a casino at the bottom, but I'm too cheap to play big casino minimums anyway...so I go to my favorite places for Blackjack.  It's slightly off the strip, but who cares, you Uber everywhere in Vegas anyway.  Terrific mall directly across the street....the whole experience was just excellent for me and my wife for a couple of nights!

reviews.title: Great time at Trump Tower!!!
reviews.text: We enjoyed the hotel, big, quiet and comfortable room. Great and relaxing pool area. Luxury lobby and restaurant. Good location, 15 min walking to the Strip

reviews.title: Enjoyed Trump Hotel
reviews.text: The room was huge and extremely clean.  There was a coffee maker but no cups.  There was no notepad or pen in the room.  I thought there would be bathrobes, but nope.  The food was outstanding.   We loved our stay but thought those small things were odd for a fancy hotel.

reviews.title: Excellent Value and Location
reviews.text: The Trump International is in an excellent location and represents very good value.  The rooms were large and well appointed. Bedding was comfortable and the pillows magnficent. Bathroom very large and well set up.  Lifts were fast.  Cleaning service efficient and prompt.  You are 2' walk from the Strip and across the road from a massive shopping mall.  The pool was a tad small for my taste but I wasn't there for that.  The hotel doesn't have a casino which is a plus as there are a lot less people coming and going.  Parking was free, and the valet parking efficient.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: The best place to stay in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: We stayed at the hotel for the second time and loved it again. Having no casino in the lobby is a very quiet and safe hotel, which for us is one of the main points. The rooms are spacious, nice, well maintained, and have everything you would expect them to have in a hotel of this category. The restaurant is very good, both for breakfast, dinner or going for drinks. Thanks to Michelle, front desk who with her willingness helped us a lot with a somewhat problematic Reservation extension that we had with booking and the hotel manager did not help us at all. In short, super recommended hotel, we will surely return in the future.

reviews.title: Fantastic Hotel for large groups
reviews.text: I booked 13 rooms for a family wedding. Everyone was overjoyed with the hotel and service. All I would recommend if a guest is coming in late to put your credit card down to secure the room for incidentals.

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER!
reviews.text: The sheets on 1 of our beds were stained.  The hot water for the shower took forever to get hot.  Never did see a maid, or even a maid cart.  I fell out of my wheel chair on their property, and was injured.  they never addressed this either.  Employees' seem so unhappy also.  Not a good atmosphere at all.

reviews.title: The Real Trump Was There
reviews.text: My GFs and I stayed one night at the hotel before we headed out to Zion National Park. The universe decided that on the one night we were there the real Donald Trump would show up and host a campaign rally. Every which way into the hotel was blocked except for one route which required your car be searched by Secret Service. That was fine. Then there was a very long line into the hotel which required your suitcase and bags be searched again by Secret Service. By the time my GFs and I got into our room, we were so tired. Check in wasn’t bad. Dude that helped us was a little grumpy but I could imagine his stress from the crowd. Restaurant is limited but food was good, whiskey/Old Fashion was great!  The rooms are absolutely huge for Vegas standards and what you pay for makes it worth it. Cleanliness is top notched! People’s reviews are accurate when they said the hotel smells so good! It does! It smells like fresh clean laundry. Overall, I enjoyed our stay. I think it would’ve been made excellent if we didn’t run into the Trump man and his campaign crew and the whole of the secret service agents. That was nosy but I would definitely stay here again. Valet is great! Nicest folks available and eager to help out. The elevators can get congested. Check out at least 15-30 mins before 11 am.

reviews.title: First Class All The Way!
reviews.text: I have never been to a better hotel in my life.  Everything from the valet, to the check-in personnel to people helping with our luggage, to the gentlemen by the elevators checking customer info, to the lovely ladies in the Gift Shop, to the waiters, to the individuals responsible for cleaning rooms...each and every one of them made my husband and I feel like we were family.  It was a first-class hotel and I feel so blessed for our time there.  I hope one day we get to return.  Wonderful wonderful wonderful!!!

reviews.title: Trump International Gives You LOTS for your money!
reviews.text: Huge suite accomodations with full kitchen. Great restaurant at reasonable prices. Service was impeccable. They even let us check-in at noon rather than usual 3 pm check-in time. Very sedate, unlike other strip hotels with casinos. Only negative is that it can be noisy since the main highways run past the back of the hotel.

reviews.title: Close to everything, but quieter
reviews.text: I state that I was staying on the 16th floor. Very clean room. Spacious: Huge bathroom with whirlpool tub and shower, two sinks, huge mirror and lots of light. Definitely large bed, very comfortable. Kitchenette with induction hob, fridge, microwave. Lounge with sofa and armchairs. Breakfast for a fee. Expensive but plentiful and tasty. If you order room service for breakfast, you will be disappointed. They don't serve on carts, they don't carry plates or glasses, but they just stuff everything into a plastic bag and deliver. Considering the cost, some attention onwards would be appreciated. Overall, super recommended hotel because who does not want to stay in the confusion.

reviews.title: Luxurious Weekend
reviews.text: My husband and I had a wonderful time at the hotel. The property is very clean and elegant. We loved the complimentary water bottles! The room had a pleasant smell and are spacious. The bed was very comfortable with the perfect down filled comforter. The hotel is a little ways off the strip but a short walk to it and the Fashion Show Mall directly across the street.

reviews.title: TRUMP LAS VEGAS
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, Staff was pleasant and helpful. Would definitely book again when going to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Make Las Vegas great again thanks to Trump International
reviews.text: We stayed here for two night. From the 28th till 30th of August. We had a extraordinary Room with a stunning view. It was the corner Suite Nr. 4325 thanks to the wonderful Ashley on the reception! We felt welcomed from the first start till the end. Room super clean and the gym has a nice view to the pool and skyline of Vegas. The Valet worked out perfectly. We didnt had to wait longer than 10 min. The Hotel is close to a Mall and you can walk through there to reach the famous Vegas strip. I would say its a 30 min walk but its built with moving staircase so you dont feel like walking a lot. You can see the tower also from the famous Venetian. Room Service was also very quick. We def. Come here again.

reviews.title: Not a convenient location
reviews.text: This hotel was booked by accident on Hotwire. Was the room nice, yes.  Were the staff nice, yes.  The location wasn't convenient to the strip when the adjacent mall was closed. Police presence around the clock was bothersome. Never would have stayed at a Trump location in the current political climate had we known.

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: This is a non-political review.Great location at the end of the strip. Service was superb, and the cleanliness was fantastic. Loved the room and had a great view of the sphere. The pool was nice, gym too. Only small thing I would like to see USB connections in the room. There are no gambling rooms/areas in the hotel, which we didn't mind, but if wanting that, then it would be best to look at other hotels. Overall, it was a really great stay, and we would definitely come back again.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Location of the hotel was great, was nice to be a short walk away from the madness of the strip.. The lack of casino here is actually a big positive for us having visited the other hotels and seeing how busy they were and how it would probably be a nightmare navigating through everything to get to just get back to your room! Food here was great and our room was fantastic, only reason we can't rate as 5/5 is because of the train noise (loud horn!!) when you get the mountain view room; it woke me up a good few times during our stay and we were on the 25th floor! 😔

reviews.title: Decentralized city hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is ok. Slightly off the beaten track. Expensive and loud. Small pool, manageable breakfast. Railway line nearby. Large room and large bathroom. Roomkeeping only upon request. Very anonymous. No airport shuttle. No casino and that is very good.

reviews.title: Beautiful food and service, gorgeous decor .
reviews.text: We visited to have a look around during our stay in Las Vegas. The hotel is gorgeous, absolutely immaculate and the staff are amazing. We were dressed very casually and were a bit worried that we should have dressed better but nobody seemed to care. We checked out the gift shop and bought a few little treats. We had a look around and then had a look at the food menu. We were surprised at how reasonable the prices were so decided to have dinner there. As you can imagine, the service, food and drinks were top notch. The seating area was beautiful. The other patrons were all very chilled out friendly people, a mixture of well dressed and casual patrons. The bill was surprisingly cheap for what we got. We were very impressed, will definitely return and would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Pamper yourself in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Located at the end of the Strip (so conveniently located), while still immense, this hotel offers a quieter and less chaotic environment than the facilities on the Strip with in-house Casinos. We stayed in a superior suite on the 56th floor really spacious and welcoming. Living area with kitchen, bathroom with shower and sitting area with double sofa bed; sleeping area with corner double bedroom and immense bathroom with bath and shower. All with a truly amazing view of the city. The hotel has a gym, spa and swimming pool. Very convenient that parking is included in the price, with a very fast service.

reviews.title: Good value but dated
reviews.text: Arrived as a family of 5 we had 2 rooms both were clean but dated no working phone sockets bedside jacuzzi baths in both rooms were not working lamps had to be unplugged to switch off but this hotel is good value compared to other hotels luggage took 45 Minuits to get a bell boy as they were too heavy to carry had to go up to desk 3 times as car was waiting allso nowhere to sit in lobby had to buy a drink from bar while waiting for luggage

reviews.title: Peace and quiet in Vegas
reviews.text: Comfortable hotel, close to the top end of the Strip. We appreciated the fact that there are no casinos, so much quieter than many of the big hotels, nice to come back to after the hustle and bustle of Vegas. Tried to sit out by the pool for an afternoon but had to abandon as the golden glare, reflecting from the hotel,  and the heat, made it unbearable for us. Bed very comfy. Hadn’t appreciated that we’d have no kitchen items, such as bowls, spoons etc, although these can be requested from housekeeping. Staff were all courteous and helpful, and got a lift one evening down the Strip from one of the team, instead of getting a taxi. He was a joy, just wish I could remember his name!

reviews.title: An amazing timeshare exchange!
reviews.text: Generally our timeshare exchanges have been for location with inferior quality rooms and service.  Not Trump Hotel! We had a great room, great service, and would absolutely exchange here again.

reviews.title: Great rooms, staff...
reviews.text: Currently here. Stayed here last year and loved it.Pros: Rooms are great. There is plenty of space.  Cons: On arrival, no help from staff with bags. They were too busy talking between themselves. Staff at the front counter were rude. Wife actually said   she's happy now after checking in, she won't have to deal with any staff members.  Not sure if we will stay here again next year after a few negative interactions with staff, to many other options on the strip.

reviews.title: Exceeded My Expectations
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, and it exceeded my expectations. Initially, I was apprehensive about booking, unsure of what the atmosphere would be like. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the diverse and welcoming clientele. The hotel room was not only spacious but also impeccably clean and luxurious, with thoughtful decorative touches, including beautiful pieces in the glass built in bookshelves. The bathroom was absolutely luxurious. The staff were incredibly friendly and accommodating, making our stay even more enjoyable. The hotel's location is also a major plus, with everything we needed just a short walk away. I especially loved that the mall was right across the street.Everything about our stay felt top-notch, first-class, and yet it came at a fraction of the cost of other hotels. Overall, this was a wonderful experience, free of any political overtones. Everyone we encountered was friendly and respectful. I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.text: Very elegant hotel, clean and friendly staff.It is located slightly moved from the strip (easily accessible on foot) great thing not to be in full chaos. Swimming pool open all year round and indoor restaurant (very expensive). It has no internal mess.Recommended.

reviews.title: Disappointing experience with inexcusable customer service
reviews.text: Disappointing Experience with Inexcusable Customer Service at Trump International Hotel, Las VegasOur recent stay at Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas was marred by an appalling lack of customer service and poor management that I would never have expected from a hotel of this caliber.Upon check-in, we were assured that we wouldn't need to check out and check back in despite having two different rates for our stay. This was meant to simplify our experience, but it was only the beginning of a string of issues. Around 3 PM the following day, I received a call inquiring if we had requested a late checkout. I politely explained that we had discussed this with the front desk the day before and asked if they had reviewed the notes on our account. The response I received was rude and dismissive, setting the tone for the rest of our stay.When we returned to the hotel later that day, we had to get new keys for our new room. We were told that a bellhop would assist with the move in about 20 minutes. However, after waiting for what felt like an eternity, no one showed up. We were forced to move our belongings ourselves, which was both inconvenient and frustrating.To make matters worse, when we tried to go back to our original room to retrieve the rest of our belongings, the keys no longer worked. We called the front desk, only to be told that management was aware of the issue but no one was responding. This was a blatant disregard for our time and comfort. After going down to the front desk in person, we were informed that it would take 10 to 15 minutes for a manager to come out and assist us. This further delay impacted our evening plans, and despite the obvious inconvenience, we did not receive an apology or any form of compensation.Adding insult to injury, the room we were moved to had a view that was far below what we had expected—certainly not the quality one would anticipate from a supposed luxury hotel.In summary, the customer service at Trump International Hotel was abysmal. From the rude staff to the complete lack of communication and follow-through, this experience was a huge disappointment. I had expected a stay that was both seamless and enjoyable, but instead, I encountered nothing but frustration and poor service. I cannot recommend this hotel to anyone seeking a pleasant and professional experience.

reviews.title: Wonderful hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: We booked two rooms here for our 3 night stay in Vegas and it was a wonderful hotel which we would highly recommend and would stay in again should we ever return. We had 2 rooms (a king bed with strip view and 2 queen bed room for my teenage boys). Both rooms extremely big, beautiful bathrooms and very quiet considering where we were! Yes the decor is slightly dated but everything was so big and so clean it was worth it. Housekeeping came every day and did a brilliant job. We chose this hotel as it has no casino and people didn’t come to walk around it as they do with the other big hotels. We all felt really safe there and appreciated the men on lift duty ensuring no one accessed the rooms unless they were guests.We used the pool, the bar and the valet and every staff member we encountered were polite and friendly. Based on this stay I would definitely choose a Trump hotel again!

reviews.title: Absolute 5 Star customer service and attention!!
reviews.text: Absolute 5 star clean hotel, quiet, with superb customer service!  We were in town early and needed a place for one night so stayed at the Trump Hotel.  There is not a casino, it feels much more of a private, high end resort. The restaurant DJT was delicious for both breakfast and dinner. Our service there, at the front desk and at the pool were all amazing!!  The room was very spacious and the bathroom was amazing!!  If you want to feel like a millionaire, stay here!!  Our best service in many years of travel to Las Vegas.  We will return.

reviews.title: Will stay again, loved Trump hotel from Australia
reviews.text: Wow! Love this hotel will stay again. Kerb appeal golden beautiful building with a lovely lobby very tasteful. There is no casino here which is what we wanted, so relaxing from all that is Vegas. Food ate breakfast every day the egg Benny is very nice, we also tried the oats and fresh fruit everything served perfectly. Had one evening meal tasty and reasonably priced plenty of vegetarian options. Restaurant staff were just so nice.  We arrived at 10am and they checked us straight in which was much appreciated after travelling from Australia 🇦🇺 The gym was good with clean towels as had the pool, hubby swam in there few times it was clean and very organised with lifey on duty. Rooms large, with separate lounge and chairs. Bathroom had separate shower and toilet behind frosted doors, the whole room was full of PowerPoints including a x10 light up make up mirror.The strip I’d read comments but literally it’s a 4 min walk to literally be level with the Wynn on the strip, safe at night. During the day to stay in the air con you can walk through the shopping mall, Nordstrom is opposite the hotel just walk through and come out on the strip, not sure when it shuts.Trump store good to look round and well priced. Also a coffee, pastries area in the lobby. Although the restaurant DLT didn’t close from early to late. Will stay here again.

reviews.title: A great safe relaxing stay
reviews.text: 2 adults 2 kids 10yrs old and 14yrs old . A great room  on the the 57 th floor over looking the mountain's.  The sun rise was spectacular to see  from the room . Clean spacious comfortable.  Small hob ,oven, fridge which was great . It was a great base for us we came to sight see and explore . No casino here . It's easy going pleasant and not rushed unlike the other hotels on the strip with the millions of humans inside them .Pool was great the life guards so nice and friendly . The bar staff down stairs were brilliant small bar but friendly and I had great chats with other guests. The food looked great bit pricey I thought untill we looked at other hotels . We walked to dennys down the Rd for breakfast 10 min away and stocked up with a few bits for the fridge too . Fashion show mall just across the road and we ate 3 times in calfornia pizza gotta say really good . Also ate at happy camper very good too . It's  close to wynn which has a great buffet too.We moved to another hotel on the strip for the kids to play in the pool park and to see what a casino hotel is like .it's not a patch on the trump . I can't recommend the hotel enough really ticked all our boxes. We all felt safe comfortable relaxed ,we also didn't get lost in it unlike the huge casino hotels .The train does go beat time with 3 too 5 honks of its horn but didn't bother us . Night time View was great too . Looking forward to visiting again .

reviews.title: All That Glitters May Be Gold
reviews.text: As you walk to the Trump International Hotel, you may be intimidated. The gilded exterior, the sidewalk that sparkles, the sheer height of the tower. These feelings will be debunked the moment you step into the elegant interior.and replaced by wonder. Each spotless corner is covered in detail from top to bottom. The service is lovely, as we were greeted with warmth and enthusiasm. Our suite was quite comfortable, as there was a stovetop, plenty of cabinet space, a stellar view of the Strip, and a high quality robe that I would quite possibly give five stars for alone. However, the factor that impressed me the most was that there is no casino whatsoever in this hotel For travelers looking for peace and quiet, Trump International is the accommodation worth staying at.Verdict: Elegant, peaceful hotel worth the price.

reviews.title: POOL CLOSED-STAFF ARE LIARS
reviews.text: POOL CLOSED FOR NO REASON. Hotels often do this to save money on staff or liability and then lie to patrons saying it’s “lightning” or “ mechanical issues”. It is 101 degrees outside with only a few scattered clouds and the concierge had the gall to tell me there was a “ lightning threat”.When I pay this kind of money for a supposed luxury hotel I do not like to be lied to or have the pool closed when it’s 101° outside just cause they don’t wanna pay somebody $20 an hour to hand out towels on a slow day. LIARS. This place is too far away from the strip anyway and it’s a miserable walk to get there. Hey Trumpster- your hotel is a LOSER

reviews.title: Very clean
reviews.text: The comfortable beds The hotel was spotless Many comforts Unlimited bottled water (not discounted in America given the costs)It's just very uncomfortable walking compared to the others that are right downtown.And the extra 10 minutes 15 minutes in crazy heat is toughPool staff not very nice children can practically only breathe.But at check in they give the gadget (backpack with things inside) Would stay again for cleaning but I think I would opt for something else in a more central location

reviews.title: Normally this would have been a total non-starter…
reviews.text: ….but there are only two five-star hotels in Las Vegas with both no casino AND no smoking on the property. One - the Four Seasons, was sold out, not that I was paying $600/night x 2 rooms for 3 nights (was traveling with my son to celebrate his 21st birthday). The other - this one - $100+ per night, per room ($200+) cheaper than any other 5 -star hotel in Vegas, essentially meaning one of the two hotel rooms was free.So, I really didn’t know what to expect and had steeled myself for the worst. Accordingly, I was very pleasantly surprised at how… normal… and nice… everything was. Valet service? Not super-fast (lots and lots of cars always coming and going), but efficient and professional. The lobby? Big, bright, very normal looking…totally appropriate for a 5-star hotel. The room? Also big...even though I selected the smallest, least expensive rooms available…and bright. Well furnished, lots of really nice touches (Sub-Zero hotel room fridge…nice. Wolf mini range top…also nice, even if you can’t use it by law…lol). Bathroom? Also big and bright, with all the 5-star hotel touches, like rainwater shower head, separate shower and tub, with the commode in a private closest area…plus the requisite double sinks. Absolutely my favorite hotel room ever at anything remotely close to this price point.Service? Competent at every turn. Not Four Seasons level of service - on multiple occasions it took forever for someone to answer my call, there with a minor housekeeping misstep (one of my calls...I had to call multiple times to get things made right) and no room service (Takeout pseudo DoorDash from the hotel restaurant ordered through a maddening app is NOT “room service”), but whenever I dealt with a person, they were pleasant and professional.I would not call this a 5-star property because of the room service shortcomings, but in every other way it certainly qualified as one. Again, the room was fabulous, as was all the other infrastructure in the hotel. Bright, well maintained. For the rate paid, I would consider it an outstanding value, and I wish I could repeat my stay (not that I anticipate going to Las Vegas again…first trip was to marry my son’s mother…second trip was to celebrate his 21st birthday…I don’t anticipate a third trip…just not my scene).But I can’t repeat my stay. Because…the cult members.There weren’t as many as I was expecting, but those that were present were certainly as loud (in both tone and dress) and as obnoxious as I imagined. Borderline vulgar t-shirts. Loud conversations at the bar about the way things “should be” and how they were going to be made right once their cult leader returned to power (let’s hope not). No, there was no J6 riot. But the J6 attendees were there. Not many, but boy did they want you to know they were there. One even confronted my son, asking him how he could afford to stay there (both my son and I are Black men).These properties for awhile were real bargains in every city they existed, as guests stayed away due to the unpleasant nature of their “owner”, and not wanting to be associated with him in any way. I had always thought that I’d be good with taking advantage of those market forces at play (given how well reviewed they were), but I never had because there was absolutely no way in hell my wife would ever stay at one of these properties (I didn’t even tell her my son and I were staying here until the day before departure, because I didn’t want the grief). So, I did it. Do I regret it? No. Would I go back? Also, no. The cult-members...can't stand them.

reviews.title: Trump Hotel has it all location, comfort, amenities and attention to detail! Great stay!
reviews.text: First time at Trump hotel and I must say it was an awesome stay met and exceeded all expectations.  On a trip with family we stayed at two other hotel / casinos days prior and was looking forward to trying this place out.  The location was great next to the mall and easy walk to the Venetian Harrahs and the main strip.  The place was super clean, elegant and the employees were all friendly and helpful.  The amenities are great as well gym, spa, pool that you can access without renting expensive cabanas.  The restaurant had great food and service but the best part is the ultra comfortable rooms huge clean luxurious bathrooms.  Very well appointed nice furniture, cabinets microwave and sink with garbage disposal.  Great stay.   And it is a bonus not having the casino to keep all the hustle bustle if anybody coming through.

reviews.title: We’ve travelled a lot and this is a first - avoid and stay elsewhere when in Vegas!
reviews.text: We’d traveled from Glasgow via London so we just wanted our room and some rest but that was scuppered on arrival when we were told our room wasn’t ready yet. Now I get that if you’re checking in before the allocated check in time or even shortly thereafter, but five and a half hours after the hotel’s check in time, seriously? We were given a credit on our room to use in the restaurant where it was suggested we wait until the room was ready. The restaurant was average and overpriced for what you got and soulless. After an hour we finally got to our room, which was decent enough. By that time all we wanted was a bed to fall asleep in. It was a nice enough hotel - typical huge Vegas monolith but as we were only staying one night before departing for our next destination it worked out being a very expensive bed for five hours rest! They need to up their service and organisation, but I guess get away with it being Vegas and all that. Definitely won’t be back and its location is a bit rubbish too, built on a bit of wasteland away from the Strip at the back of a shopping centre. All in all a bit of an odd hotel.

reviews.title: Luxury in Vegas
reviews.text: Lovely large rooms and comfy beds in a plush hotel. It is across the road from the fashion mall so we spent time shopping in there during the day and enjoying the a/c. It also provided a cut through to the main strip. We had a view of the strip too which included a view of the ever changing Sphere. Hotel is beautiful and was good value for money.

reviews.title: Loved it.
reviews.text: The hotel is excellent. The rooms are serviced daily and always a pleasure to return to each day. The facilities are very well maintained. Every member of staff was excellent, you couldn't really ask for more. The view was exceptional, you could see the strip, the surrounding area and the mountains from the front of the hotel. The hotel is off the strip but you can walk to the strip in 5 mins. You will be charged 500 USD for damages which is a reservation value booked against a bank card. Try to take a credit card, because if not, this will sit against your balance which may restrict how much you can then take daily from an ATM, depending on your daily limit, you can counter this by increasing your daily limit easily enough.Only thing I didnt like are dogs which can be barking in the lobby, to me it doesnt make sense even though I like dogs. It's not what you want to hear inside a building, but I guess you have to cater for everyone. The hotel has no casino which adds to its exclusivity. Will go back for sure!

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean
reviews.text: Beautiful, clean hotel. Friendly stuff. The rooms are big and quiet. Great location right across from the mall and a walking distance from the Vegas Strip. We loved our stay and would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Vegas but doesn’t want to stay right on the strip.

reviews.title: Good hotel but requires more amenities
reviews.text: In general a good hotel, very well located, but requires maintenance to hydromassage system in the tubs of some rooms that they say in the hotel have decomposed by failure of parts of the manufacturer. Improve the periodicity of the cleaning service, they only performed it to the room on a single occasion in a stay of 7 nights because they have it defined in their program that they deliver to you at the time of checkin. A railway passing near the Hotel emits perceptible noise in the rooms

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: I recommend anyone to stay at trump tower. Best experience ever. I love the service from the valley to the front desk to the security to the housekeepers everything. Definitely recommend this place to families and friends

reviews.title: Great hotel to relax at. Thanks again Savanna.
reviews.text: Whilst having a long vacation in Las Vegas my wife Tracey and I (Mick) decided we needed to have a break from the manic strip and resort we were staying at and visit a more relaxed hotel for a chill out drink.So on the 23rd June 2024 we came across the Trump International Hotel and decided to visit. So glad we did and we had a great time relaxing at the lobby bar. There we were served by a lovely girl bartender Savanna who treated us so well with her fun and friendly manner that we decided to stay at the bar longer than we’d planned ! So we’d like to send her our best wishes and many thanks. If in the future we return to Las Vegas then this is the type of hotel, which looks great, we would definitely stay at.

reviews.title: Beautiful 5-star hotel with poor customer service
reviews.text: This is genuinely a beautiful 5 star hotel. However, they were drinking near my room for over 30 mins and work me up when I needed sleep! I called hotel manager and they didn’t como me in any way or even really apologize. An expensive 5-star hotel should have MUCH BETTER CUSTOMER SERVICE! Was utterly disappointed! Beautiful accommodations though!

reviews.title: Quick stay passing through Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed as a family of 4 in July in a suite room.The rooms are very large with kitchenette area in the living space.  Cutlery/plates/cups etc need to be requested on arrival which sort of defeats the objective of the space. However the fridge freezer is the coldest I've had in hotel rooms which is excellent.Views from the room are great, and it's location at the end of the strip is good but sometimes the walk around the area by the CVS on the corner is a little seedy.Ss it's just a hotel and not a casino it does all the basics right and is at a good price point.  The room was better than the average strip hotel I would argue.We will return.

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The bellhop and other services were really on point.  The hotel is right across the street from a mall so it makes getting to other hotels easy and cool because you can stay mostly indoors for walking. The pool doesn’t look like the pictures it’s regular.

reviews.title: Exceptional Stays at the Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
reviews.text: My multiple stays at the Hilton Grand Vacations Club at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas have always been pleasant. The staff is superb, and the views are breathtaking. I chose this hotel for its convenient location near the Las Vegas Strip and a quiet environment for work if needed. The rooms are spacious, peaceful, and comfortable. The pool and surrounding seating areas are perfect for lounging, taking a refreshing swim, or simply soaking in the beautiful surroundings. Plus, the hotel features a nicely equipped gym for a great workout session.

reviews.title: Flawless
reviews.text: Extremely nice stay, really amazing and luxurious hotel. Fantastic bathroom with top bathroom. We really enjoyed our stay here. The hotel is a short walk from the Strip, easily walkable. Valet parking was well organized as is the whole hotel.

reviews.title: Yasmine is the gem.
reviews.text: During our Vegas trip, we stayed at Trump International Hotel and had an exceptional experience thanks to Yasmine's warm and beautiful smile. She welcomed us with such friendliness, which we had never experienced before. Despite the super hot weather and the traffic affecting our mood, Yasmine made our anniversary celebration special.Our plans had changed several times before the trip, and some guests canceled at the last minute. At the hotel, we heard other guests complaining about the lighting and pool access limitations. We considered canceling our stay due to the lack of a casino and pool, but Yasmine's cheerful attitude and funny stories lifted our spirits. She even suggested upgrading our room with discounts and perks, which turned out to be a fantastic decision. She sent goodies to our room, provided extra towels, and made our stay memorable. For the first time at a Trump hotel, we felt like VIPs.Her manager, Jake, and Lili P were also friendly and helpful, although one manager at the first-floor bar was rude and dismissive. However, Yasmine's exceptional service overshadowed any negativity. Although the bedding had some spots, which I usually make a big deal about, I overlooked it because of Yasmine.As world travelers, we have never experienced such outstanding service. If you stay at Trump International Hotel, ask for Yasmine, and you’ll be guaranteed VIP treatment. We heard other guests in the elevator praising her as well. Yasmine is a gem, and we will always look for her. She truly deserves to be the head of the Trump hotel, as her dedication and warm smile solve all problems. We will definitely continue staying at this hotel.

reviews.title: Very nice, nice staff but in the room nothing works.
reviews.text: Pension is very nice and well located, really nice and pleasant staff, everything is bling bling, golden ☺️. On the other hand, there are some signs of lack of maintenance, we had a room for 4, very large and pleasant with a breathtaking view, a huge bubble bath but not working, like the toilet, as well as the fridge. When we reported it at reception, the guy didn’t care, too bad.

reviews.title: Nice big comfy room
reviews.text: Very roomy and quiet unit. Location is good and very close to shops and other casinos. We will definitely comeback.

reviews.title: The man knows how to run a hotel business
reviews.text: Once again back to Las Vegas after 8 years to visit family and once again a stay at the Trump.  There is no casino and no smoke, only comfortable rooms and excellent service. Having a luxury experience at a reasonable value is all we ask. We've stayed at this hotel multiple times in the past and if given the opportunity, we will stay at the Trump again. The hotel is close to shopping and the Strip.

reviews.title: Agradavél stay
reviews.text: Good location , clean hotel , good reception , great facilities , very spacious unit , huge suite bathroom, which would fit 4 people very quietly and we were only in 2 people . The only thing is that in the unit we stayed the kitchen utensils were few in comparison to other enterprises of the genre.

reviews.title: Excellent property
reviews.text: We had a great time and the room was excellent and very clean. Service was outstanding! Will be back!

reviews.title: Wouldn’t give us a refund after few minutes of making reservations. What’s this world coming to
reviews.text: It’s our anniversary 40th anniversary. I made reservations last night to stay here and right after making them realized there’s no slot machines. My husband loves Vegas and gambling! A few minutes after making reservations, I tried to cancel, even sent them a text and they refused. So now I’m left with, figuring out, how to break the news to him. Thanks trump for refusing my request! You made my vacation/ anniversary the best one! 😭

reviews.title: Five star quality!
reviews.text: My whole family absolutely LOVED our stay at the Trump Hotel! It is very clean and family friendly hotel. It definitely has a five star feel. We truly enjoyed ourselves and we plan to make this our exclusive hotel each time we come to Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Perfect stay
reviews.text: This is our 4th time to Vegas and we have never stayed at the same hotel. We decided to try Trump because they do not have a casino and have free valet parking. Upon arrival we were greeted by amazing staff, they took our car and a young bell boy took our bags and said he would meet us in our room.After check in which was quick and easy even at 16:30, not wait at all. The lady who checked us in was so helpful, curtious and smiling.Our room was on the 18th floor, very clean, large and the WC was of good size as well, Bathtub which we did not use and a huge shower, good pressure and some good toiletries. We only tried the breakfast once and it was pretty good and quick.The pool are is not the biggest but their level of service was excellent.In all the service was amazing, everybody  wanted to assist, security was also excellent.This is a quiet hotel and we will surely stay again when in Vegas, that is crystal clear.100% happy and thanks.

reviews.title: Trump international is the best stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: First class all the way!  Great security.  All staff was very nice and helpful.  Great pool and nice restaurant.   The room was immaculate. Clean and so very nice.  Valet was very fast    I will for sure stay at the Trump international in Las Vegas again!!

reviews.title: Last minute stay Vegas
reviews.text: Easy checkin. Staff were very nice and helpful. Loved the rooms . Spacious room with great view of the Sphere. Coffee maker in room was nice since most hotels do not have them. Rooms and bathroom very clean. Bed comfortable and a spacious sitting area . A Trump gift shop for souvenirs. They had hats, drinking cups, and clothes. Would recommend hotel to friends and family.

reviews.title: Trump Towers was AWESOME!
reviews.text: From the minute we pulled up to Trump Towers, we knew that our stay was going to be AWESOME and it totally was!!!!

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel!
reviews.text: Very systematic and technology on valet parking as well. Very organized. Security is great when it comes to people going to elevator who have accessed card only with security personnel.

reviews.title: Luxurious Penthouse Suite , Great Value
reviews.text: A luxurious home away from home. We booked a 2-bedroom penthouse with 1700 square feet on the 64th floor for two nights. The penthouse suite was luxurious with one guest bath next to the foyer. The main master room had a fabulous bathroom and his and her closets. The floor to ceiling windows in the living room were outstanding, especially with the view from the high floor. The kitchen and dining room area was cozy. The pantry was stocked with all the kitchen wares you can think of. The other bedroom was great as well with floor to ceiling windows and a very good-sized bathroom. The only complaint with the high floor was with lots of helicopter noise during afternoon and evening from the local tours. One night, there was also loud club music till 2am and the front desk said that was ‘normal’ since there is large club venue next to hotel.  Maybe the other side of the hotel is quieter.  We ordered breakfast two days in a row from the downstairs restaurant and the entrees were all generously sized and delicious. Unfortunately, we had to go downstairs and order it from the bar and wait for it as there was no room service for that. Access to all parts of the strip was very easy by Taxi. Overall, a great value for a luxury penthouse suite and better priced than other 2 bedroom penthouse suites on or near the strip.

reviews.title: Outstanding Hotel
reviews.text: We stayed at the Trump Resort on June 18 -20. This was the 2nd time we stayed there. This is the only 5-star resort that does not have a casino. So if you want to get away from the element that hangs out in casinos and avoid the choking smoke, this is a great option. We paid an extra $25 per night for a high-level room facing the strip. The rooms are very comfortable and the view was excellent. We only ate breakfast at the hotel, but the service was outstanding. The food was very good and the portion size was large. We had cocktails at the bar each evening. It's a very nice bar and it was a true pleasure to see Fox displayed on both TV’s. The free valet service is very good – although there was some serious congestion in that area on several days. I am not sure if that is a staffing issue or a customer volume issue. I always tip on the vehicle drop off and pick up, as do most people. Although I witnessed a number of people who think “free” means you don’t take care of the valet people. Some people have no class and you can see them in Las Vegas – even at 5-star resorts.  Overall, the hotel is very nice, the staff is excellent, and service is outstanding. I recommend you stay here when traveling in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Perfect view of the room
reviews.text: I stayed at the hotel for two nights. The hotel is very clean and works very well, the room was on the high floor and had a sensational view of Las Vegas, being able to see the whole strip and the sphere, which makes the experience much cooler.The parking is valet type and free, which is very good.I think it is one of the best options to stay in LV as it is an oasis in the middle of the bustle of the city.

reviews.title: Top!
reviews.text: Meraviglioso Trump! Room on the 56th floor, very comfortable bed, very large and really elegant bathroom, parking included in the price, staff all in all ok, although a guy specifically with whom we dealt at the beginning for check-in was not much "empathic".. indeed... very "about his" and "rigid". Luckily the other two girls were softer.Outside the Strip (about 1.5 miles)...No casino inside the Hotel, and that s good! Ne ripaga la tranquillità! Super promosso!

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay!
reviews.text: Excellent hotel!The beds are very comfortable and the pillows are like resting your head on clouds!  Excellent room - we stayed on the 52nd floor.  Besides that, staff was AWESOME!  The ONLY down side to it was the parking.  They had FREE valet service to park in their underground facility, which is nice, but if you forget something in your car - or go out multiple times a day, it gets cumbersome & I chose to tip each time.I've seen other reviews that said the fridge wasn't cold.  They turn them down to the lowest setting during non-occupied times.  If you change it, it gets very cold.  Our room had a stove, microwave, sink & cupboards.  They will send up all dishes and utensils as needed as Clark County code prohibits them from stocking each room with those items.Spendy stay, but an EXCELLENT HOTEL with EXCEPTIONAL STAFF that go above & beyond for you!Photos I posted are AFTER we had been there 4 days, so that's why it looks somewhat messy.

reviews.title: Great experience.
reviews.text: I’ve been to Vegas 3 times now and wouldn’t stay anywhere else. It was a great experience. From the first class room to amazing staff, we enjoyed our stay immensely. We loved the fact it is a no smoking hotel and didn’t have a casino and it’s kid friendly and they welcome pets! Oh and it’s very affordable, what’s not to like? We will be staying there when we go back no doubt.

reviews.title: Very good hotel
reviews.text: Free parking with a valet service who takes care of your vehicle upon your arrival.A room overlooking the splendid strip (option that I recommend) the other views are on the mountain side or on the sphere side.Very large, fully equipped bedroom with large shower and large jet bathtub.Free WIFI.Swimming pool small but sufficient because very well equipped with enough deckchairs.Possibility of having lunch on site (or pop-up bar in the morning with coffee and pastries to take away); two restaurants on site.Hotel right in front of a Macys Dillards shopping complex... with a large food mall.The hotel is certainly at the end of the strip so bring good shoes, the resort fees are 42 dollars per night and no surprises at check out 😉A very very good stay and impeccable cleaning!!

reviews.title: BEST IN VEGAS
reviews.text: This is our second year in a row staying at the Trump hotel and we loved it even more the second time! The hotel is so beautiful, upscale, and extremely clean! The service is very good and the staff is very friendly. We love that the Trump doesn’t have a casino, it’s so quiet and not packed with tons of people. It’s right off the strip, so you can explore and enjoy the madness all you want and then come back to the serenity of the Trump! We will definitely be back next year!

reviews.title: Not the best experience
reviews.text: The rooms are nice and the layout is very comfortable. I love the fact that there is no casino here.However, when checking in the staff focus on trying to convince you to upgrade your room and during the check in process there is no information provide about the hotel such as where the pool is or restaurants etc.  I had to call down to the front desk the get that information.  The straw the broke the camel's back is finding out, after the fact, that they charge $4 per letter for mail delivered to you at the property.  It may be difficult to find a better alternative in LV that does not overwhelm you with the smoke smell from the casinos.

reviews.title: Gorgeous place
reviews.text: We have stayed in many properties in Las Vegas including the Wynn, the Venetian and the Bellagio however the Trump is by far our favourite. Although it doesn't have all of the bells and whistles of the aforementioned hotels, it is spotlessly clean and the staff are by far the friendliest we've come across. It smells absolutely gorgeous as soon as you enter the hotel and the sense of elegance hits you right away. We've stayed twice now and look forward to our next stay. Thank you so much.

reviews.title: Best stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I can’t recommend this hotel highly enough, from the minute we checked in to the moment we left, the staff made us feel at home. The rooms are expansive, the health club is first rate and the pool was wonderful. This was our second stay here and I doubt we will stay anywhere else when visiting Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Trump!!
reviews.text: Highly recommend this resort.  Top notch service.   All the staff were helpful and polite.   Would recommend visiting Trump resorts!

reviews.title: Elegant, professional staff and nice clientele.
reviews.text: We stayed in a studio for a week. We have stayed in one bedrooms too which if you get a corner unit the view is awesome. The studio is very spacious and includes a huge bathroom with jacuzzi and also a sofa and a desk. The mini kitchen has coffee, a spacious refrigerator, plates, wine glasses, a stove and microwave. Only negative thing I can say is I could see lots and lots of dust under the bed while sitting on the sofa. If you need anything, you call and they bring it right away. We didn’t use the pool this time because it was hot and the pool is all in the sun and we heard from others it was on the chilly side. We look forward to going back in a few weeks. Oh..the restaurant is great. We love the DJT burgers and the haddock. The server was professional and no fake friendly blah blah blah like other places. She was very friendly not overly gushy friendly waste time stuff.

reviews.title: Dont use the valet
reviews.text: The valet damage my car tire. The roim is clean. The showers are clean. Just dont use the vaket if you can

reviews.title: Great accommodation option in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: Hotel is practical as it does not have a casino. It has a large, clean and very comfortable room! Safe development and great service!

reviews.title: Stopped on way to Hawaii
reviews.text: Lovely hotel Large room with comfortable bed and beautiful bathroom including a jacuzzi. The staff were friendly, we had breakfast there a couple of times but not dinner as it is quite expensive.. as is everywhere in Las Vegas. The room had a kitchen area which is handy for washing up anything you buy to eat in. I just had to call housekeeping to bring up some plates etc. The housekeeping was brilliant, someone came every day.

reviews.title: Fabulous place!
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about this hotel. Besides the fact it is a beautiful hotel, it’s immaculate and was so quiet even being sold out we were told. So obviously a well built hotel. We ate breakfast every morning there and it was fabulous. Gorgeous place. Used the pool also which was great. I can’t leave this review without thanking a very special Individual at the bell desk, Miguel!!  He went above and beyond for us when we checked out and needed a ride to the airport.  There was another bellman who helped us with a ride the 2nd night we were there as well, but unfortunately I didn’t get his name. Almost every staff member at the hotel is amazing. We had a small hiccup when checking in, but it was quickly corrected. Bravo to the Trump managers and all employees here, you rock!!

reviews.title: Hotel of wealth and prosperity
reviews.text: Hotel of wealth and prosperity, I am a rich man from Du Bai. If you come to this city, you should not miss the hotel of the world's great President Trump. Professional service, beautiful scenery, beautiful space, delicious food. Come here with all your enthusiasm and passion for America.

reviews.title: First Impressions......
reviews.text: First time here as usual I called ahead to let the hotel know hey don't give our already paid for room away, we are going to be there just not until 1030 pm, we were flying in late hubby had to work, his bad right?! (Sarcasm) We get to the hotel just as I said. At first the girl at the front desk Ashley, as she will then repeat several times after this, is pleasant and proceeds to check us in. The hotel itself is beautiful, a little plain I was expecting more from Trump but okay. Ashley asks us the normal questions, how was our flight, our information etc..., then she looks puzzled and proceeds to whisper to her female go worker smiles at us and says she will be right back.
