We say okay and she walks away, a few minutes later she returns. Earlier we found out there was some music festival going on we had never heard about and all the hotels were crazy booked up. But I had concert tickets to Maroon 5 and had made these reservations months ago, so I was not concerned. Until Ashley proceeded to tell me about the inconvenience we were now going to have to go through because they had overbooked their hotel. Now I was okay with it UNTIL the attitude came out. I had mentioned that I had a feeling there would be an issue when I had called earlier during check in time to make sure that I called as a courtesy that I let them know we would be there but just later in the evening. Ashley stated well your reservation doesn't guarantee you a room, I stated my full payment does! She states you made that you made through a third party, in a very demeaning and degrading tone. Like third party was a dirty word I thought it was pretty sweet, considering she was someone who was working on the other side of the counter waiting on me at the time.  (no offense to anyone in the industry I was just mad at the time) I work very hard for my money which I am sure a lot of people do, in any case. She went on to say if I don't like it, I can find another hotel to stay at! Now anyone that knows me at this point knows I could have said a lot worse but all I said was this is BS but that is the short version. I told her you have no customer service skills. Ashley said Well you can speak to my manager if you like, and you don't need to curse at people. I said no one is cursing at you and then her co-worker chimes in and says you were cursing. I said because I said this situation is BS! It is! your hotel over books, she has an attitude and tell me if I don't like I can find somewhere else to stay at 11pm at night but I am not supposed to be upset about it, okay!! I said I didn't call anyone names; she gives us our room keys has the audacity to tell my husband thanks for being so nice about the situation and we go to our room. The hotel is nice the rest of our weekend was great, and the spa was the best the staff there were lovely, they need to get rid of some of their staff or train them on their customer service skills or they won't have repeat customers and the over booking is terrible. I paid for my room and expected to get what I paid for bottom line. I shouldn't have to compromise or be put out and you should take care of your guests. It shouldn't be the other way around and your staff shouldn't be ganging up on your guests. Customer service in key, I am seeing less and less of that now adays.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: A great place to stay, with a great location very close to the stripThe room is well equipped with many accessories and a very comfortable bed.Spacious and clean bathroom

reviews.title: Very clean hotel
reviews.text: Great customer service.  very clean hotel. New carpeting in the hallways.  clean room.  quick and free valet service.  quiet and doesn't smell like cigarettes.  i would definitely stay here again and recommend to everyone.  reasonable priced too.

reviews.title: Good hotel, be aware of what you get for what you pay.
reviews.text: We had a limited time in LV, so when we went to check- in too early (12:15) we were offered a two- corner suite for a $100 upgrade. SOLD!The 52nd- floor suite was huge and included a wetbar, dining table for eight, floor- to- ceiling windows on the south and east, a huge bathroom with a shower large enough for a party, and His and Hers closets with enough space for a three- month stay.Only one big downside: Above was a disco, and the thump- thump- thump was constant, from the moment we checked in until 3am. AND, there was no coffee machine, something that's standard in even low- end hotels. The $40 "resort fee" did not include the pool, for which another $25 pp was payable, so the resort fee was just a junk fee and brought nothing at all, beyond a slow internet limited to only two devices. RIPOFF.

reviews.title: Never Again.  Terrible Service.
reviews.text: Paid for a shuit that had full kitchen but no utensils, pots, pans, dishes provided by the hotel.  Can not order meals by phone.  Terrible or shortage of services.  Have stayed at Trump Las Vegas many times before, and had wonderful stays, it appears that this hotel is having to cut back on service to save money.

reviews.title: Nica stay but could be better.
reviews.text: Overall my stay at Trump International was a good one except for the noise disturbance from the contactors removing old carpets and installing new ones the floor my room was located and the floor above. They started the removal during the midnight hours. They left dirty debris on the carpet in the hallway and equipments in the hallway. The hotel management did not inform us this.

reviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
reviews.text: Beautiful reception and organised friendly staff  Room was spectacular couldn’t fault anything bathroom also large with duel sinks large shower and bath , lots of marble and mirrors, toiletries supplied were superb Housekeeping did the room everyday, clean towels and toiletries, tea and coffee Asked for a room overlooking the strip which we received and the views where spectacular, from the front of this hotel you have great views of the sphere and the strip All the staff always greeted you with a smile  Very secure hotel,  security always looks at the passes before you enter the lifts There is a restaurant on site and a small cart,  of a morning selling coffee and pastries There is no casino here so no noise or smoke Small walk to strip through a shopping mall and if closed it’s about 10 minutes around the outside of the mall Wonderful experience in a wonderful hotel, fabulous thankyou for a wonderful stay

reviews.title: Good non-casino option
reviews.text: We stayed in the Hilton Vacation Club part of the hotel.  It was a suite very nicely appointed.  Granite  counter in kitchen.  Lovely, large master bath.  Also, a second bath.  Large sitting area.  Clean comfortable.  We loved the fact that there was no casino.  Staff was attentive and professional.  Particularly liked the fact that everyone must scan their room card to enter the elevators.  Nice security touch.  We had one meal in the only restaurant.  Very average breakfast.  We were not interested in the menu options for dinner so passed.  Would stay again.

reviews.title: Chic, quiet premium hotel on Las Vegas Boulevard
reviews.text: The Trump International Las Vegas offers a unique, upscale and quiet ambience on the Strip, making it a retreat where you can feel at home. Located on a side street of Las Vegas Boulevard, this non-casino hotel is a jewel of postmodern architecture, both inside and out. The rooms are clean and furnished to the standards of a five-star premium hotel. The service staff are consistently friendly, always attentive and helpful, and have the right answer for even the most difficult of requests, and respond extremely quickly to any inquiries. There is a small minus point for the housekeeping. Our room was only cleaned twice during our 7-day stay. In a hotel of this quality, I expect daily cleaning and changing of towels.

reviews.title: 2024 vacation
reviews.text: Me & My Wife Stay at The Trump International Hotel was so surprising Excellent I mean 10☆ Quailty & Service.5 or 6 minutes walk to the strip perfect location no smoking or gambling inside the Hotel! This is my favorite Hotel in Vegas now!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: The cleanest room I've ever stayed inFriendly staff made us feel very welcomeRestaurant food was goodVery nice pool area and gym areaWill return for sure

reviews.title: The Trump in Vegas no complaints!
reviews.text: First off let me start by saying that this is customer service at its finest!From the moment we checked in Ashley had a smile on her face and made check in pleasant and simple.Her mannerism even when I was actually a little hangry and cold was on point.She made my first impression a good one to say the least.The room is very spacious, the bed is actually very comfortable and the room clean. The view at night was insane as one wall is all window it’s really nice.The pool area is on the smaller side but beautiful and well kept and we found chairs everyday no issue.The kids that work at the pool are respectful, kind and helpful. Really nice to see that the younger staff also aims to please.We ate daily while at the pool and in all honesty probably the food I enjoyed most. It was fresh, tasted good and Decent prices considering Vegas and hotel food.Coffee station is perfect for a quick grab and go early in the morning and the staff is super friendly as well. The ladies always had a smile on their faces.Also the added security check before getting into the hotel elevators is very nice to see as added protection. Also always greeting you with a smile. The resort fees are the lowest compared to some of the other hotels and free internet.Maybe the only thing is it’s a bit off the strip but literally it’s about a 5 min walk to the Wynn and main strip. We love walking so this wasn’t an issue at all!The mall is directly across from the hotel and you can even cross through it. some doors open as early as 6am which you can grab Starbucks if you wanted.It’s not the most modern or biggest hotels like the other ones but it was what we were looking for.Also liked that it had no casino and no smoking. All in all for me it’s the Staff and customer service that I appreciated the most.Well done !! Keep up the good work!

reviews.title: Ct travelers
reviews.text: We enjoyed everything about our stay. It's close to everything. The pool staff is excellent, very attentive. The floors were very quite and clean

reviews.title: If I went back to Las Vegas I would stay there again.
reviews.text: Clean, no cigarette smell, conveniently located. The staff was friendly and helpful. The rooms were spacious and had great windows. The bathroom was very large and beautifully kept.

reviews.title: Great place to stay if you're working a convention.
reviews.text: After a long day on the convention floor, it's good to stay someplace clean, smoke free, that really is more of an apartment than a hotel. The restaurant is rarely more than a ten minute wait without reservations, the food is terrific, and the staff is exceptional. No walking through a casino, no smoke, no crowded restaurants, and it's easy to get a cab in the front back to the convention center (10 minutes @8am). Great view from the rooms also.

reviews.title: American luxury
reviews.text: We stayed 5 days in this hotel during our 2nd visit to Vegas and it was quite a good surprise.Certainly this hotel is not on the strip and there is nothing around it which is a shame (allow 5 minutes on foot) but we had a breathtaking suite on the 54th floor with a 180° view of the city and the mountains! Truly a magnificent spectacle.The room was very clean, sheets and towels changed every day. Kingsize bed with good bedding, 2 dressing rooms, a kitchen, a living room and 2 bathrooms all in marble, including a splendid one with a large spa bath opening onto a bay window, a large shower, 2 sinks with a huge mirror. Hair dryer ok, shower gel, soap, shampoo and conditioner every day. There is a spa in this hotel but we did not try it.The disadvantages of this hotel:- the swimming pool is not fun at all and not pretty compared to the other hotels on the strip, it's frustrating.- There is no attention that makes the difference in a hotel such as the provision of a bathrobe and slippers- There is no casino in this hotel- A single restaurant on the ground floor which is very expensive and austere.- This hotel is not well served by taxis.

reviews.title: You will be impressed.
reviews.text: First thing I did was send pics home of how nice the room accommodations are.  Was concerned not right on strip, but walk to strip not bad at all, and if you have been in Vegas before you know you are going to have to Uber downtown or to the other end anyway.   I will be back.

reviews.title: Viva Las Vegas Trump Hotel
reviews.text: The Trump was very clean and has an excellent location and spacious suites. We enjoyed our stay in a smoke-free hotel without a casino. The pullout bed was not comfortable (very thin mattress) and we ended up adding another room to our suite. If you have stayed in Trump NYC, be prepared for a less well appointed room and drastically reduced service however the price reflects that.  Overall, it was a pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Is big but gawdy
reviews.text: Needs to be updated and modernized , as this is not what I expected for a trump plaza. The place is comfortable and clean and quick roomy, but the gawdy gold Color needs to go, and the place needs to be refreshed. This is not a place I would stay again at , but my style

reviews.title: Relaxing week with friends at Trump Int
reviews.text: We vacation twice a year in Vegas at Hilton-Trump, as a safe and very clean resort with excellent service and large pool. Friends (older couple) joined us and were very impressed with what Trump has to offer. Large rooms, nice kitchen, hot tub, view of Sphere, security, etc. Short walk to casinos and Caesars, Fashion Show mall and restaurants across the street. No resort fees and complimentary valet parking.Reservations this month and again in the fall.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Excellent hotel. Luxurious and quiet. They have rooms that face the strip and from our room we could see the Sphere. It has a pet relief area and inside the room it has an electric stove, microwave and minibar. Although there are no plates, glasses or cutlery in the room, with a single call to housekiping, they gave us all the necessary instruments to eat in the room.

reviews.title: Super disappointed
reviews.text: I was taken by surprise on how disappointing this hotel stay was.  I used my credit card's travel program to set up the accommodations.   I specifically paid for a room with two beds because I was traveling with my 13-yr-old old.   There was a less expensive king bed option, but I paid extra to have 2 beds.  When I arrived at the hotel, they had put me in a King bed room.  The gentleman at the counter very rudely stated that I paid for a king bed.  I tried to show him my emailed receipt showing otherwise and he wouldn't even look.  He then stated "well, we didn't approve it because we sold out of all of those rooms.  You will have to take it up with your credit card company".  I had no idea I had to be approved for something I specifically paid for, but his attitude was the worst part.  The room included a very uncomfortable pull-out sofa, so I called and asked if they could send additional bedding to make it more comfortable.   I wanted to go get dinner, but I waited for housekeeping first.  I waited about 45 minutes and had to call again because they never showed up.  The gentleman was very nice during both phone calls, but why did I have to call twice?  They came the 2nd time.We soon discovered that the jets in our tub didn't work.   We tried numerous times with different instructions from the staff and the tub was never functional,  so we asked for someone to come to take a look at it.  They said they would send "engineering".  We waited about 1.5 hours and then we had to leave.  Engineering never showed up and we never heard from them.I can't remember having such repeated poor service or being treated so rudely in any establishment.  I always greet people with a smile and I do expect the same, especially on vacation.  I had such high hopes for this hotel.

reviews.title: Find a better hotel
reviews.text: The hotel was outdated compared to other hotels. Our flight was canceled and they put us up at this hotel. I asked for any other hotel but this was the only one they had available. The staff was rude and unhelpful. Room was dated, smells bad like it was not aired out or ac was not turned on. Plus, the room seems dirty like it was rushed to clean. There was a stain in and around the kitchen area. We asked for another room and was told this what the airline paid for.  The food was over priced and not very good for the food credits we got. For a man think his hotels are great no so. Tasteless gold every wear. I seen new hotels and timeless hotels do a better job. I would so what a dump.  I seen a a basic Hilton hotel better than this. He run his hotels like he ran the country….crappy . Trying to screw everyone over. There are better deals and better places to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel
reviews.text: As I am not fun of Trump,I ended in his hotel in Las Vegas!iI have to admit it is great hotel ,great service and if you prefer not to be that near noisy strap (10 min walk)this will be great hotel for you!There is no casino in and just cross a street is beautiful shopping centre with e coffee place !Definitely I would come back!

reviews.title: GREAT
reviews.text: I had already stayed with my family at the Trump in July 2022 and when we planned the new trip with Las Vegas on the itinerary, we chose the Trump again. It is well located, close to the Strip without necessarily being on the Strip. It is easily accessible. Parking is free, although it is valet. There are no casinos in the hotel, which is an extremely positive point when you are traveling with minors. The view is breathtaking! GIANT rooms, very well decorated, fragrant, complete! Microwave, minibar, stove, sink, dishwasher, bathroom with isolated shower and toilet, huge bathtub, countertop with double sink! Exclusive and high-quality amenities. In short: excellent! There is a resort fee, but when compared to what other hotels in Las Vegas charge, the price is perfectly acceptable! I recommend it with my eyes closed and I would definitely stay again!

reviews.title: Not Good
reviews.text: We have stayed at other Trump properties, and frankly, none of them were really up to snuff. But this one really isn't very good, so many nicer properties to stay at. It's tired and everything is a little worn looking. I mean, the shears were practically shredded.

reviews.title: Very clean, great amenities!
reviews.text: Very clean, great room amenities!For the room size, pricing and quality of this hotel, you really can’t beat it! We stayed here as a quick place to sleep before heading to Zion and it was only a 6 min Uber from the airport. Check in was a breeze and same with the check out. I love the kitchen option and all toiletries/amenities were great quality. If we come back to Vegas, I would definitely consider this hotel again.

reviews.title: As always, our first choice in Vegas! However, they should renovate in the next few years.
reviews.text: We stayed there for two nights for the fifth time in three years. Much of it was just as good as usual (see other reviews). Unfortunately, the receptionist was not as friendly this time as we are used to. The rooms were large and good as always - but they should think about renovating them in the next few years. The brown couch in the room and the carpet are probably no longer up to date or will soon have seen their best. In terms of rooms, there is NO comparison to the Trump Hotel in Chicago.

reviews.title: It’s no Four Seasons.
reviews.text: My husband & I were traveling for a work event. We typically stay at The Four Seasons, but knowing we weren’t going to spend much time in the room, we opted for something we thought may be comparable, but less expensive. We were wrong. It’s non-gaming & that’s about the only thing it had in common with The Four Seasons. The room was spacious but dated. There were some stains on the carpet. The water pressure was poor & when I turned the shower knob, it fell off into my hand. I just slid it back on. There weren’t any robes & the towels felt cheap. The windows aren’t soundproof, so I could hear the train & no one came to clean our room. The gym was nice. The customer service was excellent. If The Four Seasons is a 10, this is a 6. We wouldn’t stay again.

reviews.title: Would never expect the experience from the Trump Brand
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Trump Towers prior, always great stay. Until our door did not lock,didn't realize until night two. Contacted the front desk, security was there within seconds and very concerned. Due to a security issue, security asked us to move. The front desk didn't put us in a room comparable nor apologize for the issue. I asked for the sofa bed to made... it took over 20 minutes to respond.We didn't get a room that was comparable. I contacted a front desk to complain, and Lilly, Front Desk Mgr. hung up on me. I expressed my frustration with her, and she could not handle the call.

reviews.title: A nice experience again at this hotel
reviews.text: Always a nice stay at this hotel... I've stayed here many times over these past years both with family and solo. Upper floor room this time a bit more noisy, but not too bad... Too bad they don't have a few nice restaurants to make the stay more convenient.

reviews.title: Trump still holding strong!
reviews.text: The Trump just works.  Well located, well staffed, well priced rooms.  We’re here often and some of the rooms furnishings are getting long in the tooth but linens are very nice, great pillows.  Stay on the strip side unless you like train noise and a view of the penis museum and pot store!The strip side is amazing with a great view of the “Dome” and endlessly entertaining site at night.  (AKA The Sphere!),Coffee and pastries are not cheap.  The pool is staffed by pleasant bright young people who really try hard to keep the place clean and neat.  We calculate the elevator travels at an amazing 1350 feet per minute or about mph!Next week we’re at the Fontainblue for the next event.  Just giving it a shot because otherwise the Trump is just fine.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel and friendly staff. Wish they still had a free shuttle to The Forum Shops.  It’s great that the mall is across the street. Quiet except for the traffic noise even from the 22nd floor.  Food is very expensive but there was plenty of water and coffee in the rooms. When I asked for more water and coffee it was brought up promptly.

reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Nice hotel. Great location just off strip but easy to walk to everything. Near Wynn and Venetian. Less congested than casino hotel but still some Vegas hustle and bustle. Lobby and room clean. Nice pool area without party scene. Food at restaurant was good. Nice staff. So much better than the chaos of the casino hotels.

reviews.title: Loved their bathtub and view of the sphere
reviews.text: It was a great experience! I loved the view we had, the bathtub was fantastic, staff was friendly, the room was clean to my standards, free valley parking, no smoke smell, fast check in and check out, and would love to return.

reviews.title: Great Hotel and even better People
reviews.text: I wanted to say that the people that work here made a huge difference in my stay. The manager Lilly P. was so nice to me and she gave us a care package for my 8 lb Pomeranian. The rooms are fantastic and it is close enough to the strip where you can walk to the casinos but the mall is directly across the street to go shopping. I always say that you want the ability to go to the party but not have the party go to you. At Trump International, it does just that. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Put away your politics and go for the luxury
reviews.text: The main reason to pick this hotel is the fact there is no noisy, smoke filled, obnoxious casino on the property. It is a luxury hotel, conveniently located with the friendliest staff. There is a great pool with attendants dressed smartly, not like cheap classless tarts. The rooms are over the top luxurious with kitchenettes if you so desire. Would not hesitate to recommend or re-book.

reviews.title: Old world opulence
reviews.text: Old world opulence is the best way to describe Trump International. They upgraded us to a suite which was huge! Seperate lounge and powder room and bedroom. The decor is very 1990s Dynasty all marble and chandeliers, perfect for Vegas. A bit off the strip but you can walk through the shopping complex across the road and it’s not far. Quiet , restaurant downstairs bit of a limited  menu but the food was good.

reviews.title: Excellent place
reviews.text: Nice and clean. First time to Vegas.Service great and employees are helpfulSort of hike to strip but nice and quiet at end of long day out. Great views. Very accommodating. Great valet services. Would stay again

reviews.title: Service in decline.
reviews.text: We recently stayer here on March 31 , April 2, 6 & 7. This is the second time we stayed at this hotel. It was much better the first time we stayed there. I will not be staying there in the future. Both recent stays required we had to ask for items that air listed as items that are in the room. When calling for your car the Valet would not answer the call.

reviews.title: Cubitac group KBIS 2024
reviews.text: I would give 6 stars if I could!!!The staff at the trump is top notch We were here for KBIS 2024 with Cubitac. A flawless experience with a large group. Thank you to Amy and her team for taking care of every detail of our stay!We hope to be back soon .

reviews.title: Perfect hotel - class in every way
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel, wonderful in every way.  We had a corner suite, which had a commanding view of the Strip, a bathroom as large as most motel rooms (and there was a second smaller one off the living room), and a full kitchen - complete with Zero King fridge.  Restaurant food was excellent with large portions.  The staff could not be nicer.  This hotel defines class in every way.

reviews.title: Excellent place stay to stay.
reviews.text: We had five nights at the Trump this week.  The weather was nice and sunny so we had a lot of time at the pool and exercise room.  The staff in the hotel is generally on top of the situation and come promptly when required.  The car valet service team is so attentive and recognize you almost immediately.   We stayed in the one Bedroom Suite with our own kitchen, dinning area and TV sectional, extremely comfortable.  The two downsides were the Hot-Tub bath in our Master Bathroom, the pump wasn't able working and the part was on back-order, along with the Hot-Tub outside on the pool deck was quite dirty!   The pool deck Hot-Tub needs to be emptied every night and cleaned properly even after discussing this with the attendants, they could do nothing but report it to Engineering, which do not show-up to maintain the Hot-Tub properly.Another thing was when we checked in, we were treated as non-paying client it seemed.  Although Hilton Grand Vacation Club owns a number of floors/rooms, the feeling was like we were not welcomed.  The front-desk person, was even aware that our room was flagged that the Hot-Tub in our room was not working, yet given the room anyways!  "AN OVERSIGHT"  so it was explained.  We were are on our 35th wedding anniversary trip around the USA, and we used a lot of prepared points to stay here per night.  Oversight or not, we didn't want to repack our clothes to move to another room, which was the only option.In general, excellent place if you don't want a casino on the ground floor, close to all the action, shows, Malls, and excitement.    We did not use the bar or restaurant as well love to cook on our 55 day trip "FROM SKI TO SEA TO SKI" anniversary drive.

reviews.title: Trump does it right
reviews.text: Where do I start? Check in was fast and easy. We stayed on the 51st floor and didn’t have any issues with the elevator, never had to wait for an elevator and got to the floors very fast.Rooms are getting dated but they are very clean and still very nice. Had a small kitchenette with stove and sink and mini fridge. Beds were comfortable. Room service was great. They cleaned up the beds and bathroom everyday. Stocked water. We had 1 issue when we got to the room with the safe. It didn’t work, so we called front desk and within 10 minutes they were there with a new safe to replace it.The employees were all great, they go out of their way to say good morning or hi. Disha in the trump store was great. Bartenders,  waiters/waitresses were all great. Food was excellent. Although they don’t have a ton of options for meals what they did have was good. Had coffees with breakfast then was able to get coffee to go when we finished breakfast and it was goof coffee.The location was fine. We were there for the IBS so it was a half hour walk for us to the convention centre. We also don’t gamble so we liked how the hotel didn’t have a casino and was smoke free. The strip seemed to be chaotic and loud so it’s nice to be away from that. Just go to the strip for dinner and night time then come back to the trump bar to unwind and have beer. Will definitely stay at a Trump hotel again! Thanks for a great experience!

reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text: I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas while attending the KBIS show with the Fabuwood group. From the moment we arrived, the service was exceptional. The staff went above and beyond to accommodate our every need, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable stay.The cleanliness of the hotel was impeccable, and the attention to detail in every aspect of service was evident. In particular, I would like to commend managers Amy and Laurie for their outstanding hospitality. They truly went out of their way to make us feel welcomed and taken care of throughout our stay.Overall, the Trump International Hotel is a beautiful establishment with top-notch customer service. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Good option in LV
reviews.text: Hotel that I appreciate and where I usually stay in LV.I don't understand the changes for the worse in the Hotel.Absence of luggage racks.Having to please ask to tidy up and change towels in a penthouse suite. It's not what I was used to.Hotel without Casino, which makes it quieter than most in LV.

reviews.title: High-end hotel with 5 star service
reviews.text: Service and staff were exceptional!I attend the KIBS show and was part of the Fabuwood group. Management went out of their way to ensure the group had everything we needed. Amy, Laurie and the entire housekeeping staff were amazing and provided us amazing service. We can’t thank you enough

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Just stayed here with fabuwood during the KBIS show. Great hotel and accommodating staff going above and beyond making sure all guests have what they need. Special thank you to Amy and Laurie and the entire housekeeping staff for getting us whatever we need, whenever we needed it

reviews.title: Awsome place
reviews.text: The Hotel was great.Everything about it was just seamless.Nice & clean.Great service.Stayed with the fabuwood group for the IBS show, we really appreciate the dedication they gave to our groupShout out to Amy and Laurie, They just went above and beyond to make sure all was taken care of.Trump for the win!!

reviews.title: High quality service
reviews.text: I was a part of the fabuwood group & was amazed at how well we were treated.  I will def be staying here again.  Every single employee was respect ful and extremely help ful. The location is great as well. Being freaky close to the convention center.

reviews.title: From Las Vegas
reviews.text: Enjoyed an unparalleled stay with friends for a business convention. The service, rooms, and particularly the valet parking reception were nothing short of spectacular, exceeding all expectations. Absolutely flawless experience. Can't wait for our next extraordinary visit!

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: We’ve been coming back year after year. Well appointed large rooms. Extremely comfortable beds. Clean and open lobby. Great looking bar and restaurant. Pleasant and accommodating staff. Quiet block, right off the strip. It’s a Trump spot, it’s always gonna be great.

reviews.title: Very pleasant experience.  Best hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: What a beautiful hotel! We came for the Kbis/ibs at the convention center. Our stay was s with fabulous. They were very accommodating and friendly.Thank you Amy and Laurie for great service.  Housekeeping was also si kind and they all went above and beyond

reviews.title: Fonominal
reviews.text: Unparalleled luxury and exceptional service! From the moment we arrived, we were treated like royalty. The opulent decor, plush amenities, and impeccable attention to detail made us feel like we were in a dream world. The staff exceeded expectations, catering to our every need with warmth and professionalism. The gourmet dining options were simply sublime, and the rejuvenating spa treatments were the epitome of relaxation. Our room was a serene oasis, with breathtaking views and a heavenly bed that ensured a restful slumber. This hotel truly sets the standard for 5-star excellence. We can't wait to return and indulge in the ultimate pampering experience again!

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I had an exceptional stay at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas during KBIS2024. The hotel has consistently gone above and beyond to accommodate all our kosher  and religious needs, distinguishing it from others. From what I heard you shout out to Amy and Laurie provided outstanding service, and the entire housekeeping crew went the extra mile to ensure our comfort. The commitment to guest satisfaction and attention to detail make Trump Hotel a top choice for those with specific requirements. Thank you to Fabuwood year after year goes above and beyond.

reviews.title: Amazing hotel stay!!!
reviews.text: Just stayed at the trump in las vegas on a business trip with fabuwood. The hotel experience was fabulous.  They went above and beyond to accommodate our needs.  The staff was super friendly and eager to please. The rooms were clean and very comfortable.  The location wqs fantastic and so very convenient.  I will definitely stay here again

reviews.title: 100 Star rating
reviews.text: The stay at the Trump Hotel was phenomenal. I was with Fabuwood for the 2024 Kbis show, and Amy and Laurie treated us like royalty. Couldnt be happier to have chosen trump hotel! I can’t recommend this enough. Also all the cleaning staff and housekeeping personnel were so kind and helpful. Really a well deserved ten star review

reviews.title: Hands down best hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: I cannot stay enough how happy we are with the Trump hotel and the Trump hotel staff! This is hands down the best hotel to stay in Vegas! Amazing staff amazing service beautiful and clean! Very friendly! We stayed with the fabuwood group for the IBS show, we really appreciate the dedication they gave to our group! Trump 2024 MAGA!

reviews.title: Felt like royalty
reviews.text: Truly amazing!! I was part of the Fabuwood experience during KBIS 2024 at the Trump. Hotel staff went above and beyond . Amy and Laurie were absolutely magnificent in accommodating the needs of our group. We couldn't have asked for more. Hope to see you again soon!!

reviews.title: Top notch!
reviews.text: Well 1st of all I pulled up and the lily P was sooo nice to us and really helped us out with the reservation!!!2nd we got to the room and it was spotless clean and just beautiful and especially the room service will get you anything u need with a smile 😃 😊 Only the best Higley recommended!

reviews.title: Excellent!
reviews.text: The staff was superb! The property is A class. Great amenities and really very accommodating. Shout out to Amie and Laurie and their great housekeeping team. I will definitely be back next year for KBIS 2025 And the only place I would stay would be here!

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: Was here for KBIS show with Fabuwood, service was amazing, the place is beautiful, clean, and amazing service from all the staff, would highly recommend, Amy and Laurie were extremely helpful in every way, thanks alot Trump hotel in Vegas rocks!!!

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The service was fantastic.   The staff were very accommodating to our group on the 62 floor. The rooms were spacious and the beds  were amazing. I told everybody I know that my experience was over the top.  Other hotels are right on the strip but this is way better.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: The trump hotel is a great place to stay! Beautiful lobby, fast elevators, very accommodating staff! We really enjoyed our stay when visiting with Fabuwood for KBIS 2024!We really enjoyed our visit! We highly recommend trump hotel for your visit in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: KBIS 2024 with Fabuwood cabinetry
reviews.text: What an experience!!! It was a pleasure staying at Trump hotel for the KBIS 2024 with Fabuwood cabinetry, the staff and service is unbelievable, would recommend everyone to check out this place whenever visiting the area.#KBIS_2024#Fabuwood_cabinetry

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: What a Great hotel!!!! real amazing customer service!!!The place is clean the atmosphere is amazing!!! #kbis2024 at fabuwood, #kbis #fabuwood #2024Amazing amazing stay!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!Would definitely come again !!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Fabuwood
reviews.text: Amazing views,  fantastic room, initially didn't have available exactly what I reserved,  so they upgraded and gave me a newly renovated corner room large and spacious, sparkling clean, jacuzzi and kitchen All in all, A Wonderful experience

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: We stayed at the trump hotel in Las Vegas the room was beautiful and clean The beds were very comfortable and the kitchen was very convenient. Amy and Laurie were very accommodating with Fabawood kbis 2024 we will definitely return and recommend to others

reviews.title: Great Stay! 5 Star ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.text: This hotel is the best! I stayed with fabuwood and the hotel staff was very accommodating especially Amy & Laurie !The housekeeping team was caring and very helpful. The room was very clean and the meeting facilities where well set up and the overall experience was seamless.Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Royalty treatment.
reviews.text: We stayed during KBIS 2024 with the Fabuwood group, the hotel staff treated us like royalty with quick check-in and check-out, contrary to the big Vegas hotels where you can wait 30 minutes to get keys, the rooms were very clean really great ppl. Thank you

reviews.title: KBIS 2024
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the trump hotel with fabuwood KBIS 2024The hotel was very accommodating and polite!The elevators are quick, lobby is nice and clean Highly recommend trump Las vages for your stay We had a great time in las vages!

reviews.title: My last vegas stay at the trump
reviews.text: I travel for business alot. Las Vegas is somewhere I go often.  I am so happy I did! The room was nice and the view was nicer.  I was here for KBIS 2024 and we had kosher food sponsored by fabuwood. The hotel went above and beyond in helping us keep kosher.  Thank you.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed at this Property with Fabuwood at the KBIS 2024.  All I can say we had the best accommodation,  Amy and Laurie was there to help anything we might need.    Clean rooms.  Great amenities, Great choice to stay Looking forward for next year KBIS at the Trump.

reviews.title: Very accommodating great ambience
reviews.text: We went with Fabuwood for the KBIS show and were looking for a hotel without the Vagos noise We found the Trump hotel and had a great experience the rooms were clean & ambience was great The hotel staff were very nice and accommodating.Thanks so much.

reviews.title: Wonderful experience at The Trump International Hotel
reviews.text: My stay at Trump International in Vegas was absolutely fantastic. I was in town for the KBIS show and was pleasantly surprised by the hotel's accommodation of kosher meals, courtesy of Fabuwood. This attention to my needs was greatly appreciated and made my stay even more enjoyable. The staff at the hotel were incredibly friendly and accommodating, and the room was impeccably clean. Overall, a top-notch experience that I would highly recommend to others.

reviews.title: KBIS 2024
reviews.text: Was here for KBIS 2024. Accommodations were great. I especially appreciate the accommodations make to allow kosher food to be provided during the show. It is not at all simple for a hotel to allow the setup and special arrangements. It was flawless.

reviews.title: Kbis
reviews.text: I want to express my gratitude to Amy and Lauria  Fabuwood for generously provided me with accommodations at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas during the KBIS conference. Despite being a guest of Fabuwood, the hotel's staff still went above and beyond to ensure my stay was exceptional. The housekeeping crew was meticulous, and the hotel's service was top-notch. A special thank you to Amy and Lauria for their kindness and hospitality  and the Trump International Hotel's excellent service made for an unforgettable experience!

reviews.title: Super Great Service Again
reviews.text: Our stay was with Fabuwood during the KBIS 2024 show and the service of the Trump Hotel Staff was SUPER! As by our stay in 2023. The whole staff especially Amy & Laurie went out of their way to help us and make sure we have a great stay!! Thank you!!

reviews.title: Amazing hospitality!!
reviews.text: Amazing hospitality, beautiful spacious comfortable rooms. Massive bathrooms  !! Best hotel to stay if you don’t want to have casino in hotel and quick access to rooms. Very clean hotel  , fast valet. Very friendly staff. Definitely recommended and will be back next time.

reviews.title: 5 star
reviews.text: great hotel and serves ..                5 star........very clean and nice the views  are supper  i would highly recommend for vacation and business.....  no casino is a big plus.   beds are great and clean.  great price for what you get......looking forward to my next stay.

reviews.title: The Most Accommodating Hotel I've Been to
reviews.text: Stay here if u want an oasis from the craziness on the strip, but still enjoy it and are relatively close to it. They accommodated out group very well and have been for the past few years. It's a classy place with NO Gambling, what a breath of fresh air!

reviews.title: Outstanding Accommodation for KBIS Event
reviews.text: I want to express my gratitude to Trump International Hotel Las Vegas for hosting the Fabuwood event during KBIS. As a kosher food service for Jewish visitors, the accommodations were exceptional. The community room was comfortable, clean, and provided a welcoming atmosphere. The service was impeccable, catering to every need. Thank you very much, #TRUMP2024

reviews.title: Great views, good value
reviews.text: The location is great, easy walk to the north strip.  Complimentary valet is particularly nice given that we wanted to hike at Valley of Fire.  The room views of the strip are amazing and worth the additional money.  The service was first class and the amenities were as well.

reviews.title: Superb Hotel, Go Trump
reviews.text: Just outstanding. We loved the location, the room is super spacious, staff very helpful, hotel felt upmarket, safe and staff were excellent No smoking was a major plus and we enjoyed the respite of no casino inside so you felt like you were heading back for absolute relaxation from The StripReal value and cannot say anything negative whatever!

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: I traveled with my family and had a great experience at the hotel, good location, you can cross the street and get to the mall, and easy access to the strip. Comfortable, large rooms with kitchenettes

reviews.title: Freedom loving owner luxurious Hotel!
reviews.text: We absolutely love the Trump hotel Trump store  restaurant & spa.  We only come here if we come to Vegas.  Jacuzzi bath tub & very happy & friendly staff. & freedom loving presidential owner! The rooms are really luxurious & everyone seems genuinely happy working here.

reviews.title: MAGA blast
reviews.text: The restaurant food and coffee in the room were good. Would have liked more pillows. Lobby is glitzy. Staff was friendly and helpful. The Trump merchandise was a hoot. I also enjoyed seeing the Fox News channel instead of CNN in the restaurant.

reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text: Complained twice about the lack of room service. Reception promised me a $150 credit on my room number. Now my credit card has been charged, so the credit has not been posted. No one responds to email inquiries.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: Excellent hotel just off the strip.You can walk through the fashion mall which is about 100 yards away.It doesn’t have the hustle and bustle of casino hotels which is lovely.Hotel is spotless We had a corner suite room 5410 which had great views of the sphere.Room had a small kitchen 2 bathrooms. a pull out bed and large wardrobe spaces.En suite had the biggest bathroom I have ever seen.Fantastic pool area which was spotless and well serviced Free valet parking as well which was an excellent bonus If i had one gripe it would be our room wasn’t serviced during our 3 day stay and when I informed reception on check out they told me cleaning was in availability and i should have called 0 for service. I would have done this but just assumed it was serviced every day.Apart from that we Would definitely come back as it’s a great hotel for people who don’t want to hear noisy parties or idiots running up and down the corridors it’s also a great hotel for families too as it felt safe. Thank you for our stay

reviews.title: Very clean and professionally run hotel
reviews.text: Very nice place to stay. The positives:  Extremely clean, large size room with very large bathroom, wonderful bed, great jacuzzi tub, and wonderful shower. Front desk personnel were very nice and helpful. Loaned me an umbrella when it was raining. Only negative I have is that I wish there had been a coffee bar. I haven't been to Vegas for at least 20 years and was shocked at the prices. Everything is so expensive. So, the morning coffee I can't do without was $7 at the small stand in the lobby. The breakfast sandwich was about $12 but very good.  Never did eat at the restaurant. Too expensive. The location was good. About a 25 minute walk to the Bellagio.  A great option and the price was good.

reviews.title: Very nice stay!
reviews.text: Very nice registration system quick and easy. The staff were great! Room service was quick and very good food! Our room was clean and everything worked very well! Forty first  floor one bedroom suite gorges! Will so stay here again!Free valet parking in Las Vegas great deal! We had a car to go onto the strip so that was nice. Away from the strip and the madness but easily accessible. You can walk to the strip in about 20 min! Very worth the stay.

reviews.title: Our home away from home
reviews.text: As always, my home away from home when am in town. Convenient to everything and with great view at night, fully equipped kitchen when I feel like cooking for breakfast. Staffs were amazing and restaurant food was great. Room is clean and spacious.

reviews.title: Unprofessional, bait and switch, nickel and dime, disappointment at the Trump Las Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: We booked the hotel at Super Bowl prices. The upgrade charges I happily paid upon booking, it was one of the few times I booked with a live reservations  desk person in the past 17 years. 1. 11 am checkin2. Adjoining entry3. Upper floorWe are traveling and flew our kids in from out of town. Wanted adjoining entry so we would see them more and make sure they were okay. Arrived and they put us in a mid-level room (tried to claim it was a high floor when I complained but the *security* guard was the one who told us in was not. And it doesn’t match the high floor information on the booking website). One room smelled like sewage and we had to move rooms. I hoped paying for early check-in would let them identify cr*p before we arrived.  So now we are on a midlevel floor, rooms on different floors, still in a kind of stinky room,  and surly, uncaring front desk personnel. We got seven families associated with the team to book here. Totally regret the $40,000-50,000 we caused in revenue for them this weekend. And they charge for internet. Not what I expected. Never again.

reviews.title: Amazing- one of nice hotels I have ever been too!
reviews.text: An amazing hotel! Immaculate and well appointed! Service and food were excellent and the room was spacious. We will be back! A bit quieter as well with no Casino! We were pleasantly surprised as the hotel rate was well priced compared to other hotels in strip!

reviews.title: Great view
reviews.text: Nice hotel with perfect location. The rooms are extremely spacious and have great view (we had 58th floor!). There is a microwave, coffee maker, dishwasher, fridge etc. The breakfast is á la carte. Nordstrom or Macy' s are across the street.

reviews.title: Old fashion
reviews.text: Old hotel with dated room, windows are not properly isolated so we can hear anything happening outside, poor quality bed, no safe box….torn carpet…this is clearly not a 5* hotel Overpriced for what it is. Have been many times to vegas and this is certainly the worst hotel I experienced

reviews.title: Amazing resort
reviews.text: Trump International is THE place to stay. We love it. The staff are super helpful and the resort is so clean! We especially like that there is no casino in the resort but it is close enough to the strip that you can just walk to it.

reviews.title: Trump
reviews.text: Resort is lovely in a quiet location but still close to the strip. The suite was well equipped with a very comfortable bed. Our room was on the 31st floor with a view towards the Stratosphere and mountains. It was very easy to walk everywhere or catch the Deuce.

reviews.title: Majestic hotel
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights at this hotel. It is not very central but it is very close to the center and can be reached on foot. Which ends up being more advantageous because even though we are in Las Vegas we are not in the middle of the “mess”.Points in favor- free parking and very friendly and helpful staff- very large rooms with many amenities- huge bathroom with hot tub and shower.- essential hygiene items, missing cotton swabs and make-up remover pads, hairdryer- daily bottle of water offered- good cleaning- there is a kitchenette but without any dishes or equipment (toaster for example) but we can ask if we want to eat something in the room- in the room there is an ironing board and iron, which is very useful for those who are travelingUnfavorable points- not having USB sockets because for non-Americans they don't have many transformers, which causes some discomfort when charging equipment.- they didn't have a continental breakfast, if we wanted to have breakfast we had to order à la carte which was very expensive.- not being a hotel with a casino, we had to go to competing hotels to be able to have some funAll unfavorable points are constructive criticism in order to improve customer service, and this is my perspective.Other than that, these nights were quite pleasant.

reviews.title: Huge rooms and non smoking - great stay
reviews.text: It's big. it's huge...and no smoking or casino so bonus points.Rooms are huge, bathroom is to with a spa bath and shower - and an exhaust fan - rare in the USA. Good location across the road from the fashion show mall but a little far from the strip - depends what you are there for.In room there are kitchen facilities but due to some law they cannot stock it or give you plates etc unless you ask - we did and ate breakfast in our room most days saving some money.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel!
reviews.text: We stayed for a long weekend after wanting to for many years.  This is a lovely hotel, beautiful lobby, pool, restaurant and rooms.  It is nice to have a mini fridge, microwave and mini stove although it was not needed with the options in the hotel and across the street at the Fashion Show Mall.  I love that there is not a casino in the hotel, no smoke or noiseyness to walk through.  It was also very quiet through the night, you didn't hear people walking the hallways.  It isn't too far of a walk over to Las Vegas Blvd but there are taxis waiting if you need it.  The staff went out of their way to help you with anything you need, especially the valet attendants.  I highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, 'Horrible Spa'
reviews.text: Every year I come to Las Vegas for conventions and seminars like CES this past month and usually stay at Trump International.  This time I tried the Spa at Trump.  What a waste of money.  Amenities are cheap, service is below average and even if you complain about anything there is no one there who professionally knows how to resolve anything.  Save your money, go to any other spa in LV.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text: I was reluctant to stay here candidly due to the name on the hotel but it did appear to be the nicest hotel option without a casino that we were able to choose from for a "stay and play" based soccer tournament for my daughter  (have to choose from a list of pre-approved hotels).  We were offered an upgrade to a suite for an extra $60 a night so we took that. The room (2706) needs to be renovated.  Bathrooms were clean and master bathroom giant but carpet very dingy and walls and furniture showing their age.  Unfortunately the first night when we pulled the sofa bed out for our daughters, it was broken.  They only had one rollaway left at that point (11pm) which they told us was their oldest and most beat down.  One daughter slept on that, the other on the couch.  Suffice to say, neither got any sleep that night.  Staff made a note and when we returned to the hotel the following afternoon they had a new room ready for us.  The new suite (5911) had been renovated and was fantastic.  Was a pain to have to pack up and switch rooms (had to take one elevator to lobby then get on separate elevator up to new room) but we handled it within 30 minutes or so.  Not sure why people complain about the staff at this hotel, they treated us wonderfully.  So the new room was great.  Other cons were:  the linens (sheet and towels) aren't as nice as what you would expect, the hot-tub closes at 5 pm, and there is only one restaurant that kind of sucks.  The menu is very limited, much of the food is pre-made/frozen and of course it is way expensive for what you get.  So again, as much as I can't stand the namesake, this hotel worked for us.  I just wouldn't take a suite "upgrade" again because the pull-out sofa is a budget motel quality and was one of the worst my kids have slept on.  Two other families from the team stayed here as well and all the sofa beds had issues with being broken so beware of the upgrade.

reviews.title: Okay, but nothing special.
reviews.text: Nice room, but a little disappointing. The passing trains on the nearby rail line are loud when they hit their horns every morning.  The bathtub water jets didn’t work, which was a bit of a let down to be honest. Hotel is very clean and the reception staff were polite and friendly. Didn’t use the restaurant so can’t comment on that.Perfect distance from the strip.

reviews.title: Prime Location
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay and with no gaming it was very quite when needed. All the staff was very courteous and professional. When we called service for anything our needs were taken care of right away. I would recommend this hotel for anyone.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel and very helpful staff
reviews.text: Excellent value for money. One of the few hotels that continues to offer free parking. We liked the location, incredible view, large room and very large bathroom. Good amenities and good closet space. If you need kitchen utensils, just ask and receive quickly. Very kind staff. If we go to Las Vegas again, we will certainly stay at this hotel.

reviews.title: Very nice visit to Vegas
reviews.text: Great experience. No casino in hotel so no smoke, noise. Excellent security as room keys checked before access to elevators. Staff very professional and friendly. Daily housekeeping and hotel is kept clean and maintained.. Next time in Vegas, we are staying here

reviews.title: Top Trumps for this hotel
reviews.text: As travellers to Las Vegas who don't really want the casino trip, we decided on the Trump.  It has been a great decision.  The hotel is immaculately clean, the staff are fantastic.  We are not political in any way, so we didn't consider that when booking.  The room has everything you need to enjoy a week or more here.  If you are on a budget then there is a big microwave oven and you just request the number of plates and cutlery you require and it's delivered to the room.  We have not used the microwave, so can't say how good or bad it is, but it is available if needed.  The strip views are probably some of the best available as they can look straight down the strip as the hotel is built at a 90 degree angle to it.  There is also a great view of the Sphere from the strip side of the hotel.  We stayed on the 55th floor.  We were offered a low or high floor when checking in.  I would definitely stay in this hotel again and recommend it to friends and family back in the UK.

reviews.title: Upscale suite in great location
reviews.text: Wonderful, upscale property walking distance to the Las Vegas Strip, but just far enough off the Strip to be quiet. The staff provided excellent service and the one bedroom suite was spacious and comfortable. The kitchen has top of the line appliances, however lacks practical kitchen items such as knifes or measuring utensils. We didn't cook in the room but at minimum a shot glass for mixing cocktails would have been helpful. Mattress was comfortable, however the pillows are too flat/deflated and remain uncomfortable no matter how you fold/bunch them. We are hoping the resort might improve the pillow situation prior to our next stay. Overall we greatly enjoyed our stay and are looking forward to returning in the near future.

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: Very good service compared to other 5 stars in Las Vegas.This hotel is much more human than the others.The room was super spacious, with an incredible view of the Strip. It's just a shame that they don't provide little "amenities" like cotton, slippers or bathrobes. But it's just a detail.I would return without hesitation.

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: I loved the hotel and the structures... I knew it was off the strip and far from the main hotels and casinos, but that didn't stop me from enjoying it a lot... I stayed in a high room facing The Sphere, as good as it gets!!!! I stayed for a week and, as a cherry on top, I met, talked and photographed with Donald Trump at the hotel (which is part of his hotel chain), hahaha I made my life go away.I recommend

reviews.title: I loved!
reviews.text: I loved! Beautiful room, spacious bathroom, everything clean, incredible view!! Ficamps on floor 52 with views of the Strip and the Mega Sphere. Attentive staff and the location is good for those who don't want the hustle and bustle of the central strip area. Would certainly stay again. Free parking.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: We love staying here. The amenities, the size of the room and staff are the best. We’re able to see the Sphere from our room window. It’s right across the fashion mall, the Wynn hotel. The only thing is they took away the shuttle service and no more buffet breakfast.

reviews.title: Not like the luxury of Trump Waikiki
reviews.text: This hotel is ok. The good is a reasonable location and very spacious clean  rooms. Parking included. The bad. Dated and certainly is not anything like luxury of the sister property Trump Waikiki (that we rated a five and love!). Kitchen had nothing in it. Nothing! Had to ring for every single thing (chopping board, plates, dishwasher tablet, a knife and fork, a pot, a salad bowl etc etc etc). Why don’t they have a pre built pack for the room sent up? Took so much time and we often had to ring 2-3 times. Then things were wrong. Charges for a sing the steam room - really? People were nice enough. Restaurant and bar were boring and expensive so we walked to the Wynn. Not terrible,  just not great.

reviews.title: Not a real luxury hotel
reviews.text: The good :- nice strip view when de luxe suite- free valet parking- good location - fitness room- large and comfortable king size bedThe bad :- sad hotel- poor check in- low quality cleaning room- De luxe suite : the second bed is the coach with the thinnest matelas! Real shame - dirty carpet- the hotel is a king of building with rooms owned by particulars and rented with some wardrobe locked! - toilets are inside the bathroom with a glass door. No privacy at all.I wouldn’t recommend this hotel at all. I ve been lots of times in Vegas and stayed in better establishments (Golden nugget, Palm, Wynn, Caesar).

reviews.title: It's completely different from a few years ago
reviews.text: The front desk at the hotel was expressionless, with a cold and impatient demeanor. The room service had a very poor attitude, displaying disdain when I asked for clarification. And despite being clear on the phone, some items were still missing from the order when delivered. During the Christmas holidays, valet services required a waiting time of at least 20-30 minutes, causing us to alter many of our plans. This wasn't our first stay at Trump. The service was exceptional around 10 years ago. However, unlike now, where ordering room service feels akin to receiving a delivery from Doordash. The high-end dining experience expected at a luxury hotel has completely vanished. In summary, don't come here unless you have no other place to spend your money.

reviews.title: First time staying at this hotel
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel this time, I usually stay at Encore.  It I was a guest part of a group. Nice property, staff is amazing and my room was spot on, super clean and beautiful. It’s located right across a shopping mall. Food is not that great if compared to other hotels in Vegas but not a big deal as we went to other restaurants outside. I missed reading my digital magazines and newspapers, all hotels in Vegas offer this service via Pressiereader but trump is way behind on this matter, it’s a free service and I suggested the staff to add it. Food wise the hotel is also behind if compared to others. Other than that I’d stay again if my group of friends decide to stay again there,  it was a pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Not worth the money
reviews.text: Nice view but stunningly poor and unfriendly service at frontdesk and central housekeeping (NOT: the people actually doing the housekeeping). Took hours to make up the sofa bed for the kid (suite was reserved for three and we arrived late), room was not made on the following day despite us being out for ten hours and despite and explicit request. When we returned, I called housekeeping and again was treated quite snottily and told now it was to late to ask for housekeeping. Room ok, I am not a fan of the decor but that‘s personal taste. View of the strip was great but isolation is poor, so if you are sensitive to noise, not for you. Given we paid new year‘s eve prices I am hugely disappointed by what we got.

reviews.title: A step back in Time.. classic elegance
reviews.text: The whole experience was wonderful, from arrival to departure... Professional, Polite and attentive... the cleanest hotel experience... excellent service in all departments.Looking forward to returning... otel

reviews.title: Nightmarish service. Management don’t care about customers.
reviews.text: Terrible service. We booked ( through 3rd party) and asked for room with 2 beds. Checked in dec24thand they were nice enough to check in before 3 pm(2 pm) and gave us a room with single king bed. The gentleman at the reception said they are oversold and we will get a room on 26th with 2 beds. On 26th we paced all our stuff and came down to re check in-this guy name CRAIG( I I am not wrong) said there is no note put in by the last person and they are oversold. No apology - nothing as we showed that our initial booking confirmation shows for 2 people - 2 queen beds. He was eager to get rid of us as others were waiting to check in.We checked out with this girl name ALICIYA -she seemed upset to be at work and was not at all helpful - my wife said good morning we are ready to check out- she was not happy to get off her texting and help. We asked may we please speak to a supervisor or manager to at least tell them a what went wrong- she said no one except her was there and gave us a card for a manager.We have stayed at this hotel for last 7 years. Sadly the service quality have gone down. Rooms are dated now with worn out chairs. I know they don’t care if one guest don’t return as they have many repeat customers but Management should spend more time and effort to train the staff and treat repeat customers with providing what they paid for. This use to be an awesome hotel next to a mall/ great service and non smoking atmosphere- we that’s all gone now. Only good thing was that the housekeeping team was great- front desk service quality is same a motel 8 now.Stay away from this hotel - way better alternatives nearby.

reviews.title: Vacation at Trump
reviews.text: Excellent service and accommodation. Very convenient location especially to Fashion Show Mall and the convenience of the food court and restaurants. Only one problem, they promised to clean the room after the fourth night but this never happened. The pull out couch bed was very unconfortable.

reviews.title: Not clean,  unprofessional and lack empathy.
reviews.text: I just left this hotel this morning on December 30,2023. I am not sure if I will return. They took very long to bring  dishes and other things guess often request.  If they took long with  orders  they would claim they didnt have such a request.  We waited over 7 hours one night for items. The worst thing is they back each other up with their lies. My first room was in the middle tower. Beware of rooms 16-30's. They have horrible lights , bad commodes, hair all overthe  floors and no heat. The window vent was bent and wouldn't shut . My favorite part was the couch that had a bad . Oh my God,  the thing had sprints from the top to the bottom.  They moved me on the  third night ,and  we still had to deal with long hair on the floors. Simply nasty! The manager was shown a picture and he only said "I'm sorry".  He had no suggestions.  Maybe the maid had a bad day  is what he said to me as I was leaving. I told him my son does videos and blog.  He looked drained and said nothing.  So ,I am leaving this view . As promise my son will blog.   I showed pictures and no one in my family has that type of hair textures or color you can see below. Simply uncaring and not cleaning.  It is jo way you can mop or sweep and leave long pieces of hair on a floor . It is unsanitary and spreads germs.  We even found dirty socks in our room Near the bed . I am very happy I travel with cleaning items cause both rooms were nasty . My daughter was hurt at the  mall a cross the street, and the staff did not care one bit. I rushed out and forgot my key. They pretended they couldn't find me in the system. I told the manager this and he didn't care.  Only said he would talk to staff about it .  he said they didnt want to accidentally let someone in my room ,but I could  have shown ID .  Who would have been that detailed about how registrations were made and with my names. Smh ! If you can ,I would say just avoid them on  major events or holidays. They're the worst and can't keep up with guess needs.  BTW , I wanted to cook vs eat out for health reasons.  I waited 7 hours for them to bring stuff for me to cook with . I ended up going out . Never had this at a so called 5 star hotel in my life. I travel often .  Hair everywhere , dirty sock under beds and no knives for certain guess is why I left this morning instead of rebooting. No thank! I will be at a nice hotel on the strip for new years. 😌

reviews.title: Great hotel near the strip
reviews.text: Great hotel near the strip. Comfortable rooms, great staff and awesome views. Stayed in a suite….good layout and spacious for 4 of us. Love their pool and terrace area.Limited food options for vegetarian but the mall is right opposite with plenty options

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: The structure is certainly beautiful and very shiny as befits a hotel of that level in Las Vegas.I stayed at this hotel in August 2023.However, there were two things that lowered the approval rating.The first is linked to the fact that we added a night to our stay asking to keep the same room, a request which was granted to us, only that no one came to redo the room and we found ourselves with dirty used towels and without shower gel or soap, we called to say that the room had not been made up and that we needed clean towels and washing products and they didn't send anyone after a couple of hours we went down to have them given to us directly at the reception, an inconvenience that is not very acceptable for a hotel of this standard.The other problem was with the return of the deposit which was never refunded either on my partner's credit card for the first booking, nor on mine for the second booking, I wrote asking for explanations and I was answered after a month that they had made the refund but that perhaps it was a timing problem of the bank being on the European circuit.On December 29, 2023 I was still in Las Vegas and at the request of my bank I went to ask for a copy of the refund of the deposit for both me and my partner, as that money had never arrived on our two credit cards and I they gave a copy of the receipt already provided at check out in August and the statement with the indications of the withdrawal of the room payment and the deposit which took place in August, but no code or receipt of the refund, dismissing me by telling me that they only had that and that the problem was with my bank.However, if neither I nor my partner have received a refund of the deposit and in fact we have not received our money back, it is not possible to simply tell the customer that the problem lies with the bank because if they have withdrawn money that is not ours' been given back, it means that they still have them, they certainly didn't get lost along the way.Therefore I would not go back, nor do I recommend it because it was their duty to look into the matter further and provide the necessary elements to get the bail money back, not to close the matter in a simplistic way.It is clear at this point that we will never get the money back and this is really annoying, because it was around 300 dollars which is not a big amount, but if I plan a trip and estimate an amount of expense I cannot put the money at a loss deposit of a hotel is not correct.

reviews.title: Great Experience at Trump
reviews.text: We actually stayed in the Hilton Vacation Club portion of the hotel.  We had a one bedroom condo.  Very nice with all of the amenities.  Great to stay in a condo with the benefit of hotel room service.  Only drawback was they only have valet parking and we needed to allow 15-20 minutes each time to get our car since it was always busy.  Highly, recommend this hotel.  Great location by Fashion Show Mall and just off the strip.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: Our rooms and hotel were beautiful. The staff was very kind. Great security. We felt safe walking to/from hotel at all hours. Enjoyed the large jacuzzi bath tubs and the outdoor pool/hot tub. Wish there were more food options in house but thats it!

reviews.title: Experienced Luxury
reviews.text: The hotel offers an excellent experience with a fantastic location and outstanding customer service. The room furnishings are impressive, featuring ample countertops and towel racks. The inclusion of a kitchenette is a nice touch, and the water pressure in the shower is strong. The spacious bathroom includes a large shower and a separate whirlpool tub. The elevators are notably fast, with minimal waiting time – never more than 30 seconds. The staff is exceptionally courteous, and the availability of free valet service adds to the convenience. The hotel's location allows easy access to roads other than Vegas Blvd, making it convenient for driving. Furthermore, the absence of a casino ensures a smoke-free environment, free from cigarette or pot odors. Overall, a highly positive experience.

reviews.title: Huge room with a great view
reviews.text: We booked this as it was one of the more reasonable hotels during Oct half term. We were upgraded on arrival and our room was huge, lavishly furnished and had a great view over the strip, The pool was lovely, cocktails great and the staff very welcoming and attentive. The location was fine for us, a few minutes walk to the bottom of the strip. We would stay again.

reviews.title: Lovely and sophisticated
reviews.text: This is a beautiful resort with spacious and well appointed rooms.  We had coffee and water available in room and a stove, microwave and refrigerator for eating in room.  Location is just off strip and easy to access many places by foot.  Valets are quick to bring out cars as needed.

reviews.title: Great service and a beautiful room
reviews.text: Pricey but we choose the Trump for our Las Vegas stays for one reason -  there is NO CASINO to navigate as you arrive.  You go straight to the elevators.  The concierge is very helpful and the service was excellent.  You have to request housekeeping service by calling each day but it is available without charge.  We reserved a king suite accessible room and it was roomy with 2 full baths.  However, the showers had a tendency to leak water and the marble floors become very slick.  We used towels to stand in the shower and walk out.   The fitness center is well equipped.  The pool temp is heated, but only to 75 degrees, not enough for us in December.

reviews.title: Definitely Recommend
reviews.text: There’s a lot of conflicting information on The Trump Hotel so I thought I’d share our experience!Location : Just barely (the tiniest bit) off the strip. 8-10 minute walk to TI, mostly down Fashion Show Drive which is a little empty at night. Closest hotel to the North is Resort World which is about a 15-20 minute walk.  Biggest complaint is definitely the proximity to the train. It can be loud. Hotel : Is it a little dated? Yes. Even being a little dated, is it still nicer than all the other places at a similar price point? Absolutely! It is clean, good quality, and the rooms and bathrooms are BIG with full size windows. The only complaint about the rooms is that the windows aren’t as soundproof as you might expect so there can be some road noise. House keeping came everyday but only remade the bed. Didn’t touch towels or throw away empty water bottles on bedside table. Dining : It is undeniably lacking for dining options. DJT is one half of the lobby. It feels like you’re eating at a Holiday Inn Restaurant. They serve the same small menu for lunch and dinner. There is a small coffee cart with expensive coffee and limited pastries for breakfast.  Very different from most Vegas hotels. Staff : 10/10! Friendly and helpful! Check in was super quick. The bellman was super fast and full of good information. Had a small issue with our key and they fixed it way faster than I expected!Atmosphere : WAY more quiet than casino hotels. Doesn’t smell like smoke, or perfume to cover it up. Felt incredibly safe. No shenanigans in halls at 4 am. We loved it!

reviews.title: Most off staff do not care about you..
reviews.text: My wife and I arrived at the Trump International Hotel in Las Vegas for a 8 nights stay. We thought very highly off the city and the surrounding Nationalparks. We had a great time when away from the hotel. We booked through Hilton Grand Vacations - you should never do that.. The front desk treated us like dirt. When in a hotel you expect them to come and clean the room, but because we booked through HGVC they did not want to do that. They told us that they would make a cleaning every 3 days. Guess what they did not so we went to the front desk to times a day after that and asked for a cleaning. They could not care less, they even kicked me out off the lobby on the 6th day for being rude.... because I asked if it is normal to harass people from outside the US. ( we are from Denmark)On the 6th day we received two large towels.On the 7th day we received a 3 min cleaning ( we waited outside ) She only just made the bed.The pool area was very nice, they served us very well here. Here you can easily take a day off..The Lobby restaurant is very expensive and very average.The boys in the front ( valet parking ) are the best, we choose to give them all the tip that we did not give inside the hotel. They loved it..Would we recommend this hotel to anyone? NO - not because of the above because I hope not they treat everyone like this. The hotel is old, outdated dark rooms. It is a bit away from the Action, expensive and snobbish.

reviews.title: Trump International
reviews.text: Great rooms, service and convenience. One of our favorite places to stay in Las Vegas. Easy to access rooms compared to walking through a Casino and convenient to all areas of town. Generally use a car service to move to the casino's although they are within walking distance.

reviews.title: Trump Hotel LV was hands down disappointing.
reviews.text: I was expecting so much more. We checked in today. No greeting, no bellmen, and a disheveled front desk. We have a three-bedroom suite: No fresh flowers, fruit, or champagne on arrival. They do not offer turndown, so strange for a luxury property.Coffee service is mediocre and skimpy for this size suite. Bar drinks are $23 with poor service but good quality.Rooms are bland and lackluster, sterile and uninspiring. So disappointed. This is my first Trump property. I was hoping for a true Trump-level experience.

reviews.title: Amazing room , great service
reviews.text: Was here for a conference and I notice over the course of many years I stay healthy staying here instead the smoke filled hotels on the strip.They always go above and beyond great security , really good fish and chips and just nice people.Jake the manager went out of his way to make me feel comfortable and I had a personal emergency and he did nothing but show empathy and care for me. Made me a lifelong customer here.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Great place to stay. Room was excellent. Staff also excellent. They went the extra mile to make sure we had everything we needed including a room with a great view of the strip. We would stay here again

reviews.title: Find somewhere else
reviews.text: Horrible!!!Save your money and find a better alternative I guess there’s a reason why it’s so cheap.We asked to set the sofa bed several times over a 4 hour period and with no response. The room wasn’t cleaned over our stay. The drain in the bathroom is all clogged including in the shower. So disappointing

reviews.title: Disappointed
