reviews.text: I checked in yesterday and mentioned in my notes that it was my son's 1st birthday as well as requested for a pack n play for his comfort. None of that was recognized, front desk look disheveled and unfortunately, the pack n play wasn't in the room when we arrived.Additionally, I had asked for some coffee cups and water, but even after an hour, they hadn't been delivered. I understand that sometimes things can get busy, but called 3 different departments to request something so simple. Up to now, it has not arrived, given that they said it has been "expedited". No apology for the delay was given. I also noticed that the room seemed a bit run down, which was unexpected given the reputation of Trump Hotels. I've always heard about the personalized service and Forbes service standards, but unfortunately, my experience didn't quite match up to those expectations.This has undeniably cast a shadow over the perceived value of staying at a Trump Hotel, and it is regrettable that the service provided does not align with the esteemed reputation the brand seeks to uphold.

reviews.title: Fabulous Vegas weekend
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel with excellent views of the Northern part of the strip.   Good option if you are not a gambler and prefer to have a cigerette smell free experience.  They also do free valet which is awesome. Suite was newly renovated and water pressure was amazing.  Great coffee bar in the Lobby in the morning with the best muffins.  Staff is very professional and courteous and as expected all good looking lol.  Shout out to Julia at the front desk who was very personable and helpful.  Would definitely stay here again.  Two thumbs up!!!

reviews.title: Sanctuary off the Strip
reviews.text: My wife and I spent three nights at TI during a trade show. It was a return trip and as always a pleasure. The furnishings are elegant, the restaurant truly marvelous and the employees so helpful and well trained. This is our place in Las Vegas from now on.

reviews.title: Fantastic views across the strip.
reviews.text: Easy check in & out. We stayed in superior room suites on the 46th floor, the views across the strip was amazing. As the hotel is tucked away at the edge of the strip we had a fabulous view of the sphere. Rooms were clean and cleaned daily. Elevators were prompt and quick to the higher levels. The pool was super lovely, although the water was a little cold but it is November. We ate in the restaurant and the food was served hot and tasty. All in all we had a fantastic stay at the Trump International.

reviews.title: Great experience at Trump hotel Las Vegas
reviews.text: My stay at the Trump hotel in Las Vegas was good. Its location is not so good if you want to get to the casinos and main hotels on the Las Vegas strip, but the location-price ratio is very good compared to the other hotels. The bedrooms on Very spacious and have spectacular bathrooms. The beds were very comfortable and the pillows felt like clouds. In the room there was a stove and dishwasher, personally I didn't use it but it looked of good quality. The bathrooms were very large, they had two sinks, a tub, a shower and a toilet. The water came out perfectly to my liking. The restaurant service was good and the food was excellent. I can't say much about Valet Parking because I didn't use it much, but the one time I used it it was fast and efficient. I think it is a great Hotel that I would recommend to friends and family. I am thinking about returning to Las Vegas and this hotel would be my first choice without a doubt.

reviews.title: Bad room cleaning.
reviews.text: We stayed for four days.  The room was not cleaned on a single day, despite our request.  Very bad service.  We also sent a claim no customer service and there was no response at all.  We will never go to this hotel again.

reviews.title: Great off strip option
reviews.text: Positives, value for money, great pool that stays open all year with an outdoor hottub.  The hotel is a short walk off the strip.  Directly across the street from the mall, which has several options for food, coffee etc.  The room is spacious and has a refrigerator, microwave and dishes upon request. The restaurant onsite was excellent as well.Negative - valet parking.  This is your only choice here and although it's free you should tip and have to wait 10-15 mins every time you want your car, which is annoying.  Just let me park my own car so I can come and go as I please! Also, the carpet in the room was visibly dirty.

reviews.title: good non gaming hotel
reviews.text: nice non gaming hotel..rooms are large and comfy..a little on the old side..but pretty clean even though drapes could use a deep cleaning. Service was ok nothing memorable..could use more restaurants very limited for a hotel of this size. pricing hight, $19 for a muffin and double espresso...$54 for a chicken caesar and coke with tip..I do not have to pay for Truism re-election campaign

reviews.title: Attention they do not refund room deposit
reviews.text: Great Room and view on the Strip. Unfortunately the room has not been cleaned during our stay of 2 nights (they simply put a bag with the beauty products on the door(photo). In addition I have been charged the deposit of 360$ for the room. This is simply impossible. I troed to contact them but no answer from their side. Avoid the hotel and if so do not let them charge any deposit on your credit card!!

reviews.title: Anniversary trip
reviews.text: Very pleased with the location and customer service but very displeased with the cleanliness of the bed linen and the pillows were very flimsy. The should also look into airport shuttle to and from the hotel

reviews.title: Elegant, more than comfortable, and great casino-free respite!
reviews.text: Beautiful elegant hotel with wonderful staff and guest attention. The pool was relaxing and so pretty, especially at sunset.  We loved that it is casino-free, a real respite from the craziness of being on The Strip.

reviews.title: Great property if you don't want a casino :)
reviews.text: The lack of a casino makes this property more relaxing, more clean feeling and a bit more upscale feeling.  The pool is lovely and the staff at the pool is very good.  The food and drink we had at the pool was very good, although more variety / more options would be nice.  Only real downside was that the pillows were paper thin.

reviews.title: Poop smell
reviews.text: This hotel is terrible.  It smelled of poop in my room.  The food was mediocre and the service was so slow when I requested new pillows due to the smell in the room.  It's far from the strip and around some bad areas.

reviews.title: GOOD
reviews.text: Easy to access hotel, large room equipped with microwave and hotplate but no dishes, large bathroom with separate toilet but glass door, quick arrival, valet parking only but included, easy to access and just in favor of the fashion show.Mattress finished, it was digging so much that my back hurts, the toilet was leaking, the shower handle remained in our hands, we were on the 50th floor and at night you hear club music, the train and sirens and even cars., far from everything so always a lot of walking. After 2 days, no one came to clean, I had to call to ask for clean towels and to empty the trash cans, someone came, gave us towels and a bag to empty the trash cans ourselves.I would have given 3.5 stars

reviews.title: The worst hotel service I’ve ever had
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas on October 27th and 28th, and my experience was far from satisfactory. 1. On the first day, we found a hair clip in our bed, which was not only unpleasant but also raised concerns about cleanliness and hygiene.2. We promptly informed the front desk about the issue, but to our disappointment, our sheets were not changed on the second day of our stay. This lack of response to a clear sanitation concern was disappointing.3. During our stay, one of my friends got injured when they stepped on a plant prick in the hotel's vicinity. This incident raises questions about the safety and maintenance of the hotel's grounds.4. To make matters worse, when we discussed our concerns with the front desk manager, he displayed a bad attitude and unprofessional behavior. He simply dismissed our complaints and mentioned that he had provided a $150 credit to our room as compensation, which hardly addressed the issues we encountered.Overall, our experience at the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas was marred by hygiene concerns, safety issues, and poor customer service. We expected better from a reputable establishment. It is essential for the management to take these issues seriously and implement improvements to ensure a more enjoyable and safe stay for their guests."

reviews.title: Fabulous Service at Trump International Las Vegas
reviews.text: Fabulous well run hotel in Las Vegas.  The staff in all departments are really professional and so nice from the pool staff to front desk to housekeeping, everyone is really welcoming and friendly.  One person in particular that I have to say is so amazing is this one lady in housekeeping who is incredible, her name is Yattou, she is does an amazing job.  Overall, one of the best hotels in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Terrific hotel, polite and attentive staff, with a wonderful location, just off the Strip.
reviews.text: Terrific hotel, polite and attentive staff, with a wonderful location, just off the Strip.  Our room was spacious, well equipped, and had wonderful views.  Will definitely be back as we enjoyed our stay as well as our visit to the Spa.   Although there is no casino in the hotel, you’re only a block from the Wynn/Encore complex.

reviews.title: Credit Card Charge
reviews.text: Hotel was great but extremely angry with the charge of over £1100 that was taken from my holding card after I had checked out. It was only when I contacted them that they admitted they had taken this by “accident” and would take up to 10 business days to be credited onto my card. All I received was a lame apology and no explanation as to why this was charged to my card. This was after another incident where the hotel took money from 4 separate credit cards but then said they couldn’t process the payments their end but had already taken the money. One further transaction had to be made to pay the receipt and a refund was given to the 4 cards but again taking up to 10 business days to receive the refund. This all left a very bitter taste

reviews.title: Appreciation and wonderful memories
reviews.text: I can’t express enough how much we LOVED our stay at Trump International.  Amazing!!  We left our car with the complimentary valet parking, walked through the sparkling rotating doors, and into the pristine foyer with high ceilings and massive chandelier.  We were provided fast, friendly and efficient service at the front desk.  We had two rooms booked , one for my husband and I & another for our friends.  We hadn’t seen them for  long time and decided to rendezvous in Vegas. We had VIP status with Expedia and we were anticipating an upgrade…perhaps a higher floor or better view.  We were offered an upgrade indeed… a penthouse suite!  It was unbelievable!  We felt like royalty. The suite had 5 bathrooms, 2 jetted tubs, 3 bedrooms, a massive kitchen…it was incredible.  It gave us time to visit with our friends until late into the night in a beautiful settingThe master bedroom had a his and hers bathroom with a huge richly tiled adjoining  shower.  3 shower heads and luxurious amenities.  The suite had a full size kitchen with complimentary Trump water and a coffee maker.  We loved the freshness of the non-smoking establishment with no loud casino noise. The restaurant served a delicious breakfast including a perfect omelette.  Everyone at the hotel was so welcoming and accommodating.  We were all so impressed with the standards at the Trump International.  I can’t thank them enough for the amazing stay we had there.  It was an experience we will all hold dearly in our memories. Absolute excellence.

reviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas, EXCELLENT
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, excellent service, very cordial treatment, spacious, beautiful and clean rooms, I recommend it to rest because it does not have a casino and that gives a lot of tranquility and silence to the hotel.

reviews.title: A Pleasant Stay for a Birthday at a Convenient Location
reviews.text: We chose Trump International because we didn't want to be forced to walk through smoke-filled casinos to get to our rooms every night, but there are more reasons why this place was the perfect fit for me and my family! The staff was friendly and quickly attentive to our needs. The hotel is conveniently located at the top of the Strip, but not too far north like Circus Circus or the Strat, and it is a nice distance off the Strip, away from the hustle and bustle to decompress after a long day. It is certainly walkable, and we did a mix of walking and Lyft rides between the hotel and the Strip depending on how we were feeling at the time. We chose rooms with a Strip view, and the views from the 50th floor did not disappoint! We were also celebrating a birthday, and were able to effortlessly arrange for our cake and balloons order to be delivered to our room while we were exploring for the day. We also got the Zen for Men massage at Trump Spa as a birthday gift, and he raved about the experience! All in all, we can agree that we would stay here again!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Supposedly five stars, but I dispute that rating. The room could have been cleaner (hairs all over the velour covered hide a bed sofa). shower floor was so slippery, I can't believe nobody has fallen. coffee maker in room, but no coffee or tea provided. Furniture was worn and dated.  $16 for a PB&J. Never again.

reviews.title: 2wks at trump
reviews.text: Cleanliness great staff  very help but may be not enough valet extremely busy waited 20 mins at least. Kitchen could have been stocked had to ask for basics ie bottle opener. But delivered promptly when asked. Also no daily clean had to ask again just for rubbish to be emptied.  Pool not a place to relax sun lounges that close together could not move you had to climb on not good for elderly or disabled.  When we moved them told heath and safety and put them backNo buses to strip so lots of walking and short cut of mall shuts early. You can hear the train.and some traffic But other than that you don't hear anything from other staff or customers

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Big, clean, luxurious, nice bedding, great pool area & huge master bath. Kitchen could use bigger skillet, pots & steak knifes. We always cook & maybe most people don’t in Vegas. Not a big issue. In our Florida stay we had to buy a skillet.

reviews.title: Beautiful resort and good restaurant too.
reviews.text: At first we were assigned  a room which obviously wasn’t finished being cleaned or something because soap was open and a used towel. Phone didn’t work properly. We were moved to a different one bedroom the next day and it was beautiful and had a wonderful view on the 41st floor. We both agreed the bed had seen better days and needs replaced but it wasn’t miserable. Bring earplugs! The street noise is loud even on high floors. Trains, loud motorcycles, etc. We ate at the restaurant and it was excellent! I had haddock which was huge and my husband had the DJT burger and it was the best burger ever. We will be staying here again. One can walk a few minutes to Resort World or Treasure Island, etc. The Fashion Show Mall is right across the street, a one minute walk!

reviews.title: Great Stay in Las Vegas
reviews.text: If you are looking for a quiet place in the middle of chaos, this is the one.  With no casino and no smoking it is a much quieter resort than any we have stayed at in Vegas. It is clean, spacious and staff attentive. There is no charge for umbrellas at the pool, which you definitely need if you want to protect yourself from sun. It is a bit of a walk off the strip, but during daytime hours you can cross the street and walk through the mall.

reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel
reviews.text: Top of the line service from check in to departure .  Lovely first class hotel with spa services, restaurants, gift shops.  Very professional staff. Great location  Rooms offered very nice ammenities

reviews.title: I do not recommend
reviews.text: I am outraged by this hotel. During our stay, everything went well, although they didn't clean the room even one day. But the big problem came later. I consumed snacks and drinks at the hotel pool, signing the notes, and that was it. To my surprise, when they released the security deposit, already deducting the consumption made at the hotel, I noticed that there was some extra charge, for the amount that was refunded. I contacted the hotel asking for the invoice so I could check it, and they placed two undue charges, which totaled more than 100.00 dollars. I asked the hotel for clarification and for them to check the signed notes, as I did not recognize that charge, and until today, almost a month later, no one has responded to me. The hotel simply ignored my complaint. I contacted Booking who said there was nothing they could do, as they were not responsible for this type of “problem” with the hotel. In short, avoid this hotel, because if you have problems of this type it will be almost impossible to resolve, and will prey on your money for undue charges. Very disappointed, as processing a hotel that doesn't have a branch in BR will be difficult.

reviews.title: Good option for a less noisy hotel than casinos. Very good facilities
reviews.text: A very good option if you are looking for accommodation with less noise and movement than in casino hotels. Although it is a little far from the center of the strip, it is in front of an excellent mall. Very spacious rooms and comfortable hotel.

reviews.title: Level of service is sinking
reviews.text: This hotel was on the top of my list but that was in the past. Now they have sunk to a level far below what they used to be. The building itself is fine, just like so many of the Vegas hotels but the 'service' is now sub-par. It WAS a friendly, welcoming part of arriving in Vegas, but like so many other establishments, it is operated by people and people sometime can have less than the best attitude and representation for their place of employment. It's unfortunate but true, expecting any level of quality and professional service these days is certainly not easy to find.

reviews.title: Be careful not to end up in the Hilton Vacation Club
reviews.text: The most important point: when checking in, make sure you get a room in the Trump Hotel. Some of the rooms have been sublet or sold to Hilton Vacation Club. If, like us, you get a generous upgrade to a suite, you will probably fall into exactly the same trap as we did and end up in a Hilton room like this. What's so bad about it? If you want a hotel room without daily cleaning or service, that may be right for you. Every time we asked for the room to be tidied, it was a big fuss. Sometimes they just did a refresh, which consisted of putting a plastic bag with coffee and shampoo on the counter in the kitchen and a few new towels on the chair next to it. Even a visit to the front desk and a conversation with the manager didn't help. Also notable was the arrogance of a certain manager on duty, who you'd be better off not letting loose on guests! He then explained to us that the Trump Hotel was NOT a 5-star hotel. The room itself was OK, but you could see its age. You immediately felt like you'd been transported back 15 years. But everything was intact and not broken.If you arrive by car, you should know that there is ONLY valet parking (free). But if you arrive at an inconvenient time, you will have to wait a long time for the car.But as far as all the rooms are concerned (due to the construction): noise. Yes, you really can hear every noise from outside. And because there are several large roads right behind the building, you can often hear engines roaring. Sometimes that wakes you up in the night. But that's not the worst part: the trains also go right through there. And every time, the trains use their horn, several times. You will feel as if the train is going right next to your ear. This is despite the fact that we had a room on the 35th floor. Sometimes the trains go through there at 6 a.m. and you are involuntarily woken up early. At the weekend, you can hear the bass from the club at the Hilton Hotel even though it is far away, but you could only sleep with earplugs.All in all: I would not recommend the hotel. It can't even compete with a 3 star hotel. It was my first and last time here!

reviews.title: NOT A 5 star
reviews.text: It is absolutely not possible to consider it a 5 star. Dirty rooms, UNprofessional staff.We waited more than an hour to be served for breakfast.The pool area has deafening music, no one comes to hand over towels.Absolutely NOT RECOMMENDED

reviews.title: The BEST with a family
reviews.text: Stayed at almost all 5 star hotels in vegas with the family. Trump is different. Very different:All valet parking. No fuss. No hassle. Located just off strip away from the trash but 30 seconds from the mall.High tower but small footprint.Great Gym overlooking pool.Lovely pool..amazing attentive service. Fair prices. Not pushy. No upselling. Free Iced water no problem. Big shout to Ernest.Dated yes but lovely room with terrific bathroom. Huge spa bath. Huge double sized shower. Fridge ( no mini bar nonsense). Microwave and hob.No smoking…and no casino…no teen trash. No hen or stag parties..just nice people. They have sold some of the units.. met owners..its their home…they want it well kept.Well done to all. Without hesitation this is the place to stay with a family.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel, right at the end of the strip
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, super luxurious and comfortable. Comfortable and clean beds, great shower and bathtub, beautiful pool (not so popular). The hotel is great as a whole. There was a lack of good service at the reception and a nicer restaurant for breakfast (the only restaurant option is very formal and the breakfast is not attractive and has absurd prices).It doesn't have a casino and it's almost at the end of the strip, so you need to walk a bit to restaurants and attractions. If you are with children or babies, you need to see if this distance makes sense, as it is quite hot. The shopping mall that cuts across the road also closes early.

reviews.title: Anti-Woke Las Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: This is a great anti woke hotel.  No Casinos, no smoking, Like minded Conservative guests.  Everyone is friendly and willing to do a great service for guests. We stayed here for our 50th Anniversary and were not disappointed.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: From the minute you walk it you are greeted with friendly smiling faces. Beautiful decor. Security in place. Free valet parking. Great food on site. Clean beautiful rooms that meet all your needs. Mall is walking distance.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel in lovely quiet location
reviews.text: What a room!  Was offered an upgrade to a corner suite for a small daily increase of the room we had booked and were not disappointed!!  The room was huge, had floor to ceiling windows on all sides and even had a spa bath with Las Vegas strip view along with a huge lounge/dining area, kitchen, second bathroom and beautiful bedroom with dual aspect views.  An absolute pleasure to come back to after a very hot day in Vegas.  Concierge, Niko was really friendly and helpful and booked us reduced price tickets to the Cirque du Soleil show at Treasure Island and was a pleasure to deal with.  Location is great as lovely and quiet off the strip itself.  Only small negative was there was a notification in the room about room service and one afternoon we fancied a proper pot of tea in our room after a long day out.  However, we called the number on the telephone for room service, explained what we wanted and a few minutes later a lady arrived at the door with a plastic bag full of "tea pods" and plastic milks for our coffee machine along with cardboard cups!  We went down to reception and was told we needed to order on the App which we had attempted to use but when loading was asking us for a monthly fee to be paid so we cancelled it.  We managed to get a pot of tea in the restaurant in the end but really fancied a proper relax in our room with proper crockery!  Thought calling direct to room service would be more straight forward!  Otherwise, would highly recommend as the hotel feels very upmarket and luxurious compared to some of the other hotels on the strip which are so casino and fast food orientated.  Would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: My family and I spend 10 days at Trump International and loved every second of our visit! We stayed in a beautiful 3 bedroom penthouse, which was surely the most beautiful hotel room I’ve even been in! The staff here is extremely friendly and helpful. The atmosphere is perfect, it’s a very quiet oasis only steps away from the excitement of the Vegas Strip! We will definitely return to Vegas and will ONLY stay at the Trump!

reviews.title: Not really a Trump property.
reviews.text: Over the years I had stayed in other Trump hotels in NYC and DC so I was expecting a certain quality when I booked at Trump Las Vegas. This is a totally different level of quality, much much lower. The good: The property itself is beautiful, the rooms are spacious, nice pool, great new gym, and the staff inside the hotel is not 5 star hotel quality but friendly. The Bad: no real room service, you can get some food dropped in a paper bag to your room instead. The hotel is kind of a tacky hotel blasting loud bad pop music everywhere you go especially at the pool. I could hear the music from my room on the 40th floor. Only 1 basic hotel restaurant that makes the food for the entire property. The UglyNo self parking. You have to give your car to the worst valet service I have ever seen. I wonder if the valet is handle by a 3rd party company. It is a mess. Wait forever to get your car. Wait for ever to drop your car too. It is totally disorganized. If you have Tesla insurance this valet is going to cost you big as they drive like maniacs. They are also dirty and leave your car’s window open so you can get all that desert dust all over. My advice, avoid this property especially if you have a car.

reviews.title: Modern and luxurious
reviews.text: A 5 minute walk from Streep.Very nice, clean, attractive and spacious rooms with bathroom equipped with shower and jacuzzi tub.Large, cozy beds. No casino inside and free valet parking. Hotel also suitable for children.Inside you can find a swimming pool and a gym.

reviews.title: Loved this hotel
reviews.text: Loved this hotel! Everything was perfect from the room, the view, the pool and the staff. Valet parking is free of charge. We had a complimentary room upgrade with a view of the strip and a larger room which was lovely. Complimentary bottles of Trump bottled water in our room. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Very well-equipped and quiet hotel (without casino)
reviews.text: Very well equipped and quiet hotel. This hotel does not have a casino so it is a great choice if you are looking for a quieter and restful environment, since hotels with casinos have a lot of noise and people on the ground floor as well as people entering and leaving their rooms continuously. The location is very good, in front of a large shopping center and close to the Palazzo, Venetian, etc. The rooms are very spacious and perfectly equipped, with a very complete kitchen and no skimping on towels, bath gel, etc. Good value for money. I recommend it and would return

reviews.title: Striking views and Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: Wow, been to hotels throughout vegas. This is one beautiful hotel. And very clean. Great valet at the front. Excellent service at the lobby. Service person at the elevator very personable and cordial.  And now the room. Clean. Doesn’t have the stink of drunk casino goers. Will absolutely stay here again.

reviews.title: Not really on the Strip
reviews.text: Good hotel, quiet, not having a casino, suitable if you want quality at a not exaggerated price and if you are willing to walk a bit to reach the Mirage - Cesar Palace area, as this hotel is located in a side street, all beginning of the Strip, the street with all the casinos and luxury hotels.Decent room quality and services. The catering offer is limited.

reviews.title: Will definitely be back.
reviews.text: Our 12th trip to Vegas and decided to check out Trump LV. Great hotel. Our room was fantastic. Huge shower, huge spa bath, and the room itself was bigger than expected. Staff were all friendly. Stayed a week there until we moved to a different hotel in the middle of the strip. The only down side was its a little far away from everything but we knew that before we booked it as we had a car and weren't really planning on seeing much of the strip our 1st week here. If you have a car there is no self car parking as it's all valet parking. This was great dropping the car off, but picking it up, you'll be waiting 15/20 mins for it, so just allow for this. Valet parking is all free except for the tip. Didn't try the restaurant, so not sure about that.

reviews.title: A (relatively good) choice of hotel which does not endorse anything of the label, but which was intended to be rational...
reviews.text: A (relatively good) choice of hotel which does not endorse anything of the label, but which was intended to be rational...

reviews.title: TRUMP INTERNATIONAL HOTEL LAS VEGAS NEVADA
reviews.text: The suite was absolutely plush and beautiful. We really enjoyed staying here. One issue, I left my portfolio in my rental car by accident. It was stolen by the parking attendent which it contained many receipts I needed. They took a report but nothing was "found" recommend don't leave ANYTHING in your cars EVER. They also challenged us stating we didn't have a rental car the next day. The attended mis-typed our rental car information in the database. Took us arguing over 4 hours before they would give up our car back to us. It clearly was retribution. Also should have contacted the police, but again the mgt challenged us non-stop not believing we had a rental car.

reviews.title: Best hotel on strip
reviews.text: This is the best hotel on the strip if you are looking for an oasis of quiet, an actual coffee maker, fridge and microwave in room (absent from other hotels), no casino , no smoke and they don't charge $30 for a drink at the bar.  We had late night sandwiches at DJT restaurant in the hotel.  Food was excellent.   Over the years, all vegas knows how to do now is price gouge everyone.  It is getting so obnoxious.   I have family outside of the area in utah...only reason I will go there anymore is convenience to airport.   Trump hotel 5 stars for not being obnoxious and for being next to fashion mall and convenience to shopping and restaurants.

reviews.title: Housecleaning steals
reviews.text: Housecleaning steals items left in room. I left an item on the bed when I checked out to leave and a few hours later I realized that I left my item. I did the lost and found report which I filled out 2 years ago. My lost item hasn’t been found up to this day I went here on 2021. If housecleaning really does take out the sheets of the bed then they would’ve seen my item. I’m tired of the housecleaning employees lying about not finding my item.

reviews.title: NEAR BUT OFF THE STRIP
reviews.text: The location of this property is ideal for allowing visitors to have walking distance access to the Mall and to enjoy the entertainment provided on the Las Vegas Strip, while having a quiet get away to relax at away from the hustle and bustle.

reviews.title: Never again this hotel
reviews.text: Catastrophic front desk I can only advise against visiting this hotel. I had paid for this booking in advance and was charged twice. The customer service was rude and refused to admit the error... despite receipts!!!! It was only with the help of the travel company that the money was refunded... then processing fees were deducted for their error!!! Now the complaint marathon continues... They also vehemently tried to charge the resort fee twice... even though it had already been paid!!!! Never again!!!!

reviews.title: Mixed reviews
reviews.text: We stayed here with our two girls and there are many positives about it. We loved that there wasn’t a casino in this hotel and it felt like you were escaping the hustle and bustle of Las Vegas. It was great it was right opposite a shopping mall. It was clean and easy to access the facilities.The downside was the restaurant for breakfast where the staff were fairly rude and the bedroom seemed a little tired and dated. But they were comfortable. We had to ask quite a few times for the room to have the daily clean, and Infact we had to go down at 11pm after our supper to come and make beds and clean as it wasn’t done that day. The swimming pool just felt like it wasn’t that clean either But overall it was an easy place to stay and comfortable.

reviews.title: Staff could care less, just doing their jobs!
reviews.text: Staff were not very friendly. The food was ok and very pricey. When you had a problem, staff were not good problem solvers. The room was very nice but my head was slanted back because the mattress was not even and flat. The location is not good for walking to the strip. You will have to Uber everywhere except the mall located just across the street.

reviews.title: The nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in in Vegas, but not the most expensiveThe nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in Vegas, b
reviews.text: The nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in in Vegas, but not the most expensiveThe nicest hotel we’ve ever stayed in Vegas, b

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel for family holiday
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel, easy parking, very comfortable bed, massive suites, 1 1/2.bathrooms, comfy sofa bed, comfy roll-away bed, comfy king-size bed, lots of storage, full kitchen with massive fridge/freezer, prompt room service, fantastic staff, clean, nice smelling, non-smoking, perfect temperature control, fantastic views of the strip, excellent pool area, not too expensive, ATM with reasonable charge for Vegas.  What is there not to like?

reviews.title: Not a Five Star Experience
reviews.text: If, like us, you are booking Trump expecting a highly rated five star hotel at very reasonable rates (no doubt due to issues with the Trump brand) you will be disappointed. If however you are comparing it to similar priced 3-4 star hotels, then it’s probably a good option. We stayed here for one night only (luckily) having stayed at the Palazzo and the Wynn in previous visits. There is no comparison. Trump might look five star from the outside, but it fails to deliver the five star experience. The rooms are large but dated and tired. Ours had a kitchenette which might be useful if you have kids or are staying a while. The bathroom was large and had a jacuzzi bath and a shower. however only two very small bath towels, very basic shower, basic toiletries, two tiny water bottles, thin, rough toilet paper etc etc. we didn’t really use the resort, but the gym or pool, both looked small compared with the other resorts we’ve stayed at before (Wynn and Palazzo)On the plus side, location is good and no hidden extras such as for parking (a big bonus if you are staying a long time). Trump isn’t a bad hotel but it doesn’t come close to the other five star options on the strip.

reviews.title: The Trump International Hotes in Las Vegas is great!!!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Trump Hotel for our family vacation in Las Vegas this year.  We had two wonderful suites on the corner and loved every minute of being there.  We ate at the hotel restaurant the first night, and it was delicious.  Service was excellent as was ALL the services.  The valet parking was great, the pool beautiful and refreshing.  We especially liked the extra security near the elavators.  Someone was always there to make sure only guests and authorized people were allowed up to the rooms.  All in all, the hotel was wonderful.  It was close to everything, but yet out of the way.   We plan to go back!

reviews.title: Room was not ready
reviews.text: My reservation was July 7, but our flight does not get in until July 8 early morning. I called front desk two days before our check in date and informed them about this, I was told it should be ok, they will put a note late check in and hold the room. when we checked in our room was not ready and waited for 3 hours, even after I called and informed them our arrival time and paid for the night of July 7

reviews.title: Wifes birthday party
reviews.text: I threw my wife a birthday party last Oct 2022 at Terrace 16 at Trump Int'l Hotels in Chicago. The Director of Private Events, Maria Bejar, really took care of us and did an excellent job!  She was great in communicating with us, and everything went off smoothly without a hitch. She sat all twelve of us in a semi-private room, which allowed us to enjoy the evening with some privacy. The food was excellent and well-priced. Maria sent my wife a nice birthday cake! We had a great time, and felt welcome at Trump. Thank you, Maria and team Trump! M Duque

reviews.title: Shiny exterior doesn’t translate to shining service
reviews.text: I have stayed here 2 previous times 2016 & 2018 and was quite impressed with it all. Now, the exact opposite is true. Their service has definitely lost its luster and there is NO way this is even close to a 5 star hotel now. I should have known something was amiss when upon check in I wasn't asked if I wanted to upgrade, even at an extra cost. Next was the room with the uneven bed that made me feel like I was rolling off the side every night. The street noise from the 45th floor sounds as if we don't have windows at all, and yes the fresh air vents were closed. Next, room service is now a 2GO scanning app with limited items and a DoorDash delivered feel. They even cut out the free shuttle that used to run from here to Caesar'sBut the worst part was ZERO housekeeping service. Stayed for 4 days and had to call twice to get fresh towels and garbage picked up, absolutely ridiculous; and yes we hung the SERVICE REQUESTED sign each day we left for hours on end. Super 8's turn their rooms more often.Sadly, if I visit Vegas again, this will not be on my list of places to stay. Do better, I've seen it.

reviews.title: Great Couple Experience
reviews.text: Not being big gamblers, this hotel was perfect. Great pool. No casino in Trump International but only steps away from the Fashion Mall. RTC Deuce double deck bus has a stop at Fashion Mall. Lots of reasonably priced food venues for breakfast and lunch at the mall and great service at the hotel.

reviews.title: We look forward to returning
reviews.text: We loved the Trump hotel! The staff was exceptional. We always felt welcomed and well cared for. The insulation/soundproofing was wonderful. We never heard any neighbors. Everything was clean, the bathroom was beautiful, and the bed was comfortable. The pool could have been more inspired, but it was fine. They could hire more valets; be prepared to wait for your car for awhile. Overall- it was a stellar experience.

reviews.title: Fabulous hotel and restaurant
reviews.text: Amazing hotel! Luxurious and beautiful. Great restaurant good and service. Every employee acts like it is their hotel/restaurant - empowered to answer all of your questions, get you whatever you need/want, and have great personalities.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Staying at this hotel exceeded my expectations, the rooms were clean and spacious.  The hotel had good facilities and the staff were very friendly. The pool was fantastic, the staff extremely helpful and the water was the perfect temp.The gym was being refurbished and the temporary gym was a bit disappointing but understandable.Only thing worth commenting was that housekeeping only came to clean the room once during our 4 night stay, I think it should be a bit more frequent. The hotel is a little set back from the strip but right opposite the mall which turned out to be great.

reviews.title: GREAT HOTEL GREAT LOCATION  EXCELLENT STAFF AND HOUSEKEEPING. VERY NICE AND SPACIOUS ROOMS. Good food at DJ RESTAURANT..
reviews.text: GREAT HOTEL GREAT LOCATION  EXCELLENT STAFF AND HOUSEKEEPING. VERY NICE AND SPACIOUS ROOMS. Good food at DJ RESTAURANT..

reviews.title: Sin City with a twist
reviews.text: Trump hotel is located at a convenient location. Great for ppl that wants value and not looking to spend all day and night gambling. We went to Vegas to party and sight seeing so trump hotel is perfect. Staff was awesome, room is awesome. Overall super happy with this trip.

reviews.title: EXCEEDED ALL EXPECTATIONS!!!
reviews.text: The Trump International Hotel at Las Vegas was an absolutely awesome experience! The entire staff from the valets, to check in, to the bell hops and security were all top notch.  Everyone was extremely professional, organized, conscientious and accommodating.  This hotel stay is one of the nicest experiences I've had and the staff was extremely accommodating and pet friendly to our large breed dog who joined us on the trip. The room was very spacious and clean, the beds and pillows were incredibly comfortable and the small kitchenette was a definite plus for our week long stay.  The view from the room was panoramic and you can see the LV Strip and the mountains in the distance. It's easy to get off and onto the interstate from this location and there are so many things to get to within walking distance.  I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Las Vegas and it is an extremely pet friendly hotel with lots of amenities and a very accommodating staff.  Thank you so much Mr. Trump and your staff for a wonderful week in this beautiful city!

reviews.title: Amazing Place To Stay
reviews.text: Amazing!This is by far one of the best hotels in the city. The staff are great, the hotel is kept up very well, and the rooms are expansive and comfortable. Our room was very large, had a fridge and stove top, plenty of storage areas, sitting area, huge bathroom with jacuzzi tub, double sinks, separate restroom area, huge marbled shower. This was our second stay here and I will be returning. The pool was big and luxurious and the staff there were attentive and super nice. I can't say enough good things about the Trump Resort. Thank you Mr. Trump and your staff!

reviews.title: I wouldn’t stay anywhere else in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Best hotel I have stayed at in North America so far.  It was beautiful, clean, friendly staff, excellent food in the restaurants.  The pool was great with very helpful staff that find you a good seat, lay out your towels and immediately bring you ice water and anything else you may want.  Our hotel room was beyond great, beautiful views, super clean, full kitchen with stove, microwave, dishwasher, full size sub zero fridge with ice maker and my husband’s favorite; two bathrooms.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel, great views
reviews.text: - Good location, opposite Fashion Mall- Great Views from our hotel suite on 42nd floor- Good security at reception, you need to tap in before going up on the elevators- Great amenities such a pool- Bathroom was great, fixtures were made of quality- Kitchenette in hotel suite, however you would need to call reception for plates and cutlery.- Walking distance to Venetian, Palazzo, Treasure Island etc- Walking distance to Linq Monorail- please note, there is a resort fee charge added to credit card… but well worth itWe made a great choice of booking into a hotel that doesn’t have casino at the bottom - ease of check in and check out.  I recommend making your own judgement about booking hotels with casinos by watch YouTube blogs on them!Can’t fault the Trump International Hotel

reviews.title: Definitely not 5 star
reviews.text: Pros:- No casino- off the strip, but close enough to walk (recommend going through the mall. Walking down fashion blvd is trashy, smelly and a construction zone). Still close to the hwy and it can be noisy on the back side. - the pool area is quiet and lovely. They all work very hard to keep chairs rotated. There is a fee for the cabanas poolside. - double sinks in the bathroom are a plus. Large tub and generous walk in shower. Cons:- biggest complaint was housekeeping every 3 days unless requested. Must request consumable replacements every day. We stayed 3 nights. They serviced our room once - the bed was made and towels replaced but the room was not cleaned and coffee not refilled. It was disappointing. - the rooms are showing their age. The upholstery is a little nasty 🤮 - if you have sensitivity to fragrance, bring your own toiletries!In general, we were not informed that housekeeping was still on Covid level frequency. Don’t charge top rates and provide subpar service.

reviews.title: Expected better.
reviews.text: We are currently staying on a week long booking and so far (day 3) are very disappointed with our stay.  We have  encounted problems with poor house keeping and rude barman (Saturday night in the lobby bar) Here's the issues so far: unclean room - mould in the shower and dirty and dusty carpet. Bath towels are too small and thin (not worthy of a 5 star hotel). Shower is either too cold or too hot. You have to stand there playing with the tap for 5 minutes to reach anything close to comfortable. No kitchenette equipment like glasses, cutlery and other basics. Only one disposable cup for coffee making. No "do not disturb" or " make up my room" options in our room also.Our issues at the bar where when we couldn't get 2 spots together at the bar, we walked around to the other side to another lounge area but were then told that the area was "closed". We then attempted to move a bar stool to the other end of the bar to sit together  before the barman advised this was not allowed? He made no suggestions for alternative seating and promptly decided to serve our cocktail and Shiraz in plastic cups (expecting us to walk away I presume) On a positive note,  the situation was saved by a friendly wait person that suggested we sit at one of the tables already set for meals.  BTW this all happened at 9:30 on a Saturday Night.  Not a very good experience so far from a supposed 5 star hotel. Probably not 5 star anymore as the rooms are becoming dated and worn. After 15 years it may be time to refurbish the rooms. Here's hoping the rest of our stay improves.

reviews.title: Outstanding Property with top notch staff!!!!
reviews.text: This resort is our go to resort when we go to Las Vegas. Absolutely love everything about it. Total class and professionalism from everyone !!!! We will be back every year!!! No casino so it’s a wonderful reprieve off the busy strip!!

reviews.title: Exceptional Staff and Clean Beautiful rooms!
reviews.text: This was a wonderful experience! Every single staff person that we encountered were kind, helpful and friendly! We ate at the restaurant just once, but it was delicious!  I had the avocado toast for dinner (yes for dinner) and it was incredible! The rooms were clean and beautiful and very spacious! We had 3 adults females staying in our room, and I though we would be fighting over the bathroom. Nope, they have the bathroom segregated with frosted glass, so one person could be in the shower while another was in the Toilet and the other was getting ready at one of the double sinks. It was perfect! the A/C was on point and we were able to adjust it to our liking! It did have a mini fridge and a microwave which was nice. It also had a 3 burner stove top, which we didn't use. There were no pans or items in the cupboards but with how helpful everyone was, I'm sure they would have brought us what ever we asked for. We had them bring up safety pins and scissors one day while we were getting ready for one of our nights out for the bachelorette. "absolutely, no problem"  was always the response. There were NO BED BUGS! I say that in caps because it's super important me, especially in Vegas to be in a bed bug free hotel. They had zipped mattress covers. I pulled the sheets off both double beds and lifted each mattress to look for rusty droppings. NOTHING! Totally clean! The pool is clean and quiet which is rare in vegas! Also, we got to ride in the Trump 2 escalade to the airport, so much fun. PS our driver was amazing and super friendly!  I will definitely stay at this hotel again!

reviews.title: Trump International was beyond our expectations!
reviews.text: We recently went with family and friends and stayed in 5 rooms at the Trump International in Las Vegas.  Everyone had an amazing time.  It was very relaxing and had plenty of access to everything that Vegas has to offer.  The rooms were immaculate, even my mom had no complaints!

reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: Try to get the view that you can see the Main Street of Vegas, otherwise it’s boring. The room is very big, and that’s about it. It feels very old, the pool is not impressive and it’s small. It’s about 7 minutes walk to the nearest casino and eating place which is in the Wynns. And Macy’s is right across the street from Trump International. If you can get the room in the high level with the good view of the street, go for it, other wise it’s okay. Though it’s not as busy and noisy, away from the chaos of Vegas. About 40 minutes walk to New York New York.

reviews.title: 5* Indeed
reviews.text: We we’re n room 2207 and it was amazing. Corner room and 5* doesn’t do it justice. Living room, bedroom, 2 bathrooms, full size kitchen, ect… Velet parking was a breeze, and everyone was ready to assist in any way possible. Can’t wait to get back soon

reviews.title: Excellent hotel away from all the noise and riff-raff
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed her for four nights.  Away from all the noise and crowds but a ten minute Uber ride from anywhere you want to go.   Our room was excellent.  We liked having a fridge but didn't use the stove.   Across the street was a shopping mall which had multiple restaurants so this was handy.  If you want to see some sights, catch a few shows, go out for some nice meals and do a little shopping then this is a great place to stay.  It is too far to walk to the main area of the strip especially with the hot weather.  We have stayed at Delano and Vdara before and we liked those places but this was better.  Maybe not the best choice if you want to drink party and gamble.  Then again drinking partying and gambling are not the best choice anyways but eventually you will figure that out for yourself if you have not already.

reviews.title: Classy hotel, good location
reviews.text: Very classy hotel in a great location just off the strip. The staff were all professional and knowledgeable. Our room was huge and quiet. The cocktails at the restaurant were amazing. We still talk about them months later. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Donald Trump would not be Happy with the degradation in service.
reviews.text: The building is still magnificent, but there are some major service issues that I have yet to experience in the past. They no longer service your room daily. So I called on day 2 to have our room serviced, and they kindly agreed but failed to do so. On Day 3 I called to get our room serviced, and they kindly agreed but DID NOT do so. Only on day #4 did they clean our room, provide new sheets, and remove the waste in the garbage cans. DJT, would never stand for this! They also have a major parking issue. On Friday note at 8:30 PM,  we waited 25 minutes to give our car to the valet. Cars were backed up on each side of the street out in front of the Hotel. Not having a person directing cars and the lack of staff often leads to this mess. It is not the Trump Hotel of the past. Sadly it will be my last stay.

reviews.title: Our Trip to Vegas
reviews.text: This Resort is one of the best we’ve stayed in and we’ve had timeshare for 37 Yrs and used it all over the world.The resort is a five or six star resort with all the amenities you could wish for from Gym Spa, Pool ,great restaurant which you could order your meal to go, which families did with small children.Our unit was on the 22nd floor which was huge with everything you needed in it. The staff went above and beyond to make sure all your needs were met so you could relax and enjoy your stay.When you first arrive you are met with the most beautiful chandeliers everywhere.A fun place to stay and can’t wait to return some day…

reviews.title: This is are go to place for LV
reviews.text: Say what you want about the man but he sure knows how to build Hotels. Get the strip view rooms. Ours was on the 47 floor and what a view. The only disappointment was the bathroom, it had a combined tub shower. The other room we had was separate. It also had a kitchenette.

reviews.title: Just average
reviews.text: Pros:1) Big rooms/ big bathrooms2) Not modernized as Wynn 3) Comfortable bedsCons:1) Restaurant has ONLY ONE vegetarian dish on the menu ( Avacado toast) + Juices are from the can :(2) Service is slow in the rooms3) Hotel does not arrange cabs

reviews.title: Overall, a good stay
reviews.text: Check in, valet, bell boys all excellent..Room slightly dated, good sized, comfortable bed, great spa bath, large but rather weak shower.  Sink was slow to empty. Room was clean. Coffee making facilities. Bell boy organised for tea to be sent up but this did take chasing. No robes or slippers which we had to chase. Slippers arrived, no robes, had to chase again.. Had a pool day, which was very nice, excellent pool staff, and nice pool with seating. Came back at 2pm and room not serviced. When we phoned down were told it might not be serviced before 6pm as standard unless specifically requested early service?? Never had this anywhere before. We requested towels and left room unserviced. Short walk to the strip. Nice that there was no casinoBarman was rather surly. He was on his own, so maybe stressed, but didn’t acknowledge we were waiting for quite a while. Liked the extra security, though there are no safes. Would still recommend and stay again. Small niggles really.

reviews.title: Real 5 Star
reviews.text: I've stayed at most of the hotels and casinos on the strip, the Trump hotel is the best, true quality.  Friendly staff and good location.Close to great shopping, too.Lovely pool area. The food is fantastic, I recommend Capitol Grill 2 minutes walk from here.

reviews.title: excellent
reviews.text: Everything very nice, the only thing is that they don´t clean every day, only every 4 days...the rest was great....................................................................................................

reviews.title: Luxury shopping and trains
reviews.text: The hotel services were great! the fashion mall nearby was a great escape from the casinos. As a kid always enjoyed the trains sounds as they are passing by. the vales were very efficient and truly safe guarded our vehicle!

reviews.title: Tired rooms and non existent housekeeping, nice pool, great security staff
reviews.text: Stayed at Trump International 21st to 25th April. Check in was quick and easy. Was asked if we'd stayed there before and as we hadn't, was given an info sheet on the hotel. Security is fab and you have to scan your room key via a security guard to gain access to the lifts to get to your room. The room unfortunately was not 5* standard, it was very dated, drab and to be honest battered, but it was clean. It was a decent size though and had a nice bathroom, but I wasn't sold on the glass toilet door, but maybe that's just me. Having a microwave and refrigerator was a bonus, we didn't use the kitchen area other than that but if you want to, you have to request untensils, plates and cutlery. There was also free bottled water provided and a coffee machine with a few coffee pods. This would have been a nice thing to use but as we only saw housekeeping once, on our first day, and never again, we never got any water or coffee refills. I did query this with reception and they confirmed housekeeping should have been daily and insinuated the problem must have been mine and did I have the do not disturb sign on the door. That would have been hard as there wasn't one in our room. They did eventually refund 2 days resort fees but it was a fight to get anything. The pool area was very nice and the pool attendants can't do enough for you. They do whip your towels back quick if you turn your back though. I popped back to my room to get something and when I returned, 10 mins later, my sunbed had been stripped. If the pool area was full I could understand it, but it wasn't. The hotel itself advertises itself as a strip hotel, it is not. It may only be 1 block off the strip but you do have to navigate past the homeless people and a dirty great open lot/piece of scrubland. We did walk it as a couple but I wouldn't walk it on my own. For us, it was also at the wrong end of the strip. We didn't think we would miss having a casino right downstairs, but we did. That's just our view and others might like the casino free environment. All in all, would we stay here again, it's a definite no.

reviews.title: Great overall for right person
reviews.text: Overall we really enjoyed our stay at The Trump.  Large clean rooms, incredibly fast room service, quieter slightly off the strip location, very fair prices, nice pool and great spa.   The only downside is the dining on site is limited.We would happily stay there again.

reviews.title: Trump does not disappoint
reviews.text: This was a trip that I put together for my entire family and we have been looking forward to for the past year.  The Trump resort made it possible for us to travel to several destinations and take in so many of the sights that surrounds Vegas.  We were also within walking distance of the strip without the hustle and bustle of the casinos.  The staff was kind, friendly, and helpful.  10 out of 10 recommend!

Such a beautiful, clean hotel with friendly staff! We stayed for the week and had an easy check in/ check out. Our room got upgraded and it was very spacious with a kitchen and living room, big bathroom with a tub. I can’t say enough good things about Trump Hotel.

reviews.title: Our favorite hotel
reviews.text: Everything about this hotel  is 5 star. The service is outstanding. The rooms are spacious, clean and has everything you could need. Stayed 5 days. We dont need the casino so this is great and quiet. Always come here when in Vegas.

reviews.title: Wonderful!!
reviews.text: We loved our 900 foot square suite. We had 2 bathrooms and 2 showers. The view of the strip was wonderful. We had a full kitchen as well. The room was quiet on the 56th floor. The higher floors had a separate elevator. We appreciated the water each day and coffee in the room. The main bathroom was huge. A huge tub as well and double sink vanity. Comfy robes were provided as well. I really enjoyed staying at the hotel. In the morning in the lobby a nice selection of coffee and pastries are available to go. Or, you can eat at the restaurant which we found was very good. The coffee, cappuccino, and almond croissants were excellent. I asked for a late check out and they were gracious. Non smoking, non gaming, and quiet. Perfect!!!

reviews.title: Middle of the road Trump
reviews.text: Located a little off-centre, Trump International is well located over the road from the extensive Fashion Show Mall and for those intending to partake of the Wynn Buffet. Rooms are clean and spacious with a taste of luxury in the bedding and bathroom. The rest is pretty standard hotel offering, perhaps just a bit dated and with an unnecessary huge bank of drawers and cupboards. Reception is efficient as is concierge. Breakfast was not tried.

reviews.title: Noise is an issue
reviews.text: The noise from the bands that are at adjacent hotels is beyond safe noise levels. We were on the 41st floor and the beat from base drum   permeated our room. The noise went on way into the night. Ear plugs are a must for a good night's sleep.The jets in the jacuzzi tub did not work even after hotel engineering attempted twice.The employees are courteous and helpful and that's the only good thing about the hotel.Think twice before reserving a room here.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: As always another fantastic stay at the Trump Hotel Las Vegas. I appreciate the early check in and the the staff is always top notch. I do however, wish they would have the shuttle to the Wynn and  Caesars Palace.

reviews.title: On the whole an amazing Hotel.
reviews.text: Trump International is an amazing hotel, lovely spacious rooms. Marble bathroom with large whirlpool bath and large shower cubicle.Staff very friendly but professional easy check in with no issues. Pool lovely area my only gripe would be the waiter who seemed to favour certain guests took him 3 days before saying “you guys ok?” Yeah we were ok and could manage to get ourselves off the sunbeds and get our own drinks thanks!We had breakfast most days in the DJT restaurant lovely food eggs Benedict was awesome and we had 2 dinners at DJT first meal was excellent however the second was not such a good experience tbh, we were still eating our starter when a strange waiter brought our mains over and although I was still eating moved my soup bowl over, when later asked if our meal was ok but our regular waiter I did comment about the service and the fact the food was cold, he offered complimentary desserts which we declined, it had spoilt the meal by then. Bit disappointing considering the cost of the meals quite pricey!Other than the 2 comments and issues I would have given top scores and if I do ever return to Vegas 🤷‍♀️I will definitely be staying at the Trump.

reviews.title: Outstanding staff making a memorable stay.
reviews.text: Excellent stay on two separate occasions during our trip.Beautiful hotel in good location.We found the staff outstanding and were polite, friendly, reactive and always smiling.Special thanks to both Jason and Ian to whom checked us in on each occasion. They were professional, polite and made us feel very welcome.Very reassuring to have friendly staff checking key cards on entering room elevators.We booked both rooms overlooking the strip and were large, very well equipped on firstly, the 48th floor and secondly on the 50th floor.Only issue we experienced during second stay (5 nights) were the lack of regular house keeping. This was addressed during our stay and satisfactorily resolved.

reviews.title: Very good experience.
reviews.text: We are staying here several times and every time is a great time and experience. Highly recommended. Good location, great rooms, great service, everything is great, not a single complain. I hope to be back soon.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Very good hotel, the only problem is that it is not on the strip.The rooms are big, the bathrooms are great, the gym is spectacular and the pool is also very good.I would also hire someone speaking Spanish or Castilian to help visitors

reviews.title: Trump Tower Las Vegas
reviews.text: Was best stay ever and loved the service the room was huge for 1 bedroom was first class all the way.Would go back anytime we could loved it felt special staying there.Came here last year will come back next year

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Very very clean, nice finishes, good quality hotel. Slightly worn over the years but nothing in the hotel is cheap. Staff are wonderful and extremely friendly, breakfast was top notch. Would 100% stay here again, plenty of pool loungers, pool large and not busy even when the hotel is busy.

reviews.title: We loved it!
reviews.text: Read some of the negative reviews on here and was a bit worried about our 7 night stay here. Really no need the hotel and it’s staff and facilities are excellent! No casino, no smoking and a short distance from the main strip made this the ideal location for us. Room excellent, bed comfortable and the nice little touches in the room made our stay really enjoyable. Seen previous comments about the lack of housekeeping, absolute rubbish, just press the button by the room door which alerts the staff you want your room cleaned and bingo! Ours was cleaned every day, fresh towels, linen and water / coffee etc… Pool was excellent and beds available any time of day, staff were efficient and polite and you were always asked if you wanted drinks / food etc… For us, we couldn’t fault it. We wouldn’t hesitate in returning in the future.

reviews.title: Absolutely Horrible Experience!!!!
reviews.text: We received an offer from Hilton Grand Vacations (HGV) for 4days/3 nights in Vegas at the Trump hotel. We decided to make this our annual anniversary trip and extended it to 6 nights, through HGV. We also elected to go through the hotel itself and add another 2 nights. My wife had never been to Vegas before, so we made plans to go to Hoover Dam, Grand Canyon, and doo stuff around town. We're not big gamblers, but obviously there are a lot more things to do there then that. I booked 1 bedroom suite through HGV and when I went through the hotel for the additional 2 nights, I asked the lady if we could stay in the same room with 2 different confirmations. She said yes, as long as you book the same kind of room, which we did. Upon arrival, we found the staff to be friendly. We had rented a power wheelchair for my wife that was delivered the day before we arrived. They kept it in the back for us. So, all was well starting off. The room was spacious and we really liked the suite layout have a living room, dining area, kitchen with dishes/silverware/cookware, full size fridge with ice maker, and separate bedroom. It was odd, but the fridge turned off several times a day. It also had 2 full baths. We are not much on bring home dirty clothes, so when we stay where they have washer/dryer, we do our laundry before traveling back home. This suite was equipped with a washer/dryer combo. After our 5th night, we decided to do laundry, but could not get the machine to work. We called downstairs and they were going to have someone come up there and show us. After an hour, I called back and was told the washer/dryer in that room was out of service. They offered for us to move suites at the other end of the hall, which we did. Upon getting settled in, I found the ice maker didn't work and the ice machine was at the other end of the hotel. So, I had to make trips when we needed ice, not the end of the world. After our 6th night of our original reservation with Hilton, I stopped by the desk on the way out to make sure all was well with transitioning into the other reservation. The lady told me I had to move rooms, to which I responded with a firm "no, I'm not!". She went and got the manager, Jake Jacobsen, who told me that there are rooms there that are owned by HGV and the others are owned by the Hotel, that's why I had to move... again!! This time I went from the 44th floor to the 52nd. I explained to him what I was told by the lady I spoke with making the reservation and he had a smirky smile and told me "I'm sorry, that was not accurate information and we had no choice but to move again."We were one the way out and I told him we weren't moving anything until we got back, which would be later that evening. That didn't seem to be a problem. So, we packed up again and moved up 8 floors to an identical suite. Upon getting settled for a 3rd time, in our 3rd room, we noticed the door in the bathroom was locked where the washer/dryer was located. We also noticed there were no dishes/silverware/cookware, nothing in the kitchen at all. I made another trip down to visit Mr. Jacobsen to ask about this. He proceeded to tell me that booking through the hotel, you don't get the same amenities that you get when booking through HGV. There is no washer/dryer in these rooms. You have to request dishes/silverware and all that upon making the reservation. I proceeded to ask Mr. Jacobsen just how long he planned on my laying down and taking the bull$h!t he has handed me over the last couple of days. He stood there smiling, which elevated my anger even more. At this time, I was weighing out the options of satisfying my anger with this guy and going to jail, or walk away. Thankfully, I chose the latter. Mr. Jacobsen offered me to bring all my clothes downstairs by 9:00a and he would have them laundered and back by 5:00p. I asked him how in the hell he expected me to trust him at this point. Again, he just stood and smiled. Seeing how they ran their hotel, there was no way I would trust him with my personal belongings.I would strongly encourage everyone to avoid this hotel like the plague. We chose not to let it ruin our anniversary trip, but this place absolutely sucks! You only get your room cleaned on the 5th day. Any options for service before then results in an upcharge. If I could give them negative stars, I certainly would. I'm glad Trump ran the country far better than his people run his hotels. Typing this out makes me angry all over again. You have 1000 options for hotel stay in Vegas. I chose Trump hotel. Don't be like me. Go somewhere else.

reviews.title: Over an hour waiting to check in
reviews.text: We did an RCI timeshare trade to get into trump International.   RCI gave them the two names.  but Trump only put one name on the reservation.  We had a booking confirmation with both names, but since the Trump folks only put one name into their system, they would not let us check in.  We had to  contact RCI, Hilton vacations,  etc.  To have them resend the reservation info to Trump.  But the trump front desk would not accept the email until their "system " updated" two hour waiting in the lobby for a system update.  Never coming here again.

reviews.title: Good Hotel
reviews.text: A great hotel.  Clean, beautiful, secure.  Downsides are railroad tracks nearby and access for drop-off and pickup is chaotic.  The restaurant was pricey, but there’s a mall across the street with many food options.

reviews.title: Best Hotel, Best President, Best customer service bar none.
reviews.text: Take it from someone that has been going to Vegas for parties, golf, and concerts for 40 years. This hotel has the best customer service in Vegas. I hate outting this place because I would rather keep that on the down low.

reviews.title: A giant neon advertising sign for ya Man.
reviews.text: Please understand that this Hotel is NOT on the Strip. It’s disconnected from anything at all. No Casino, no real bar, just a small restaurant in the lobby. So you will be getting Uber/Cabs/Walking. A lot. Pricing in the Vegas hotel market is very efficient, so don’t be fooled (like I was) by the suggestion that this is a 5-star bargain. The rooms are spacious but a little rough around the edges. An older crowd here than the strip hotels, so you might want that? Constant Country music drove me to leave the pool area, which is otherwise the best thing about this hotel.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Only the facade of the hotel is luxurious, the interior neither works nor looks like it should. If you stay more than one night don't expect room cleaning because they don't do that!! So you ask them to at least bring clean towels, you call after another 30 minutes to remind them. You get them in an hour. The rooms have old furniture and dust everywhere, no bathrobe, no slippers, coffee machine not working. THIS IS FIVE STARS?!?!

reviews.title: Would have given this hotel 5-stars if the night time front-desk people had been actually helpful and not rude.
reviews.text: Would have given this hotel 5-stars if the night time front-desk people had been actually helpful and not rude.

reviews.title: 5-Star Hotel with service that is not up to the standard
reviews.text: The Hotel is rated as a 5-Star Hotel. The Installations are clearly up to it, but the service is not. We stayed two nights, our room was not cleaned when we came back the first day. The reason given was a lack of personnel which is clearly unacceptable. After having spoken to the Housekeeping Manager he promised to send somebody to at least get some amenities and towels. We even agreed on a time, but nobody showed up. Only after the second call we received towels. This is the main reason for the low qualification .

reviews.title: May be the best place to stay for conventions in LV
reviews.text: Quiet, Clean, no casino, no smoke. Easy 5 min. cab or rideshare to LVCC. Full kitchen (bring your own pan, cups, and utensils) with Keurig style coffee maker. Dishwasher (bring some dishwasher pods) and our room even had a laundry machine. The restaurant food was delicious and the staff was friendly. There was no wait for breakfast or dinner any night we were there, saving us time compared to the big casino hotels we normally stay in.

reviews.title: There’s no place quite like it!
reviews.text: This is now the second time we stayed at the Trump International Las Vegas and it just keeps getting better. This time we were on a Make-a-Wish trip for our daughter and the staff couldn’t be nicer. The room was immaculate, and the staff from valet to front desk were so thoughtful and professional knowing how special this trip was for us. With its unique location, just off the strip, you never few like you are in the middle of all the craziness. It was really a trip of a lifetime. Thank you Trump International for making our last visit so memorable!

reviews.title: Classy Place with Great Service
reviews.text: This is my third visit here. It is such a great place to stay. Love that it is a Hilton affiliate. We have a one-bedroom suite on the 26th floor, overlooking the Las Vegas Strip. The room is top-notch quality. Two bathrooms, but the Main Bathroom is palatial  - just gorgeous. So glad there isn't a casino attached or a bunch of kids running around - everywhere!

reviews.title: A Very Good Experience Overall
reviews.text: Good:1. Kitchen (Fridge; Stove Top; Microwave)2. Free Water3. Nice Spacious room4. Jacuzzi5. Security - You have to scan your pass to get to the elevator section (we notice not every hotel does this)6.Quality - Room Quality is as good as Luxury Hotels7. Price Point - I felt we were getting Luxury level quality but at a reduced price. We used the money saved on other things while visiting Vegas.8. Clean air Bad:1. Some items were not working initially but were fixed (specifically the Stove Top, Jacuzzi and Table Lamp).2. Lack of USB ports. Our initial room had a clock radio that had 2 USB in it but our other room did not. Having said that, some may argue that it should be USB-C now, so maybe it was smarter for the Hotel not to put any for now. Just make sure to come prepared with wire and the proper plug in.3. Location - It is not on the Strip. To get to the strip will depend on what time of day. During the day, you can go thru the Fashion Show Mall and get to the Trump via Nordstrom. But during the night, the Mall is closed and you could either take a taxi/uber or just walk (the walking is around 10 minutes & there is less people in that area).4. No Casino - This is not necessarily a negative, some may see it as a positive.5. Only 1 Restaurant - If you are looking for something other than the Trump Hotel Restaurant, you can always go across the street to Fashion Show Mall and get some other food. For cheap eats (there was Earl of Sandwich close to the Nordstrom which I liked) & there are some some highly rated restaurants in the Fashion Show Mall as well.Overall, a very good experience. The negative points were very minor in my opinion. I Recommend the Trump International Hotel to anyone that is reading this.

reviews.title: A Vegas Haven
reviews.text: I was comped three nights at another hotel on the strip, but I was so repulsed by the smell of pot and cigarettes everywhere that I left after one night and checked into Trump. What a difference. All class at Trump. Beautiful rooms, professional staff and good food. The pool is ideal for those that want a relaxing day with very comfortable loungers (free umbrellas even, imagine that!) At night the bar provides good strong cocktails to accompany quality dining. A nice peaceful breakfast too. I am too old for the new Vegas of pot smoke and pool parties. Trump is my new go to in Vegas. If I want a casino, I’ll get an Uber for $9 and wade through casinos with smoke and noise and the people that like that stuff. Also, directly across the street is a mall with some food offerings and lots of stores. The security at Trump is phenomenal too. Very nice and protective of the guests. Great experience!

reviews.title: Dirty and no management
reviews.text: Overall, dirty hotel. We stayed 4 nights, we had our room cleaned once. Ended up having to call for service because of the lack of room service. Ran out of clean towels, toiletries, etc. Even the vent was caked up with dust. Management doesn’t care about the condition of rooms.

reviews.title: Island of elegance and great taste
reviews.text: We dropped in just for coffee & tea & ice cream &pastry. The place is outstandingly elegant and the prices are reasonable. The staff is exceptionally friendly and helpful.  We bought some souvenirs at the little shop where the lady was absolutely wonderful.

reviews.title: This resort ticks all the boxes! ✅
reviews.text: The checkin was flawless, with our one bedroom suite ready at our arrival around 2 pm. The suite was quite large with a separate bedroom, 2 bathrooms and 2 showers, and a full kitchen.  We did not have maid service daily, but it did not bother us.  We did have a towel refresh midweek only.  We really enjoyed hanging by the quiet pool.  Getting chairs is never an issue, it is quiet and very clean.  We always spend on drinks and food by the pool, so we would rent one of the $100 sun beds, and that gave you a $100 credit to use on purchases. Perfect!  The service by the pool was very efficient and the bloody Mary’s delicious served with bacon and a large shrimp.  We ate in the restaurants only once for breakfast and had the best Huevo Ranchero Eggs, yum!!The hotel is perfectly situated in our view, across the street from the high end mall and the Wynn Hotel.  Be aware that there is a train track near by that whistles around 4 times a day or night.  Takes a few days to be able to ignore it ans sleep through that annoying sound.

reviews.title: Employees Make it Great
reviews.text: Can't wait to visit Las Vegas and the Trump Hotel again! We did not want to stay in a casino hotel with all the smoke. This was perfect for us, close enough to the strip to walk over to have dinner. The room was nice, especially with the kitchenette, but the greatest strength at this hotel is the employees. Everyone was friendly and helpful. It was weird they didn't clean daily but they brought fresh towels, coffee, etc whenever we requested. We also noticed the people staying here were friendly which made it an even more pleasant stay. I appreciated security key check before allowing you to go up to the rooms.  The pool is beautiful and the pool attendants were helpful. One thing to change would be the pillows, no support at all, I had to use three.
