All in all, it will be our first choice when looking for a hotel in Las Vegas next time we can get away.

reviews.title: 5 star experience. Look no further
reviews.text: Excellent place to stay in Vegas. I was looking for somewhere to stay in Vegas that met my needs. Non smoking, quiet, close to the strip, great price and value. Trump international met all those from the smooth check in process, upscale rooms, 5 minute walk to the strip so I was still close to the action but at night I had somewhere quiet to get some rest. Definitely staying here again. Final comment. Everyone that works at this hotel is so nice and you can tell they enjoy working here. Just book it! It’s one of the few hotels without a casino which cuts down on the foot traffic.

reviews.title: An OK hotel, but just the worst (lousy) service, very disappointing.
reviews.text: This stay was to be very special for us and way stretched our budget but seemed a bucket list opportunity. Nice room but trying to order room service tonight took two hours and was an absolute debacle. Room service would not send us a menu (despite the order app being down) and told us bluntly to go down to the bar and order, your meal will be delivered to your room. OK, did that, but then got told that we had to return to the lobby and pick up our own dinner! It was in a paper sack like Uber eats and stone cold. All this while being treated like a third world citizen. We are so unhappy with the service that we considered checking out but that would cost more than we can afford. All I can say is that the hard product is quite nice but the customer service is absolutely appalling. We will be sure to eat elsewhere during our stay.

reviews.title: Not a 5 star hotel, 3 would be generous!
reviews.text: This is the first hotel I have stayed at in the world where “housekeeping” only appear upon request and then only if you are lucky. Stayed here for 4 nights after a cruise, no comparison. Towels changed twice a day on the cruise, once in 4 days in this hotel. Bottled water & coffee not replaced after day 1. Only good point is the pool……..plenty of beds and well staffed. Up your game Donald !!

reviews.title: Double charge with no resolution
reviews.text: Hello I stayed at the hotel in Las Vegas with the above reference number .My booking was made via booking . Com and I paid for the booking on the 27th March 2023 which was $1077 . The booking includes the room total and the resort fee as attached .However on upon check in I swiped my card as the damage deposit and for any charges that may occur during the stay . Upon in check out the receptionist stated there was nothing to pay as everything was pre paid .However on the 6th April you charged my card ending 2012 the full amount of $1077 again as shown belowThis is an incorrect charge as I have already paid for the room and resort fees and all taxes on the 27th and as per the booking conditions .I called the hotel on the 9th April and spoke to Eric who explained the charge was in error and would refund the stay but was unable to refund the resort fees as this is only ever paid at the hotel . I explained multiple times that my original booking included resort fees and taxes and sent a picture of my booking confirmation and he stated I was wrong ….I explained that if there was an additional charge how come both booking.com and trump charged me $1077. He couldn’t answer that and stated I needed to take it up with booking.com . I stated that Trump charged me incorrectly .I have currently been refunded $855.92 but I require the additional $221.10 (resort fees and taxes ) to be refunded , as this was included in the original booking fee.Additionally I have now enquired additional charges for this error . As I’m from the UK I got charged £25 in a foreign transaction fee that i require to be refunded as you can see circled belowAlso I have incurred a phone call charge from calling your hotel to get this rectified , which is £52. You can see this below with your telephone number statedThis additional cost of £77 at current exchange rate is $95So I require $221 dollars and $95 to be refunded to me .This is very frustrating as I have stayed at Trump twice now , and last year I stayed for my wedding . I did have another booking for September that I have now had to cancel as I’m concerned I will be charged twice , and even though I have illustrated the overcharge I am yet to be compensated .I messaged the hotel today and they provided this email .Thank youNikolay Ivanov

reviews.title: Easily A 5 Star Rating
reviews.text: This is the best hotel we have ever stayed in.  Service and security are beyond anything we have ever experienced anywhere else we have stayed.   We stayed in a “ superior” King room on the 52nd floor that had both a shower and jacuzzi tub.  The bathroom was huge and had a double bowl vanity with storage places below.  The restaurant was the best that we experienced in Vegas.  Service was excellent and seating is spaced far enough apart so that you can enjoy a conversation while dining.  Overall a fantastic hotel that is well worth the price.

reviews.title: Relaxing week at Trump Int
reviews.text: Resort was 5 star, excellent and very well maintained. Courteous, professional staff. Quick sign in/out, no resort fees. Large studio, double closets, safe, 12x15'bathroom (oversize 2 person jet tub/ large shower). Large pool, hot tub and exercise facilities were very well maintained. Fashion mall across the street with restaurants, food court , ABC store, etc. 1 block to Wynn and Venetian, 10 min walk to Caesars and center of the Strip. We are booked for Apr and Oct this year

reviews.title: Trump for the win!
reviews.text: From check-in to check-out, we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Trump.  Just 1/2 block off the strip made this a perfect location without all the craziness of non-guests walking in and out of the hotel.  I'll return to the Trump for all my future Vegas stays.

reviews.title: Nice place for a short stay
reviews.text: We chose the property because of it's closeness to Resort World and availability while in Vegas for a concert.  There was nothing wrong with the hotel.  It was very busy while we were there and if you use the complementary valet parking (the only parking option available), it can become an inconvenience having to wait for your car or for traffic to clear out of the driveway.  Dining is limited and it is a little more than a short walk to the next closest options.  We had a flexible schedule but only stayed 3 nights (was reserved for 7).  All staff we interacted with were exceptionally friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Disappointing Stay
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Trump several times before. This time we had 2 units..one unit was never cleaned during our 7 day stay. It took 3 attempts to get a feather free room as only partial job done in the beginning and lack of language understanding. If i hadn't noticed the comforter i would have had serious health issues

reviews.title: Definitely NOT Like Trump Chicago
reviews.text: I guess I should have known with the cheap prices that this would be a “Hampton Inn” like hotel. Don’t get me wrong the lobby is beautiful and the DJT restaurant was amazing but the service and the rooms SUCKED! We were actually downgraded just to get a room. They didn’t even comp us in any way. The carpet in the rooms was not soft (yes that sounds petty) but it reminded me more of burlap. We are visiting Vegas again in December and will NOT be staying here. But will visit DJT for dinner.

reviews.title: Terrible value
reviews.text: Not a good value.  So many other places in Vegas were a better value for the price.  This Hotel has a smell to it and needs refreshing.   0 stars.  Would not recommend.   The only thing good was the location, but there are better options.

reviews.title: Needs some work! Lost it's touch.
reviews.text: We have stayed here a couple of times prior and it was amazing pre-covid. It is simply not as good as it was. Check-in was easy, got upgraded due to Expedia gold vip status, was quick and easy. The carpet in the room was filthy - we can deal with that, the hotel is getting a bit old and things wear down. We asked for some dishes and they brought them up quickly. The main issue is with housekeeping, they ask that you notify them if you require housekeeping daily and we notified them daily. We did not come to Vegas to make beds and clean up!! We did not pay to stay at a hotel to clean up! Everyday there was at least one issue with housekeeping, no vacuuming, robes taken and not replaced, sofa bed not put away, no decaf coffee pods, the list goes on and on. Then a call to the front desk and magically the next day everything is completed. We should not have to call the front desk every day to complain about housekeeping. After covid there is no excuse to not do this daily. Pool was a bit cold (if the weather is not above 20 be prepared to deal with a cooler pool). We didn't mind much as we are use to the cold but lots of people did not enter the pool as they were not use to the cooler temperatures. They say it's heated to 84 degrees, but the pool doesn't retain the heat when it's cold and windy. They should pump it up for those days but do nothing. No outside food allowed onto the pool deck, I don't remember this being an issue prior - food choices are not good for kids, and a smoothie for kids is $14-16 + tax + tip, ridiculous pricing for a kids smoothie. Save your pool chair and money, and go across to Nordstrom to get the kids smoothies. Other than a few of these issues the stay was great. No noise at night, did not hear the train, ask for a high floor, mall has improved their food choices over the past years, easy walk to the Wynn...no more shuttle service to Caesars or the Wynn, that was a nice feature with kids. Resort fees are too high especially if housekeeping is bad and you don't park a car, and you can't bring any outside food or drinks to the pool. We will likely not stay here again, has lost it's touch. We stay here mainly since there is no casino and no smoking but I think housekeeping is a must and being flexible with kids at the pool with food is required. No door man anymore either. Gym is convenient and close to pool which is a nice feature.

reviews.title: Getting run down
reviews.text: We have been staying at the Trump hotel for the last several years and it's been very nice. Although still nice I believe it's gone from a five-star hotel to a four-star hotel. The carpeting in the room was dirty there is no house cleaning service for 3 days while we were there the bath room itself was not as clean as one would expect from a Trump hotel.Eric if you're listening time for a remodel.

reviews.title: Trump Hotel so very nice!
reviews.text: Wonderful experience. Everyone was pleasant and helpful. Didn’t lack for anything. Pool was lovely and well maintained. Lifeguards on duty!The suite was lovely and well appointed. We called for pans, dishes and utensils since hotel doesn’t stock them in room. Kitchen had full size refrigerator and appliances. View was amazing. We loved the bed and bedding and nice soft water. At the hotel were couples, business folks, conventioneers, families with children and of course lots of dogs! They had wonderful valet parking, too!

reviews.title: Shocked at how many stars this place had
reviews.text: I was woken up all hours of the night because the street behind the hotel is a common drag racing street. This was verified by a porter at the Wynn but when I spoke to the manager at Trump he acted like I was crazy he said this is an isolated complaint that they’ve never had before so it’s invalid and they wouldn’t even comp a resort fee but that’s fine although it would have been nice if he acknowledged it and didn’t act like I was crazy. The rooms are similar to an extended stay but if you want a kitchen it’s good, the seating areas in the room  are all cloth, not ideal. The bathrooms were beautiful and it was a great price. Staff is pleasant as long as you don’t have an issue, then it changes. It might be a good place if you have to bring children to Vegas (which I don’t recommend) because there is no casino/smoking inside but another bummer is the pool closes at 7:00 pm, too early.

reviews.title: Great trip for fun and relaxation.
reviews.text: Nice rooms, good service, coffee makers need to be upgraded and bath robes are missing. Tubs and showers are great, the rooms have very nice fridge,Cool too stove and microwave. The roomHas a great amount storage and drawers. The View of Las Vegas is beautiful. The Hotel has none of the cigarette smell like The casino hotels and the hotel is a short walk fromThe strip so the location is very convenient.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: We loved this hotel. It is not a casino so it felt way more relaxing. The rooms were large & nicely laid out. I especially liked how quiet our room was. No noise from other guests in above rooms. Our room was beautifully cleaned every day. And huge bonus…right across the road from an amazing mall!

reviews.title: Busy and Noisey
reviews.text: Too close to train tracks.   Trains blowing horns at 12-2am that cant sleep throughEntrance to difficult.  No taxi/ uber stand to cut down on cars in entrance. Valet works hard but never enough.   Pots and pans were horrible— worn out

reviews.title: 99.9% perfection
reviews.text: Fabulous hotel in every way..The rooms are first class. The service is first class. The views from the room are brilliant ( we had a city view). Try a Bllody Mary from the bar.! It contains things you just wouldn’t expect but which actually complement it. I shan’t give the surprise away.And that lift - almost as fast as the space shuttle taking off.

reviews.title: Jets in the hot tub
reviews.text: Disappointed with jets in the bath didn’t get fixed. Contacted service attaché three times and final response was we don’t have the parts to get that fixed. They could’ve offered a different solution but unfortunately didn’t happen.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Vacation
reviews.text: No housekeeping was provided during the 3 night stay. The room was lacking paper towels, water bottles, coffee/ tea pouches etc. They charged me more than what I was supposed to pay. I had to call the hotel to get it reversed.

reviews.title: Beautiful to look at, but lacking in intelligence!
reviews.text: Perhaps the most "beautifully appointed" timeshare we've seen in 38 years, but there ARE many weaknesses also.  The kitchen has a Wolf range, Bosch dishwasher, and Sub-Zero refrigerator, but was missing a wine opener, tall water glasses, steak knives, butcher knives, a regular coffee pot (not a Keurig), at least two more wine glasses (need 4 not 2).  Stunning bathrooms with gorgeous marble and large showers, (2 full baths), but the smaller bath was not bright enough, there's inadequate shelf space for belongings (no cabinetry), there was no hairdryer, and there was only one small towel bar (does not accommodate a second couple).  Neither bathroom provided hand-towel rings or bars for convenience, and the paper products were the cheap thin rough tissues unworthy of a Trump property.  The mattress was very good, but the bedding was cheap and unimpressive.  South facing rooms see the strip, but north facing rooms hear the freight trains several times per day and sirens.  Good large modern TVs, but NO DVD players provided, unlike most other timeshares!  Room coffee, via Keurig, was terrible (KONA).  Hot water was rarely hot enough in showers.  Downstairs restaurant was truly EXCELLENT!  Staff was very friendly throughout.  Location was great, across from Fashion Mall, a couple of blocks off of the strip.  The drive-up entry was chaotic and disorganized due to lack of signage, which could easily be fixed by management.  The hotel is like a beautiful woman or handsome man with no "brains", great to look at but lacking.  The rooms should be top of the line, but management has obviously never stayed in their own property to see what is lacking.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Our experience at this hotel was excellent. It is located within walking distance to the strip and has shopping malls directly across the road. The check in and check out process was quick and smooth. The rooms are spacious and very clean. The staff were courteous and professional and valet parking is included in your stayWould definitely recommend this hotel if staying in Las Vegas

reviews.title: Expected more
reviews.text: Stayed two nights in a one bedroom corner suite.  Room was spacious and well appointed. The hotel is just off the strip but easy to access. While the room was nice I expected more dining alternatives. When we were there (2 weeks ago) they only had one eating area. Having stayed at other Vegas establishments this is definitely on the light side. Overall I found the Trump experience under whelming. Suggest folks book something on the strips at one of the popular venues.

reviews.title: Valet stole souvenirs from our rental cars trunk
reviews.text: Checked rental car on Monday left it there until checked out on Friday. Friday we discovered our souvenirs were missing from the trunk of our rental. The only keys to the car were in the valets hands. They STOLE our souvenirs from our car!Security was notified. I don’t believe anything will be done. Not comfortable booking here again!

reviews.title: Musty smell in the room 4014
reviews.text: I am not sure if all rooms had the same issue, but my room 4014 was musty and had a mold growing in the corner of the shower. Pool was great, service was awesome, but I am allergic to the mold and got an asthma attack after the night sleep.

reviews.title: Had better experiences at 2.5 star hotels
reviews.text: Room smelled like sewage.  I reported to front desk, but they could do nothing as were sold out.  No other attempts at satisfaction were made.  Room cleaned once during stay (M-F) - had to call to get that.

reviews.title: Vegas Business Trio
reviews.text: The hotel staff was very nice. The room was clean although off of the strip, it is well located. The lack of casino makes it a quiet place to relax. May need a little updating soon would benefit from a couple of other options for food on site.

reviews.title: Amazing view of the lights of Vegas
reviews.text: Wonderful experience at Trump for my mother and IClean, quiet, comfortable, safe, every amenity available for our comfort.Any questions were answered fast and  accurately before our stay. Our room on the 52 nd floor was superb. Fast elevators that were always readily available. The housekeeping was perfect everyday. Loved coming back to a spotless room that smelt lovely. Loved everything about our stay and would highly recommend. Also loved that there was no casino at this hotel ( although one not far away) and that it was totally smoke free.

reviews.title: The golden hotel.
reviews.text: My experience was great!, room size and amenities were excellent, just make sure your room is not facing the back of the hotel, you won't enjoy the view. otherwise, it is a good hotel. the restaurant does not offer a big variety of meals but the food quality is there.

reviews.title: Trump Disappointment
reviews.text: This is no where near a luxury hotel. The room was outdated with the furnishings being worn and dull. I do not understand having no glasses in the room and having to request more bottled water. And a resort fee for what? If you don’t use their parking it is just excessively charging the guest.

reviews.title: Great overall stay
reviews.text: Great overall experience. Nice hotel. Great location across from fashion show mall. Having the little kitchenette in the room is a good feature when travelling with kids. Housekeeping staff was great and accommodated  all our needs.

reviews.title: Awesome stay
reviews.text: I cannot believe I am giving this hotel a five star rating. The reason being I had called and cussed out Hotwire because I had booked a hot rate not knowing it was the Trump. I was totally wrong please believe the hype it is clean and better than expected. The only negative is that it is not really on the strip. I love that it is non smoking and that it does not have a casino. The rooms are clean and huge. I gotta tell you I have no problem with Trump I just wanted to be on the strip but I am happy that we stayed here. Kudos to the staff who are always friendly.

reviews.title: Incredible Stay
reviews.text: I will only stay at Trump International Hotel Las Vegas when in Vegas. I was very impressed with how professional the entire staff is and the incredible environment. I enjoyed every minute of my stay and will be back soon!

reviews.title: Very high end hotel.
reviews.text: Enjoyed it overall. Top high end hotel. Fashion Show mall across the street. About 5-10 min walk to Treasure Island (for location). No casino, but I wanted that. The rooms are HUGE, clean and the staff friendly.

reviews.title: Wow, what a treat in Las Vegas without the casino and smoke?!
reviews.text: Wow!  What an incredible hotel and service. Best views in Las Vegas. Our very own @trumplasvegas !  Brian and his team are here to serve you with the highest hospitality. Well done!  Don’t forget to check out the spa and the fitness areas as they are very nice.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Good facilities, friendly staff, delicious food. Good location, away from the noise of "The Strip".                                                                                   We loved it.

reviews.title: Make Hotels Great Again
reviews.text: We stayed at the Trump International hotel for one night as a way of varying our stay in Vegas. This hotel is much taller than many of the other hotels in the area and our room was located over 55 floors up, which gave incredible views of the strip and surrounding areas. There are rooms even higher than ours. Must be amazing views higher up. The hotel is cheaper than others located nearby but is still meant to be high quality.Check in was quick and simple. The two young men working at the check in desk were friendly and helpful. All other staff we met and spoke with were great and helpful too. The lobby is really very clean and beautiful looking. It made a nice change to not have to walk through a crowded and smokey casino to get around as this place doesn't seem to have a casino at all, which is fine for me. The location is a bit further up from the strip and takes about 10 minutes to walk to the top end of the strip where the casino hotels are. This would be a lovely hotel anywhere in the world. It stands out a bit in Vegas for not having shows, a casino etc depsite being very close to the strip. But that was fine for us. It has a pool, gym, restaurants etc so it was still very good.Our room was huge and spacious. The bed was great. The room had so many cupboards and drawers. I have never seen this in a hotel before. It appears that these rooms can be purchased as apartments so that would also explain the small kitchen included. No cooking items are provided but these are available on request.We had a fridge provided that was empty so this is a nice change to being filled with expensive minibar items that no one ever seems to buy. The bathroom was also enourmous with a huge jacuzzi bath tub. The provided toiletries were very nice also.Sadly, it wasn't all positive though.The furniture in the room was dated and quite badly scuffed etc.The A/C inlet was dusty and in need of a clean (see photo)We were provided with two small clear plastic cups (the style and size you would normally give to children) for any and all drinks we might have. No mugs or glassware. I don't remember having this in any other hotel, ever. This can't be good for the environment either, to have to throw away more plastic. An in room coffee machine was provided with a paper style takeaway cup and lid. This seemed like a great idea for those who wanted to start their day with a free drink when they go out. But we had only been given one cup and two lids. So this hadn't been checked properly.The views were affected by filthy windows which didn't appear to have been cleaned for some time.The soundproofing to other rooms seemed fine but to outside was shocking. As well as general noise that could be heard clearly, I was woken by a train going past at 0100hrs despite being nearly 60 floors above it and several hundred metres away. I could also hear police sirens which I could see were coming from the strip - again, some distance away.The bathroom had mould on the ceiling (photo) and also mould in the silicone around the shower cubicle.Under the bed was filthy with a thick layer of dust (photo), despite it being a high bed and it would be easy to clean underneath.The ironing board was broken and very dirty (photo)The toilet roll holder was broken and couldn't really stay in the position it was meant to be in.The shower didn't drain properly so when I went to have my shower, some hours after my partner, the first thing that happens is I step into her cold and stale water from earlier. In general, the whole room could do with a clean / refresh. Many of these issues could easily be rectified. I would consider staying here again in the future. But right now, this is not a 5 star hotel experience as advertised.

reviews.title: Stay through hotel,not HGV
reviews.text: Enjoyed 4 nights at the Hilton Grand Vacation Club at the Trump.  Lovely hotel, appreciate the location, kitchenette and bottled water.  Very friendly security.  Also appreciate that ride share is at main entrance.  Not many food options in the hotel but across the street from Fashion Show Mall and a 10 minute walk to Resorts World.  The negative for us I think was from being a guest through HGV.  No daily housekeeping but we could get a room refresh with clean towels and more water.  We called every morning before we left to request one and every evening when we returned, no one had been there.  The last night we had to call again twice over an hour after 11:00 pm.  Not sure why these calls go into a black hole.  I would certainly stay here again but only through the hotel and not through HGV.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice hotel and being across from the mall with a tween made it all the better! I would say again, it was a nice stay. The rooms are very nice, we had a studio which has a kitchenette, microwave, and refrigerator.

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: I had a good time while staying at the trump. Really don’t have any complaints. Any issues that we had, they took care of them. It was kinda cold so unfortunately we couldn’t experience the pool but everything else was cool. Just note that trump name is everywhere. 🤣

reviews.title: Fantastic stay in Vegas: highly recommend!
reviews.text: Absolutely fantastic room- super clean, spacious, gorgeous spa-like bathroom. Free convenient valet parking. Courteous staff. Nice pool area and workout room. No casino, no smoking makes it a quieter alternative to the main hotels on the strip. Close to everything but not too close. Comfortable bed, great room appointment and amenities (coffee, microwave, safe, toiletries etc). We are picky about hotels and this was top notch

reviews.title: Nice decor but not clean
reviews.text: Arrived to a great looking building with lovely décor. lovely welcome from Ian on reception.On arriving at the room the carpet edge all around the room had not been hoovered for years under the bed was the same. The kitchenette had no utensils or cutlery you had to request them from reception. The restaurant did not meet the level of the hotel looked more like a cafe.

reviews.title: Great Value for a Real 5* Hotel
reviews.text: I loved this hotel from the moment I got inIt is valet only parking and it can get very busy in the hotel drive way. But, I see these valet guys really running to cope. They deserve a TIP and they are very thankful. You need to plan for 15 minutes wait till they bring you back your car. But I was very happy with their service and it is FREEThis is not a typical Las Vegas hotel with huge lobby and gambling halls. The hotel has no gambling and no smoking. It is a quiet, safe and family friendly hotel. Yet you are 10 minutes walk to the Strip where you see all the action.Check in was very easy, I was offered a room upgrade to be facing south looking at the strip for $25, on 57th floor, I took it. The north facing mountain view is also nice if your room is high enough (above 40th)The room was very nice, clean and well maintained. The little kitchenet was very handy in heating our left-over take away food. The housekeeping did provide everything we requested. It would take them 45-60 minutes, but this is OK for a hotel of this size.The room is very large and well furnished, the bathroom is Huge, but I would have loved a bidet toilet. The bed mattress was perfect  and the room has good noise insulation. I could not hear any noise from the other rooms. Of course, there is some noise from police cars, and the train but nothing really bad Right across the street there is a nice high end mall (Fashion Show), where you will find one convivence store ABC. I did buy some beverages and sandwiches before our drive to Zion National Park. This mall has a lovely Italian gourmet restaurant Maggiano's and a high end grill among many other fast food restaurants

reviews.title: Perfect Superbowl  wknd getaway!
reviews.text: We enjoyed our 3 night stay at the Trump Hotel Las Vegas. Staff was on point and helpful, professional.  Accommodations were first rate…The hotel is located directly across the street from Nordstrom, definitely a plus IMO!

reviews.title: WARNING!! They hold your car hostage!!
reviews.text: They have ‘complementary’ valet service which means no access to your car. The wait was 90+ minutes for our car!! We ended up calling a cab to get to where we needed to go! $50 later!!! What a joke!!! They tell you to give them 15 minutes when you check-in. I will never stay here again!!!

reviews.title: Nice, but could use a detailed cleaning
reviews.text: Checking in and out are super easy. Valet service is top notch. Bar and restaurant were great. The only issue was housekeeping or shall I say a lack of it. Not only was my weekly service skipped, but the common areas could use a detailed cleaning. My understanding is housekeeping is a challenge everywhere so take it with a grain of salt. The studio unit was perfect for a couple and the location is just across the street from the fashion mall and a sort walk to Resorts World, Wynn, Palazzo and the Venetian.

reviews.title: Exceptional!
reviews.text: Excellent facilities, staff, service and location. Looking forward to staying at Trump International Hotel again in the future. First class hotel and very professional staff. Free valet parking was a plus.

Looking down from the window was beautiful sparkling pool and look out to the Palazzo, Venetian, Treasure Island and Mirage Casinos.No traffic noise and very quiet Hotel.Staffs were all pleasant and helpful. Beautiful Hotel, quiet accommodation.

reviews.title: Just drinks
reviews.text: We were walking down the strip and thought we would check out the bar. We had to walk a bit down the road which wasn't very pedestrian friendly. It's very convenient if your doing some shopping at the fashion mall though. We ordered a couple of drinks as we planned out the rest of our day. The bartender was really nice and the drinks were pretty darn good too. The drinks were a little pricey but on par with any upscale bar on the strip.

reviews.title: Simply Perfect
reviews.text: My stay at the resort was very pleasant.  Staff was friendly, room was impeccable and security of the guests seems to be one of the highest priorities of the location.  Facilities were kept impeccable and sanitized throughout the day (very discreetly staff would sanitize lobby areas all throughout the day), and a "Guest Greeting Station" was strategically located right before the entrance of the elevators where all guests were required to key in in order to enter the elevators area.   This made me feel secure and at ease while traveling with my husband and my elderly mother.  I highly recommend this location for your next stay.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We had a great experience at the Trump Hotel while visiting Las Vegas for KBIS 2023 with Fabuwood!! Beautiful, clean, nice and calm hotel! Great environment! Definitely highly recommended place to stay in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Amazing place to stay
reviews.text: We were there with fabuwood during the kbis show and was amazed by the service we got and everything was so nice and beautiful Will definitely only go to the Trump hotel in the future Thanks so much

Amy, Ellie and the entire housekeeping crew treated us exceptionally well. I highly recommend this hotel for anyone visiting Vegas. I will definitely be back!Thank you!

Very clean and up-to-date rooms.Accommodating kosher needs. would recommend anyone as the first and best hotel choice for a Vegas stay!We tried other hotels before nothing comes close to this.Thank you for the entire trump international hotat staff you guys are the best!!

reviews.text: First time ever to visit the Trump hotel during KBIS show with the Fabuwood group, The staff where very accommodating and dedicated, The vallet parking staff were responding quickly even they were overwhelmed

reviews.text: We stayed there with Fabuwood group for the KBIS show. Trump staff are A1 with first class service.  Special shout-out  it to Amy and Ellie. The all around service was great and we would definitely recommend  staying at the Tump in Vegas.

reviews.title: NAHB IBS Fabuwood

Well priced and delivered same day.We had a large group there and used multiple suites for meals and meetings and the hotel staff went out of their way to welcome us and accommodate our needs. I would highly recommend this hotel and look forward to going there again next year. Thank you!

reviews.title: My stay
reviews.text: I was there for business with Fabuwood during KBIS.The stay was unbelievable and the staff went out of their  way to accommodate our needs. reviews.title: The best hotel

The hotel staff was awesome, especially Amy and Ellie they treated us like kings with whatever was needed Would recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to have a first class stay Thanks again for everything.

reviews.title: Fabuwood Group - KBIS 2023
reviews.text: I’ve stayed at the Trump with the Fabuwood Group during KBIS a few times now. The dedication and service of this team is superb. The hotel is beautiful and I wouldn’t stay anywhere else. Thanks Amy and team. You guys are amazing.

reviews.title: Fabuwood kbis 2023
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing, Going there for a few years now because of their accommodation to Fabuwood @kbis. they have gone above and beyond each year and i would like to thank them both the hotel and Fabuwood. on top of that its always clean and smells really good when you walk in. keep it up, looking forward to my next stay.

reviews.text: Our stay was with Fabuwood during the KBIS show and the service of the Trump Hotel Staff was SUPER! The whole staff especially Amy & Ellie went out of their way to help up and make sure we have a great stay! Thank you!

reviews.title: Trump hotel Vegas KBIS show 2023

reviews.title: Fabuwood KBIS 2023

reviews.title: My stay with Fabuwood during KBIS 2023
reviews.text: My Stay with Fabuwood during the KBIS 2023 convention was excellent. Special shoutout to Amy for going above and beyond. reviews.title: Great choice for a hotel in Las Vegas!
reviews.text: This is the second time I have stayed at the Trump Hotel Las Vegas. I go to Las Vegas for the Kitchen/Hardware shows.I participate in the Fabuwood Cabinetry meals and events at the Trump Hotel. The Trump has been so accommodating and generous of the Fabuwood events that I decided to stay there as well.After a long day walking the aisles it's such a pleasure to stay at the Trump. Luxurious, well appointed rooms and a great hot shower! The staff is professional and pleasant. Add that to the delicious meals provided by Fabuwood, and you get a wonderful trade show experience.Thank you Trump Hotel and Fabuwood!

reviews.title: Will definitely stay again at the Trump!!!!
reviews.text: Staff at Trump is amazing! I was there with fabuwood for a few days and my experience could not have been better. They are so accommodating and have excellent service! The rooms are so clean, valet parking is so efficient and nice. The environment is so friendly and I can’t wait to be back next year!

reviews.title: Amazing week at the Trump International in Vegas
reviews.text: We had a buisness event at Trump International in Las Vrgas from January 30 until February 2nd with a company Fabuwood. The Trump team went above and beyond in every aspect.Especially Amy who helped cordinate the whole even and Ellie with the full housekeeping crew.Thank you Thank you Thank you for an amazing week. Keep it up

reviews.title: Great hosts
reviews.text: The service was fantastic! And the hotel accommodated the fabuwood  group with excellence.  This was the second time that I was a guest and the service got better this time.  I would highly recommend the hotel Great job

reviews.title: Amazing hospitality & service!
reviews.text: Our company stayed there during the KBIS 2023 show. We needed many rooms and a couple of suites to host public events and all meals during our week's stay. They were amazing at accommodating our kosher and religious needs. All staff were very friendly, especially Amy and Ellie, always making sure we had what we needed. We hope to stay with them in the future.

reviews.title: Very Accommodating
reviews.text: We were there for the KIBS show a few days ago and I joined some fellow contractors at Fabuwood for prayers and breakfast at the hotel. Apparently, they were the only hotel willing to accommodate us. Ellie and the entire housekeeping staff is amazing!

reviews.title: KBIS/ FABUWOOD 2023
reviews.text: Stayed at The Trump during the KBIS.Beautiful Hotel and amazing service.Special thanks to Amy and Ellie and the whole housekeeping crew for doing everything possible to help and serve all FABUWOOD guests, you guy's are amazing!Looking forward for next year!

reviews.title: TRUMP TOWER FABULOUS!
reviews.text: We stayed a week at the Trump Tower Hotel and were overwhelmed and felt like we were rich for a week! We had to borrow some of our next year's points for the 1 bedroom/living room/kitchen suite, but we'd do it again if it was available! We thought it's location was absolutely perfect as it is located at the end of the strip a block's walk from the Wynn, where we enjoyed the buffet for breakfast 4 of 7 days we were there. (It's a MUST/w/FABULOUS FOOD/Worth the $ spent).  We walked home late most nights, but never once felt unsafe walking to the Trump Tower from the Strip.  If we returned before 9pm we could even walk through the Fashion Show Mall and then exit and cross the street over to the Trump Tower. The staff was nice, the swimming pool area was really cool and it's the nicest place we have ever stayed using our RCI Points. I want to go back!!

reviews.title: Business
reviews.text: Thank you Trump hotel in Vegas for hosting the Fabuwood team,This is my 3rd time at the trump hotel attending the KBIS show with the Fabuwood group,It It was a great stay and I'm looking forward for next year to join the trump hotel with the Fabuwood team

reviews.title: Great experience on a very busy week
reviews.text: I come to Vegas yearly for a business expo. This was my first time staying at the trump hotel. I was very impressed with the details from the way the towels were rolled perfectly and the cleanliness of the room. The extra security before getting into the elevators to reach the guest rooms is a huge plus especially in las vegas. I stayed at trump for the fabulous event. The house keeping staff went above and beyond especially Amy and Ellie. This past week was a very busy week in las vegas and the trump team pulled off this great event. I will definitely come again.Thanks

reviews.title: Five Star Experience
reviews.text: We were on a business trip with the Fabuwood team for the KBIS 2023 Show, our group had an amazing amazing experience…… Amy And Ellie treated us with extra hospitality and the whole housekeeping crew went above and beyond to help us. Would highly recommend

reviews.title: Best experience!
reviews.text: I was beyond impressed with the service and level of care the staff have to us all who attended under Fabuwood for the KBIS show.  Not to mention the comfort and cleanliness of the hotel too.  This hotel is A++++ for all!!!! Enjoy your stay!!!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: My stay was with Fabuwood during KBIS.Amy and Ellie treated us so well as well as the whole housekeeping crew, they went above and beyond to helpThis is by far the best service hotel in the area.Next time I’m staying here!

reviews.title: Br
reviews.text: It was grate experience to stay whit them beautiful team of employee very helpful and knowledgeable. Will be highly recommend it for our future trips. Looking forward for a great experience. With such a great team.

reviews.title: 3 Nighter
reviews.text: Great hotel in a quieter, off strip location. You can see it from most points on the strip so easily located. We walked through Fashion Show Mall or got an Uber so easy to get to the action. Lobby big and well marshalled. DJT restaurant was available all day with great service and delicious food on offer. There's a gift shop selling Trump tat as well as drinks and snacks. There's a 'to go' collect or room service menu option which was well worth it.  Entry to the elevators is via key card and security.  Room was massive on 23rd floor with a side view of West Vegas to the Red Rock Mountains. Pretty impressive despite not being the premium strip view. The bed was huge, the kitchenette wasn't used, the coffee machine and fridge were. Free bottled water too. Safe in the room was in a bottom drawer but was also free. Bathroom was also big with toilet and walk in shower in adjacent cubicles and a deep jacuzzi bath. No cleaning over the 3 night stay but not biggie. Check out trouble free. Only real downer was the train 'toots' whilst going through the level crossing towards the freeway. Not much they can do about that really so it didn't detract from the stayAlthough Vegas wasn't for us we did very much like the hotel but if you want the strip action then pick an appropriately located one.

reviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Staff
reviews.text: It was a little expensive and not in a perfect location, but the Trump International is an outstanding hotel.  Super clean, large modern rooms.  All hotel amenities are very convenient.  Excellent gym, highly efficient (free!) valet parking, and the best hotel staff in Vegas.  The hotel is off the strip but we never paid more than $10 for an Uber ride anywhere.  Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Exceeded all my expectations!!!!
reviews.text: The hotel totally exceeded my expectations. The check in staff were very welcoming, the lobby is clean and  was excited about free valet parking. Yes!!!! Free valet parking in LasVegas!. The rooms are clean and spacious. The decor is nice. Loved having a fridge, microwave,coffee maker, stove top. extra pillows,sheets and blankets. They have Cooking utensils available upon request as per the sign in the room.  Seating area with a couch & table are a great addition. The bathroom is amazing. The shower is wonderful. The fashion show mall is right across the street. Gift shop & restaurant in the lobby.  The only negative was the uncomfortable bed.. overall it’s a wonderful non casino smoke free hotel and loved the short walk from lobby to hotel elevators. The hallways smell good. I enjoyed my stay here.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with Amazing Staff
reviews.text: Hotel has everything you need but a casino. 100% smoke free, pet friendly. They have great buffet breakfast, fantastic food and bar, pool, spa, and gym. Friendly staff, walking distance to the strip and shopping!

reviews.title: Wow - this place exceeded all my expectations for sure!
reviews.text: The staff was so incredibly nice, the hotel is super clean, and everyone was eager to help with whatever your needs might be.  We had breakfast at the restaurant it was SOOO GOOD!      I’m pretty particular to please so for me to leave 5 stars is a big deal!   This place did NOT disappoint!

reviews.title: Excellent service and views
reviews.text: after a slight miscommunication regarding our room type through the third party booking site, reception staff were excellent In resolving this and very pleasant. 64th floor view of the strip was fantastic, room also spacious and clean. Excellent bathroom and room cleaned daily. Overall a very good Stay, at a reasonable price.

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Great accommodations, across from the Fashion Shopping Center, close to the strip for the shows. The one bedroom room was large, great view, would stay there againQuite for sleep.... Dining room was OK for a quite bit to eat.

reviews.title: Great property and large rooms - no parking garage, free valet only
reviews.text: This was a great trade. Nice big rooms with upgraded amenities. Request a lower floor if possible, the air traffic gets louder the higher you go up. We were on the 44th floor and had to wear ear plugs all night long. Oh and there's no parking garage... just valet.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Hotel is nice and like it is non smoking and across from mall.  However there is a huge freight train that runs and blows its horn all day and ALL NIGHT!  For that reason, the location is not good and recommend elsewhere.  Not sure if they hear this train at the Wynn.

reviews.title: Great hotel and stay
reviews.text: Great hotel and stay.  We really enjoyed the hotel, the view and its proximity to the strip. You can walk to a number of restaurants and casinoes. Hotel is also very clean and we enjoyed that genre were no casino to deal with at this hotel. Would recommend this

reviews.title: Increible!
reviews.text: This stay was a birthday present for my husband.  The accommodations are fabulous.  The entrance way was just stunning.  Our view was beautiful.  The pool area was windy but that is Las Vegas. We were treated like royalty every minute of our stay.

reviews.title: Trump Tower Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very nice location and very nice sized room. The cleaning staff was very efficient. The website says they have shuttles to hotels on the strip but they do not. The front desk said that had stopped before COVID. Overall an excellent place to stay.

reviews.title: From wow to oh no! Could have been better...
reviews.text: We checked in on Christmas day  at 7pm and had to be moved twice from Rm  5622, 5811 and finally 5411. The problem has always been the broken sofa bed. When we saw the first suite, we all said wow!  Very spacious living room, with dining area,  kitchen  and the master's bath was really something .Then came the broken sofa bed and the wait for room transfers and I thought Trump hotel just messed up our Christmas. And to think we booked for five nights.Talked with Jenna on Dec 26 and asked whom I can speak to about customer satisfaction. She's a good front desk staff, so patient and sympathetic, Told Jenna about our experience and  moving forward, January 1st is around the corner and I don't want future guests' holiday to go wrong. If sofa beds are a problem, please tell your housekeeping to check on them now. I mentioned to the housekeeper last night if she can coordinate with Front Desk for some complimentary drinks like soda to cool us down and she said  "no we don't do that" but offered water. I did tell her to mention it to Front desk. The Trump brand is synonymous with excellence and that reply was a disappointment with regards to customer satisfaction. I did suggest to Jenna that in the future, a plate of cookies or any of those small gestures will probably calm down an inconvenienced guest. I eventually sent an email to the Front Desk Manager Jake Jacobsen who apologized on the room changes and offered to provide us a couple of soda in the fridge.Tuesday morning, I  requested Jake  for  a desk clock for the bedroom  and for the room to be  serviced. The housekeeper came in the afternoon and gave us  a bag of toiletries, coffee pods and sugar and towels for the next couple of days. I figured there will be no housekeeping for the rest of our stay.  ( It's a good thing I brought disinfectant wipes so I wiped  the toilets seats) . When the housekeeper handed me the clock she said, they have tested it and it's working, I concluded that the problem in this hotel is the Housekeeping.  They should have checked all  sofa beds are functioning,  curtain rods are in place, supplies are adequate for the number of guests registered. If there are three guests, shouldn't there be three complimentary water bottles and cups?  Don't say no instead say,  " let me see what I can do about it".On the positive side, the front desk ( Jenna and Julia) were all very nice and gracious. The checker before you go  to the elevator was also nice. The valet staff were all very friendly.  Even the security who came to our room to get a statement from my son after he suffered a cut in the gym was very nice and helpful .  We liked that the lobby is so close to the elevators, smoke free. Getting food in the mall was convenient.This was our first stay in a Trump hotel  with so much expectations, but five nights  in a 1 bedroom suite with no housekeeping? It could have been better for a brand known for excellence.  Unfortunately,  I cannot recommend the hotel right now.

reviews.title: Never more!!!!! Stay away
reviews.text: I’m in the Trump hotel since yesterday in a Deluxe suite with my husband and 3 daughters. The mattress of the sofa bed is really bad : thin and you can feel all the mattress spring. Terrible!!!I complained about that yesterday and they told me that it was possible to change the mattress, but when we got the hotel late at night, there was a thin mattress inside a plastic bag hanging on the doorknob waiting for us.Today, the second day in the hotel, when we got here another surprise!!! No housekeeping!!! They don’t clean the room. I called to the housekeeping and they told me that hey can’t do anything to help us at 9pm , I have to wait tomorrow…no apologizes…and the front desk told me that housekeeping is coming… they don”t know or they are pretending??? I looking forward the next 2 days…

reviews.title: 3 of us, parents and 15 year old son
reviews.text: We booked corner room, 1 bedroom on Expedia. Check in easy. Elevators super fast. Our room was amazing. It was 1 bedroom/condo size. Windows floor to ceiling.  We did not have strip side. I'm guessing for additional cost or book with hotel you will get strip view. But to our surprise we woke up to mountain view! We couldn't see mountains when we arrived at night.Shower water pressure AMAZING. No fan but never humidity in bathroom cuz it was HUGE, with bathtub with jets. Toilet had separate door in its own room. We have a huge bathroom at home but unusual at hotel.  Shades seem to block all light. I usually wear eye mask to bed when traveling but didn't need to use. We never heard other people when in our room. There is a train near by incase you are light sleeper I heard in morning but was already awake.  My son slept on sofa sleeper with couch cushions on top for added comfort.  When we arrived we called front desk for bedding for sofa sleeper, kitchen plates.. and water and we received quick. After our 5 day stay and seeing other hotels we all agree we would stay at Trump again hands down.  My husband ordered from restaurant at the hotel at the end of the night every night and thought it was great.  One night we split a meal. I wasn't that hungry so we ordered filet with extra sides to split. Cost was about $60. But not bad cost for 2 adult dinners. We ate in our room which really saved us a ton. CVS is a few minutes walk. We bought huge bottle of Jose Cuervo for 45$  and a few bottles of diet sprite.  That saved us a ton to make our own drinks.  After all we had an amazing kitchen.  We felt right at home like we could live here. Ice machine on each floor. My husband had Uber eats one night. Every thing was so easy and convenient. We are active and fit. So used fitness center daily. Pool was open but to cold for our liking . We are from Wisconsin but Dec was still to cold for us to swim. We used Uber to get around a few times but mostly walked.  I justify read review to my husband and son b4 I post. My son pointed out his bathroom had a fan. We had TWO bathrooms. How cool is that for a hotel.  As far as taking a teen to Vegas there is alot to do. His favorite was battlefield vegas.

reviews.title: Unacceptable Experience
reviews.text: I checked in super excited & looking forward to a great experience & I was beyond disappointed.  The mattress must be 15 years old, and impossible to sleep on as there is a huge dip in it.  The bed sheets quality, looks & feel of fabric compares to a motel 6, pretty low.  There was no robe, nor slippers in the room. WiFi on TV doesn’t work.  I, we just can’t believe the super cheap equipments & accommodations.

reviews.title: The Luxury Hotel for the Best Price and Value
reviews.text: 24/2022 First, thank Hilton Grand Vacations with 750,000 HGVC owners for sending us to stay in that 5-star hotel, where it owns 300 guestrooms.Surprisly, this hotel is better that any luxury hotels I stayed in terms of value, comfort, quality of a guest room and bathroon, like The Ritz-Carlton, JW Marriott, InterContinental, Conrad, Sheraton Grand, etc. For example, (1) a hot tub (Jacuzzi) surounded by each 12x12 high-end marble at the bathroom with a same style of marble floor in a lower-priced 500 square-foot studio (guestroom) is better than most at a high-end $2 to $3 million residential home built by Toll Brothers because it provides high-pressure water jets streams in four different directions with three different speeds, which let you feel the experience of surf massage; (2) enjoyed its steam room and relaxation room with a variety of specialty teas and drinks at your leisure; (3) provides a complimentary valet parking for any guest; (4) across the street, you can visit a big shopping mall or drive to Wynn Las Vegas in 3 minutes or so; (5) a $9.00 Uber ride can let you enjoy many fine dining restaurants at the heart of Vegas, like The Venetian Resort or Bellagio. The best happy hours place at downtown Los Angeles can't beat many in Vegas in term of food and drink quality as well as prices and ambience, etc.Enjoy its SPA at the Relaxation Room as well as a strong steam room with eucalyptus scent.Wish a high-speed bullet train would arrive soon between Las Angeles and Las Vegas.Once again, thank Hilton Hotels & Resorts with 6,800+ properties worldwide for bringing us here.

reviews.title: 2nd stay but disappointed this time
reviews.text: Stayed here in 2018 and was impressed and liked that it’s smoke free and casino free hence decided to book a suite this time however experience has been rather disappointing. Just checked in today and although check-in was smooth and fast, suite room is rather dated with a few things broken and definitely nothing like what was posted on their website (where’s the dresser table in the bathroom as per your website??) Queen sofa bed was broken with really thin pocketed spring mattress-do they really expect anyone to sleep on these mattresses at all and to think that I had even tipped for it to be assembled!  Bathroom door handle is broken. Sheets and curtains are stained and although suite comes with a kitchenette, no cutleries or kitchen appliances like kettle, plates and even mugs can be found. Yes there is a dishwasher but no detergent? Had to keep calling housekeeping for basic amenities and tip each time, seriously? Pillows too soft. Noisy room. Poor wifi. In summary, think twice - felt really sorry for my girls who had to sleep on the broken sofa bed 😔

reviews.title: Clean, classy and convenient
reviews.text: Lovely hotel with amazing staff. Clean, spacious bedroom with kitchenette. Nice couch and seating are and comfortable bed. Two good sized closets with inside lighting so you can see. Large clean bathroom with soaking tub and giant shower. Quiet halls and easy to get from floor to floor quickly. We loved the staff that made things safe by having guests show their key cards to access the elevators. Directly across the street from Fashion Show mall. We will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great if.....
reviews.text: Pros- No casino, quieter crowd, very clean (exceptionally so), solid rooms. Nice attentive staffCons- There are no taxis here or really anywhere in Vegas now that isn't a major property. Uber or have a car. Its a 10 minute walk to any restaurant. There is only one in the hotel.If you like to walk this place is for you. The Wynn is close by.

reviews.title: This is a very good hotel
reviews.text: Let's leave politics aside.It's a non casino hotel and that is not for everyone.I have stayed at most hotels in vegas, this is not the best, but this is very very good and i think its the best value hotel in Vegas.You really get a lot for your money and i liked not having a casino.Its a good size too, big but not too big.Its very good - end of the story

reviews.title: Trump: small, unsanitary, and doesn't come with many amenities
reviews.text: It's an OK place to stay, if you're expecting an average accommodation. but it is NOT luxury and it is far away in quality from other hotels on the Strip - like the Wynn/Aria/even Mandalay Bay. Trump is small, slightly dirty, and doesn't come with many amenities of other hotels (understandable due to its size). We had to be moved during our stay because our first room had bloodstains on the mattress. The new room had blood spatter on the curtains but at that point we were like, 'this is probably the best it's gonna get'. There is absolutely NO FOOD to be found in the hotel after 9 pm. as in - ZERO. no mini bar, no room service, no vending machines, not even a bag of chips at the front desk. FOODLESS. the front desk informed me that the closest food was the CVS in front of TI. CVS!! 0.5 mile walk away! I just fail to see how that's ok for a hotel.There were no meeting rooms for me to take a simple work call in the morning. 2 out of 4 elevators were broken in our tower. One girl commented, "this is the longest elevator ride of my life" as we stopped on each floor to disgruntled guests. When I returned home, I realized I had broken out in rashes on my legs from my stay - probably from the unwashed blankets (much like their unwashed mattresses and curtains). Only positives: a stove in the room (prob to feed yourself since the hotel doesn't have any other food at night), big closets, and AMAZINGLY KIND employees; some of the most accommodating hospitality workers. Also good location: walking distance to the Fashion Show Mall and Wynn/Encore/XS.Overall - it's a Holiday Inn quality hotel dressed up in sparkling gold so people get tricked into thinking it's "luxury." If I hadn't gotten this comped room, I wouldn't have ever chosen to stay here.

reviews.title: Still great
reviews.text: We stayed at the Trump as part of a longer multi-destination trip.This is the second time I have stayed at the Trump, previously back in 2018.You really cannot fault the hotel itself. It really is of a high standard, from the smooth way that you are checked in, right through to the security personnel that make sure only guests can access the elevators to the rooms.We stayed on the 55th floor and the views out towards old Vegas and the mountains were simply stunning. The rooms are large and very well appointed. The bed was huge and really comfortable. The bathroom was huge and contained the biggest walk in shower I have ever seen and a bath with water jets. It was really a pleasure to stay in such luxury.The main reason we picked the Trump was the competitive price, we found it was around half the price of staying on the strip. The trade-off for this is that you are somewhat isolated up one end of the strip and it takes around a 10 minute walk to reach the main part of the strip. This can get annoying late at night or if you have been shopping.When we stayed in 2018 the hotel provided a shuttle bus service down to the strip for free but, it would appear that this was discontinued a while back. This was a useful service and would impact on me deciding to stay at the Trump again in the future, it really depends on whether you feel it better value to stay away from the strip and walk in everyday.The gym and pool areas are excellent, very clean and with a wide array of equipment.Overall, as a hotel and for the price we paid, you cannot go wrong with the Trump.If you want to be in the centre of the action and don't mind paying more for the privilegethen stay on the main strip. If you don't mind a walk and want to use the money you saved on something else, choose the Trump.

reviews.title: Quiet location at end of strip with no Casino
reviews.text: Initially we were concerned about staying in this hotel, but we were pleasantly surprised by the ambience and quality of the fittings. When checking in the receptionist asked if we would like to be high or low and whether we would like to face towards the strip or the other direction. It is right at one end of the strip so a long walk if one is wanting to do the entire strip on foot. We stayed three nights in a suite and could not have wished for more. The kitchen was well fitted out but with no crockery or utensils. Maybe account of COVID problems. A call to housekeeping and they provided us with a complete dinner setting and cutlery. A small selection of breakfast offerings and drinks are set for sale up in the lobby each morning for those that may wish to dine in their rooms, which we did. We will happily stay there again if we ever return to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: First time here….won’t be our last!!!!
reviews.text: This was our first time staying at Trump Towers. We have been to Vegas other times and stayed at other resorts. We were not disappointed in our choice this time!! We were blown away by the kindness of the pleasant staff throughout our stay! We loved that it was a quieter hotel! It felt like home away from home after walking the strip!We had breakfast at DTJ and it was amazing every morning! Our bed was comfy, our room was spotless! We were aware that cleaning was not done every day of our stay, but housekeeping was great at sending extra towels and coffee for us! Valet was always quick and friendly! I wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again and even take our kids next time!! Way to make Hotels great again!

reviews.title: Expensive, no heated swimming pool, not very good for disabled access to the strip
reviews.text: Chose this Hotel above others because of heated swimming pool which when we were there for 7 days was not heated. Access to the footpath to the strip in a wheel chair is very dangerous with the lack of ramps or no ramps and getting up and down the curbs was not easy with the curbs being about 6in high. Burger n fries were about £25 and a bottle of larger abour £10 plus at the end of our stay charged us tax per night.

reviews.title: Outstanding Experience
reviews.text: This hotel pays attention to every detail, which makes for a magnificent stay.  Luxury at every turn and everything is sparking clean.  The entire staff is unfailingly kind and respectful.  The suites are appointed with the finest of everything - Subzero appliances, a giant spa tub and such things.  The bedding is supreme.  The elevators are amazingly quick - never a wait for an elevator which is impressive considering there are roughly 50 floors in this building.  Everything is designed for beauty and comfort and a great experience. There is a lot of glass and a lot of shiny surfaces in this hotel - all are always free of any kind of smudge.  Even though I stay at a lot of nice hotels, I can typically find something that needs improvement.  Not here - everything is perfect.  Our breakfast was perfect as well.  The location is great - directly across the street from a mall and very close to many casinos.  I cannot recommend this property highly enough.  A perfect experience.  If you want a beautiful, comfortable hotel with great food and outstanding staff, try the Trump International Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: Terrific staff from check in to restaurant to housekeeping to security to check out.  Every entree at the restaurant is delicious.  Restaurant staff are friendly and quick.  Rooms are spacious and inviting.  The jacuzzi in the bathroom is a treat.

reviews.title: The place where i prefer to stay in Vegas, with the Wynn.
reviews.text: Perfect hotel for people who do not want to be in a Casino, We had a very nice large suite facing the strip on the 60th floor, stunning.The service is very good apart from the Valet Parking where you have to queue permanently for your car. At the end it was better to take a cab and come back with a cab: Less expensive and faster.The rest is perfect.

reviews.title: We enjoyed our stay, close enough to Las Vegas strip. No cassino on the hotel.
reviews.text: The hotel is not on the strip, but perfectly close enough to walk. It is in front of the Macy’s store, Men’s departament entrance (good short cut there). Room was clean, very well taken care of, a minor shower pre-existing clog incident they took care very fast. The restaurant at the hotel  serves great breakfast (not included).

reviews.title: Very Enjoyable Family Holiday Stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for 3 days in August as part of a Family Muti City stay. Could not fault this stay. Staff were very helpful and catered for all our requests. Room/Hotel was immaculate & very spacious. In the very hot months I would recommend this tip when heading to the strip, walk directly across from Hotel into underground Car Park and into/through the Mall out to strip, worked for us. I read negative reviews that this hotel was too far from the Strip (no more than a 5 min walk), the fact that this Hotel had no casino suited us also as we aren't big Gamblers and had a teenage Daughter with us. Wouldn’t hesitate from staying here again.

reviews.title: Best Hotel
reviews.text: Service 5/5 - The staff here is very friendly and cooperative. Room service also cleaned our room very well.Value 5/5 - Very worth it for its price!Cleanliness 5/5 - The place is very clean and the design is sleek and modern.Room 5/5 - The rooms are spacious and comes with everything!Overall 5/5 - Would stay here every time I’m in Las Vegas.

reviews.title: From a fan, Used to be
reviews.text: This site used to be flawles & we choose this resort over  others for many years until now.I have been hesitating for a few days (out of a week stay) writing a mediocre review since I have been a fan to this resort for so many years.Staff services are still unbeatable but not the room.We arrived in our one- bedroom suite supposedly with full kitchen.  Somehow  Trump implement a policy where you have to call to have what you need to send to your room by request. In my case, kitchen  tower paper, washer detergent, scrub pad, wine opener,  knives( they sent us only one), cutting board, soup  pot, etc were  requested. In the past, these items are in kitchen ready to be put to work.TVs are extremely  old timers. We have asked to engineers  to adjust the color & darkness a few times  before issues got resolved. The biggest no no is the wi-fi, especially  for our one week of working/ leisure.  Wi-Fi is constantly  down and downtime is often over 1 hour.I hope Trump with an upscale hotel reputation can quickly fix or improve  these issues to sustain still good images.From a fan, used to be...

reviews.title: first rate rooms and service near the strip
reviews.text: I stayed here for 3 nights in November. Check-in and check-out were easy and painless. All the staff around the hotel were really nice and helpful! When staff greet you with a smile and a "good morning" it really just makes your day. The location is a bit off the strip but not too far from the action. The room was incredible. It was spacious and the bed was quite comfortable. The bathroom was huge and the shower was perfect. If you want a nice hotel without all the commotion of a casino, this is the place to be. It's also conveniently located across from the mall which is nice if you need to do some quick or not-so-quick shopping.

reviews.title: EXCELLENT HOTEL IF REQUEST FOR HELP WAS RESPONDED QUICKLY
reviews.text: Everything looked great EXCEPT THAT I had to telephone the Reception four (4) times just to request for some staff to come & help me set up the sofa bed for my room partner. The sofa bed frame was so heavy for me to lift up & open. Otherwise I would do it myself because it took too long to get help from Hotel Staff. It was quite annoying because it was getting so late (1am) and we just wanted to get some sleep after a long 6-hour drive to Las Vegas. It was quite frustrating that we had to …. wait too long while getting asleep then had to telephone the Reception again and again keep asking for help.

reviews.title: Great hotel bang in the middle
reviews.text: With this being our 15th visit in 20 years, we thought we would do something different. This hotel exceeded our expectations by a long way, the quality of room cleanliness and overall presentation is excellent. Fantastic position in the middle of the strip so access to Fremont street is good and taxi waiting minimal. Would I recommend it hell yea and it was very reasonably priced..Now the down side it’s right next to the railway line and those drivers like a honk at specially at 4am bless them and the in-dining we thought was a bit steep to yoghurts and orange juices 60 dollars but I guess that’s the whole of the USA at the moment…

reviews.title: Great place to stay other than the RESORT FEE con.
reviews.text: I like this place as its just off strip, great rooms, non smoking and best of all, no casino in the lobby!  Valet parking is free and efficient, ony downside is $35 PER NIGHT RESORT FEE, PLUS $4.68 RESORT FEE TAX.  Leaves a VERY bad taste in the mouth, and the "free" WiFi is then v slow, but you are invited to buy (for nre mobey) a faster service (so what are you getting fitted resort fee?).

reviews.title: Relaxed comfortable stay.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Trump International. We booked a standard king room which was huge and had a beautiful view of the strip. Super comfy bed and lovely large bathroom. The kitchen area was very useful and we used it to cut down on the costs of eating out.The bar was relaxed and we enjoyed cocktails there. It was great staying in a hotel without a casino as it always felt calm to come back to, and the lobby area is decorated tastefully with a mix of bling and fresh flowers.We found the staff to be friendly and efficient for the most part, particularly the valet and front desk staff. However we found the housekeeping in the room a bit hit and miss - one day they didn't clean the room at all. Plus there were lots of things missing from the room such as gowns, kitchen equipment and door signs. They should have been there but instead we had to keep asking for things and wasting money on tips. So, 4 star review based on that. Otherwise I think it would have been perfect.

reviews.title: Good Hotel
reviews.text: The Hotel is well maintained and offers a great view of the city on one side and mountains on the other,Had booked a corner suite and it was excellent.Offers Valet Parking,The pool area and gym is good

reviews.title: Location amazing. Suites great. Volet parking bad.
reviews.text: We have been many times to this hotel for the location,  the suites and everything else. The only downside is the valet parking.  They are really nice but so disorganised it is mind-blowing.  You can wait 20mn for your car during weekends.  A trick? Maybe. Park across the street at the fashion mall.Apart from this very annoying thing, this hotel is perfect if you want to be one to the strip but not in a casino

reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.text: Excellent stay at The Trump International in Vegas! Very impressed with the whole experience! Great pool, great service at the pool, the front desk, housekeeping and on the phone. Rooms were very large and beautiful. We highly recommend a stay at Trump in Vegas!

reviews.title: Amazing stay in this Stunning hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, immaculately clean. We were upgraded on arrival and had a strip view. Jacuzzi bath absolute bonus. Took us a while to work out there are buttons outside rooms to request housekeeping. Short walk to strip and was nice to go back to a hotel each night that was quiet and didn’t smell of smoke. Food easy to order and tastyWould highly recommend this hotel

reviews.title: Trump Las Vegas- can’t be beat!
reviews.text: I had high expectations for this hotel, based on reviews, photos, and my own imagination of how our stay at a luxury hotel would be.  I really had my expectations set unrealistically high.  I was just waiting for disappointment. However, my experience ended up actually exceeding my expectations!  I called the hotel a couple times before vacation started, and both times a person answered ( I was not placed on hold!!) and the person was very polite and helpful.  When we got there, we were able to check in early after checking our car with the free valet service!  The room was large and comfortable, with a mini kitchen including a mini fridge, cooktop, sink, microwave, and counter space.  We bought our own pop and snacks (including microwave popcorn), and saved some money with that, plus had the convenience factor.  The bathroom was huge and beautiful! We had several meals in the hotel restaurant.  They were quite good, and the service was wonderful.  Over 3 days, we used the valet service many times, ate at the restaurant several times, and enjoyed relaxing in the beautiful pool area.  The time spent in the room was relaxing. The beds were nice, internet was fast, and there was a safe box in the room.  The hotel was quiet, non-smoking, no casino, and great for what we were looking for. Overall we had a wonderful visit and plan a return soon!!  We interacted with many valet employees, the front desk, housekeeping, restaurant staff, and the concierge.  EVERY interaction was positive.  I don’t have any desire to try any other hotel when we’re in Vegas.  Why would I when everything at the Trump International was fantastic?! Highly recommend!!!

reviews.title: Trump Hotel Las Vegas Very Poor Service
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing, the staff need help! Justin the manager had given our room out hours before our arrival, tried talking us into another hotel in Vegas and when we complained and the Manger Justin explained he has the power to turn us away completely without even a reason and we could not believe our ears.20 year anniversary and choose Trump to get the rudest Manager ever and the bell guy made it a point to step back into our room after delivery luggage to make sure my wife and I knew they live off tips (just arrived in Vegas no cash, ooops we got change first stop for future tips (standard) however we were 100% offended by the bell guy coming back into our room almost confrontational regarding no tip that 1 time.Oh, we did end up checking out early and went to another hotel anyhow! Much better service there from beginning to end!!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel to get a break from the casino seen!!!
reviews.text: We stayed here for our wedding week in Vegas.  This is an excellent hotel just off the Vegas strip.  We stayed in a 1 room suite, which was very spacious and clean.  Our flight to Vegas got changed multiple times by the airline causing us to arrive well before check-in time, but we were still able to check in early (10:30 AM).  There is an outdoor pool, a poolside bar/quick eat, a bar, restaurant, and gift shop all on location.  It is also very easy to order room service (online menu, just click what you want) and they are very fast with the orders.  The only negatives are the maid service is not automatic (you must call for it) and the kitchenette has no utensils/dinner ware (you have to call for that as well).

reviews.title: Lovely hotel but let down by poor room maintenance
reviews.text: The Trump is a very nice hotel, gorgeous foyer, great views, lovely pool and nice bar area. The rooms are huge and it’s a short 10 min walk to the Strip however the lack of room maintenance at the hotel is concerning. Firstly we found a bag of clothes left behind by another guest.. was the room properly cleaned before we arrived? Our first day on our return to the room, room hadn’t been made up, no fresh towels and shower gel wasn’t replaced. We rang and complained and the next day we just got fresh towels, no amenities were replaced and bed wasn’t made, we complained again.. and this went on for our entire week stay we had to constantly keep calling to just get a fresh towel! The fact that the bed sheets weren’t changed for our entire week stay was just disgusting. Mr H complained again and we had the resort fees reduced but to be honest I’d have rather had a clean room! I notice other reviews saying similar and it’s such a shame as this would be a 5 out of 5 if they sorted this issue out. We drank in the hotel but didn’t eat so can’t comment on food. Be prepared everything in Vegas is sooo expensive. $10 for one bottle of beer at the hotel although they don’t seem to mind people bringing in their own food and drink. We saw lots of people collecting deliveries at the front of the hotel. We found the staff we spoke with very good and polite. The pool is quite warm and very shallow so not ideal to cool off from Vegas heat but it is pleasant enough but 4 lifeguards… a bit of overkill!

reviews.title: Very good stay there
reviews.text: From where to begin ? First time for me in Las Vegas, was quite surprised with the temperatures during the first day in there. We arrived at the hotel, one girl who works there as a luggage handler / driver don’t remember her name but she was very professional, thanks a lot for her kindness and help every day we needed any information, she was there to help us to go where we wanted to. Thank you so much to the reception staff for replying properly to all the requests I’ve done during reservation process. Very kind, helpful, friendly, I would recommend for sure this hotel in Las Vegas if you’re looking for luxury hotels. The room was big which I loved. The view was unbelievable, I can’t wait to go back there. Advantages  : Price, Swimming Pool, View from the room, Staff. Drawbacks : Upgrades not available, breakfast not included in every room reservation type, Spa & Swimming Pool not open 24/7, quite far from the closest attractions like The Bellagio & The Circa.

reviews.title: Luxury in a Warm, Friendly Atmosphere
reviews.text: From the moment you step in to the sparkling opulence of the lobby, you are treated like a valued guest!  The check is was a breeze and the young lady was so warm and friendly.
