Guests and staff were all friendly and easy to talk to.  Our room was beautiful and our mountian view was awesome. I thoroughly enjoyed the deep, jetted tub. It felt like spa day after walking the Vegas strip for hours! The robes were soft and the pillows fluffy and soft.We ate dinner at the DJT restaurant and my husband ordered the haddock fish and chips!  They were crisp and delicious!I can't say enough positive things about this hotel and I would definitely stay here again!The hotel is pet friendly, although we did not bring our dogs.

reviews.title: Luxurious And Surprisingly Quiet
reviews.text: The hotel is located right across the street from a shopping mall (which is on the Strip) and doesn't have any of the distractions of a casino constantly pumping you full of oxygenates air and slots. Sophisticated rooms that are spacious and a staff that is top notch! Highly recommended to try "The Burger" at the restaurant along with some interesting cocktails. You won't be disappointed I had a King Suite corner room with amazing, unobstructed views. Every room has blackout shades in case the bright lights are too much and the bed is comfortable.  Take a chance And be treated like royalty.

reviews.title: Nice but not cosy
reviews.text: Stayed only 1 night. Arrived very late in night due to flight delay. First impression-when we got out if taxi with the children and luggages non of porters helped us or pay any attention. Reception staff was great and check in was quick. Beautiful view from our 40th floor room. Room is spacious, but not very cosy. No slippers, no bathrobes! Jacuzzi in bath tap did not work! It is not far from the strip, only like 10 min walk. The lobby in the hotel is very nice. We had not tried any food there as we gone eat elsewhere.

reviews.title: Decent hotel, let down by lack of cleaning and delays to providing amenities
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for 2 nights. On arrival (at around the 4pm check in time) we were really impressed at the check in desk and at the room itself, which was spacious and had brilliant reviews. After our first night, we left at around 10am for the day. We arrived back at the hotel at around 10pm to find our room had not been cleaned and amenities were not topped up. After phoning reception, we were advised there was no one around to clean the room but that they'd send someone over with amenities. No apology was given. The amenities took over 45 mins to arrive and we were waiting to go to bed. I phoned reception after 20 mins and also attempted to speak directly to reception - I was queuing and could see the customers being served we're also complaining. Oddly, one of the staff members was arguing against a customer complaining that their room had not been cleaned - this is quite a basic expectation for a 5 star hotel. Another set of customers were complaining about security.Overall, it's a shame this hotel was let down by poor service.

reviews.title: Everything taken care of
reviews.text: We are currently halfway through our week staying at the Trump and it’s fantastic no casino which is a bonus and just off the strip. We are staying on 57th floor with a great view of the mountains looking towards Death Valley. Nothing seems to be too much of a problem everyone is friendly and helpful. Our room is enormous with a giant jacuzzi bath tub. Express elevators, gym pool and a bar. We didn’t drink in the bar at all due to only bottled beer @ $10 a go.Dead opposite the hotel entrance is a shopping mall if you fancy spending some of those winnings. Overall great thanks Trump international we are having a great time.

reviews.title: Fabulous Experience!
reviews.text: We visited the Trump Hotel, Las Vegas in October 22 for 5 days and we had an amazing experience from the moment we walked in the door to the moment we left. This is a really professional outfit,  all the staff were amazing throughout our trip, the pool is amazing and the staff there cater for your every need in a relaxed but professional manner. We had a suite on floor 31 which was so clean and serviced well, only down side was the sofa, the bed side was very slumped into the frame but this did not detract from the quality of the hotel.  The views of the strip are amazing, air con great, I'd go back in an instant, even though we are not fans of the man himself, he should be proud of this fantastic hotel.

reviews.title: Excellent place, Exceptional Service
reviews.text: We stayed with family while visiting the Grand Canyon. The property is close to the main strip. The hotel was kept in an  excellent condition.  The rooms were well maintained, clean and the service was exceptional. Free valet service was available and this was such a convenience. The hotel had good views of the city.Will certainly stay here again and recommend to all those who like to stay close to the fun but enjoy peace.

reviews.title: Generally very good. Would stay here again
reviews.text: Stayed at trump hotel for 5 nights in a 1 bed suite. Very spacious! Good location just up from the main strip. Liked that it was a non smoking hotel with no casino so alot less busy. Staff very helpful & friendly. Quickly provided with extra drink pods in room when requested. Pool very nice & clean & not too crowded. Just a few minor points we noticed. Room only cleaned once during 5 days but we were fine with this. Found a few candy wrappers under sofa & a ziplock bag under the bed & a few food items from previous guests found on the cupboard Overall a good experience & would stay again.

reviews.title: Room Violation
reviews.text: This morning was a horrible experience in our room for my wife. I had stepped out to smoke and my wife was showering.  A House cleaning man used his key card to enter the room without knocking and she was just getting out of the shower completely naked with the bathroom door open. We went to management And they didn’t even apologize for the mistake. Only made excuses. This hotel is not cheap to stay at. But something should have be done right there on the spot. But nothing was. Poor management for such a nice place. We are so disappointed in our decision to stay there. Only one person at the front desk was sympathetic about the situation.

reviews.title: Stolen Item
reviews.text: We have stayed at the hotel on numerous occasions and have always had a good time. In September we stayed at the hotel for 3 nights with family in 2 one-bedroom suites. We had been building up gift cards to use during the vacation in California and Las Vegas. The largest gift card ($200+) was for a restaurant which is located right next to the Trump Hotel (the rest were mainly California-based eateries). We had booked dinner there for our last night in Vegas but our plans changed and we did not end up going there and so that gift card remained in the envelope with the others. Upon checking out, we mistakenly left the gift cards inside an envelope in our room safe. When we returned home, we realized what we had done and filed a left behind report-we received a quick response that the the item was found and I proceeded to complete the shipping info. When the envelope arrived at our home, we immediately noticed that the white envelope and gift card for the that restaurant were missing. I reached out to the hotel, spoke to a supervisor from housekeeping (A .Magana) I emailed her a few days later reiterating my disappointment at what had happened and asked to be contacted by a senior manager. She never replied to my email. This suggests to me either a total lack of respect for what happened to us or a lack of professionalism on her part. We will not stay at the hotel again and if you do, I advise you to be careful with what you leave behind or unattended in your room.

reviews.title: Great room but very annoying pool experience
reviews.text: This hotel had a great looking room, comfortable bed, pretty hotel, good location a block from the strip.But we wanted to use the pool for longer periods of time after we returned from hiking daily & this is where we were not happy. The pool is very big, water a good temp, lots of chairs. But it is only 3.5 feet deep so not for swimming but more of a conversational pool. The hotel building itself would reflect the sun so you really needed 2 umbrellas for sun block which was not easy. It was very hard to find shade. But the biggest complaint which drove us & I know others crazy was the loud music. It was all day loud drumming disco type music or rap musice. Speakers everywhere so it was hard to read a book, make a phone call or watch personal videos. I know hotels love to put on music by the pool but this was very loud & no brake, strange music, nothing you can recognize. We asked to lower it but of course they were helpless. This made the pool area awful. If you dont use the pool, keep in mind that while you sleep a loud train comes by beeping its horn 5 or 6 times. I only heard it about once or twice while sleeping but if youre a light sleeper this may bother you. Otherwise the room was gorgeous, with great views. Nobody made the room for 4 days in a row but we didnt care about that. Also there is no self parking so you have to valet park. Have a bunch of dollar bills ready for tipping. A hat in the gift shop was $39 so not a cheap place.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, but some issues
reviews.text: We recently stayed in beautiful one bedroom corner room. Problems were one shower only had extremely hot water due to broken faucet and other one filled with water as you showered. It took a half hour to go down the drain. In addition, the hotel automatically places a hold on your credit card for hundreds of dollars. I asked about it and was told it would go away in 5 days.Never had a hotel do that before for more than $100 in case you purchase incidentals.

reviews.title: Impossible To Sleep
reviews.text: There’s a lot going for this hotel but the one thing that makes it impossible to recommend to anyone is the train line that runs right next to it. The train tracks cross the road, so the trains honk their horns before going past the road and the crossing is right by the hotel. It might seem like nothing but it is insanely loud, it’s like a fog horn going off. The worst thing is they do it all night, every night. I didn’t have one good nights sleep while at the Trump. Do a quick search and you’ll see many others have experienced the same thing. You have been warned!

reviews.title: beautiful resort- few minor issues
reviews.text: Very good resort and staff is very friendly and helpful... had a corner unit on 25th floor... beautiful and very spacious...  valet is probably a nice touch for some but it was a long wait in my opinion.  I wish they had self parking.... we used our vehicle too much and had to wait a good bit- valet folks work their butts off.  Vegas was very busy and there was a convention near the hotel... In general Vegas was busy.. I was a little shocked by that...with the economy tanking  that was odd to me.  mattress was horrible... i think the worst I have ever had at a vegas hotel... that needs an upgrade.. The train noise was horrendous.. 2am and 5 am and the horn noise do to the intersection directly behind the hotel.. It is very loud and they blow the horn like 5 times as the approach the intersection.  People were wonderful and the place was very clean.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel but not a safe place to be walking at night
reviews.text: The hotel in general was amazing.  The only thing that could have been better, is that they could have come to the room at least once (with a 7-day reservation) and emptied the trash, and brought new towels.  I emptied our trash three times during my stay and had to request towels.  I was just disappointed that would happen in the highly recommended Trump. Also, it is NOT safe to walk back from the strip.  There was a stabbing right in front to the left of our hotel.  They need to step up their game and start a shuttle service.  If you are a lady going with friends, I would highly suggest you purchasing a room close to the strip that is not going to put you in any danger getting back at night.

reviews.title: Great for adults
reviews.text: The staff was amazing and was beyond helpful.  Great food and well equipped room. I highly recommend for adults.  However,  Other than a very nice pool and deck, there is nothing for kids to do compared to other resorts.

reviews.title: Highly recommended. Great location non gaming hotel 😊
reviews.text: Great hotel great staff. Perfect location and ideal for non gamblers wanting to experience the ‘strip’ which is around 15 minutes walk to the Wynn at the bottom end of the strip. Also no ‘resort fee’ which makes its nearly half the price of some other hotels on the strip, I suppose it could do with updating as parts of the room and the decor look a bit dated but still great quality. The security guards by the rooms are ruthless so don’t forget your room key or go downstairs without your key for any reason as they will not let you back in even if youve  just walked past and said hello!! Fair enough I suppose to keep the place secure but maybe a little common sense wouldn’t have done any harm! It’s a great hotel and would not hesitate to return next time. Andrew the Barman was great and did well to cope with busy periods mostly on his own. Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Disappointing. Not really bad. Just lacking true 5 star class. I was really looking forward to this place. It was my most luxurious hotel on a huge trip across the US. It feels classy going in. Up the lift, into room, seeing (mountain) view from Window etc. But after that, hottub bath jets wasn't working, fridge door wouldn't stay shut and located kind of annoyingly out the way of where it's all happening. Complained 2nd night, they offered to change my room to be fair but I was so tired and had a trip to the Grand Canyon booked the next day at crack at dawn so asked if an engineer could come the next day whilst I was out and hopefully by time I'm back all would be ok with bath and fridge. Came back 6pm after a long day. Go to room. Nothing. Not even cleaners had been. Very strange. It was like they had forgotten me. Or the room didn't exist on their system. Complained again. Nothing. Upon checking out, told lady who offered to waive 2 nights (of 3 in total) resort fee of $35 usd  per night. I bargained for more and she waived all 3 nights with hardly any hesitation so that was very fair (105 USD saved) but I still had to pay 1 Cocktail tab that they wouldn't budge on $25. I have to mention I got this room on an extremely good deal on Agoda so I really can't complain and the lady at the front didn't make me feel embarrassed at all she was real fair and swift so I haven't left bitter at all. All in it was a well run place but just lacking true 5 class but as I said I got a real good deal anyway so not bad, just not thewow factor. I have a hunch it's why I got the room so cheap, they must have known about these problems. 5217 was the room. I'd probably only recommend this hotel if you can get a good deal (in comparison to other 5 stars). Trump store on the ground floor was real cool, the staff look the part, very attractive, professional women and the food room service was amazingly quick but not cheap.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: VERY disappointed in staff responsiveness to issues in our room. We were there for five nights. Upon arrival the closet light was out and the sink was clogged. Despite several calls to front desk to request a new light bulb and the sink clog to be taken care of neither was ever attended to. Also ice machine was broken. Lastly, their website states they provide shuttle to two nearby hotels. They no longer provide that for their guests.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel. We were made feel so welcome when we checked in here. The guy on the desk was amazing, he went out of his way to make our stay on a special occasion something we’ll never forget. Rooms were very clean and well equipped. Staff were all the most friendly I’ve experienced in a hotel for quite some time. Location is just a little off th strip but an easy walk away. If I’m back on Vegas I won’t stay anywhere else!

reviews.title: Great stay at the Trump
reviews.text: Great stay at the  Trump: booked a deluxe room for my wife and I.  Stayed four days.  Check in was a breeze.  The room was spacious and very clean,  staff was great very polite and helpful.  I really appreciate the fact that there was NO minibar.  We had the fridge all to ourselves.  We had an in room Kuerig for our morning coffee.  The Trump gave as complimentary bottled waters.   Made use of the pool to escape the desert heat.  There is no casino which is great. That made the hotel feel like an oasis compared to all the other hotels we checked out.  It is a block off the strip.  No big deal we often cut thru Nordstrom and the mall next door.  The next time I come to Vegas I will definitely stay at the Trump and would highly recommend it to family and friends

reviews.title: Luxury and hospitality!
reviews.text: Our stay was short, but perfect. We checked in early with with no issues, complimentary valet, and lunch was very good. The staff here are well trained. Our room overlooked the strip, HUGE😀and 5 stars all around. Enjoy your stay a bit off the strip and in more quiet area. We certainly did!

reviews.title: Only OK
reviews.text: Spacious rooms with a wonderful view, however the sofa bed was broken, there was no mobile phone reception in the higher rooms and the kitchen cupboards & drawers were empty. It was located right down one end of the strip, so we had to Uber everywhere. Stay was OK, but not amazing.

reviews.title: Valet parking WORSE than Self-parking!!
reviews.text: Horrible and very slow valet parking not only this time but all prior stays. The antiquated cell phone electronic ticket due not allow the guests to call to valet to have their car retrieved and waiting on the guest. Front desk informed this time and several other times over many years.

reviews.title: Excellent Experience
reviews.text: My wife and I stay here for a weekend getaway.  Check in was fast and friendly.  The room was spacious and clean with a very comfortable bed.  Our favorite part was he pool area and getting a day bed, which requires spending $100 in food and beverage.  That was pretty easy to spend with lunch and a few drinks.  We felt it was a great value and a no brainer.  The food at the pool was very good and all quality ingredients.  Also, the service at the pool was excellent.  Defiantly no bad attitudes with staff at this resort, which is refreshing.  Our only complaint is that it was tough to get a taxi from this resort.  We usually use UBER or Lift, but with surge pricing, taxis were more reasonably priced almost the entire weekend.  Over all it was a great experience and a very nice hotel close enough to all of the activities we wanted to see.  We would absolutely consider staying here again.

reviews.title: Very Nice Hotel
reviews.text: The room was simple but elegant and the bathroom was beautiful. We were on the highway side of the hotel and there was a lot of traffic noise. Get an app on your phone for background noise while sleeping. You can't order from the DJT restaurant by calling them. You have to do it online. One day the website wasn't working correctly and they still would not allow me to order over the phone. They said I would have to come downstairs to the restaurant and order in person, and then let them bring it to me. The day the website was working, it said I could have my meal brought to us or pick it up. However, there was nowhere to make the choice to pick it up. So, I just went down there to pick it up. Apparently, no one does that because they looked at me like I was from another country. It was very awkward.

reviews.title: Most Dirtiest hotel I have ever stayed in
reviews.text: Dirtiest hotel I have ever stayed in. When we checked in we supposed to get room with 2 beds, instead offered one bed and a pull out sofa bed which comes with super cheap thin springy dusty mattress I ever seen in a 5 Star hotel. Whoever rated this ‘below 2 star comfort and service hotel’  is a moron.  We are extremely angry and disappointed traveled so far from Australia to experience our Vegas trip. This is really a deal breaker. After multiple times complained to house keeping staff to get the room cleaned due to excessive amount of dust and dirt piled up on the couch and bed linen. Which made us sick throughout the night, There were no service they simply ignored our request. We have travelled all over the world and stayed at finest hotels. THE TRUMP HOTEL AT VEGAS is an absolute dump! Also it is off the Vegas strip good luck walking to the strip its not fun trust me. Do your self a favour get a hotel that on the strip and make sure the rooms are clean before moving in.

reviews.title: Absolutely the nicest and best hotel deal in Vegas
reviews.text: We like nice hotels and we don't like paying $500 or $1,000 a night ...,this was a great option for us.... Very nice room very clean great view of the city wonderful staff.  Within easy walking distance to downtown Las Vegas and anything else you want to see, would highly recommend

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointed
reviews.text: This is my third time in vegas and after staying at the Palazzo and Bellagio, Trump left me very disappointed.  First off when I checked in I was asked if I wanted to pay more money for a better room.  Thinking the standard would be high for the superior room, being a five star hotel I couldn’t have been more wrong.  The room was old and tired with a lot of damage on furniture and tatty wallpaper that was coming away.  We didn’t have a hair dryer and had to call for one and a couple of lights were out in the room.  Not what you expect in a 5 star resort.The biggest annoyance was there was no sign of housekeeping during our 2 night stay, we returned to an unmade room and to add insult the Maid was ringing on the door while we were packing up on the check out day asking what time we were leaving! We had to go out and buy coffee and water as there was no refill. I bought this to the attention of the reception clerk on checkout and she said, in a blasé attitude, “probably cause we’re short staffed”.  I said that was pretty poor for a five star hotel and she agreed with me and offered no apology. I left there stunned…The valet guys were great and an asset to the hotel but I would never stay here again after the shocking service i received.  I had such high hopes for this place but was left thoroughly disappointed

reviews.title: LOVED IT!!!!
reviews.text: Let me start with, I researched Vegas stay options for nearly 3 wks. Pros n cons of everything from cost, location, amenities and overall room layout. Why you ask? Because we planned a full wk stay, so it was going to be more than just a place to crash. So in the end we chose Trump for the room layout so we could have some comfort during the down time without having to deal with all that noise and caos of casinos. Best choice hands down!!! Staff was so helpful and friendly from housekeeping, porter, front desk and security. Overall EVERYONE we came across!!!Restaurant was a little slow serving but was great food. Maybe because perfection comes with patience!Room was upgraded for just signing up for a Trump hotel rewards card. Ended up in 1 bedroom suite with kitchenette. Lovin it!! Only one complaint, need to update plugs or lamps with modern options to charge electronics. Couch was a bit dated and can tell its one half of a corner couch which I thought was below Trump standards, but figure maybe original couch became soiled and they needed quick replacement?No kitchen supplies such as dishes or glasses which I feel should at least carry a set for 2. Why provide full kitchen with zero items to eat with? View was great. Tv went out but staff was quick to respond and get it fixed right away.Deliveries need to be dropped downstairs due to security, which was inconvenient but comforting for safety. Staying here also probably saved us ton of money we would of lost in a casino hotel. Having the comfort of arriving back to a peaceful hotel was very nice and not having to listen to all the drunken adventures other places had. Overall Loved the room and amenities! Well definetly be back again and again.

reviews.title: Vegas getaway with my high school senior
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! Very clean, beautiful pool, fantastic bar, extremely friendly and helpful staff, including the valets. Close to the airport and Allegiant Stadium which is why we were in Vegas. Motley Crue stadium tour rocked!

reviews.title: Happy to be there
reviews.text: The entrance is very clean and free valet parking service but you could give tips. Friendly workers and safety gate.The best part is the room, we had regular room but it was very big and comfortable, the bathroom was very clean and grands huge bathtub jacuzzi and shower all marble floor. So very happy we chose this hotel. Not to far from the strip mall and Nordstrom store just cross street. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Everything is First Class
reviews.text: Stayed at the hotel with my wife and she will not stay anywhere else in Las Vegas . The room was just what you expect - luxury all the way . The staff could not be nicer and the location is perfectly located next to the Strip . The lobby restaurant was wonderful . Some need to get past the politics and enjoy high value luxury for a reasonable price .

reviews.title: vegas getaway
reviews.text: great hotel with outstanding service minutes from strip and shopping mall.  Rooms are cleaning beds are very comfy. Outstanding staff service at all levels  Will only stay here when visiting Vegas. Smoke free

reviews.title: Clean and safe stay
reviews.text: Stayed for 5 nights. Enjoyed our stay. No smoking inside. No casino. Felt safe and only a 5 min walk from the strip. Drop off area in front of the hotel is easy for uber and other rides to navigate. Across the street from a large mall that has tons of shops and air conditioning for moving through to treasure island if you need a nearby casino.Room was a corner suite and was large in size with good views.First night had a party happening somewhere off the property. Hotel moved us to a quiet room. Same setup. It wasn't there fault for the loud music but accommodated us none the less.  I had items delivered for a bday surprise and they were very helpful. Staff on site kept things friendly and secure.Enjoyed out time there and would go back. Clean rooms and hotel.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: This hotel is amazing.  It is beautiful inside.  The room is comfortable and has a glass shower enclosure, separate toilet closet, and bathtub.  It is very spacious too.  The restaurant is delicious and there was a variety of food items to make everyone happy.  This hotel was such a great deal for the luxury we received.  Highly recommend it!!

reviews.title: Great Customer Service - Good Location
reviews.text: This was our first stay at a Trump International hotel. We had 3 rooms on the 36th floor - Strip View. We were celebrating our parents 60th wedding anniversary. What impressed us the most was the quality of customer service. Everyone we encountered was friendly and helpful and made us feel welcome. The room was spacious, very clean and the view was okay. The bed was firm yet comfortable. However, the pillows were terrible. One was very hard & flat while the other was very soft. Also, the furniture fabric was thin and worn. The furnishings need to be refreshed. There were no USB ports in the room. These need to be added to the room. The Wi-Fi did work well. We we're pleasantly surprised to find our sheets replaced as well as the bathrooms towels every day (something we haven't experienced while traveling since before COVID). One of the reasons we chose this hotel was because it doesn't allow smoking inside. When we booked the hotel, we thought there was a self parking lot adjacent to the hotel. There is not...only valet parking. However, there is a free parking garage across the street for the Mall. You can park there during the day. But for safety reasons, we wouldn't recommend you leave the car there overnight...it would be best to valet park at the hotel. As for the hotel valet parking, on average, the attendants retrieved our car within 5 minutes. With our elderly parents, it took us about 5 minutes to walk to the Strip. Overall, we were satisfied with our stay and would recommend this hotel to our family & friends.

reviews.title: poorest hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: worst hotel in las vegas.  zero service, miserable wifi, technical problems, lousy pool.  The hotel is an air number like its namesake. poor service attitude by the staff, good thing...room is clean, just takes 10 minutes for warm water in the shower.never again Trump hotel.

reviews.title: Trump International Las Vegas-A great experience
reviews.text: I would recommend the Trump Hotel for family and solo travelers.  It is very clean, the staff are pleasant and helpful, and it is non smoking.  It is conveniently located and just a short Uber/taxi ride from other Vegas locations.

reviews.title: Stayed here during EDC
reviews.text: I booked this place during one of the busiest events of the year as the price was slightly cheaper than other comparable hotels. We had a standard bedroom with the king-sized bed and couch. The couch looked a little sus, and the kitchen sink (the kind that has sucks up all the garbage) had a funky smell. I'd rather they just cover that up as it was noticeable as soon as we walked in. First impressions aside though, the room/bed/pillows were comfortable and great for a 4 night stay and it's nice to have all that space. This is basically a giant bachelors condo.  Downside is I was on the pool side, and even at quite a high level, you will hear/feel the bass starting at 10 or 11 whenever they start the music. If you plan to sleep in, I'd try the non-pool side. Bathroom is also spacious, had a giant standing shower which I LOVED, and a jacuzzi which was okay...and two sinks! Our sinks didn't actually drain very well, but house keeping got that sorted quickly. I used the kitchen to reheat some goods and house keeping will bring you what you need (cookware, plates etc.) if you ask. I liked that you get a fresh set of things and again they were quite quick with this.Location wise this is slightly off the strip but still very walkable (to me anyway).  Like there are 5 star tacos about a 10 walk away max. Across the street, the mall has everything. I was able to do some light shopping, pick up coffee from Nordstrom, etc. Parking is free, and valet only, and during EDC, the lines to pick up the car was understandably slow (like...20 min++ sometimes 30, and once they forgot my car). If you have a group, be smart and send someone down to get the car first. Sometimes I wish I had just parked at the mall (free).Lastly, the pool! It was quite stunning and very Trump and very Vegas. Drinks at the pool side were kind of pricey. I probably would've drank/ate more if ordering was more seamless, but it was kind of a hassle and nothing jumped out at me for the splurge.  Overall, this is nicer than your average Vegas hotel but it's not as nice the true 5 star ones.  I am not disappointed but I felt there are some areas that could be better.

reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.text: We received an excellent service and the experience was what you would expect from a TRUMP property. From start to finish a very very great experience. Rooms are large and very clean with very nice amenities. We really enjoyed the restaurant. The food was very good and arrived promptly. The atmosphere was fun and exciting. The parking was a little hectic but even that was a fun experience.

reviews.title: Trump International Las Vegas
reviews.text: It was relatively quiet and clean.  Close to the large shopping mall.  Walking distance from major casinos.  We liked it for not having a casino within the hotel.  Valley service with no fee was good.  We enjoyed a large (25 meters) swimming pool.

reviews.title: Vegas glamour!
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights as part of our honeymoon road trip around the States. Despite political controversy, we chose to stay here as this hotel offered free parking for our 20ft camper van. We stay on floor 58 and had a lovely suite overlooking the Las Vegas strip. The room was spacious, very clean, very comfortable and had an amazing jacuzzi bath and rain head shower area. Toiletries were provided. The hotel is a short 5 minute walk from the strip. We were very comfortable here and really enjoyed our stay, our only complaint would be that we didn’t receive a maid service or fresh towels during our stay which was slightly disappointing. We would recommend and stay here again in the future.

reviews.title: FANTASTIC!
reviews.text: Hotel  5 StarService 5 starCustomer service 5 starPool WonderfulRoom SuperIf your wondering where to stay in Vegas, do not hesitateSTAY HERE ! WE LOVED EVERY MINUTE OF OUR 4 DAY STAY*THANK YOU TRUMP HOTEL

reviews.title: Exceptional!!
reviews.text: Trump International is my go to place from now on.  I love the convenience of check in and the cleanliness of the rooms.  No casino so you’re in your room in a minute.  The service was outstanding from all employees. I highly recommend a sty here.

reviews.title: Superb Stay
reviews.text: The stay at Trump International Hotel in Las Vages was very relaxing. The rooms are spacious and nice. The view from the rooms was great. It was at the pool and in the gym perfect. In the whole perspective it was superb.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: Vegas vacation with the family and had a great time! Trump International is a great to place and is the most beautiful place! From the Lobby to the pool and the rooms that are spacious and comfortable it met every expectation!

reviews.title: Put politics aside this is a great hotel!
reviews.text: Put politics aside this is a great hotel. You can enjoy Vegas without having to stay awake all night due to the casino noises. Food, spa, pool all the amenities were hit! An easy walk to all casinos and convenience to the outdoors. We visited the Grand Canyon, the Hoover dam and Utah.

reviews.title: Worse Hotel we ever been in Vegas
reviews.text: We ordered 2 beds - they did not have  so they gave us a room with 1 bed.We have 3 kids, we need 2 beds. They wanted $6400 extra... 4 nights.From a $100/night they jumped it to $1600/night.We said no thanks and took the 1 bed. they tried to do the whole "let me call the manager trick" and reduced to price to $500/night... which was still 5 times what we paid. Disgrace !Then we realized  there is NO SELF PARKING... But there's more...lots more. They had NO casino, so we had to WALK every night to the casino at night - because we had no car... it was parked far away.Then there was the shower. NO COLD WATER. Only boiling hot. You put it in COLD and it comes lava hot... I complained - they sent a tech , no change. Next morning I try to shower... put COLD water - comes out boiling hot again. Ok , no showers for a week...I should have expected that from Trump.We go to sleep - 5am in the morning... we get a WAKE UP CALL from a TRAIN. I kid you not.There's a train passing by every morning at 5-6 am - because that's what you want in your vacation... to wake up at 5 am from a TRAIN !!! TSHU TSHUUUU !!! every god damn morning !!! It's like a horron movie. UN BELIEVEABLE !!Lastly... the 3rd day the whole room stinks... there's a leak in the floor - half the carpet is wet. I dont know why and how... but it starts to stinks. mold. sitting water.I hate to complain more... because they have no other rooms and we are too tired to change rooms.WORSE EXPERIENCE WE EVER HAD IN VEGAS !!

reviews.title: Excellent hotel with quirks
reviews.text: We loved our corner hotel room with this spectacular view and spacious accommodation. The service was mostly very professional, friendly and helpful. However, the valet situation needs to be improved and the breakfast food seemed to be instant microwave fare and as such was subpar.

reviews.title: Average hotel and  staff with a bad service attitude
reviews.text: We booked thru Expedia , which was a smooth experience as usual.However when checking in , we had to leave some deposit by credit card as usual . Unfortunately they did not take our credit cards (Master Card , Amex , Union Pay and also German debit card) because they require a pin . Though we never had problems on our trip in San Francisco and other places in the US a couple of days before, they refused to take the credit cards without pin. After offering to leave the deposit by cash or Apple Pay , they refused as well , as it would be against their policy . So I asked what is the solution , which they can offer now . The manager on duty told me , I should call my bank . Of course I told him , that my bank is in Germany and because of the time difference and the the fact that it is Saturday , the bank will not be available . Nevertheless he did not offer any solution . It was not just the policy which they were hiding behind , it was also their way of talking and treating the customer as an idiot , which make us upset .Anyway we managed to get one of our credit card pins online and finally ckecked in . The rooms are big and clean , though the design is very old fashioned. But as the room was very loud , because the window sealing were not very good at all and looked like poorly fixed , we asked to change the room to a quieter room . After 2 attempts we canceled our remaining stay in the Trump Hotel and changed to Wynn. The general bad attitude of the staff towards the customer was obvious also during our requests to change the room . We will not go there again.In the Wynn we have been welcomed by a by far much more helpful staff and the rooms are much nicer and quiter anyway.Additionally the Hotel charged us for nights and service fees which we did not use . We checked out one day after check in and changed to the Wyn , but Trump Hotel charged for the complete booking despite they said , that they will send a message to Expedia for reimbursement.

reviews.title: No Room Service
reviews.text: My title is the definition of my stay at Trumo hotel. there was no room service at all. even though i had two rooms the room service never came to clean. we contacted the front desk and the service desk and we are still waiting for them to come and clean the room.

reviews.title: Please staff, great location!
reviews.text: The resort and staff are excellent. Access to the stripe is through a top notch shopping mall.  Had a great time and everything we wanted was nearby. The valet service was included with our stay, and when we wanted our vehicle, the staff was quick, pleasant, and efficient.

reviews.title: Best off Strip Hotel
reviews.text: Excellent room, great staff. Super clean very friendly. Parking is a bit of a hassle but everything else is wonderful. Location is perfect, strip is less than 5 min walk and the mall is across the street. Easy to cut through the mall drops you out right at TI.

reviews.title: Loved our stay
reviews.text: Professional and fast service non smoking facility clean spacious room w/ kitchenette, quality of food from the restaurant  fast elevators good security no "riff raff" and you dont need to walk half a mile to your room

reviews.title: Disappointing unit
reviews.text: We needed to have a service worker come up to the unit THREE TIMES !!! The TV pixilated and froze repeatedly, so we had service come up. He 're-booted' and the TV worked better, but STILL froze/etc every so often. The stove was not working and we had service up for that. HE FLIPPED A HIDDEN SWITCH (behind the mirror!) and turned it on. Took less than 5 seconds.....but why wasn't it on already ?!? If I have to call for service, that's a bit of a negative, but I understand that on occasion that happens. THREE VISITS is totally unacceptable if the resort wants a good review

reviews.title: Outdated Hotel
reviews.text: Old furniture and fixtures. Front desk personnel with tattoos. Breakfast menu in the restaurant is limited. Could not get sufficiently hot coffee. USB ports did not work. Good location. Just two small water bottles per day. Pleasant personnel.

reviews.title: Miss leading room description
reviews.text: I booked the corner suite from Booking.com, it is said the room has Vegas strip view and even with photo of strip, I paid almost $100 extra comparing with regular suite. While, when I stayed in, it is not what expected. There is no strip view, at least the photo published on booking.com or Trump website are not true. The photos taken for the room are not true, you will not get what you saw from the photo.

reviews.title: large rooms but room service and food is ugly
reviews.text: trump is what it is we know that.a huge vessel with few attention to guests. In room dining was a terrifyng experience FOOD was awful uncooked, wrapped in plastic containers , super greassy .... pool is always full with kids and people talking loud Trump is not for refined people but for families with uneducated kids.

reviews.title: Great stay !
reviews.text: We were very apprehensive after reading some of the reviews, we shouldn’t of worried Once we arrived you can see the opulent reception area Check in was very swift and the staff were very helpful We had a stop facing room, on floor 50 so very quiet no train noiseFirst night we arrived late and ordered room service although small menu it suited what we needed Room was very large and clean, had a small kitchen area, although never cooked the fridge was a god send We had our room cleaned every day, although it was mentioned it’s every other day The pool was great, never struggled once for 4 beds together, servers round the pool do the hotel proud, quick service for drinks and food Direct over road from fashion show mall, 80 meters max walk 10 minute walk to main strip wynn / encore etc We used Uber a lot to get around, very cheap and efficient We found our 11 night stay excellent and would recommend the hotel to anyone

reviews.title: Exceptional Hotel
reviews.text: Our first stay at the Trump International in Vegas and it will not be our last.  Exceptional hotel, service and staff.  Everything one would expect from a product with the Trump name on it. Everyone was genuinely welcoming and cared for us as guests.  Felt very safe with the person checking all key cards before going up on the elevator.  Also, enjoyed not having a noisy and smoky casino attached to the hotel.  That made the stay peaceful.  Food was very good in the DJT restaurant as well as good service.  So happy we stayed here this time instead of another hotel.

reviews.title: Best kept secret in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Great resort if you are looking for a low key resort. Very secure resort. No casino but not far from the Las Vegas strip. Pool stage and location was great and they do have a full food and beverage menu with pool service.

reviews.title: Trump Hotel treated our pets like gold
reviews.text: Our first time staying at a Trump Hotel. One of the few hotels on the strip which allows us to bring our pet cat. He travels everywhere with us, so a 5 star hotel shouldn’t be any different. We had great stay and they had water bowls and place mat for our pets. How cool is that? 😺

reviews.title: THIS IS THE PLACE TO STAY IN VEGAS!
reviews.text: If you want the sights of the strip bit not everything else that comes with the strip then Trump is the hotel for you.Easy to get to the hotel is back off the strip so away from the noise and people.The hotel is clean so well presented, staff are excellent, valet is quick, rooms are huge, 2 queen size beds, mini kitchenette with big microwave oven and small hob.Bathroom has a bath with jets, 2 wash basins, and a huge shower.TV had ample channels and the floor to ceiling windows gave an unbelievable view of the strip.We were in room 5948, perfect room.Pool Was nice, didn't get to use the gym, free ice water by the pool and towels.Shop sells everything Trump, along with other essential items.This is the only hotel we'd stay at if we came back.No casino so no smoking or undesirables, although there are plenty of those on the strip!

reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text: Excellent hotel service.  It met all my expectations.  I felt secured, rooms super clean, service to the room quick, room space fantastic and comfortable.  I liked the fact it did not have casino.  It was a nice break from LV Strip.  Huge Mall just across the street and very convenient for any need you may have.

reviews.title: Great hotel for family
reviews.text: It was great to stay in this hotel. Everything was clean and well-tidy. The staff members were extremely friendly and kind. There is no casino so it would be amazing to accommodate with family. One thing that is inconvenient is the location. The hotel is located at the the end of the popular street of Las Vegas so it takes us time to to walk over to see the downtown street at night. Adults would be fine but young kids would be not. It is very hard to use cars at night so you should consider the location if you accompany young kids.

reviews.title: Where is the room service??
reviews.text: We got married in Vegas and wanted to have nice room service and when  I called in advance to make sure , they said yes ... But it was only to-go food!:(  Conceire was never around and when I finally talked to her they said sorry and told me to get tickets to shows online .

reviews.title: This hotel sparkles !
reviews.text: Staying for one night before flying out of Vegas wished we had stayed longer was travelling with my father.. Booked a corner suite with pull out sofa - the room & view was exceptional. Every detail of the hotel from the beautiful lobby to the cleanliness to the friendly and professional staff, the marble bar and the delicious drinks and food was beyond expectations! I also loved being able to shop in the Trump Store ⭐️ I will def be returning!

reviews.title: Amazing service and rooms.
reviews.text: We has an amazing experience.Customs service was top notch. The hotel is beautiful. We enjoyed the spacious room. The kitchen was convenient, it was nice to have even though we didn’t use it much.  The pool was amazing and family friendly. We had dinner at DTJ restaurant and everything was spectacular. We will definitely be returning.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: We needed ear plugs for our concert and they didn't have any at the convenience store at the hotel, so we asked where to purchase them and were given directions to a nearby Walgreens. A few minutes later, an employee came out and gave us four pairs before we left the hotel. Fantastic service.

reviews.title: Perfect Stay!
reviews.text: An AMAZING experience at Trump Hotel Las Vegas. I arrived and was checked in by Jenna, who was very kind and informative giving a run down of the hotels amenities. The next morning Nancy was our server at breakfast and she was prompt and friendly with fantastic menu suggestions. Last but certainly not least Makenna Simmons is a true host and incredible at what she does. The personalized service that I received made me feel like a VIP guest. Thank you to the Trump Team for a fantastic stay!!!

reviews.title: Easy, luxurious works perfectly well.
reviews.text: We went to Vegas for a short escape on a weekend and I booked Trump. In the big messy Vegas story Trump is no hassle , easy, practical and luxurious. Valet takes your car in 5 min (free) check in is done in 5 min and you are in your room which is overlooking the Vegas skyline for a very reasonable price for a Vegas weekend.

reviews.title: Jason the manager is rude mean racist
reviews.text: I arrived at the hotel in the evening and the reception was terrible. I've never seen such rude service. The racism of the lobby manager made me understand why the front desk service was so rude. With such a lobby manager, it is not difficult to understand the service attitude of the front desk.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
reviews.text: This is a wonderful hotel. The rooms were very large and included a small kitchen in living room and a huge bathroom with Jacuzzi tub. The view was beautiful from the high floors everything was clean the staff was professional the pool and hot tub and fitness center were amazing and the restaurant food was high-quality.

reviews.title: Early arrival to vegas
reviews.text: We arrived a day early to vegas, booked room at Trump since Caesar’s could not accommodate our early arrival . Wish we had stayed there instead. Front desk , valet attendants , room service , everyone there was extremely nice and accommodating. Trump shop has descent prices and was right across from the mall. The greatest thing was you could walk down hallway, ride elevator , be in lobby and outside without the awful smell of “weed” all around like we e experienced  at Caesar’s. If we ever go back yo Vegas this is where we will stay.

reviews.title: Best Valet Service
reviews.text: The Valet service was the best everyday! Those guys /gals really responded quickly to get the cars in and out! The hotel maid service could of emptied the trash every other day after a 5night stay. That was disgusting.

reviews.title: Nice pet friendly hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed with our dog. The hotel is beautiful, room is clean and spacious, and dining is yum and pretty reasonable price compared to other Las Vegas hotels. We could walk to Wynn, Venetian, and Fashion Show mall in August. We’ll stay again.

reviews.title: ALMOST 5*
reviews.text: Everything was perfect except for the sofa bed, very springy and looks old. The staff were great again except for one by the elevator, acting like in a military field, lol. U can be strict but nice and kind

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Very nice hotel with a friendly staff, close to the strip. The only complaint that we had was that there was no room service between day one and two. The coffe was filled up immediately once we called the front desk

reviews.title: Without my recommendation
reviews.text: We are staying in this hotel, we were travelling all day and nobody made up our room, then when we went for a dinner I called and asked for making up our room, so they just dropped towels on the table… terrible and ridiculous performance… no dressing gowns in the room…

reviews.title: Great location and hotel
reviews.text: Great little spot if you want to be close to the strip but away from all the noise. It was very peaceful and relaxing by the pool and the hotel is right across from fashion show mall so you have access to my choice if you enjoy shopping and quick bite to eat . Overall great experience and would stay there again. I wish you could call down ahead of time fro valet parking instead of waiting around in the hot sun for your car but parking attendants where really great and tried there best to move quickly in such a busy environment.

reviews.title: Enjoyed the size of the guest suit and bath
reviews.text: We visited for vacation and stayed at the property already 4 times at least, returning again. It's located in convenient place close to the Fashion Show and Strip, Wynn etc. I like the idea that there is no casino there and as a result - no crowd and no smoking inside of the building. This is a kids and pet friendly hotel. This year they extended hours for dining and we were able to dine when arrived really late. Also bar is available until 12 am or even later.  We usually take corner suite, it has 1 large bedroom and guest room, panoramic views from all rooms, full kitchen and 2 full baths, 1 is in master bedroom and it has a huge bath with 2 sinks, large shower and huge bath tub where you can enjoy the view from it to the Strip, we easily fit together with tall husband. We also tried SPA with massage, facials etc in Trump's hotel and were pleased with the experience. And not the last thing for me also - quality of sleep, the master bed has good quality mattress and pillows, you literally do not hear neibours, thanks to the soundproof walls (it's my guess). Strongly recommend for the peaceful and enjoyable stay to everyone, couples, families. dogs etc.

reviews.title: Great first impression
reviews.text: Great first impression when we walked into the room. Plenty of room for 4 adults. Check-in was swift although we weren’t sure where to go when we pulled up as there were many cars in the entrance. Swimming pool experience was wonderful.

reviews.title: Ok but dusty and missing the spark
reviews.text: We stayed at the 59th floor with an amazing view on the city and desert (not on the strip). Rooms are very spacy and also bathroom is very spacious. Beds are very comfortable. The room includes a small kitchen. However, there was quite some dust on the room and in the cupboards. Also the additional 'spark' which could be expected from a 5 star Trump hotel was missing. No bath ropes in the room available, no pens or slippers available. What a missed opportunity. In combination with the Trump logo on amenities (logo was nowhere found in the room) this would have given it a luxury experience. Late check-out was not available at this hotel.

reviews.title: All gold everything!
reviews.text: The trump hotel is upscale, quality and the staff are all tremendously helpful and professional.  The room was cozy and traversing the building couldn't have been easier.  Loved the pool side feels and amount of people were all within a comfortable level.  Ol Number 45 always keeping it classy!

reviews.title: Worst Experience Ever
reviews.text: I had one of the worst experiences while staying in a hotel.I booked my stay for 4 (my wife along with my old parents) for one night (8/6). The room which I booked had a double bed and a sofa bed as we needed 4 people to sleep.When I tried opening the sofa bed at night, it did not work and I called room service. After waiting for 20 mins, they came with a pillow and bed sheet. The staff told me the sofa bed is broken and he would get me a roller bed. I waited another 30 mins, then I received a call from the front desk saying there is no roller bed as well and they are fully booked. Basically I was told to somehow manage and the front desk told me they would take off resort fees. My wife and I could not sleep even when we tried sleeping on the floor. On top of that, when we tried putting the bed sheet which we got from room service, even that was torn. After all these mishaps, the front desk has the audacity to charge me completely for my stay and just take off resort fees? This is highly unacceptable and I demand a complete refund of my stay.From my experience of being a business traveler for a long period, I can confidently tell this is a very serious mishandling of a reservation.

reviews.title: Terrible expierence at Trump Las Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: The corner one-bedroom suite spelled like sewage, the carpet was old and dirty, the trains blow their horns all night when they go by the hotel (obviously not Trump lovers), and the spotlights that shine on the hotel at night light up the rooms.  Terrible hotel... and I used to stay their in years past, but never again.

reviews.title: Amazing, super clean the front of the House staff was super attentive.
reviews.text: Security was on point, loved the valet parking as well.  The pool vibe was relaxing and all the staff was professional and observant if your needs as a guest.  The best part is having the feeling of Vegas without the Casino crowd when you need to rest.

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!
reviews.text: We upgraded to a suite and glad we did.  Great view! Beautiful room, with a bathroom as big as my home bath, toilet area and shower combined.  Bed was very comfortable.  We were on the 47th floor, and each room has small air vents on the window ledge, which I suppose are for air pressure during a storm.  It rained several times while we were there…something we have never seen in LV, and the windows whistled some, but not bad and not for any prolonged period of time.  There was some signs of wear on the carpet between the bedroom and living room, but nothing to turn us off..The staff is great! You can hear the pool and noise from the strip on that side of the building, which faces the Strip, but it’s not bad, Make sure you have extra cash for tips, as they don’t stock the kitchens with anything and you need to order stuff.  We are so use to traveling with our bank cards, but they have a teller downstairs.  The hotel is directly across from the Fashion Mall, and Nordstroms, so you just walk across the crosswalk to it.  Very convenient!  The staff was excellent, the new items added to the menu were lovely..try the fish and chips!  We will stay there again.

reviews.title: Rooms and service at the level you would expect of #45, Donald Trump.
reviews.text: From the parking Valet to the Desk Staff to the Housekeepers to the Restaurant Personnel, this Hotel was like a finely tuned machine, with every part perfectly in sync. So, it's not right on the strip. This is Las Vegas and it's close enough without being in the middle of the craziness. So, it doesn't have a casino in the middle of the lobby. Thank you very much for that one, sir. We loved it and will be back again.

reviews.title: No customer service ethic
reviews.text: Yes it was somewhere to rest but the lack of customer service ethic was profound. No-one to offer help with luggage. At check in i received no guidance on where the room or lifts were and had to ask. Having booked for 3 people there was only one bed in the room and when i called to ask for the extra bed to be made up i was told it’d be a one hour wait (not great with a tired daughter after long uk flight). Then room service did come but they literally dropped two pillows and some sheets on the coffee table and walked out - they didn’t offer to even make the bed up. On day 2 when i called at 4pm to ask when the room would be made, the staff member said they ordinarily don’t clean rooms daily but could put in a request for me! Definitely not the Vegas experience we hoped for. Thankfully a great Canyon experience and show at Bellagio helped compensate for a really poor Trump International experience

reviews.title: Filthy Carpets!
reviews.text: Seriously? This is Trump Hotel. Why are the carpets, especially in the elevators and hallways, and even my 1st room...dirty. Not acceptable.Also the valet service is free. That's great. But when I have to wait 35 minutes to get my car from one of them...not great. My vacation was waiting! Hire more people please.

reviews.title: Don’t Bother
reviews.text: The show valve came off in our hands, the air conditioner made a high-pitched squealing noise constantly and never actually cooled the room. The hook was missing off the back of the bathroom door. The Wi-Fi was so slow, I couldn’t even check email. I complained and the lady on the phone told me I could upgrade the Wi-Fi I was already paying 40 bucks a night for. The gym was small and did not have a good variety of machines. And, as usual, the “valet” parking is a complete disaster. We will NEVER return.

reviews.title: Vegas Getaway
reviews.text: Nice hotel!  Comfortable, clean and quiet.  Good breakfast but pricey.  Staff is friendly and helpful.  Valet takes 15-20 minutes to get car.  It’s valet only.  10-15 minute walk to Encore, Wynn and Venetian.  Across from Fashion Mall which is a good short cut to strip.  Will be Back!

reviews.title: Trump International Hotel
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with amazing amenities and great customer service. The rooms are spacious and very comfortable and the pool/spa was so relaxing. We will definitely stay again our next trip to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Stayed here for 1 night after travelling around California. As soon as you walk into the lobby you feel relieved to not be surrounded by a casino floor. Everything is immaculate. Staff are friendly and efficient. Rooms are big and clean. Pool area has a really nice vibe. Feels more upmarket than the rest of the hotels in Vegas and the clientel are sober. Also the hotel doesn't smell of cannabis like most of the others.

reviews.title: Honest review
reviews.text: I was there on 08/01/22 to 08/04/22 and all was good and I had a nice stay with my friends until I checked out and forget my new sneakers at the room 4217, I came back a couple hours after and they let me look at the room, there was nothing , the room was already clean and they say there was nothing in the room, I was pretty sure that the shoes where there , I can’t believe that this happen to me in a TRUMP HOTEL, the shoes were expensive they even ask me for a purchase receipt that I already sent them , anyways I will never go back to this hotel that’s for sure , can’t believe they made me change my mind just for a pair of shoes

reviews.title: Absolutely recommendable!
reviews.text: We travelled to Vegas making it the end of our family road trip. Nice experience, price quality is guaranteed! Spacious and comfortable rooms. Finally a Hotel with sufficient seats around the pool! Would book Trump Int again without hesitation.

reviews.title: Best Hotel in Vegas
reviews.text: Huge rooms, super clean, full-size products, plenty of large towels, great internet. Free valet parking.  Nice pool!Full kitchen with nice coffee maker and great coffee!Free internetreally nice place to stay!

reviews.title: NOT STAY IN HERE
reviews.text: The service is terrible, the rooms are old, and the hotel walk to the strip is far and dangeorus, also the service from the people in here is the worst, rude people and fees they neverk ask you for paying

reviews.title: You have to make your own bed
reviews.text: This is billed as a luxury hotel. I have stayed in many luxury hotels but have never had to make my own bed. On returning to our room on day one, the room had not been made up, towels replaced and coffee and milk replenished. I called house keeping and they informed me that rooms were only made up and cleaned every three days!! Seriously!, this is not mentioned on the website, reception do not tell you when you check in and it is not on the information sheet that reception issue.

reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: The hotel is in a good location, we were happy that there wasn’t a casino inside, the hotel is pristine and the customer service was fast and friendly.The rooms are big and super clean.We used the pool and the gym and it was very nice, excellent to bring your family and a have a break from the overwhelming outside.

reviews.title: Amazing stay with great views of the strip!
reviews.text: Right off the strip.  No smoking. No casino. Quiet adult focused stay with super clean rooms and amazing views of the strip if you opt for that.  Beds were SUPER comfortable.  Huge jetted tubs were great after a long day of work. Staff is amazing and super friendly and helpful. Great places to eat are nearby if you do not eat here.  Rides in and out of the hotel are super easy and available.  A friend recommended this place and it definitely did NOT disappoint! We will stay here from now on when in Vegas.  Truly awesome!!

reviews.title: Staying with the Trumpster
reviews.text: It’s a great place to stay. A casino is a short walk from the hotel if you want to gamble. The pool and outdoor jacuzzi was very nice. Plus they  are dog friendly. We will definitely stay again while in Vegas.

reviews.title: Customer Experience
reviews.text: I would love to recognize DISHA. She made us feel at home. Overall it was a great experience. The hotel did not smell of cigs, the staff were inviting, and the valet was very speedy & consistent. I love the drop off/ pick up system valet has going on. The pillows were amazing & the room was pretty sound proof.

reviews.title: Las Vegas / Trump
reviews.text: Very Good Hotel with large e clean rooms. Good location few steps from  the Strip. Pool is ok but not very big. Car valet for free is fantastic. In front of a new commercial center: No Casino inside and no shops.

reviews.title: Great for families!
reviews.text: Rooms are spacious and family friendly, our room had a nice kitchen.  This is a great place to stay on the Vegas strip if you are traveling with children.  Very safe, very easy to get in and out of, great pool for young kids.

reviews.title: Excelent
reviews.text: Very clean , the staff were very courteous and loved to help . The hotel location was great . right in front of the Large fashion mall . staff were exceptional. the food was fresh and was brought to the table quickly

reviews.title: Pleasure
reviews.text: It was absolutely beautiful loved every bit the bathroom in the hotel room was Devine and the restaurant in the trump hotel was very yummy good food too I just wish the pool was deeper then 4ft that is my one and only complaint

reviews.title: Old, yellowish, smelly pillow, blanket
reviews.text: I was first very impress with valet parking, room size come with mini kitchen, nice clean bathroom.  However, they need to replace yellowish smelly pillow and blanket or at least wash them!  We booked two room, after requesting to exchange clean pillow for the first room, we found out blanket of the second room is so dirty and smell, we have to sleep with the smell the first night.  Even wr request room to be refresh before we left hotel the second day, we came back after midnight and saw towel thrown on counter, shampoo, soap, toilet paper, water all put in plastic bag and left on floor by bathroom door.  This was very bad experience staying here!

reviews.title: Amazing as always
reviews.text: This hotel is the only place we stay in Vegas. Rooms are so big and beautiful, staff is all so happy and we love there isn’t a casino filled with smoke. We keep coming back! Only a short walk to the strip.

reviews.title: Bad service
reviews.text: Never had such a bad experience. They never cleaned our room and we stayed for 5 days. They didn’t even tell us they weren’t coming to clean the room. They just stayed away. Then we staye 2 more days and were promised a specific room. And when we got down in the morning. Suddenly the room weren’t available. And then he filled me a lie about the room was broken. But we saw other people stay in the room instead. I felt so sad. Why lie. I will never come back.

reviews.title: Terrible Service
reviews.text: Great disappointment.They changed the room booked, gave no alternative, claiming that the Hotel was crowded, my 2 adult children had to sleep on the sofa bed, nor extra bed was offered to us.Besides, we didn't have room service, a shame. Reception staff were arrogant and unwilling to help, lousy service.Restaurant options is very poor and slow service, the meal was ok.We do not recommend Trump International Las Vegas

reviews.title: Trump Las Vegas Needs Improvement
reviews.text: We had stayed at Trump Las Vegas in the past and had very good experience and room cleanliness.  Upon checking in at 2:45PM we were told that our room was not ready and will be ready in 1/2 hour to 45 min.  We wait for 40 minutes without receiving a text that our room would be ready.  Upon checking in with the front desk we were told that our room was ready.  We had booked at corner room with strip view.  The room definitely had odor as if some one had used the room, but was not cleaned.  We asked for a different room, but was told that it would be on a much lower floor.  We ended up upgrading by paying a lot more for a higher floor room.  Room cleaning services didn't always replenish all items such as coffee, clean cups, and coffee stirrers daily.  We stayed in a Presidential Suite!  Definitely much improvements are needed.  We have recently stayed at the Trump Waikiki and definitely there is a huge gap between both of these hotels.  The Waikiki facility was more superior in all regards.

reviews.title: Close, but No Cigar...
reviews.text: First:  Not a "bad" place to stay, let's get that up front.Room:  That said, my room was large, nicely furnished and had a great view of the Strip; yet, the furniture was a bit threadbare ~ The bath area was quite nice though the shower control was a bit finicky and getting a good mixture took a bit of getting used to; not a big deal...Arrival:  to put it bluntly, and I'm betting you've heard this previously, the "all valet" parking is a disaster ~ The valet crew were running their butts off and trying to provide the best service they could; they were polite and responsive ~ It's the system/plan which needs overhaul ~ Arriving vehicles stack literally into the street and guests wait~n~wonder; that's not good ~ Vehicles brought out of the parking garage add to the confusion and the delays; again, not good ~ I am literally surprised no one has been hit by an errant vehicle ~ I'm not a parking engineer, hence what do I know; I'd suggest, though, this issue be studied toward the end guests self park, as is common on the Strip, or avail themselves of the valet.Issue:  I hit the road for a day trip only to come back and find my room had not been serviced ~ When I went to dinner, I advised the desk clerk who apologized and said she'd send someone up ~ When I returned, no service had been done ~ "A" or "B"; "A" signals got crossed which happens but doesn't make a good impression; or, "B" it's Trump policy rooms are serviced only at end~of~stay to prep for new arrivals [I hate this, but it is what it is...] ~ In that case, the clerk flat out lied to me rather than advising me of the policy; that not good...Departure:  I went to the concierge desk and to speak with the on~duty manager and, after getting grilled as to why, and advising I'd speak to the manager about that, I was pointed to an area and told to wait ~ And wait i did for a few minutes, asked again and was told he was "on the phone" and told to continue waiting which I did for a few more minutes; maybe ten (10) minutes in total ~ No manager appeared whereupon I left not a happy camper.Bottom Line:  These are fixable issues; again, not a "bad" experience, but certainly not up to Trump standards.

reviews.title: Family Fun In Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed in a twin Queen room as a family of four with two children (10 & 12) for 3 nights. The room was large with a kitchenette and fridge which was perfect for our jet lagged needs of needing to eat at random times. The bathroom was enormous, with the toilet and shower separated from the main bathroom area in their own compartment accessed by dividing doors. There was also a gigantic bath with massage jets that could easily fit 3 people!We found the hotel to be spotlessly clean and that it always smelled fresh.We made use of the gym and the staff were perfectly happy for children to use the equipment under supervision which made a refreshing change to other places.The pool area was also clean and family friendly with children allowed to play with pool toys/ balls all day. The pool is open 7am -9pm which was great unless there are strong winds in which case it can be closed. We ordered food from the pool menu and found it to be very reasonably priced for a 5* hotel and also of really good quality. Would definitely recommend this hotel and especially to those travelling with children as there is no casino here and it is a no smoking hotel. Although the hotel is not on the strip itself, you can walk to the strip through the shopping mall that is directly across the road from the hotel.

reviews.title: A great choice.
reviews.text: Having been to Vegas before, I knew the location of this hotel (difficult not to miss a gold tower block stuck out on its' own) This is an easy walk to the strip (Wynn/Venetian are 5 minutes or so) either straight down the road or through the Fashion Show Mall. The hotel does not have a casino, so doesn't attract hordes of tourists, which is a distinct plus point.A nice pool area with great staff and the staff generally were very pleasant and helpful.Apart from the outside of the building, there is very little "bling" in the hotel, compared with the other main hotels on the strip. The rooms and corridors are spacious and well cleaned/serviced. Water flow in the shower was only just adequate, which was a shame in a nice large shower area, but water is something of scarce resource in Vegas! The hotel was generally quiet during the evening/night.I only ate breakfast in the hotel, but what I had was fine with an adequate choice.Security staff checking access to the lifts makes you feel secure.I asked for a cab to the airport, but was taken in one of the "Trump" registered limos. Very nice, but wasn't sure if people thought I was a celebrity or a legitimate target!There is a very noisy train track behind the hotel. The track has multiple road crossings, so the engines sound their bull horns almost continuously when passing. The trains are very long, sometimes pulled by three locomotives, so the noise of the trucks can go on for up to 5 minutes. They pass by both during the day and night.Overall a great choice and will return.

reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: Everything was First Class! Check In Process was smooth and easy! Loved how they had someone monitoring who had access to elevators. The dining option had a great assortment and priced perfectly. Everything was extremely clean! Bathroom was a great size. Bedding was comfortable

reviews.title: Best Hotel
reviews.text: I loved the bathroom and spacious room and the view is amazing in our room (city view). Valet parking only. If you are driving Tesla, they’ll need the key. And put it on valet mode if you wish. Would stay there again definitely!

reviews.title: Trump Hotel
reviews.text: All the hotel was clean and lovely, I booked two rooms for my family and they put us four floors apart and it required us taking two different sets of elevators and we couldn’t share any toiletries or items etc. since I have children on this trip this was very disappointing. The staff at the front desk made no attempt to help remedy the situation.The positive side is it had a very nice upscale bathroom and a lovely view of the strip which was gorgeous in the evening. Well it was clean and luxurious, I’ve had better service at the comfort suites.There’s no self parking option, so you also must wait for complimentary valet parking which can take 15 to 30 minutes and is also a bit of a nuisance.

reviews.title: Best hotel
reviews.text: We travel pretty much. This hotel was the best. Not expensive and a really 5 star hotel. I can’t complain of anything. Rooms were really good. Jacuzzi worked perfectly. Beds comfy all clean. We came for one night and stayed 3.

reviews.title: Perfect hotel neer the strip
reviews.text: Perfect hotel neer the strip, very goed service and without all the people from a casino, vallet parking works verry good, room was on 34 and the other time on 59. Both with room to the strip, it was a perfect place to stay for some days with my family

reviews.title: Trump delivers a great hotel experience
reviews.text: The hotel was everything you expect with the Trump name. Excellence. Staff was friendly and great. Room was very spacious and clean. Beds were so comfortable I didn't want get out of it in the morning.

reviews.title: Honest review!!!!
reviews.text: First time staying at Trump and would definitely stay there again. Pet friendly, clean, location and price in that order. Pet price was the best in Vegas hotels, I looked at them all. They even surprised us with treats for the puppies!! We ate at the hotel twice. Burger and French dip sandwich-Great!! Chicken sandwich and salad could’ve been better.

reviews.title: Great View of the City
reviews.text: We arrived about 1:30 in the afternoon. Even though check-in time was scheduled for 3:00. They had a a room available. Check-up was fast and friendly.The view was spectacular on the mountain side of the hotel.  The room spacious came with a cooktop, microwave, large mini- refrigerator, walk-in shower, and spa tub. There are two options for breakfast. The first option is a small coffee bar near the elevators. This bar had coffee, breakfast sandwiches and assorted pastries. The other option is the full-service restaurant.                                 Had the eggs benedict with smoke salmon and diced potatoes.  Both the bar and restaurant food were hot and fresh.The hotel was Pet-Friendly.  There is no casino at this hotel.  Which was a nice quite change of pace.

reviews.title: Fantastic room with great view on the Strip
reviews.text: We booked a suite for my wife and myself and a standard room for the children. Both were adjacent on the 59th floor with a fantastic view on the Strip. The suite was very spacious, which allowed us to spend a great evening with the children, dinner in the room, playing cards with an amazing view.Great experience !

reviews.title: No Housekeeping
reviews.text: If you stay more than one night, do not expect housekeeping... When calling reception: "this is our new policy. No housekeeping". Yes but you don't advertise it anywhere: "yes I understand. But sorry, that's it"... 5-star hotel ?And no room service. App is not working. When calling: "you have to come downstairs".Trump... what a lie.

reviews.title: Meh.
reviews.text: This property is 3-star. Very average, especially when compared to other Vegas choices (Wynn, Venetian, Aria, Cosmopolitan, etcetc). And if you like not having a casino, the Vdara is more upscale. Plus things are not what they seem here; whenever I thought something was marble, gold, or granite, I looked closely and found plastic and imitation. Whenever I really “took a look under the hood” all the furniture and furnishings throughout the property was cheap and cheaply made. I guess it’s worth it if it’s under $150 per night. Pretty blah stay.

reviews.title: dripping spa faucet
reviews.text: Never fixed.  Called on it 3 days never sent anyone up to fix.  Ended up with water all over bathroom.  Never offered to change our room and it was on bedroom carpet.  No dishes or silverware in the kitchen.  Had to call for a robe, extra blankets.  We rented 2 rooms with one upgrade.  They moved our room to be on the same floor as our. second room with our daughters.  Did not happen, different floors.

reviews.title: Cost-Effective Hotel
reviews.text: Excellent service and staff, all areas clean, comfortable beds and rooms with kitchenette.  They accepted pets in all areas.  Free valet parking 24 hrs. Prices are goods. They made us feel valued.Great Experience!!!

reviews.title: Trains Trains Trains
reviews.text: I’m only giving 3 stars because of the train noise and because our key had issues 3 x where security had to reset the lock which took a lot of time and aggravation.  Otherwise the room was very spacious and comfortable. Humongous bathroom! The train horn noise was ridiculous, 230am, 430am, do they really need to make such a loud noise? If you are a light sleeper I would suggest staying elsewhere. The pool was very nice, nothing special compared to other resorts in Vegas, but good service for drinks! Wish I could recall our server’s name as he was fabulous. The gym is also very nice. Skip the restaurants if you can, they are pricey! $8 for apple juice! Starbucks is in the Fashion Mall right across the street as is many other restaurants

reviews.title: Room with a View
