reviews.text: Awesome hotel and better yet NO casinos!  Also, the staff couldn't be more accommodating!  It is child and pet friendly which we were not totally happy about but seriously, was not an issue.  We will stay here again.

reviews.title: Classy
reviews.text: One of the best hotel stay’s we’ve ever had. Exceeded our expectations. Stellar staff. If your going to stay at a hotel without a casino in Las Vegas I would definitely choose this one. A very memorable experience.

reviews.title: near railway
reviews.text: room near railway so noise during night if not pay extra to upgrade to room facing street. kitchen in room but no any cooking wares. valet parking sometimes cause problem l, I have to wait 30 minutes cause they could not find my car even I have the parking number.

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: I had a great experience….. just Nothing to complain. The room was beautiful , the staff was great and the quality of the room wasImpressive. I enjoyed the beautiful shower and the views of the strip of Las Vegas from my room.

reviews.title: Great stay at the quiet end of the Strip
reviews.text: The Trump took great care of us, didn't charge for parking and the staff was awesome. Being right across from the fashion mall, yet far away from the noise of the Strip was perfect for us. When we come back to Vegas, we'll stay again.

reviews.title: Great hotel just off the strip
reviews.text: Big contrast here between the Trump Hotel we had left in Miami Beach and the next day we arrive in Las Vegas - this was a quality hotel, great staff, great rooms, great pool staff who were on duty before I arrived at 7am to swim. Its a little of the strip so be prepared for a little bit of a walk but compared to the Virgin hotel we stayed at in Vegas later in our trip this was a small walk and very well located hotel with Fashion Show Mall 30 steps across the road which was great. Would thoroughly recommend this hotel, lived up to the expectation of the brand!

reviews.title: Vegas or Bust
reviews.text: Great hotel. Marble tile and real porcelain sinks, jacuzzi tub, separate large marble shower. Large apartment luxury style design. I gave 3 stars for location, but it is not the fault of the hotel. Unless those on the boar support liberal candidates and their policies. Vegas is at a fork in the road of either going towards the way of Portland and Seattle or towards the way of Florida. Choose wisely.

reviews.title: disappointed
reviews.text: I took my spa staff to a conference in Las Vegas and used hotwire to score a 5 star hotel deal.  We were excited to stay at Trump International.  We went to the pool at 4  on Saturday night and there weren't enough "free" chairs for the 5 of us.  They charge $50 a chair if there aren't enough free ones and this pool isn't big enough to seat its guest for the size of the hotel.  They also closed the pool at 5:30 every night which seemed ridiculous to me.  To just use the sauna was $30 a day because it was inside the spa.  When we got home there was an additional $500 of charges on my card.  I called and was told there were resort fees for the extra amentities...I explained we couldn't use the pool or sauna and they didn't care.  I also left a new Apple charger in the room and called before I took off on a plane.  I filled out all paperwork and never received it in the mail.  This is the first hotel that's  not returned something to me.  We won't stay at  a Trump hotel in the future because of the poor service.  The $21 hamburger was the best part of our stay!

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 night in this beautiful hotel. Yes, it’s off strip and away from a lot of attractions, but couldn’t resist trying it. We had tickets to see Jimmy Buffett at MGM and what a great show Jimmy put on.Service was amazing. Friendly staff. DJT had lots of options at affordable prices. Pool was beautiful. This hotel completely changed my outlook and lives up to a higher standard. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Tub is to die for!
reviews.text: Truly enjoyed my stay at this unit. It has everything I need including the mini kitchen. The staff was gracious enough to provide me with what I need, since the cleaning for my unit is after 4 days of stay. I wished they cleaned it daily, but I guess that is the rule for this type of timeshare accomodation.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: The bed was extremely firm & very uncomfortable. The jets in my tub wouldn't work for most of our stay. The room service was bad. They forgot our drinks & cutlery so our food got cold waiting. The suite has a kitchen but no dishes are provided. The woman who answered the phone to fix our room service issues seemed irritated with me instead of apologetic that I just spent $100 on a cold meal. The pool was nice & the elevators are super fast to get up to the top floors. I don't plan on staying again but I think they can do better with the right staff changes.

reviews.title: Great hotel!
reviews.text: Service was amazing. Friendly staff. DJT had lots of options at affordable prices. Location is great. Pool was beautiful. This hotel completely changed my outlook and lives up to a higher standard. I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Traveling for vacation
reviews.text: The best hotel experience at Las Vegas I would like recommend this Hotel with excellent costumer service and delicious food and very quiet compared with others with casinos inside .The best hotel if you are traveling with family

reviews.title: Pampered Stay
reviews.text: First class from the time we arrived-until the morning that we left. It didn't matter who they were....what job they had.....what position they had achieved......everyone bent over backwards to please us and wait on us. So very impressive-especially today. We were there 8 days and enjoyed everyone. Not necessarily Vegas.....but the Trump Hotel. Sadly, we left the day before President Trump arrived. Hated that. Probably won't go back to Vegas...but will surely look for more Trump properties. He never does anything halfway. Thank you, Marsha Nordyke

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: The room was spacious and comfortable. The ability to cook something to eat to break up eating hotel food all day was nice. The bathtub was a perfect addition to relax my mind and body. The staff were kind and helpful. Overall the hotel was quiet and peaceful. Awesome experience.

reviews.title: Unfortunately more Cons than Pros
reviews.text: This is a very nice Hotel, but too many cons to give it more than 3 stars.We visited as a family and these are the pros and cons.Pros: Great rooms, Not too crowded, Good Attitude, Close to the Mall.Cons: Location (You need a car or a cab. Either way it'll cost you at least $60 each time you leave, and it's huge time consuming), Proximity to adult content (Sits right by all the Gentlemen Clubs, and next door to the Penis Museum), No real room service (They deliver from the only restaurant, and even then until only 10pm).Next time I would stay closer to the strip, away from the Penis Museum, and won't have to pay over $100 a day to leave the hotel.

reviews.title: Frequent Vegas Vacations
reviews.text: I go to Vegas at least once a year using my timeshare points. This was the first time staying at Trump Hotel under RCI exchange program. The hotel is set back a little ways from the strip but is directly across from Fashion Show mall if you need some retail therapy. Valet service is free, just make sure you go down there about 15 minutes before you need to leave so you won't be late to your destination. Had a view of the strip on 33rd floor, room was near the end of the hallway (#142). Overall, the hotel was quiet, a few instances where you can hear the train (as others had mentioned), but it did not bother me. Wifi was good, used it for school twice during the stay. Rooms were large, nice bathrooms (two showerheads in the master bath). Only negative was one showerhead had a fluctuation of temperature, where it would alternate from cold to hot, and back to cold, so I just used the other showerhead...no issues there. I used the kitchen appliances to cook a few meals which was not bad. I did have to go out and buy a frying pan, potholder, and some utensils to help with making meals....maybe they have an option to borrow the items at front desk, but we never asked. I just took the frying pan and other stuff I purchased and brought them home with me.

reviews.title: One of the Best Hotels I've Ever Stayed in
reviews.text: Trump International Hotel has truely been one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in. From the outside the hotel is truely buetiful, and the inside is no exeption. The Food in the restraunt was absolutly wonderful. We stayed on the 59th floor and our room was VERY nice, including a huge shower and luxury jet tub. The room had every little detail you could imagine like, personal robes and slippers, and a curved screen TV so you can see it better. Our room also had a great veiw of all of Vegas especialy at night. The fitness center was nice with many workout options and nice eqiuptment. The pool could be cooler seeing some of the others in Vegas, but it was cool because it was on a platform above the entrance, so it was elevated of the ground. But out of all of these things one I loved the most. The staff and employees. Every employee we met was very friendly and helpful, from front desk, restraunt, store, and everywhere else. The location is good with a short travel to everything there is in Vegas. Before we left we stopped at the gift shop and bought two pairs of Trump slippers, a chocolate bar in the shape of a gold bar that says Trump on top, and a refrigerator magnet of Trump's Boeing 757. Trump International Hotel was truely a great stay and I highly recomend staying, especialy because of the amazing staff.

reviews.title: Weekend get away
reviews.text: Hotel is within walking distance to the Vegas Strip. Yet it was far enough that it was calm and family friendly. Best of all, rooms were comfortable and spacious. The gym is overlooking the pool area and is well equipped with weights,ellipticals, and treadmills. The staff was also very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Incredible First Stay
reviews.text: After a long road trip we decided to treat ourselves to a few nights at Trump International.  So glad we did.  All of the employees were courteous and respectful.  Our king suite was on the 47th floor with city views, and complete with living space, small kitchenette, bathroom with double sinks, jacuzzi tub and large shower.  Comfortable bed and well maintained furnishings.  Fashion Mall is across the street.  We had lunch at the restaurant, and as others have stated the menu is somewhat limited but the portions certainly are not.  We hope to stay here again.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: The hotel was amazing would stay next time we visit . All areas are easy and the room we had you could see the strip . Room is laid out well and a kitchen if needed . Bath and shower . Staff all very willing to help

reviews.title: July 2022 trip
reviews.text: We had the best time at this hotel.  The service is first class and very affordable.  We had a great time at the pool and Ernest, our server was the best.  We will be staying here every time we will go to Vegas.

reviews.title: TOP TOP TOP TOP TOP
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, very elegant and very Rock 🎧. The staff is amazing and really welcome. Very Middle East standards. You have valet, they will take care of you from check in to the check out. All very very very kind and very professional.  Very clean and full of amazing amenities. The restaurant and the cocktail bar just WOW. Last things, we met and saw Mr. Trump, which was in Vegas for a political event.

reviews.title: Perfect, clean, quiet (kinda), spacious, convenient
reviews.text: Rooms clean. Check in was quick and professional by Leo. Staff always greets you when you come by lobby. no noisy casino floor. clean pool area with Corntoss game, grills, shade or sun. pool table inside. we stayed in north tower. Flamingo GO pool did have lots of music bass during day but i napped through it. mornings and evenings were quiet. monorail and big red bus tour, and complementary parking garage all within in 5 min walk.  1/2 block from strip. Ballys shopping site and CVS and Linq promenade within 10 min walk. one of best RCI exchanges i have stayed at. They did not ask you to take garbage out to garbage chute or strip beds or do dishes like others do sometimes (we did though). We have 3 teenager's and each had there own bed in 2 bedroom unit. will stay again. Only petty suggestion would be to take a pressure washer to parking garage steps.

reviews.title: Surprising let-down if staying longer than 1 night…
reviews.text: Stayed here pre Covid and was truly 5 star hotel. Post Covid, standards have slipped. If staying longer than 1 night - rooms are NOT serviced daily & we were not advised at time of booking nor at checkin. After a long day out in 109degree heat a fresh room and towels are always a plus but sadly not here any more. Need to ask for service & housekeeping seem not to please about it as photos will show.  Restaurant menu is very limited. I think it’s time they invested in USB ports in the room also. It’s the small things that make the lasting impression & for this trip they’ve dropped the ball. Not sure I’d come back to this hotel again despite the draw card being that it’s non-smoking

reviews.title: Imperfect stayed the second time
reviews.text: The reason of returning to Trump International was the convenient to the Strip with the shuttle bus. Disappointed to find out the shuttle bus was no longer available due to COVID. The assigned unit has ;ot of noises from the passing train.

reviews.title: King Suite is a great value
reviews.text: The Trump's King Suite is the way to go if you want a spacious, clean, well-appointed and quiet place to stay in Vegas. It's a short walk to The Strip. Every staff person at the Trump was friendly & courteous. Unheard of these days. Housekeeping stocked the kitchen with everything we requested at no extra charge. County ordinance prevents them from stocking in advance. The pool & staff were wonderful. Would definitely recommend  the Trump.

reviews.title: Horrible management - not responding appropriately to strong Marijuana smell in room
reviews.text: I am truly disappointed in the Trump hotel at Las Vegas. I stayed there with my family including an infant and a toddler and their grandmother during the July 4th weekend 7/1 to 7/4 on our vacation with hopes for a relaxing trip. It was anything but due to our unit reeking of a strong Marijuana smoke smell.We were exhausted after a Saturday out seeing different hotels on the strip and were quite surprised by the extreme unpleasant marijuana odor that hit us in the face when we opened our door. I understand marijuana is legal in the state but this is supposed to be a SMOKE FREE hotel and should have been enforced. We are sensitive to the odor and soon developed a headache and sore throat and could not tolerate being in the room. We contacted the front desk and talked to the manager who stated there were no other rooms in our room type (a 2 bedroom lockout consisting of a 1 bedroom and a studio suite in the same unit). This was extremely frustrating as there were other 1 bedroom and even 2 bedroom suites available on their website! The best he could offer us is to spray the unit with fragrance or downgrade us to a studio room. He stated that he could give us a $75 room credit and get us a new room the following day. We were frustrated about the situation but were tired and decided to see if the febreeze would help. It took 3 calls and over an hour before a housekeeper came to the room and just sprayed multiple puffs of their house febreeze mix which did nothing to cover up the marijuana smell!. Due to the strong smell even after the febreeze we all had to squeeze into the studio unit for the night as the smell was mainly in the 1 bedroom unit and it was already close to midnight.On the morning of Sunday 7/3, around 9:30am we asked the front desk about the new room. They said they had no idea about this and had to talk to the on-shift manager and they said as they had no rooms available at the time, but that it would be for sure ready by 4pm and to check back then. We packed all our belongings in anticipation for this room change and came back at 5pm that day to find out that the room was not reserved for us and there was no room available. I couldn’t believe that they didn’t reserve the room switch for us! We asked to speak to the manager on duty, who was Josh, and he said that he didn’t know about the request for a new room. We expressed our frustration. Apparently, the day and evening managers and the front desk staff don’t communicate! We were obviously very frustrated with the lack of management and them being unable to accommodate us as promised. Josh said that he couldn’t change rooms as there was none in our type, and that he could only downgrade us to a studio unit – even though again, on the website, there were 2 bedrooms in the hotel. This is poor management service as they had space to accommodate! He verbally said he would give us two $75 credits for all the inconvenience which would be a total of $150. We were unhappy  with the situation but agreed to getting credit again. So, we suffered through another night with our room smelling like marijuana and couldn't even sleep in the room that we paid for.The next day we AGAIN, were blindsided on checkout as they had only given us 1 of the 2 $75 credits we were promised on our room. We spoke to the day manager (Jacob) and asked about the situation, which I patiently explained. After looking at our room charge file, he was very rude saying there’s nothing he could do for us, specifically saying he wasn’t the one who promised the 2nd $75 credit. I asked him if he had the ability to add the 2nd $75 credit as a manager and said that he could add the $75 credit but wouldn’t because he inferred we could be lying just to get more credit. Do NOT expect any type of quality service at this hotel. Management will promise you one thing and NOT deliver. And when questioned, make us look like we are the liars! We wouldn’t have ordered breakfast at the hotel if we didn’t have a room credit! It’s like adding insult to injury! And worst of all, if you are ok with exposing your little ones to marijuana smoke and the hotel management do little to nothing, then this is the hotel for you.

reviews.title: An oasis
reviews.text: All class, clean, treated well, and loved the freshness of the lobby-no smokey casino to navigate through to get to rooms. Always an Uber within 1 minute. Loved the food in the restaurant and the Trump Vineyards Chardonnay. Will definitely stay again.

Overall good experience - hotel and the personnel were excellent - expect the older pool "boy" who selected who to serve - he selected who is served by him, his service doesn't belong to Trump hotel.Room was not cleaned every day which was a surprise

reviews.title: Top Notch!
reviews.text: Incredible experience at an amazing hotel. The staff are incredibly friendly, polite and eager to help. The room was immaculate and spacious. The pool-side drinks were tasty and the bar tender was very friendly. It was our first time trying out a Trump hotel and we were shocked at how incredible the experience was. The room was reasonably-priced compared to nearby Vegas hotels but the quality and cleanliness was astounding.I can say that when we travel again and need a hotel, we know where we’ll want to stay.

reviews.title: Very nice hotel just off the strip.
reviews.text: Clean rooms, friendly staff and the lack of a casino makes this an attractive getaway. It is a great hotel for families who can come and go without having to deal with crowded casinos and bars to get in and out.

reviews.title: Classy Trump
reviews.text: Everything was very classy. Really enjoyed our stay. I was really impressed on the service and all the little extra amenities. It was like everything was above and beyond what was to be expected. Loved it.

reviews.title: Stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Nice to stay in a hotel and not a casino close to the strip.  The fact that we didn’t have to walk thru a casino and cigarette smoke was a extra for me.  Room service was the fastest I have ever experienced.   Rooms were nice and staff was always helpful.

reviews.title: Excellency
reviews.text: I had an early arrival 830am I was at the hotel and they checked me in anyway no questions asked and no extra fees, that was awesome. The staff was excellent, at the restaurant, the pool good services.

reviews.title: Great Experience!
reviews.text: Always great when we stay at the Trump! Easy to check into the hotel. We love the valet parking. The pool is very nice, not amazing, but nice. Rooms are always clean, conveniently located near many popular things in Vegas.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Pros: easy check in, room big with kitchen. Great for families. Cons: no housekeeping services for 5 nights unless you call. No one told us this on check in. Pool and fitness center closed at 7pm. No one told us this at check in. No signs posted with hours. Kicked out of fitness center by rude employee. Charged full resort fee. Full staff at pool standing around talking to each other.  No one offered food or drinks at pool. Had to get out and order inside. Pool opened at 7am with blaring loud music that woke us up. Food and drink menu limited, expensive, and not very good.

reviews.title: Clean, quiet, no hidden fees
reviews.text: Very nice option for your stay in Las Vegas. Quiet - there is no casino downstairs. Free valet parking and no hidden fees like there usually are in some other neighbor hotels. Nice restaurant on the first floor. Great stuff, fast elevators, rooms are very good and clean

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: The hotel is very beautiful, we checked in earlier with no extra charge. The customer service was really great, the room was very clean with lots of closet space, amazing restaurant, the food was excellent!

reviews.title: Trump hotel doesn't trump some of the others
reviews.text: While this hotel was very nice looking and at first blush, is beautiful in all appearances, the missing part was the small details.  Surprisingly, a hotel owned by a man who's all about services and details, doesn't have it.  There were stupid things overlooked in our room, that basically were housekeeping issues.  To begin with, hotel provides "kitchen area" facilities in the rooms, sink, stove, microwave, refridgerator, etc.  They also provide bottle of water free...all great.  However, because of "COVID", they have signs up that say they don't provide any of the equipment needed to cook...no pans, no dishes, no cups, etc.  You have to call and ask for any of that.  No toaster etc, nothing that you could really use for breakfast or whatever.  They could've at least put paper goods.  Coffee provided but maybe two paper cups, no stirrers, supplies were short.  The blowdryer in the bathroom was filthy and dusty, phone in our room was filthy, dusty.  Valet service provided for your vehicle was a nightmare, not enough staff to work it.  Driveway was always full of cars, you had to wait almost 25 minutes if you were going anywhere and needed your car, so you need to account for that wait (think reservations).  Only one restaurant in the hotel and definitely not for kids.  Hours are short as well, should be a 24/7 operation but probably can't get staff like most of the other hotels.  When I called housekeeping about the blowdryer and told them about room cleaning, they did clean the room when I left, but guess what, forgot to bring me a blowdryer.  Also my ice bucket disappeared and I had to call down for that.  I stayed for 4 days, my room was only cleaned twice.  Apparently, they don't clean on a daily basis, but forgot to mention that.  We were gone all day and came back to a dirty room, that we needed our trash removed and fresh towels.  I had to call down for those so we could shower after a long day in the heat.  Swimming pool closes at 7 p.m. and we had young children with us.  Why is a pool closing that early in the evening?  Hotel is a little off the beaten path, you would be better served staying at something on the strip and save some money with parking at hotels and attractions.  Almost all of them charge $15 to park for a minimum of 1-4 hours, more money spent.  Also, be aware that marijuana is legal in Las Vegas and it is EVERYWHERE.  Smell is overwhelming in the streets and if you bring young children, it's not a good thing.  Good luck!

reviews.title: Excellent Service!
reviews.text: Service, cleanliness, free parking, reasonable rate in Vegas all A+  We felt safe, comfortable as home, which is sooo important on vacation. Would definitely stay again! Never saw so much cleaning going on all the time. Spotless!

reviews.title: Clean and peaceful
reviews.text: The staff was helpful and quick to respond to requests. The establishment is clean and quiet and I appreciated being on the Strip without having to pass through a casino to get to my room. The location is perfect for attending conventions and having access to entertainment.

reviews.title: Vegas Trump make a hotel great again first
reviews.text: I haven't received an amazing service. I had to request all the time what I need in my room, like another bar of soap, bathrobe, shampoo, cups and coffee  and cleaning services. I was felling like I need to write down a list for request and  explain people in hotel how to work. By the way I got to Vegas for my Birthday party the first time of my life and i did not receive any greeting from hotel even a card. This hotel is extremely boring, I guess for business people or who coming in Vegas for work and conference probably is ok. I would say we must do a Trump Hotel make great again and after a whole America.  Why i choose this hotel , because a name Trump - but I did a mistake with hotel.

reviews.title: Best Non-Casino Resort in Vegas.
reviews.text: This has got to be one of the best non-casino hotels in Vegas. It is quiet and relaxing as soon as you walk through the doors as opposed to the noisy and crowd filled casino hotels. Its in a great location at the top of the strip right opposite the Wynn an across the road from the shopping mall. The staff were fantastic. The rooms were spacious, very clean and luxurious. The restaurant was lovely and the pool area is very relaxing with ample seating and food/beverage selections. Would definitely stay here again. Best resort in Vegas.

reviews.title: Perfect Non-Casino Hotel
reviews.text: We loved everything about this hotel. It does not have a casino, so it is more quiet than most. But it’s still within walking distance of attractions on the strip. The studio room was very large and included a kitchenette. Room service was delivered quickly and was always delicious. The pool was fabulous with many covered beds available for a $50 minimum food/drink charge. We also liked the extra layer of security they had with an attendant checking key cards at the elevators. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Excellent hotel right off the strip most locations are well within walking distance.  Great mall right across the street from the hotel.  Pool area is great and the gym / fitness room is a great setup.  Trump towers is a great hotel.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Las Vegas
reviews.text: I have been to Las Vegas several times and had free rooms on almost every trip. I also had free room offers for this trip but decided to pay for my stay at the Trump Hotel and I am glad I did. Everything from booking to check out was awesome. This was one of my best trips to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Don’t ask for late check out even if you checked in 10 hours late.
reviews.text: Checked in 10 hours late due to flight.  Requested a late check out.. was offered 69 min no more.  He actually said we’d have to pay for an entire day if we needed more than an hour.  The room was nice and it’s next door to a great mall.  The strip isn’t too far but not really within walking distance.  Overall nice trip with valet parking too.  Really wish the late checkout was more reasonable considering the circumstances.

reviews.title: Recent stay at The Trump International Hotel
reviews.text: Excellent location and outstanding facilities and service. Would stay here again. Very suitable for families. There is no casino onsite which we preferred but the hotel is very proximal to access the main strip

reviews.title: Stay at Trump Tower
reviews.text: From the time I checked in to the time I checked out. My check in and out was quick and easy. My stay was incredible. The hotel is very luxurious. My room was nice and spacious. Any time I needed anything, resort services sent it right to me. If I had any questions they were answered. Due to them having valet, my car was safe and didn't have to worry about anything happening to it while staying there. When I needed my car it was less than a 5 minute wait for valet to bring me my car. All hotel staff was responsive and attentive during my stay.

reviews.title: 24 hrs to relax
reviews.text: We had several things to take care of on our trip and only had 24 hrs for fun. Trump International definitely came through for us. We had the best time! We will absolutely stay again and make this our destination

reviews.title: Had a great visit
reviews.text: Trump International Hotel was a great experience. We don't gamble so it was nice to have a hotel just off the strip that was not dark, dingy, and full of smoke. The hotel was bright, clean, and the service was exceptional. We will stay there again when we return. -Calder

reviews.title: What a wonderful place to stay.
reviews.text: If you are looking for a place where the casino is right in your face, this is it. Casino's are mere minutes away and shopping is across the way. Trump also provides in room dining and rooms with kitchenettes so you don't have to rely on restaurants or fast food.

reviews.title: A below 3 star experience
reviews.text: Hotel does not qualify as a 5 star. Just one restaurant with limited service. No buffet. Very slow service. Rooms are NOT CLEANED everyday. Takes a long time to get your car back during checkout. Avoidable properly. It is off the strip and has none of the attractions of the other hotels.

reviews.title: Trump International, need I say more?
reviews.text: Great location at the end of the strip with great city and strip views. Valet parking and extra large rooms and bathrooms. There is a full kitchen set up with cooktop, sink and fridge. Tons of storage if your planning on moving....lol ... Will be back again.

reviews.title: trump international
reviews.text: everyone very helpful and friendly and hotel and pool were immaculate . did not have any issues at all. everything went smooth with check in and check out. only thing i thought could have been better was the work out area

reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: Casual Atmosphere. Excellent Service. Close to the strip and restaurants. The fact that there is no casino in this hotel is a bonus. Check in was fast and easy. It has a very nice pool area. Drinks were a little expensive.

reviews.title: Trump International Hotel Las Vegas
reviews.text: One of a life time experiences at the trump hotelyou like president trump and want to be treated like king and queen, then this hotel is for you. Friendly and professional staff. The price is reasonable. We stayed on the 63rd floor in a presidential suite!!! It’s 1500 square feet!!!! I have to run around in the suite all day. It’s so big!!!

reviews.title: Great room poor service
reviews.text: Service poor - we had to request bedding and make up one of our own beds, no assistance offered for our 5 cases, room serviced only once in 3 night stay. The suite was well appointed with great views. This property is possibly more suited to longer more residential stays.

reviews.title: New favourite
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights June 13-17. Loved it. In the front doors and up the elevator in seconds, no casino to wander through to get to elevators. Prompt check in with one person ahead of us in line. Very reasonable upgrade to a huge suite with 2 bathrooms, full size fridge, comfy sectional, dining room table. Close to the Strip, Fashion Show Mall, Wynn/Encore. I did hear a train during the night, lovely wife slept right through it tho. I'm a light sleeper.  Very friendly staff. Security at elevator asks for room card to prove you're a guest. Felt very safe. Housekeeping each day too. Very well done, Folks.

reviews.title: Ok if you want away from the strip
reviews.text: Nice hotel, we chose it for the location so we would be just out of the strip madness and it did the job.I would say this hotel is geared more to business trips, it certainly lacks the wow factor you get in the other hotels. Pool area  is pretty basic and the pool  bar feels more like a cafeOnly the one bar in the lobby, again didn’t look too appealing so we never tried it.The room was lovely, we did get one vey dirty towel left for us and a door handle hanging off the cupboards, only highlighting this to lower expectations of what you are gettingIt is cheaper than most other places but easy to see why when you get there I would stay at the Wynn if I came to Vegas again

reviews.title: business travel
reviews.text: excellent staying with fast and reliable services. Room are well kept, breakfast service is super with a 10 minutes avarage time of waiting and good quality of food. I will suggest it for every business trip

reviews.title: Great Hotel
reviews.text: First class hotel & service. The full kitchens are great for a family vacation. Nice not to have a casino within the hotel but close enough to the strip to allow you to play.  The valet service is great. No worry about parking.

reviews.title: First Time Trump Stay
reviews.text: Excellent experience from the moment we checked in to the departure. First class customer service.Enjoyed a few perks for booking direct.Fantastic experience at the pool. No crowds, plenty of seats and very good service from the people working the pool. Most definitely will stay again at the Trump Tower again.

reviews.title: Perfect for business and personsl
reviews.text: Wonderful hotel. Rooms were large and with full kitchen. Good pool and spa services and food at restaurant was excellent (great burger). If you can live without a casino on-premise no better place in Vegas

reviews.title: Best in Vegas
reviews.text: I travel for business. Free valet. Free bottles of water. Great staff, great bar. You're foolish to stay anywhere else. Try it. I bet your stay will be excellent. Try the smoky old fashioned. Best drink.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay without the Casino Crowds
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful. Every employee was very welcoming and friendly. The pool was a bit chilly, but the desert sun warmed us right up. Walking to the strip is easy from here. Didn't eat at the restaurant.

reviews.title: A phenomenal view from my penthouse suite!
reviews.text: I had a very pleasant stay at this hotel.  The one-bedroom penthouse suite I booked for two nights was outstanding!  I had a view which literally went straight down the Strip, and with the ceiling to floor windows, the lights from the city and the Strip were amazing to see at night.  I'm not a great fan of valet parking, but the service was smooth, and the drivers were all very pleasant.  I liked the fact that the hotel is within a short walk of the Strip, yet not directly on the Strip.  Other reviews mention the sound of the trains running by the hotel to be annoying, but this was not a problem for me at all.  I actually enjoy hearing the sound of trains!  This was my first time to stay here, and I would definitely be interested in staying here again.

reviews.title: Worst hotel manager We have ever encountered. Room was not done during one of the days. Room smelled of cigar smoke.
reviews.text: Worst hotel manager We have ever encountered. Room was not done during one of the days. Room smelled of cigar smoke.

reviews.title: Terrible service - Rude employees
reviews.text: We booked a suite for 5 nights and paid the obligatory resort fee.  No where during the booking process or at checkin with (rudest agent ) had we been advised that you must beg to have your room serviced by housekeeping!  I have spent the past hour being hung up on and getting the run around in an attempt to obtain basic Motel 6 service!  Absolutely shocked this resort does not even offer basic housekeeping service.  The front office will not even provide with the name of the general manager!  I am truly disappointed with Trump International in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Choose carefully!
reviews.text: Was an overall disappointment.  Restaurant closed too early for being in a Vegas hotel.  No room service, no booklet of information for alternate food opportunities or general Vegas activities or shows. Nasty stains on drapes.  Nothing special here as far as amenities. The bed and room were clean otherwise.  But lets be honest that's expected at any nicer hotel.  There are so many options in Vegas.  I recommend  choosing another.

reviews.title: This has always been our favorite in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Spacious room, great location for our needs, excellent staff that always rates 5 stars.  My wife and I have stayed here several times and have never had a problem.  The valet parking service is excellent. An enjoyable experience and stay. We even brought our friends along this time and they were impressed. Highly recommended.  I wish other hotels would take lessons from here.

reviews.title: Wonderful Holiday
reviews.text: Great holiday at the Trump. Highly recommend. Wonderful room, hotel and pool area. 8 minute walk to the Strip and 2 minute walk to Fashion Show Mall. We did not use the restaurant at all as the menus were not to our taste but we did eat at the Pool most days and the meals were great!! We will be back very soon

reviews.title: Terrible room service
reviews.text: Keep in mind Vegas is hot, staying on this hotel will be inconvenient if you want to go and walk. The hotel is far away from the most popular places. Terrible room service. I was told they are short staff, reason for which the room was not made for the past 2 days. Attached a picture of what they brought me, once I requested to have my room clean. They did not event bother to pick up the used towels IF YOU ARE SHORT STAFF, YOU CANNOT CHARGE FULL PRICE FOR A SERVICE YOU ARE NOT ABLE TO PROVIDE. Also carpets in the hallway are old, dirty with bad smell. A/c does not work properly, room is always hot. Spend your money in a better place. We request a meal to the room, and it was brought in a paper bag, like if I were ordering from McDonnals. I paid for a premium suit, and end up that the room does not even have bath robs, even thought it has a kitchen, they do not provide any dinning wear. They told me I had to request it. I did and they never send it. Hopefully this kind of reviews help the company to improve their service.

reviews.title: Truly a 5 Star Experience
reviews.text: Your treated like an exclusive at Trump. Regardless of skin color believe it or not. The only place to stay on the strip. I feel a little dirty sometimes staying at a smoke filled casino on the strip.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: Great stay wonderful customer service very clean. Pool was relaxing not crowded room was bigger than I thought and tub was very nice! View was amazing. Customer service was great, check out was super easy.

reviews.title: Great!
reviews.text: Staff is friendly. The pool is great! It’s not too busy. The food and beverage is delicious. The menu is designed well. The hotel is far from the strip, which provides some relief from the hustle.Thanks for a fantastic stay.

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel
reviews.text: The Trump Hotel was fabulous!  It was a great place to relax and refresh after being out and about.  Any time I return to Vegas,  I will be staying in the Trump Hotel.  The staff were very respectful and efficient.

reviews.title: Family Road trip
reviews.text: We stayed here for two nights on a cross country trip from TN to the Grand Canyon. I chose this hotel for the great reviews I'd read and because it was close to the Strip, but not right on it. We enjoyed our stay. Rooms are a bit dated, but very spacious. We noticed a coffee stirrer on the floor, but it wasn't worth a call to front desk. They do charge a resort fee, but the valet parking is required and "free." We were with our kids and not interested in being out late. That being said, I have never been to a hotel where the gym closed at 7:00 pm.

reviews.title: Not a classy hotel anymore
reviews.text: I adore the Trump brand, and would have liked to write a better review. Having had a fantastic stay a few years ago at the Trump Waikiki, my expectations were high. First the good: Staff were friendly and responsive. The hotel has hired some great people. Location was good, because I enjoy going to the mall across the street and the Wynn a short walk away. Uber pickups were a breeze, as they were allowed to pick up right in front of the building. I appreciated the security at the elevators always checking you had an active key card, and the pool area was nice. The negatives included very worn out furnishings in the 1-bedroom suite. Scratches would have been easy to cover, but no effort had been made. Curtains had multiple visible dark stains. The carpet had a huge black stain next to the bed. A large tile in the shower was loose and dislodged - a real hazard I did not notice right away. No dishes or utensils in the kitchen, which made it unusable! They could ask as part of check-in if stocking it was desired. No housekeeping services for 3 days, and I paid cash for the stay. No robe and slippers. Bath amenities were of poor quality - not the Spa at Trump quality I had experienced at the Hawaii location. I was given two shower gels and a conditioner in the master shower, but luckily could get a shampoo from my other bathroom. Sloppy work. Lamp shades were dirty and bent. No glass tumblers in the bathrooms, only disposable plastic cups. Hair dryer was cheap and dirty. Prices were very high at the restaurants: over $20 for chicken wings and $25 for a pina colada in a plastic cup. I don’t mind the high prices, it’s just that they did not reflect the otherwise economy class of the hotel. Not sure why the Trump Organization allows the hotel to go downhill like this. It surely was a beautiful property once, and could be restored to its former glory. One morning music started blasting at the Trump pool at 5am and woke me up. Pool does not even open before 7! The loud music played until 5:45am, at which point it was turned off. It was very odd. I knew music could occasionally be heard from the neighboring Resorts World, but I did not expect it to be played at the hotel pool at 5am.

reviews.title: In decline
reviews.text: My wife and I decided to celebrate our June birthdays at Trump, having experienced wonderful service and amenities during our previous stays. This time was different. Upon arrival, we were met by a cheerless, almost listless front desk attendant who, when we mentioned the reason for our stay, responded by saying nothing, absolutely nothing. Then she assigned us a room which was not what we had reserved. We discovered that AFTER entering the room. Returing to the lobby and after dealing with a rather defensive response from her adamant manager, we were then given the room size we had reserved. What did we notice during this most recent stay? First, the hotel no longer offers shuttle service to the Forum Shops. No reason given. No newspapers either. Fewer staff. A new key card reader which must be swiped before going to your room each time, ensuring that your every move is recorded for posterity, a true invasion of privacy. Since we were staying as part of a Hilton Hotel package, no housekeeping services were provided. And last night, when we requested additional toiletries and while we were taking showers someone from the hotel actually came into the room without our permission and left the items on the table. If there was no answer from the guests after ringing the bell several times, the package should have been left AT THE DOOR, no excuses!!! This intrusion was unacceptable. At checkout, apart from releasing a good sum of money back to the credit card, no gesture of thanks was offered. The memories of staying at a classy hotel where the principles of a warm welcome, anticipation of needs, and a fond farewell, hallmarks of the former Ritz  Carlton before the Marriott purge, were not rekindled at Trump and it's rather sad to see the decline. And 4 dollars for a single banana, 8 dollars for a muffin from the food cart in the lobby, well, that's just outrageous and stupid. You can and should do better.

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Stayed at this hotel for a week. I was really impressed, from the moment we arrived it was pure class. The lobby is impressive and elegant, the rooms were huge, the pool had great chilled vibes. I prefer to stay in a hotel without a casino in vegas so this was perfect. I felt secure and safe the whole time as they have 24hour person only allowing guests in to the elevators. If I was to say a negative it was a little bit back from the strip so maybe a little too far to walk for some aside from that it is a top class hotel in my opinion.

reviews.title: No 5* experience
reviews.text: Had a spacious 1 bedroom suite on the 46th floor, great bed, grand bathroom especially enjoyed the jacuzzi tub, kitchen with subzero fridge, top notch toiletries.  Security officer on the spot. Hotel never feels overcrowded. Great pool area with comfortable lounge chairs and free flavoured water. Hardly any children during our stay (always a plus for us). About 10 minutes walking distance from the strip, mall right across the street (cheap foodcourt there). Liked the Trump gift shop in the hotel.Class casino-free hotel, but what took away from the 5* experience:- had a prepaid reservation, but they double charged our credit card. They refunded me quickly after informing them, but no apology whatsoever was made- could have paid more attention to the fact that we were there for our 13th wedding anniversary, travelling from way overseas- no housekeeping during our entire 3 night stay- no bathrobes nor slippers available- overpriced food; 7$ for a croissant pastry is simply over the top- view from our room, overlooking the flashy Resorts World and some sort of scrap yard below, took away from the suite experience. Would have appreciated a strip view.- too bad there was no tv in the bathroom- sofa could use replacement- room was noisy from time to time during the day, think it came from the music/daytime club at Resorts World

reviews.title: Excellent Hotel!
reviews.text: We loved staying here! And loved how it is slightly tucked away from the madness of the strip yet close enough to enjoy. The hotel security is spot on and everything felt like luxury! The hotel restaurant and bar were top notch.

reviews.title: The only hotel I will stay in when in Vegas
reviews.text: Trump Towers has become the only hotel I well stay at when I’m in Vegas visiting family. The staff is phenomenal, it is clean and quiet. No smoking and no loud gambling machines. We love it. We will return again and again.

reviews.title: false advertising
reviews.text: no in room dinning had a full suite room with no dishes when asked for dishes got PLASTIC silverware had to ask for more coffee kerege cups everyday even though we asked for 10 the first time and the rooms carpet was stained, chipped paint and the couch was old very disappointing and to top it off when we checked out we agreed to an e-mailed receipt that we never got so i checked my bank account and they were over charging us over 3,000 dollars WTF had to file a claim against them at my bank

reviews.title: Asphalt runner
reviews.text: Will always stay here when In Las Vegas!Upon entering the hotel the fragrance of light floral is in the air. Love it!!Food was flavorful. The service, the staff were friendly and accommodating. Rooms are spacious !

reviews.title: An oasis of calm off the Strip
reviews.text: Our stay was not perfect. Rooms were not serviced every day and when we arrived late on our first night, there was nowhere to eat and we had to make up the bed settee ourselves. The bed settee is also not very comfy. We didn’t try and get cutlery or dishes for the kitchen and used the paper and plastic cups provided which felt very cheap and not in-keeping with a luxury suite. However, after extensive research into Vegas hotel options, we chose a corner suite in this hotel as it offered us, travelling as friends, a way of getting a separate bedroom and bathroom each in one room (which also means only one resort fee to pay). We switched mid stay so we each experienced the king bed with enormous en-suite and then the bed settee with the smaller shower room off the kitchen/ living area. Arriving at the hotel each day was lovely as it is smoke free and relatively uncrowded. You have to use your room card to get to the lifts so it feels secure. Wi-Fi is good. The pool is really nice with a mix of families and couples. Basic loungers are free or you get fancier ones if you spend a minimum of $100 on food and drink. Over the road, in the Fashion Show Mall there is an ABC store where you can stock up on wine, beer and soft drinks for the full size fridge in your room. Free water is provided. The mall also has a decent food court for breakfast or snacks.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay at an elegant 5 star hotel.
reviews.text: The staff was very helpful and professional. It was an absolute pleasant Experience . Will return.We had great time and enjoyed an exceptionally pleasant stay.  Valet parking and attention was just great.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: Staying at the trump hotel currently for a weekend trip. We loved the trump hotel in Washington so chose to stay here. After being gone 6 hours our room has was not cleaned no big deal- so I called down and room service came up and asked us to put towels and bedding in trash bags for them as they provided replacements. There are no restaurants on site and room service stops early. Compared to the 8 other strip hotels we have stayed at we would not pick this one again

reviews.title: Poor Experience
reviews.text: Over priced for an off strip hotel.  Below average service,  it appears that the staff is either overwhelmed or dislike where they work.  Limited dining options with average quality food and service that is over priced.Hotel and rooms were clean, no maid service second day of stay.  Property is in need of updating the whole feel is you stepped back in time to the 90's  to someone's interpretation of what elegance should be.  First time and last time,  I've had much better experiences at the standard on strip hotels.If you're just looking to sleep and don't care what you eat, this hotel might be for you.When I go to Vegas I go for fun, which this place certainly is not.

reviews.title: The best
reviews.text: I really enjoyed the stay. Room was large & clean. The room had a Kitchen and 2 bathrooms. It was convenient. The hotel doesn't have shops but Nordstrom was across the street. Strong recommendation!!!

reviews.title: Great location, nice atmosphere without smoking and casinos gaming
reviews.text: We have stayed here before and liked the location, the services and the fact it is non-smoking and no casinos.The decor, rooms and services are above par.DJ restaurant has the best French dip sandwich meal I have ever had!!! 😋The pool area is very nice and comfortable. Housekeeping was courteous and did a great job 👏 My one suggestion is they bring back the shuttle to downtown Vegas to save on taxi fares and wait time for a ride.

reviews.title: 10/10 Stars
reviews.text: My hubby and I had a great experience at the Trump hotel. It is just slightly off the strip but during the day you can cut through Fashion Show mall for a quick walk to the strip. It is walking distance to planet 13 and what I believe to be the best breakfast in Vegas at La Trece. We were offered a cheaper upgrade on arrival and ended up with a suite with great views of the strip. I wouldn’t recommend getting coffee downstairs in the morning as it is the same price as Starbucks or Coffee Bean which is just inside Fashion show mall.

reviews.title: Awesome Staff
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, all the staff are very attentive and nice. It is good not having all the noise from a casino on site. The main lobby is very elegant, looks like a place of royalty. The breakfast, lunch and dinner food is delicious. Heated pool!

reviews.title: A top-shelf experience
reviews.text: Staying at the Trump International Las Vegas was an 11 on a 1-10.What separates this property from other hotels is simple: attitude with a smile. From the door greeters, to those staffing the registration desk, to the bartenders, travelers are in for an experience like none other. The rooms are fabulous - and quiet. There's a reason for this: no gaming on the premises keeps the noise level down. The masseuses and masseurs at the Spa are also first-rate. We enjoyed a Swedish massage that was better than anything we'd had before.

reviews.title: Trump Intl Las Vegas NV
reviews.text: It is refreshing to come to a hotel in Las Vegas that doesn't have glaring lights, stale odors, and smoke haze hanging in the air. I have stayed here several times now and each visit has been of the most professional and welcoming nature. If you want some real "down" time, this is a good place to do so. The on-site restaurant has courteous staff and well-prepared food to offer also, and its "vibe" invites you to come in. Recommend to all of my friends and family!

reviews.title: TRUMP HOTEL LV
reviews.text: Our stay at the TRUMP Hotel was perfect. We were pampered and treated so well.  Recommend for any length of stay and very reasonable on prices. Quality and excellence abound at this five star facility.

reviews.title: Great staff, nice room, okay amenities
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and well kept. Checking in/out was great, very easy. Our room was spacious and the bathroom was well designed.  It is located across from a mall in case you forgot anything.The fitness center is very lacking. It is tiny and the equipment is dated and not all in good working condition.  The pool is basic.We only stayed one night to see a show at the Wynn. We would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Very nice stay
reviews.text: Non gaming hotel, a little bit off the strip but quite nice.  Bit of a walk to the strip however.  Right across the street from Fashion Show Mall.  Staff were very accomodating.   Only disadvantage is, you’re not in the center of the action.

reviews.title: Stress-Free Mini Vacation
reviews.text: Upon arrival at Trump Int'l Hotel after 5 hours of driving, we were able to breeze-thru the check-in as there was no line presented and it was quick.  This experience reciprocated at check-out as well.  We ate at DJT restaurant for breakfast and dinner and the services as well as the food qualities were excellent!  We enjoyed our French toast and Eggs Benedicts for breakfast and NY & Ribeye steaks for dinner.  Both times, the servers were attentive.  The room was spacious and there is a full kitchen (love this feature) and the bathroom were well stocked. We also visited and hang out at the pool.  It was calm and relaxing and the servers came by to take orders and refill drinks often.

reviews.title: Travel to Las Vegas for Eagles' concert
reviews.text: We traveled to Las Vegas for Eagles' concert. We loved our stay at the Trump International Hotel. The room size was fantastic, cleanliness, valet parking, overall service was great, and the rate was the best.

reviews.title: Wonderful Hotel
reviews.text: This is a wonderful hotel!!  Everything about this hotel screams luxury.  This is the only place that I would stay in again in Vegas.  Will look for other Trump hotels to stay in for the future.  Incredible views out of the hotel.  Would recommend to stay higher up if you would love to see the strip.

reviews.title: My Birthday Oasis
reviews.text: Trump International Hotel-Las Vegas is the place where I celebrate my birthday.The safe and restful ambiance I get when I enter the complex is excellent. I am not a gambler and I do not smoke and travel solo. The location is prime to where ever I desire to go visit. The associates are all equally respectful and attentive.

reviews.title: First class resort and staff
reviews.text: Exceptional staff, very nice workout room, pool and spa.   Bed and pillows were so comfortable.   Everyone of the staff was extremely helpful and pleasant.  Nice bar and restaurant.  Located a block off of the strip so quieter setting.  First class resort!

reviews.title: Just call us loyal Republicans
reviews.text: We stayed four days at the Trump International as part of a Hilton promotion. The hotel is beautiful, situated about a hundred yards from the Strip, across the street from the Fashion Show Mall. To avoid the heat we would walk to the Strip through the air-conditioned mall. But the large lot next to the hotel is empty, and since the mall closes as early as 8:00 PM on weekdays, we would take an Uber back to the hotel from the Strip, because that hundred yards between the hotel and the Strip is dark at night, deserted and potentially dangerous. Unfortunately the hotel no longer offers shuttle services to the Strip or the airport. Staffing issues, they said. Our room at the hotel was a studio facing the not so scenic north. There is no casino in the hotel so the hotel itself is relatively quiet, but noisy, nearby freight trains late at night would sometimes disturb our sleep.The bathroom contained a tub which could be used as a jacuzzi, but the shower in the tub was not as strong as we like. There is ample closet and drawer space, but the closet had no space to hang full length clothes like my wife's skirts. Though there was no regular room service, the front desk did provide us with coffee and towels when we called for them. The one time we finally did receive room service, on the last day of our stay at our insistence, they did not clean the room, they did not make our bed; they simply brought some more towels and emptied the already overflowing trash cans. But despite the hotel's deficiencies, we would still stay there again if the price was right. Just call us loyal Republicans.

reviews.title: Elegant/Secured Hotel
reviews.text: It's perfect for family who doesn't like chaos loudness. Peaceful, clean, housekeeping service is very good and accommodating. The whole experience was amazing.  The restaurant is great... the people are very friendly.

reviews.title: vegas getaway
reviews.text: amazing stay at Trump Las Vegas. great service and comfy beds. Location is perfect and smoke free.Great hotel with like minded people who stay there. The pool is exceptional with a nice poolside restaurant

reviews.title: stay here if you like amazing service
reviews.text: this hotel is perfect!  the staff treated us like royalty. the rooms are clean and comfortable and there's nothing you need. i can't wait to return to this hotel. The Four Seasons better take notice, this place sets the benchmark

reviews.title: Absolute Pure Class!!!
reviews.text: Best hotel ever I've stayed in.  Elegant all the way.  Professionally treated at front desk, if need anything bell boy brings it right up.  The room was outstanding.  Everything was done with detail.  Bathroom was stunning.  Hallways are stunning.  Fitness center outstanding.  Hotel next to mall with food court.  Pool very relaxing.  Powerful waterfall shower!  Porcelain bathroom floor.  It's worth coming to Vegas just to stay in this hotel.  This is a 5+++ hotel.  Shows the class of President Donald Trump!  Hope he gets re-elected!

reviews.title: Very pleased!
reviews.text: This is a very nice hotel.  Our room was roomy, well appointed and clean.  The view of the strip was great and can't think of anything the room was lacking.  Our room did have a kitchenette but has no dishes, silverware etc so you have to ask for that type stuff.  Otherwise, the room was perfect.  Great, large bathroom was a really nice touch.  Whirlpool tub big enough for two with separate shower.  Pool area was nice and service at the pool was excellent but the drinks were weak and the food bland.  This hotel is about a block and a half from the strip but it's an easy walk.  We used Lyft for transportation and it worked flawlessly.  No casino in this hotel but the Fashion Show mall is directly across the street.  Closest casinos within walking distance are the Wynne and Encore.  If you are looking for quality, class and a bit quieter place but still near the strip, this is a great place.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text: I love staying at this hotel… The service was amazing, the food was delicious, pool is so large , plenty of chairs and umbrellas, lemon water poolside .. the gym was well equipped . I felt so safe traveling solo staying there. I would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: What has happened to Trump's service?
reviews.text: We have been staying at the Trump from the time they became a hotel.  I know covid has upended many things.  We don't stay in Airbnbs because we like daily maid service.  We like having our bed made and fresh towels every day.  We checked in late. The next day our room still had not been made up.  We called around 5:30 and asked.  They said they would send someone up.  I asked if we need to call every day.  They said no.  The next day no one came.  We called the thrid day.  No one came.  I happened to see a cleaning woman in the hall so I asked if we could get our room serviced.  She said she would call it in.  It was clean when we got back that night.  The next day, same thing no cleaning.  We were leaving the next morning so we didn't bother calling.  When we checked out I asked again if we need to call every day for cleaning.  I was told if you want "priority" cleaning, you need to call.  We don't care what time the room is cleaned, we just want it clean.Hotels say they are short staffed, but we've also heard that staff complain that they aren't given the opportunity to clean as much as they would like because the hotel is cutting costs. I hope this is not the case.  Trump not only had daily maid service, they also used to have a nightly turn down service.  I can sort of understand cutting the turn down service if they are trying to save money, but it would be nice if they and other hotels get their act together and start cleaning the rooms again.  Otherwise the hotel is still very nice.

reviews.title: Beautiful, but lacking
reviews.text: Everything was nice, except the mattress on the fold out couch had a huge stain and I had to call for bedding for it. The room was huge and had plenty of storage. Bathroom was amazing, but the shower head was a little on the short side for me (I'm 5'9").

reviews.title: Returning to Las Vegas
reviews.text: We were married in Vegas, so we decided to go back for our 23rd. wedding anniversary.The check in was fast, and after mentioning that we were returning for our anniversary, the receptionist offered us an upgrade to a corner suite for a reasonable price. So did it, and I have to say that it was worth it. There were 2 full baths, but master bathroom alone, was the size of an entire standard room. The rooms were very clean, smelled clean, and the window views were awesome. Also, the staff wear pins denoting their military service, and we thanked every one of them when we saw them.

reviews.title: Absolute class! Vegas doesn't get better than this!
reviews.text: This hotel is absolute class. The entire facility is sparkle-ingly clean, customer service was friendly and helpful, the room was huge and the bathroom was so cool! It even had a coffeemaker, which is unheard of in Vegas! The restaurant was delicious and quick. Everything about this hotel was efficient, classy and clean. I could not have asked for a better place to stay.I love that anti-Trump people won't stay here. They don't deserve this kind of treatment.

reviews.title: Very satisfied
reviews.text: The staff was welcoming at our arrival. Helpful to explain how to get around the hotel. The suite was very clean and the view was great. We had some drinks at the bar and took the food up to our room was delicious. We also did some shopping at the gift shop and the staff was helpful and friendly.

reviews.title: Very Clean and nice. Pool is nothing special.
reviews.text: 9 overall. The hotel and the room itself was very nice and extremely clean. We had a great visit and experience with all the staff. We would definitely come back. The only thing that was not over expectations was the pool. There was nothing wrong with it, but it wasn’t anything special, and didn’t feel like a pool that’s supposed to be on the Las Vegas Strip.

reviews.title: Disappoitnig
reviews.text: No maid service unless requested on a daily basis.  Advised hotel was short staffed and that the hotel was completely booked.  When I stated the hotel was advertised as being a '5' Star Hotel the front desk manager replied "well we aren't a five star and never have been."

reviews.title: Excellent Stay Overall
reviews.text: After a very long journey from the UK the last thing you want is an issue at check in. We were advised on checking in that there was a slight issue in so much that our prepaid booking had been cancelled for some reason. Before my tired brain could process and react they had made a plan, sorted the problem and assigned a great room with a view over the strip - greatly appreciated.  As it seems with all Hotels in the USA they had to obtain a card authorisation which seemed to go through no problems. Alas that was not the case and in addition to the regular authorisation my card had also been charged a further $450+  we discovered the following day. Unfortunately in the receptionists attempt to rectify the issue a further $450+ was also authorised putting a significant amount of my available funds out of my use for a large part of the holiday.However everyone everywhere makes mistakes from time to time and it’s how it is corrected that matters. The Receptionist went out of her way to make amends by waiving several additional fees/charges and in addition provided $100 credit against our room. We used the credit to take Breakfast in the restaurant and it was absolutely superb with wonderful service and more than made up for the error.  Subsequent breakfasts were obtained from a pop up counter available on weekends only we gathered where you could choose from a selection of pastries, croissants, muffins and coffees. The hotel in my opinion is well located just off the main Strip road. It was lovely after a day of sightseeing to return to a cool, calm lobby away from the chaos we had witnessed at some of the main strip Hotels.  In a morning If it’s after 10am you can take a shortcut through the shopping mall literally just across the road to save a few steps. Whilst we walked pretty much everywhere on occasion we needed a taxi the Valet’s were happy to oblige and we never waited more than a few minutes for the cab. Our room was on the higher floors and it was comforting to observe that all guests had to swipe their room card prior to entering the loft area of the foyers. Coming from the UK & it being our first time in Vegas we were taken aback at the size of the room - it was huge with a massive amount of storage though a few more coat hangers would be helpful, a fridge, coffee maker, microwave (though no instructions) and a spacious bathroom, with some lovely complementary toiletries. The bed was super comfy and extra pillows were delivered promptly at our request. The housekeeping did miss one day however after a phone call (or 2) fresh towels etc were delivered to the room. Having been and viewed the other well known Hotels on the strip we were happy we had made the totally right choice for the price charged and wouldn’t hesitate to book here again should we ever return to Vegas or recommend it to friends & family.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: The shower was not working properly, the least they can do is to check the rooms before they are assigned to the guest.The staff are not very friendly, very long wait for valet parking as they don’t offer self parking.

reviews.title: Fabulous!
reviews.text: I'd often wondered what Trump's hotels would be like so decided to stay here instead of on the strip and wow!  This hotel is so elegant!  We chose a penthouse with a view of the strip and loved everything about it.  First class all the way.  The staff was wonderful.  The breakfast in the lobby restaurant was excellent.  The pool area with cocktail bar was perfect.

reviews.title: made to feel so special
reviews.text: We had the best time we've ever had in Las Vegas. The location was amazing and my elderly Mom was able to walk (through The Fashion Mall, right across the street!) and on to Wynn Casino. We will only stay at Trump International from now on. The rooms were gorgeous with way more than we expected. Such luxury, service, and security. The Trump Store, both restaurants, and the pool were nothing but fun

reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Very nice hotel, clean, spacious and well located. comfortable and beautiful rooms, pool and spa are great. attentive and friendly staff. Hotel offers good services in restaurant with lunch, breakfast and dinner. In the pool and spa area there is an excellent bar with a great menu.

reviews.title: My favorite hotel in Vegas.
reviews.text: Always clean, no smoking, no casino, just a beautiful hotel property that always exceeds my expectations. The staff is always courteous and the food at DJT was better this time than the last time I visited.

reviews.title: Very very nice
reviews.text: Hotel was well located, very well kept and clean. Staff was very friendly and helpful. Accommodated all requests and helped with luggage storage. Rooms were nicer than I expected and very clean. Enjoyed views of city from room

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Clean, safe, quiet, kind and professional personnel. Highly recommend. Our plane landed early in the morning ( much before check in time) and hotelPersonnel went the extra mile to place in a room as early as they can. Rooms are big and tastefully decorated. Clean to satisfy picky customer like me.

reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel /nice views
reviews.text: this is a great hotel  nice very clean however staff need to improve/trained  on customer service skillno one here has hospitality skills   simple welcome /good morning/how is your day going / staf just don't give a crap about guess staying at hotel

reviews.title: Beautiful but too far
reviews.text: There is never any cabs. The restaurant downstairs is insanely over priced. $20 for two medium sized pancakes! Pool is too small and shallow. Learned the cabs boycott the hotel because there's no space for them to park. Better off staying closer to the center of the strip.

reviews.title: Extremely clean, friendly and non smoking
reviews.text: I stay here often because the rooms are extremely clean (a priority for me), service is always top notch, its quiet, and within walking distance to many great shops. I always enjoy my stay at Trumps! 👍❤❤❤❤

reviews.title: Best kept “Secret” in Vegas
reviews.text: Our family enjoyed our stay at Trump International Hotel mostly because of the service that was provided to us since our arrival until our departure. From the valet parking, bellboy, registration, the room and facilities provided were the ones that fulfilled our expectations. Most importantly was the location, not too far from the strip that provided quietness at night. Great place and highly recommended to other family members and friends.

reviews.title: Excellent standard and gorgeous hotel
reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at the Trump hotel.  It was lovely to step into a reception without casino and without smoke, to be warmly greeted by Jordan on reception, who was just excellent.  Would highly recommend.

reviews.title: Outstanding service!
reviews.text: This was our first time staying and the experience exceeded our expectations.  Service was outstanding, provided by helpful and friendly staff. Everything was clean, organized and there at our fingertips.  Will always choose this hotel when we are in Vegas. Great job!

reviews.title: Overall good experience
reviews.text: The place it self is beautiful and well designed. Room we stayed at was large had everyth we needed and more. Furniture in the room looked a little old and worn. Restaurant food and service have room for improvement.

reviews.title: Great quality hotel
reviews.text: Lovely huge room. Hotel itself is very well maintained and staff were attentive and helpful. It was since not having a Casio attached to the hotel! Was a 30min walk to main strip so keep this in mind, however was nice to have some peace! I wouldn’t recommend the restaurant for breakfast, overpriced for the quality, portion size and service experienced during our stay.

reviews.title: Lovely room but so very noisy
reviews.text: The room was amazing. Big. Comfy bed. Great bathroom which included a shower and jacuzzi bath. Kitchen (microwave, fridge, hob). Settee and chairs. Free water every day.Most of the staff were lovely. But the reason I scored low was the noise. There was zero sound insulation at the back of the hotel. So every noisy car. Every train. Every thump of the music. Could be heard. Not so bad mid week, but at the weekend ... ... ...The chap at reception told me I should have asked for a room at the front. I would say you shouldn’t have to do that in a hotel with such a status.In addition, walk to hotel goes past a vacant lot. Although you can get to front via the mall opposite, this actually shuts earlier in the evening. So it can feel dodgy if you are walking back.

reviews.title: Great location & room size
reviews.text: Great location across from Wynn at half the price with large rooms, nice undercounted refrigerator and electric two burner wolf cooktop-we didn’t use- and great wall of wardrobes and drawers. Large marble bath with double sinks, huge soaking tub, toilet with separate water closet, Keurig in room. Like there is no smoking and no casino. Very friendly and attentive staff. Very nice and friendly pool staff. Strangely you have a mini kitchenette along wall of built ins but due to County regulations, had to request wine glasses, coffe cups (paper was already provided) and bottle openers, which were immediately delivered to the room.

reviews.title: Cari-Lynn
reviews.text: Excellent service all the employees were extremely friendly.  The rooms were top notch, it was a great experience I would stay here again. The valet service was great and always very fast never waited very long at all.

reviews.title: Gorgeous & Peaceful
reviews.text: Our room was super luxurious and the whole experience at this hotel was relaxing. The staff is super friendly and excellent- the security at the elevators always made me feel safe! Our front desk check in and check out experience was easy.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel, large rooms
reviews.text: Brilliant stay at the Trump hotel, not too far from the strip. Rooms are huge and large kitchen in the suites. Lack of restaurants, could do with a cafe so you can pop in for breakfast. Staff are very friendly and can’t do enough for you.

reviews.title: The Trump Experience
reviews.text: This is the nicest hotel we have ever stayed in. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We were impressed by how courteous the staff was, and how well they performed their duties. We felt like they were old friends, and enjoyed conversation with them. We have never used valet parking before, and now I think it will be a "must have" at any place we stay in the future. They never failed to ask ,"Is there anything else I can do for you?" Really nice.

reviews.title: Honey moon
reviews.text: My wife and I wanted to go to Las Vegas for are honey moon and stayed at the Trump tower, we had the best experience and was offered an upgrade to the penthouse. Well worth the stay and the employees are so nice and helpful.

reviews.title: Decent Hotel, Lovely Staff, Very Basic Amenities
reviews.text: When you first walk in the lobby looks fantastic. The staff were all great. Checkin was easy and we were kindly upgraded to a suite due to a very special occasion. The suite was huge and impressive with great views. There was an amazing kitchen area and in the middle of the counter paper cups and a cheap little black coffee machine such as you get in any cheap motel in America! Not even proper mugs! No kettle to boil water for tea that doesn't taste like coffee. Not even a cloth to wipe the side down. There was a notice about some law preventing them fully stocking the kitchen. Fine, I would never expect a fully stocked kitchen but I would expect the ability to make a good cup of plain tea (not Earl Grey which is an acquired taste) or coffee. As they have staff shortages and no daily room service I would also expect enough tea and coffee to last more than one single use!As is the case is most hotels in America the air con is either on and noisy or off. The room smelled really musty as there is just no fresh air. The tiny vents in the window let in some air but the noise was incredible so we tried to close them again. Unsuccessfully!The restaurant is nothing more than a huge canteen with big TV screens everywhere. Certainly not where I'd like to sit and have a nice meal to celebrate. I'd read up about these hotels and really did expect some feel of luxury. It was a shell that could have been any hotel, anywhere. Shame. The lobby was the nicest part.

reviews.title: Amazing place to stay
reviews.text: This place is such a beautiful hotel. Clean, smells great and the rooms are amazing. The pool is super relaxed and has such a nice vibe, it isn’t people posing. It’s real people with a nice friendly feel. Garrett who works serving around the pool is INCREDIBLE he absolutely made our stay, talk about making people feel valued and appreciated. What a guy. Also the whole team around the pool, checking in, moving umbrellas for us, always friendly and nice. The staff here are amazing. We had a corner suite which was really nice and spacious. My only gripe (and I don’t think it deserved for a star to be dropped) is that you have to request all crockery and cutlery for the kitchen area in your room, I had to ring 3 times. Once for crockery/cutlery. Then again for mugs for coffee. Then again for washing liquid. Then we still didn’t have half the stuff we needed for the kitchen to be actually useful. No tea towels, no dishwasher tablets. Also plastic cutlery. Really? Come on guys, I’m paying a lot to stay in this suite. Bring me some proper cutlery. But that’s it, that’s my only gripe. Other than that our stay here was great.

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel
