reviews.text: Great staff and amazing rooms…restaurant at hotel was great also. It was nice to get complementary valet parking at Trump international too. A++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

reviews.title: “Mike Lindel”
reviews.text: Mr. President,I know you always like feedback from your constituents and or customers of your facilities. The only suggestion I have is that you get pillow toppers, from My pillow pillow for the beds. The valet service, the rooms, the pool and a hot tub area are incredible. We will be back whenever we visit Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Workout room never had sanitizer to wipe down the equipment during 3 separate workouts I did . Why pay that much of a resort fee if nobody monitors that area! The rooms and hotel along with the pool area are nice location is excellent across the street from the mall!

reviews.title: Mostly Pros, a few cons. Still my favorite Vegas Hotel
reviews.text: Pros: No Casino ( we don’t gamble, so it’s a pro for us) no smoke to walk through. DJT restaurant is amazing!Off strip, so no riff-raff coming in off the street. Directly across from Fashion Show Mall!Still good proximity to stripPool is perfect size Guests are very diverse and respectable and happy to be there. Great for families or couples or singles!Plenty of food offered at all hours. Pool restaurant is nice. Decor is luxurious and very upscale!Gift shop is awesome!Cons: There are 3 marijuana dispensaries next door, so constantly smells like weed when you’re outside for any length of time. Room service was not being offered. No full-length mirror in the penthouse suite!Hostess was rude to my 17 year old daughter when she tried to get seated at DJT for coffee while we waited for our food that I ordered from the bar, to go. First I’ll tell you my husband and I stay at The Trump in Vegas often, at least once a year. This trip he surprised me with an upgrade to the Penthouse Suite for Mother’s Day. The suite is amazing!!! Except for ONE thing. In all the halls and closets there isn’t one single full-length mirror. For a huge Penthouse suite where guests spend thousands of dollars to stay, we can’t even get ONE full length mirror??? I was shocked! Obviously when one travels to a place like Las Vegas, there are events and shows and dinners that people get dressed up for. It would be nice to have a full length mirror to see the whole view. I’ve stayed in plenty of other Penthouse Suites in Vegas and every single one of them have a full length mirror. This is just absurd to me. Other than that we love it here! We feel spoiled and pampered every time we come.

reviews.title: Best hotel in Vegas!
reviews.text: Best hotel in Vegas and best hotel experience I have had: atmosphere,  beauty of the hotel, staff service and dining/bar... all top rated. This hotel is VERY different from the carnival atmosphere of most Vegas hotels. First rate all the way!

reviews.title: Great Stay As Always
reviews.text: We had a great view from the room of the strip. Jacuzzi tub was nice to relax in on our arrival night and did the full spa experience the next morning with steam room, massages, and hair cuts then grabbed a drink at the pool bar. It's super close to the fashion show and Capital Grille for some great steaks.

reviews.title: Trump International is a Must Destination
reviews.text: A 5 star destination with exceptional customer service and beautiful features. Off of the strip, quiet, with great security, and wonderful meals. Personnel were top notch, pleasant, and attentive. Will not disappoint!

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful and very comfortable. Our room was large and very clean, and it had a gorgeous view of both city and mountains. The staff is friendly and helpful, and the location is away from the noise of the strip, yet close enough to walk. We loved our stay!

reviews.title: Beautiful hotel!
reviews.text: Wonderful place to stay!  This hotel has valet parking which was so nice. Big beautiful clean rooms. Short walk to Wynn casino. Ate breakfast at the restaurant and it was delish!!  Best of all, they welcome pets!! I can’t wait to go back!!

reviews.title: Fight trip
reviews.text: I came to Vegas with my brother to watch the Stevenson vs Valdez unification fight. My stay at Trump could not have went any better. Every part of the entire hotel smells phenomenal, the restaurant is top of the line in both service and quality, and the pool is one of the most relaxing I’ve been to.

reviews.title: amazing place to stay
reviews.text: Perfect place to stay in Vegas. No smoking, quiet, amazing rooms and service, still close to everything. My wife and I stayed here for our 20th wedding anniversary and had a fantastic time. We stay at Trump every time we visit Vegas.

reviews.title: 12th Year Anniversary
reviews.text: My husband and I will definitely be coming back to the Las Vegas location sooner than later. We felt so welcome by staff. In particular. Scott and Perry went above and beyond expectations. We had an early morning flight (6am). Scott and Perry arranged for us to be picked up from dropping off our rental car the night before AND gave us a ride in the luxurious Trump vehicle to the airport at 4am. Top notch service. Russell and Amanda Alfaro.

reviews.title: Best Hotel experience
reviews.text: We have stayed at some very "high class"  hotels and Trump Hotels have never disappointed us.Staff are always friendly and helpful. The rooms are always clean. We will always stay at a trump hotel if there is one where we are visiting.

reviews.title: Nice hotel!
reviews.text: A nice hotel which doesn't have a Casino so it is quieter at the night!We had a nice view from the room and it was a high floor also!The room was beautiful and clean and the price was relatively cheap

reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Just perfect the staff could not do enough for us and the cleanliness of the hotel was exemplary. I would definitely recommend staying here if you’re heading to Vegas close enough to the strip but far enough away to be quiet

reviews.title: Our Second Stay at this Wonderful Hotel!
reviews.text: We stayed again at Trump International because of its outstanding service, elegant atmosphere, quiet rooms and NO casino gambling/smoking.  It is an extremely well-run hotel with exceptional staff and beautiful decor.  Uber makes getting from and to the hotel very easy and convenient.  We will definitely stay at Trump International on future Las Vegas trips.  It is wonderful!!

reviews.title: Went for the deal / don’t make same mistake
reviews.text: Pay a little more stay o byte strip in a nice hotel spa closed Tuesday and Wednesday no room service no housekeeping or only every other day no open windows stuffy old food is terrible very depressing left early

reviews.title: Experience of a lifetime!
reviews.text: We wanted to take opportunity to express our sincere thanks during our recent stay at the Trump International Las Vegas. The entire staff were incredible! From every aspect of our vacation, the Trump International Las Vegas exceeded our expectations.Knowing this was our first exposure to Las Vegas as a vacation destination we did quite a bit of research determining which was to be our best option for our vacation stay. And as a wise Grail Knight once said, “We chose wisely!” Thank you Trump International for making our dreams come true, especially for our daughter, who had the occasion to celebrate because this was her Make-a-Wish wish and her opportunity to see her favorite singing group, BTS.Thank you for being a part of this magical experience.

reviews.title: Great place to stay for working Conventions
reviews.text: We just spent a week working a convention in LV, and this was our first stay at the Trump. It was great to have the kitchenette, and the restaurant had great food and was available - something we'd had trouble with in the large casino hotels. It was quiet and smoke free, and the staff was friendly. The room was clean and well appointed. Bed was very comfortable, shower easy to use, we found it very relaxing. They could do a better job with Valet in the morning, however we took a cab or ride share to the convention center most days so that didn't matter much. Overall it was a great place to unwind after a long day.

reviews.title: Most relaxing stay in Vegas
reviews.text: The Trump is in the ideal location. The hotel is close enough to the heart of Vegas, but also far enough away where you can still relax. The staff is very friendly, helpful, and professional. The hotel is clean and has a great restaurant, spa, and pool. I highly recommend.

reviews.title: Very Pleasant Stay
reviews.text: We really enjoyed staying at this hotel. It exceeded our expectations, loved that even I was greeted on the TV welcome screen, very special detail. The bathroom awesome, we used the hot tub after a nice workout at the very well equipped fitness center. Even tho we didn't use the kitchen we were glad it had a mini fridge to cool our drinks.The beds were great, very comfortable.Everything felt so luxurious. We just loved it!.

reviews.title: Decor is a little tired but still good quality and value
reviews.text: We stayed here in April 2022 for my wife's birthday trip to Vegas. We had booked here for the first and second nights and then again for another night later in our Vegas stay. Check in was going ok until they couldnt find any reference to our Agoda booking. An hour slipped by while they checked confirmation codes etc but couldnt find anything. They said it was Agoda's fault - and it probably was! They gave us a room anyway to avoid further inconvenience. The room was a good size - they put us on a high fllor and the views were fantastic - right up The Strip to Mandalay Bay. The furniture in the room is starting to show its age but everything worked and we appreciated the extra space. We turned the seats around to face the window and that's where we enjoyed quite a few hours. After we departed (for another resort) we were surprised to find a $500 plus charge agaiants our credit card. This was because they couldnt find the booking through Agoda and charged us the top rack rate!! without telling us!! Anyway I went back to the hotel and Jazmin helped immediately and efficiently and mpt only found the room booking and payment but credited the money back to the credit card. We enjoyed the hotel as the staff were friendly and the bed very comfortable. It is out of the way and was a fair walk to the centre of The Strip but the payoff was it was quiet with no casino and hardly any passing foot traffic. The shopping centre opposite has a great ABC convenience store and a food court so we had everything we needed close by. One thing we heard at night was the train using its horn - not sure why but that isnt the fault of the hotel.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel,  let down by disorganised valet service
reviews.text: Room great.  The best view on the street.  Great location. Pool is a good size with plenty of sun loungers.  Staff are attentive and welcoming. Really clean hotel. Room was not serviced during our stay despite reception telling us it would be,  which was fine but we had to ask for coffees, towels etc each day. What let this down massively for us was the compulsary valet parking.  Despite ordering our car before we came down,  our car wasn't brought out until about 20 to 40 minutes each time after we actually presented ourselves at the valet desk.  Cars were literally dumped at the entrance,  there lacked organisation in this area.  Taxis dropping off couldn't just drive through as there were 4 lanes of cars either dropped off for parking,  or delivered for the guests.  It was fairly chaotic and based on this alone we'd not stay at the Trump international Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Surprisingly Wonderful, But...
reviews.text: First the positives:  this hotel is in a great location for freeway access to outlying sights (Red Rock Canyon and Valley of Fire).  Our room on the 47th floor was very quiet, clean, and comfortable.  The room itself was spacious with a mini fridge, stove top, and microwave for the nights we decided to take it easy in our room.  The bathroom was also quite spacious with a jetted, large tub and a large shower, separate toilet and two sinks.  We felt like we were at home.  Housekeeping cleaned every-other day and did a great job, unlike our experiences at many other hotels.  Our room was super quiet at night.The negatives:   Upon check-in we were skipped over after requesting help with our bags up to our room.  Valet parking (the only option) was super slow.  Every day, and at different times of the day, it would take AT LEAST 10 minutes for our car to be brought to the driveway.  There were two to three valet employees for this extremely busy hotel.  We were taken aback at the treatment of the employees used to check room keys at the elevators.  These people were required to stand 8 hours per shift; there were no stools offered for these people to sit at their station.  We found this cruel and attributed this, as well as the shortage of valet employees, to greed.  Many hotels are trying to "recoup" their losses from the pandemic.  This greed is taken out on the customers.  Someone standing in one spot for 8 hours at the elevators does not hurt a customer, but it does reflect on the management and owner and the priorities thereof.  Not impressive.The next time we are on vacation in Las Vegas we will not choose this particular hotel strictly because of the two negatives described above.

reviews.title: Best hotel ever
reviews.text: I stayed here before and it is the most clean non-smoking friendly service and the best location and all valet parking which makes it easier to pick up your car the best hotel ever in Las Vegas beautiful

reviews.title: Love our stay at Trump Hotel
reviews.text: We pass thru Vegas twice a year and look forward to our stay at Trump.  We prefer a spot completely non smoking. No casino is a bonus for us too.    Rooms are great.  Beds super comfortable.  Bathroom spacious.   Hotel design is really nice w/o being ostentatious.    Great deal overall.   Restaurant, while good enough, could be better.   Good location too especially if driving.   Easy on/off highway

reviews.title: Tried this hotel a second time and found it to be even worse.
reviews.text: Could not muster room service, even at an early hour of the day. Second night there the room was left with no clean towels. Very noisy much  to our surprise. The roomhad a really poor view of anything but the back side of another hotel. I guess that's just Las Vegas. Would not stay here gain.

reviews.title: Vegas Baby
reviews.text: Hotel was nice, breakfast was good, room was nice and large.  The bed & pillows were so comfortable, slept great.Problems - no room service, bar closes at 10 pm and the pool was closed due to high winds yet all other hotel pools were open.  Front Desk manager never returned my phone call.

reviews.title: Las Vegas Home-away from Home
reviews.text: We can’t ask for more, we discovered and decided that Trump International Hotel Las Vegas has everything we need which we can call it as our home-away from home during our first visit in May 2021. We stayed from April 15-22 and had a wonderful time. Gym, pool, shopping, walk to strip & etc, this hotel served us well. Hotel staffs were amazing, we will be back soon for sure…Special thanks to the housekeeping team especially to Ivelice Martinez and Albert Ramirez for their amazing service, DJT restaurant staffs were always great especially to Tim…

reviews.title: Great Hotel...you should stay here.
reviews.text: Overall, the experience at this hotel was top notch. There were only two minor issues. The rooms were not fully clean. We had a window next to the tub with a ledge. My wife noticed that it was full of dust that looked like it had been there a while. And, the windows were dirty, including cute hand prints from a very small previous guest. Then there was some small trash that went untended in the hallway for a few days. We did appreciate the friendly security ensuring no one had access to elevators who didn't belong there. Note that while we had a kitchen in our suite, there were no plates, pans, salt, pepper or utensils available to make use of it. We had a full sized fridge too. Apparently, guests can pre-order groceries and kitchenware. We were unaware of that until it no longer made sense for us to get it. The bed was comfortable. We had a jet tub in our room which was a nice feature. Shower was very roomy with the fastest time to hot water that I've experienced in a while.

reviews.title: Real five star hotel
reviews.text: This is a great real 5 star hotel. Large room, huge bathroom with shower and jacuzzi, big closet. We stayed previously on the Strip but at Trump you have a feel of real 5 star hotel with the service (and also guests) you expect to be there. So if you don’t want to stay at casino hotel then Trump is great option. Distance to Strip is very short and if you want shopping there is a big mall just opposite (much better than North Outlet). Valet parking (for free) is also a plus. Only you can hear a bit the noise from the street, which was bit surprising
